    00为什么需要控制Why control at all?

    先说结论TL;DR

    八类方法不是一条从“经典”走到“智能”的演进链，而是一个工具箱：按问题的性质挑选，按快慢一层套一层地组合。一台机器人里的控制器本来就是一层套一层的（本节后面有图）：越靠上的层越慢、离任务越近，也越灵活；越靠下的层越快、离电机越近，越需要能证明的保证。

    The eight families are not a ladder from “classical” to “intelligent”. They are a toolbox: you pick among them by the nature of the problem and stack them by speed. A robot’s controllers already come in layers, one inside another (there is a figure later in this section): the higher a layer, the slower it runs, the closer it sits to the task and the more flexible it can be; the lower a layer, the faster it runs, the closer it sits to the motor, and the more it needs guarantees you can prove.

    1. 反馈只需要误差就能工作，积分还能消掉恒定负载；但随运动变化的重力、惯性力只能靠加大增益去扛，而增益被延迟、噪声和饱和封了顶。
    2. 能算出来的力就先算出来：模型补偿抵消已知动力学，反馈只处理残差；模型差多少，残差就留多少。
    3. 鲁棒控制用一个固定的控制器，覆盖参数在已知范围内变化的一整族对象；自适应控制在线估计几个未知参数。两者的保证都只在各自的假设之内成立。
    4. 一旦接触环境或人，目标不再是“跟住位置”，而是规定“被推时怎么让”：让机器人表现得像一根指定软硬的弹簧加一个阻尼器（这叫阻抗或导纳控制）。难点变成：和一个不知道软硬的对象连在一起以后，还稳不稳；能做到多软、多硬，由执行器、采样和延迟决定。
    5. MPC（模型预测控制）用模型向前看、守住约束；ILC（迭代学习控制）用上一次的整段误差向后看，学掉每次都重复出现的误差。
    6. 机器学习以物理模型打底、只补写不出公式的残差；强化学习把模型搬进仿真器、按奖励找策略，策略的输出仍交给底层的 PD（比例—微分）控制、电流环或压力环执行。模型没有被数据取代，保证也没有离开底层。
    1. Feedback works from the error alone, and integral action even removes a constant load. But known forces that change with the motion, such as gravity and inertia, can only be fought with more gain, and delay, noise and saturation cap the gain.
    2. Compute what you can: model compensation cancels the known dynamics and leaves feedback only the residual, which is exactly as large as the model error.
    3. Robust control covers a whole family of plants — the same system with its parameters anywhere in a known range — with one fixed controller; adaptive control estimates a few unknown parameters online. Each guarantee holds only inside its own assumptions.
    4. Once the robot touches the world or a person, the goal is no longer to hold a position but to decide how it gives way when pushed: to behave like a spring and a damper of chosen stiffness (impedance or admittance control). The hard part becomes staying stable when coupled to something whose stiffness you don’t know, and how soft or stiff you can go is set by the actuator, the sampling and the delay.
    5. MPC (model predictive control) looks ahead with a model to respect constraints; ILC (iterative learning control) looks back at the whole error of the last run to remove error that repeats every time.
    6. Learning methods build on physics and fit only the residual that has no formula; RL moves the model into the simulator and searches for a policy by reward, and the policy’s output is still executed by low-level PD (proportional–derivative), current or pressure loops. Data doesn’t replace the model, and the guarantees never leave the bottom layer.

    先玩一下再往下读。下面的小车由电机推着，电机只看“离目标多远”（P）和“跑得多快”（D）来出力。把小车拖开再松手（或者点“拉开 0.3 m 再松手”）：选“只有 P（弹簧）”，它像挂在一根弹簧上来回晃；换成“PD（弹簧＋阻尼器）”，就像多装了一个阻尼器。先猜：去掉 D，小车还停得下来吗？Play before you read. The cart below is pushed by a motor that sets its force from only two things: how far the cart is from the target (P) and how fast it is moving (D). Drag it away and let go (or press “Pull 0.3 m and let go”). Pick “P only (spring)” and it bounces as if hung on a spring; switch to “PD (spring + damper)” and it acts as if a damper were attached. Guess first: without D, will the cart ever stop?

    你应该看到：选“只有 P”时，只有一点滚动阻尼在耗能，左上角的能量条降得很慢，状态栏写着“还在晃”；换回 PD（默认 Kd = 4），超调约 33%，晃一两下、约 1.8 s 就停稳。勾上“挂上重物”，PD 停在离目标 0.050 m 处，正好是 2 N ÷ 40 N/m，因为弹簧得一直被拉长才顶得住重物（只有 P 时，小车绕着这一点来回晃）；切到 PID，积分会慢慢把小车拉回目标，5 s 时只差约 0.003 m。后面每次说“虚拟弹簧”，指的就是这里的 P 和 D。What you should see: with “P only”, just a little rolling damping burns energy — the energy bar at top left drains slowly, and the status reads “still swinging”. Back on PD (default Kd = 4), the overshoot is about 33% and the cart settles after a swing or two, in about 1.8 s. Tick “Hang a weight” and PD settles 0.050 m from the target — exactly 2 N ÷ 40 N/m — because the spring has to stay stretched to hold the weight (with P only, the cart swings back and forth around that same point). Switch to PID and the integral slowly pulls the cart back to the target; at 5 s it is only about 0.003 m off. Whenever this article says “virtual spring”, it means the P and D you see here.

    阅读说明：怎么读、顺序、颜色、单位How to read this: depth, order, colors, units
    • 分两层读。主线写给机器人方向的本科生；“深入一层”“工程实例”“延伸阅读”都是可选的，跳过不影响后文。
    • 最短路径。每节只读开头的问题、实验和结尾的“一句话”，全文大约 25 分钟。
    • 第一次读可以先跳过的。“外骨骼视角”小段，以及实验下面“你应该看到”里的一长串读数：先看现象，想核对数字时再回来。
    • 顺序是讲解顺序。每一节回答上一节卡住的地方。它不是历史顺序——LQR（1960）、滑模控制（1950–60 年代的研究）、动态矩阵控制（1980）、actor-critic 强化学习（1983）、阻抗控制（1985）在时间上大量交叉——也不是先进程度的排名：一台真实的机器人里，这些方法在不同层级上同时运行。
    • 每个实验都有一个实物场景。小车、手臂、关节、外骨骼，不少可以直接拖、推、踢；动画都由仿真驱动。所有仿真参数都是示意值：量级尽量贴近真实关节和外骨骼，但不对应任何具体产品，数字只用来看趋势。
    • 三种颜色 = 三类问题。蓝：用已知的物理（01、02）；橙：面对未知与接触（03、04、05）；青绿：用预测与数据（06、07、08）。图里的深灰实线是对照，浅灰虚线是目标或参考。
    • 单位与符号。角频率用 rad/s，采样和运行频率用 Hz（1 Hz ≈ 6.28 rad/s）。符号在各节内定义；和前文重名的，在该节开头的“本节符号”里说明。
    • 每节的结构。一个问题 → 从最基本的物理推出方法为什么长这样（先写理想模型，再逐项加上真实世界的偏差）→ “反过来想”：不这样做会怎样、边界在哪、卡在哪里 → 实验：先猜，再动手把它推到边界 → 一句话结论，引出下一个问题。
    • Two layers. The main text is written for robotics undergraduates. The “Going deeper”, “From the field” and “Further reading” blocks are optional; skip them and nothing later breaks.
    • The short route. In each section, read only the opening question, the experiment and the closing takeaway — about 25 minutes for the whole article.
    • Safe to skip on a first pass: the “Exoskeleton lens” notes and the long strings of readings under “What you should see”. Watch the behavior first; come back for the numbers when you want to check them.
    • The order is for explanation. Each section answers where the previous one gets stuck. It is not history — LQR (1960), sliding-mode research (1950s–60s), dynamic matrix control (1980), actor-critic RL (1983) and impedance control (1985) overlap heavily — and it is not a ranking: in a real robot these methods run at the same time, at different layers.
    • Every experiment has a physical scene — a cart, an arm, a joint, an exoskeleton — and many let you drag, push or kick things directly. Every animation is driven by the simulation. All simulation parameters are illustrative: magnitudes are chosen to resemble real joints and exoskeletons, but they describe no specific product; read the numbers for trends.
    • Three colors, three kinds of problem. Blue: use the physics you know (01–02). Orange: cope with uncertainty and contact (03–05). Teal: use prediction and data (06–08). In the charts, dark gray solid lines are baselines and light gray dashed lines are targets or references.
    • Units and symbols. Angular frequency is in rad/s; sampling and loop rates are in Hz (1 Hz ≈ 6.28 rad/s). Symbols are defined within each section; where a section reuses a letter from earlier, its “Symbols in this section” note says so.
    • How each section works. A question → the method derived from basic physics (ideal model first, then real-world deviations one at a time) → “flip it around”: what breaks, where the limits are, where it gets stuck → an experiment: predict first, then push the method to those limits → a one-line takeaway that raises the next question.
    • 蓝 · 用已知的物理（01–02）Blue · use the physics you know (01–02)
    • 橙 · 面对未知与接触（03–05）Orange · cope with uncertainty and contact (03–05)
    • 青绿 · 用预测与数据（06–08）Teal · use prediction and data (06–08)

    全文的问题链The chain of questions

    1. 只靠反馈（01）：连已知的力也得等它变成误差，再靠大增益去扛
    2. 把已知的力算出来（02）
    3. 可模型总有误差 → 用固定控制器覆盖误差（鲁棒，03），或在线把参数估出来（自适应，04）
    4. 可一接触环境，“跟住位置”本身就不对了 → 改为规定力与运动的关系（交互控制，05）
    5. 可只看此刻的反馈看不见约束、记不住重复 → 用模型向前看、用上一次向后看（MPC 与 ILC，06）
    6. 可有些残差写不出公式 → 物理打底、数据补残差（机器学习，07）
    7. 可有些目标连控制律都写不出 → 只给奖励，在仿真里试出策略（强化学习，08）
    8. 而策略的输出，仍交给底层有保证的控制器执行（回看）
    1. Feedback alone (01) has to wait for even the known forces to become error, then fight them with high gain
    2. so compute the known forces instead (02)
    3. but the model is never exact → cover the error with a fixed controller (robust, 03) or estimate the parameters online (adaptive, 04)
    4. but once you touch something, holding a position is the wrong goal → prescribe the force–motion relation instead (interaction control, 05)
    5. but feedback that only reacts to the present can’t see constraints coming or remember repeated errors → look ahead with a model and back at the last trial (MPC and ILC, 06)
    6. but some residuals have no formula → build on physics and let data fill the gap (machine learning, 07)
    7. but some goals can’t even be written as a control law → specify a reward and search for a policy in simulation (RL, 08)
    8. whose output is still executed by the low-level loops that carry the guarantees (looking back)

    问题The question

    关节里明明装着电机。想让它转到 30°，直接算出需要多大力矩再发出去不就行了吗？为什么还需要“控制算法”？

    The joint already has a motor. If you want it at 30°, why not compute the torque you need and send it? Why do we need a control algorithm at all?

    本节要点（5 分钟版）This section in brief

    • 开环就是把牛顿第二定律倒过来，算出力矩照着发。力矩只要恒定地算差一点，位置误差就会越漂越远（只有惯量时按 t² 增长）；有人推一下，它也不知道。
    • 反馈不求算准，只求方向对：测出误差就往回拉，不需要知道扰动多大。代价是得先有误差，能纠正的变化也有快慢上限（带宽）；回路里有延迟 td 时，想留足相位裕度，穿越频率通常只能做到 (0.2–0.4)/td。
    • 前馈和反馈是分工，不是二选一：已知的交给前馈，剩下的交给反馈，稳不稳只看反馈回路。反馈管不了传感器自己的误差。
    • 真实机器人是回路套回路：内环快、外环慢，外环带宽约为内环的 1/5–1/10。问一个方法“有没有模型”太粗，要拆成三问：运行时用不用、设计时用不用、怎样对待模型误差。
    • Open loop runs Newton’s second law backwards and sends the torque it computes. Get that torque wrong by a constant and the position error keeps drifting (like t² when inertia is all there is); if someone pushes the joint, it never finds out.
    • Feedback needs the right direction, not the right size: measure the error and pull back, without knowing how big the disturbance is. The price is that an error has to appear first, and there is a limit to how fast a change it can correct (the bandwidth); with a delay td in the loop and a healthy phase margin, the crossover frequency usually tops out at (0.2–0.4)/td.
    • Feedforward and feedback divide the work rather than compete: what you know goes to feedforward, the rest to feedback, and stability depends on the feedback loop alone. Feedback cannot correct the sensor’s own errors.
    • Real robots nest loops: fast inside, slow outside, with each outer loop’s bandwidth about 1/5–1/10 of the one inside it. “Does this method use a model?” is too coarse; ask three questions instead: is there a model in the control law at run time, is one needed for design or tuning, and how are model errors handled?

    第一次读可以跳过：ANYmal 实例、外骨骼视角、各处“深入一层”、实验说明里的一长串数字。

    Safe to skip on a first read: the ANYmal example, the exoskeleton lens, the “Going deeper” boxes, and the long strings of numbers in the experiment notes.

    先试开环：把牛顿第二定律倒过来算Try open loop first: run Newton’s second law backwards

    转动关节服从牛顿第二定律：惯量乘角加速度等于合力矩。最直接的办法是把方程倒过来：按目标轨迹 qd(t) 算出每一时刻的力矩，照着发出去，不看关节实际转到了哪里。这就是开环（只按事先算好的指令执行，不看结果）。它行不行，取决于方程里每一项算得准不准。下面从理想情形开始，逐项把真实世界加回来。

    A revolute joint obeys Newton’s second law: inertia times angular acceleration equals the net torque. The most direct plan is to run that equation backwards — compute the torque the target trajectory qd(t) needs at every instant, send it, and never check where the joint actually went. That is open loop (acting on a precomputed command without looking at the result). Whether it works depends on how well you know every term in the equation. Start from the ideal case and add the real world back one term at a time.

    1. 理想模型Ideal model

      Jq¨=τ⇒τ(t)=Jq¨d(t)

      只有惯量时，力矩和加速度一一对应：把目标轨迹求两次导，再乘上惯量，就是要发的力矩。

      With inertia alone, torque and acceleration map one to one: differentiate the target trajectory twice, multiply by the inertia, and you have the torque to send.

    2. ＋ 阻尼、重力、摩擦和外力+ Damping, gravity, friction and outside forces

      Jq¨=τ−bq˙−τg(q)−τf(q˙)+τext

      每多一项，开环就得事先多知道一件事：阻尼系数、重心位置、摩擦曲线。这整套方程就是关节的模型（描述“输入怎样变成输出”的方程）。最后一项是扰动（不受控制器支配、却会推动系统的外来输入），比如有人推了一下，事先算好的指令不可能知道。

      Each new term is one more thing open loop must know in advance: the damping, the center of mass, the friction curve. Together these equations are the joint’s model (the equations that say how inputs turn into outputs). The last term is a disturbance (an outside input that pushes the system but isn’t commanded by the controller) — someone bumping the arm, which no precomputed command can anticipate.

    3. ＋ 模型误差+ Model error

      Jδq¨=δτ⇒δq(t)=δτt22J

      假设力矩恒定地算差了 δτ。在理想模型里，它先变成加速度，再被积分两次变成位置误差。示意：J = 0.5 kg·m²、δτ = 0.1 N·m，2 s 后偏出 0.4 rad（约 23°），还在继续漂。有阻尼时漂移变成匀速，但不会停：开环没有“回到目标”的机制。

      Suppose the torque is off by a constant δτ. In the ideal model that error becomes an acceleration and is integrated twice into a position error. For illustration: with J = 0.5 kg·m² and δτ = 0.1 N·m, the joint is 0.4 rad (about 23°) off after 2 s and still drifting. Damping slows the drift to a steady rate but never stops it: open loop has no way back to the target.

    反馈：不求算准，只求方向对Feedback: get the direction right, not the size

    换个思路：边做边看。反馈就是每个周期测出角度、和目标相减、按差值出力：差得多就多推，推过头就往回拉。它不需要知道 δτ，也不需要预知谁会推它；只要修正的方向对，误差就会被拉回来。

    代价有两个。第一，必须等误差出现才动作。第二，能纠正多快的变化有上限，这个上限叫带宽（闭环还跟得上的最快变化频率，常用 rad/s 表示）。

    回路里的纯延迟会压低这个上限。延迟不改变信号的大小，只让它晚到 td 秒；对频率为 ω 的变化，晚到 td 秒就是相位落后 ω·td 弧度。反馈靠“往回拉”，落后太多，拉的方向就错了。这和推秋千一个道理：想让秋千停下，要在它荡过来时迎着推；反应总慢半拍的话，推到时它已经往回荡了，你反而在帮它越荡越高。

    定量地说，先算回路自己已经落后了多少。关节的惯量要把力矩积分两次才变成角度，这一步就落后 180°；D 项按速度出力，能抢回一部分（本页的“惯量＋PD”约 65°）。所以在穿越频率（回路增益降到 1 的频率，和带宽同一量级）处，回路一上来就落后约 115°，离 180° 只剩约 65°，也就是约 1 rad。这段余量叫相位裕度（总滞后离 180° 还差多少）。总滞后一旦到 180°，修正的方向就正好反了：负反馈变成正反馈，回路自己振起来。

    延迟在频率 ω 上再吃掉 ω·td 弧度。穿越频率到 1/td 时，它正好吃掉 1 rad（57°），余量几乎用光（下图）。所以穿越频率接近 1/td，回路就到了失稳边缘；想留出 45° 左右的相位裕度，穿越频率通常只能做到 (0.2–0.4)/td。延迟 10 ms 时，就是 20–40 rad/s，约 3–6 Hz。

    Try a different plan: watch and correct as you go. Feedback reads the angle every cycle, subtracts it from the target and pushes according to the difference: harder when it’s far off, back the other way when it overshoots. It doesn’t need to know δτ or who will push the arm. As long as the correction points the right way, the error gets pulled back.

    There are two costs. First, nothing happens until an error appears. Second, there is a ceiling on how fast a change it can correct, called the bandwidth (the fastest change the closed loop can still follow, usually given in rad/s).

    Pure delay lowers that ceiling. A delay doesn’t change a signal’s size; it only makes it arrive td seconds late, which for a change at frequency ω is a phase lag of ω·td radians. Feedback works by pulling back, and with too much lag it pulls the wrong way. Think of pushing a swing: to stop it, you push against it as it comes toward you. React half a beat late and it is already swinging away when your push lands — you end up pumping it higher.

    In numbers, start with how far behind the loop already is. The joint’s inertia integrates torque twice before it becomes an angle, and that alone costs 180° of phase; the D term, acting on velocity, wins some of it back (about 65° for this page’s inertia-plus-PD loop). So at the crossover frequency (where the loop gain falls to 1, the same order as the bandwidth) the loop already lags by about 115°, leaving about 65° — roughly 1 rad — before it reaches 180°. That leftover is the phase margin (how far the total lag is from 180°). Once the total lag reaches 180°, the correction points exactly the wrong way: negative feedback turns into positive feedback, and the loop starts oscillating on its own.

    Delay adds a lag of ω·td radians at frequency ω. With the crossover at 1/td, it eats exactly 1 rad (57°), and the margin is nearly gone (figure below). That is why a crossover near 1/td puts the loop at the edge of instability, and why keeping about 45° of margin usually limits the crossover to (0.2–0.4)/td — 20–40 rad/s, or roughly 3–6 Hz, for a 10 ms delay.

    深入一层Going deeper 延迟为什么会给反馈封顶？1/td 从哪来，实际能用到多少？Why does delay cap feedback — where does 1/td come from, and how much of it can you actually use?

    前置知识 频率响应里的“相位”，也就是自动控制原理里 Bode 图的入门。只想要结论，读“思路”和“自己验证”就够。

    思路 纯延迟 e−std 不改变任何频率成分的大小，只让频率为 ω 的成分落后 ω·td 弧度。回路稳不稳，看穿越频率 ωc 处还剩多少相位，也就是相位裕度。延迟在那里吃掉的 ωc·td 直接从裕度里扣，扣光就振荡发散。

    推导 以下面实验里的“惯量＋PD”为例（ζ = 0.7）：

    L(s)=2ζωns+ωn2s2e−stdωc≈1.54ωnPM≈1.14−ωctd(rad)

    1.14 rad 就是 65°。ωc·td ≈ 1.14 时失稳，即 td ≈ 1.1/ωc；想留 45°（0.79 rad），就要 ωc·td ≤ 0.35。所以 1/td 是失稳边界的量级，能用的设计值只有它的三分之一左右。带积分的回路起步裕度更少（常见 45–60°），能用的更少。

    工程上 td 是整条回路的延迟预算，不只是通信：零阶保持约半个采样周期，再加上计算、总线传输、传感器滤波（截止频率 ωf 的一阶低通，在远低于 ωf 处约等于 1/ωf 的延迟），以及执行器内环（带宽 ωi 的内环约等于 1/ωi）。先把这几项加起来，再决定 ωc 能放多高。

    自己验证

    在下面的实验里把反馈自然频率 ωn 调到 40 rad/s（ωc ≈ 62 rad/s），上式给出的失稳边界约 18 ms：延迟 10 ms 和 15 ms 都还稳定，分别剩约 30° 和 12° 的裕度；20 ms 越过边界，两条带反馈的曲线在约 2.3 s 发散。再把 ωn 调回 6 rad/s（ωc ≈ 9.3 rad/s）：穿越频率低了约 6.7 倍，上式给出的边界也长了约 6.7 倍，约 123 ms。实验里的关节还带一点黏性阻尼（b/J = 1 s⁻¹），在这么低的穿越频率上多给了约 6° 相位，所以实际边界在约 135 ms：130 ms 时到 4 s 还在晃，但一次比一次小（状态栏写着“还在振荡，但在衰减”），“停稳后的误差”一行仍是 0；140 ms 时越晃越大，状态栏变成“振荡不衰减”，这一行变成“—”；150 ms 时“仅反馈”那条在约 3.1 s 发散。

    Background. Phase in a frequency response — introductory Bode plots. For the conclusion alone, “Idea” and “Check it yourself” are enough.

    Idea. A pure delay e−std leaves the size of every frequency component alone; it only makes the component at ω lag by ω·td radians. Whether the loop is stable depends on how much phase is left at the crossover frequency ωc — the phase margin. The lag ωc·td comes straight out of that margin; once the margin is used up, the loop oscillates and diverges.

    Derivation. Take the inertia-plus-PD loop from the experiment below, with ζ = 0.7:

    L(s)=2ζωns+ωn2s2e−stdωc≈1.54ωnPM≈1.14−ωctd(rad)

    1.14 rad is 65°. The loop goes unstable at ωc·td ≈ 1.14, i.e. td ≈ 1.1/ωc; keeping 45° (0.79 rad) requires ωc·td ≤ 0.35. So 1/td marks the edge of instability, and the usable design value is roughly a third of it. Loops with integral action start with less margin (typically 45–60°) and get even less.

    In practice. td is the delay budget of the whole loop, not just communication: about half a sample period for the zero-order hold, plus computation, bus transfer, sensor filtering (a first-order low-pass at ωf acts like a delay of about 1/ωf well below ωf), and the actuator’s inner loop (an inner loop of bandwidth ωi acts like about 1/ωi). Add the items up before deciding how high ωc can go.

    Check it yourself

    In the experiment below, set the feedback natural frequency ωn to 40 rad/s (ωc ≈ 62 rad/s); the formula puts the stability edge near 18 ms. At 10 ms and 15 ms the loop is still stable, with about 30° and 12° of margin left; at 20 ms it is past the edge, and both feedback curves diverge at about 2.3 s. Now bring ωn back to 6 rad/s (ωc ≈ 9.3 rad/s): the crossover is about 6.7× lower, so the formula’s edge moves about 6.7× further out, to roughly 123 ms. The experiment’s joint also has a little viscous damping (b/J = 1 s⁻¹), which at such a low crossover adds about 6° of phase, so the actual edge sits near 135 ms. At 130 ms the joint is still swinging at 4 s, but each swing is smaller than the last (the status reads “Still oscillating, but decaying”), and the “Error once at rest” row still shows 0; at 140 ms the swings grow, the status changes to “Oscillation not dying out”, and that row turns to “—”; at 150 ms the feedback-only curve diverges at about 3.1 s.

    靠反馈让输出（位置、速度或力）跟着指令走的系统，叫伺服；关键在“反馈跟随”，精度只是对伺服的性能要求。开环步进电机定位可以很准，却不是伺服；跟得很慢的位置闭环，仍然是伺服。

    反馈要看的那组量叫状态：给系统拍一张快照，要记下的最少的数。知道此刻的角度和角速度，再知道之后的力矩，就能算出之后的全部运动，所以刚体关节的状态是 (q, q̇)；加速度由状态和力矩算得出来，不必另记。执行器有自己的动态时，电机电流、弹簧变形、气腔压力这类“还没来得及变成运动”的量也要记下，因为下一刻的力由它们决定。

    A system that uses feedback to make an output (position, velocity or force) follow a command is a servo; the defining feature is the feedback, and precision is only a requirement you place on it. An open-loop stepper can position very accurately and still isn’t a servo, while a sluggish position loop still is.

    What feedback looks at is the state: the fewest numbers you must write down to take a snapshot of the system. Know the angle and angular velocity now, plus the torque from here on, and you can compute all of the motion that follows — so a rigid joint’s state is (q, q̇). Acceleration follows from the state and the torque, so it needn’t be recorded. When the actuator has dynamics of its own, quantities that haven’t turned into motion yet — motor current, spring deflection, chamber pressure — belong in the state too, because they set the force at the next instant.

    前馈与反馈：分工，而不是二选一Feedforward and feedback: divide the work

    开环的思路并没有被淘汰，它叫前馈（不等误差出现，按模型提前给出控制量）。前馈 F 和反馈 C 一起用，就是工程上最常见的二自由度结构（下图）：前馈按模型提前出力，反馈收拾剩下的误差。

    The open-loop idea doesn’t go away; it is called feedforward (acting ahead of the error, from a model). A feedforward F and a feedback C together make the most common structure in practice, the two-degree-of-freedom loop (figure below): the feedforward pushes ahead of time from the model, and the feedback cleans up whatever error is left.

    U=FR+C(R−Y),Y=GUE=R−Y=S(1−GF)RS=11+GC

    前馈管 (1 − GF)，反馈管 S；闭环稳定只由 1 + GC 决定。（大写字母表示信号的拉普拉斯变换，可以理解为把信号按频率拆开来看。）

    Feedforward shapes (1 − GF); feedback shapes S; stability depends only on 1 + GC. (Capitals denote Laplace transforms — think of each signal taken apart by frequency.)

    S 叫灵敏度函数，它按频率回答一个问题：有反馈时剩下的误差，是没有反馈时的几成。低频时它接近 0（压得住），高频时接近 1（管不了）。原因就在分母 1 + GC 里。变化很慢的误差，回路增益 GC 很大：关节把力积分两次才变成位移，控制器里若有积分项，它也一直在累加，频率越低，这些积分放大得越多，S 就很小。变化太快时，关节的惯量让它来不及跟着动（同样大的力，频率高一倍，晃动的幅度只剩约四分之一），GC 趋于 0，S 趋于 1，有没有反馈都一样。S 里没有 F。

    反馈对来自对象的扰动和模型误差都起作用（只在带宽以内），但对传感器自己的误差——偏置、标定误差、噪声——无能为力：它跟随的是测量值，传感器错多少，输出就跟着错多少。反馈用得不好，还会让回路失稳。前馈在模型准时能让 (1 − GF) 很小，却管不了模型之外的误差，也不改变闭环稳定性（只要 F 本身稳定）；它的信号同样要穿过电流环、阀这些执行器动态，并非“没有滞后”。于是常见的分工是：已知的动力学——惯量、重力、摩擦——交给前馈，其余交给反馈。

    S is the sensitivity function. Frequency by frequency, it answers one question: of the error you would have without feedback, what fraction is left with it? At low frequencies it is close to 0 (feedback holds the error down); at high frequencies it is close to 1 (feedback can’t help). The reason sits in the denominator 1 + GC. For slow errors the loop gain GC is large: the joint integrates force twice into displacement, any integral in the controller keeps accumulating too, and the lower the frequency, the more those integrations amplify — so S is small. For fast changes the joint’s inertia can’t keep up (the same force at twice the frequency moves it only about a quarter as far), GC tends to 0 and S to 1: the loop behaves as if feedback weren’t there. S contains no F.

    Feedback acts on disturbances and model errors that enter through the plant — within its bandwidth — but can do nothing about the sensor’s own errors, such as bias, calibration error and noise: it follows the measurement, so whatever the sensor gets wrong, the output gets wrong too. Handled carelessly, feedback can also destabilize the loop. With a good model the feedforward makes (1 − GF) small, but it can do nothing about errors outside the model and doesn’t change closed-loop stability (as long as F itself is stable). Its signal also has to pass through actuator dynamics such as the current loop or a valve, so it isn’t lag-free. Hence the usual split: give the known dynamics — inertia, gravity, friction — to the feedforward, and the rest to the feedback.

    真实的机器人：回路套回路Real robots: loops inside loops

    好比开车：你看路况决定要多快（外环，几秒调整一次），脚下随时微调油门，让车速跟上你想要的（内环，快得多）。你决定车速时，默认脚下能立刻兑现。机器人也一样：反馈是一层套一层的（下图），内环快、外环慢，每一层都把里面那层的闭环当成近似理想的执行器——电流环让要求的力矩几乎立刻兑现，关节环就不必管电机的电气动态。

    前提是外环足够慢。经验法则：外环带宽约为内环的 1/5–1/10；做不到时，就得把内环的动态写进外环的模型，否则外环怎么调都调不好。状态估计和安全监控也各自独立成环。

    Think of driving: you read the road and decide how fast to go (the outer loop, adjusted every few seconds), while your foot keeps trimming the throttle so the car holds that speed (the inner loop, much faster). When you pick a speed, you take for granted that your foot will deliver it at once. A robot works the same way: its feedback is a nest of loops (figure below), inner loops fast and outer loops slow, and each layer treats the closed loop inside it as a nearly ideal actuator — the current loop delivers the requested torque almost instantly, so the joint loop can ignore the motor’s electrical dynamics.

    That only holds if the outer loop is slow enough. Rule of thumb: an outer loop’s bandwidth should be about 1/5 to 1/10 of the loop inside it; when you can’t get that separation, the inner loop’s dynamics must go into the outer loop’s model, or no amount of tuning will fix the outer loop. State estimation and safety monitoring also run as loops of their own.

    深入一层Going deeper 串级回路为什么要 5–10 倍的带宽分离？Why do cascaded loops need a 5–10× separation in bandwidth?

    前置知识 一阶系统的相位 −arctan(ω/ωi)。不想推导的话，直接看表格就行。

    思路 设计外环时，我们假装内环的闭环等于 1：要多少给多少，立刻兑现。这个假装的代价，是内环在外环穿越频率 ωo 处的相位滞后。它和延迟一样，直接从外环的相位裕度里扣。

    推导 把内环闭环近似成带宽 ωi 的一阶环节：

    Ti(s)≈11+s/ωi∠Ti(jωo)=−arctanωoωi≈−ωoωi

    最后那个约等号说明：在远低于 ωi 的频率上，带宽 ωi 的内环看起来就像一段约 1/ωi 秒的延迟，上一个“深入一层”的延迟预算照样适用。按带宽比列出内环吃掉的相位：

    带宽比 ωi/ωo一阶内环二阶内环（ζ = 0.7）
    10−5.7°−8°
    5−11.3°−16°
    2−26.6°−43°
    1−45°−90°

    外环本身通常只有 45–65° 的裕度。带宽比 5–10 时内环只吃掉 6–16°，还能当“理想执行器”；只差 2 倍，就吃掉裕度的一半左右，必须把内环写进外环的模型，否则外环怎么调都调不好。真实的内环多半比一阶环节更“慢半拍”（第三列），所以这个经验值偏保守是有道理的。

    工程上 从内到外逐环扫频，量出闭环带宽和相位；扫频幅值要接近实际工况，因为大信号下执行器会饱和，带宽随之变低。分不开时（例如气动压力环只有几 Hz，这是经验量级，以实测为准，外面还想套交互力闭环），与其硬加外环增益，不如把内环动态写进模型，或者多用前馈。

    自己验证

    用下面实验的延迟滑块扮演“内环”。取 ωn = 6 rad/s（ωc ≈ 9.3 rad/s）：延迟 20 ms 约等于带宽 50 rad/s 的内环（带宽比约 5），55 ms 约等于带宽比 2，110 ms 约等于带宽比 1。看表里“被推之后最大误差”一行“仅反馈”的读数（推力保持默认的 1.5 N·m），依次约为 0.040 rad（无延迟）、0.044、0.053、0.117 rad：带宽比 5 时几乎看不出差别；1 倍时误差已接近三倍，运动段留下的晃动到 2 s 还没停，回路已接近振荡。

    Background. The phase of a first-order system, −arctan(ω/ωi). If you’d rather skip the derivation, the table alone tells the story.

    Idea. When you design the outer loop you pretend the inner closed loop equals 1: whatever you ask for, delivered instantly. The price of that pretence is the inner loop’s phase lag at the outer crossover frequency ωo, which, like delay, comes straight out of the outer loop’s phase margin.

    Derivation. Approximate the inner closed loop as a first-order lag with bandwidth ωi:

    Ti(s)≈11+s/ωi∠Ti(jωo)=−arctanωoωi≈−ωoωi

    The last approximation says that well below ωi, an inner loop of bandwidth ωi looks like a delay of about 1/ωi seconds, so the delay budget from the previous “Going deeper” applies unchanged. The phase the inner loop costs, by bandwidth ratio:

    Ratio ωi/ωoFirst-order inner loopSecond-order inner loop (ζ = 0.7)
    10−5.7°−8°
    5−11.3°−16°
    2−26.6°−43°
    1−45°−90°

    The outer loop itself typically has only 45–65° of margin. At a ratio of 5–10 the inner loop costs 6–16° and can still pass for an ideal actuator; at a ratio of 2 it eats about half the margin, and you have to put the inner loop into the outer loop’s model or the outer loop will never tune well. Real inner loops usually lag more than a first-order one (third column), which is why the rule of thumb errs on the conservative side.

    In practice. Sweep each loop from the inside out and measure its closed-loop bandwidth and phase, at amplitudes close to real operation: large signals saturate the actuator and lower the bandwidth. When the loops can’t be separated — say, a pneumatic pressure loop of a few hertz (an empirical magnitude; measure your own) with an interaction-force loop wanted around it — model the inner loop in the outer design or lean on feedforward, rather than forcing more outer-loop gain.

    Check it yourself

    Let the delay slider in the experiment below stand in for an inner loop. With ωn = 6 rad/s (ωc ≈ 9.3 rad/s), 20 ms behaves like an inner loop of 50 rad/s bandwidth (ratio about 5), 55 ms like a ratio of 2, and 110 ms like a ratio of 1. Read the feedback-only entry in the table’s “Max error after the push” row (keep the default 1.5 N·m push): about 0.040 rad with no delay, then 0.044, 0.053 and 0.117 rad. At a ratio of 5 you can hardly tell; at 1 the error is nearly three times larger, the swinging left over from the move hasn’t died out by 2 s, and the loop is close to oscillating.

    工程实例From the field

    ANYmal 的串联弹性关节有多快How fast is an ANYmal joint?

    系统 苏黎世联邦理工学院（ETH Zürich）的四足机器人 ANYmal，2016 年的版本约 30 kg、高 0.5 m。每条腿 3 个关节，每个关节是一个集成了驱动电子的串联弹性执行器（SEA）（在电机和负载之间故意串进一根弹簧，量弹簧变形就等于量力矩）：电机、大减速比减速器、一个弹性元件，再加两个编码器，分别测弹簧变形和输出端位置。

    问题 腿足机器人既要精确控制关节力矩，又要扛住奔跑和落地时的冲击。

    怎么控制 一只关节里装着上图的下半截（按 Hwangbo 等 2019 的描述）：关节 PD 把位置指令变成期望力矩；力矩 PID 根据弹簧变形测出的力矩，算出期望电流；FOC 电流环把电流变成相电压；电机经减速器去拧弹簧，弹簧的变形最终产生关节力矩。再往上是全身控制器，或者一个以 200 Hz 运行的学习策略。

    关键数字 关节力矩控制带宽超过 70 Hz（约 440 rad/s）；全速奔跑的功率不到 280 W，续航超过 2 小时。

    学到什么 ① 每一层都用自己的测量闭环：力矩环看弹簧变形，位置环看输出端编码器。② 70 Hz 是带宽，200 Hz 是策略的运行频率，两者不是一回事。按“外环带宽约为内环的 1/5–1/10”推算，把这只关节当理想力矩源的外环，带宽上限大约 7–14 Hz。③ 弹簧是有意加进去的柔性：它把测力矩变成了测变形，也缓冲了冲击。代价是弹簧越软，电机要转过越大的角度才拧得出同样的力矩，大力矩下能达到的带宽也就越低。

    System. ANYmal, the ETH Zürich quadruped — about 30 kg and 0.5 m tall in its 2016 version. Each leg has three joints, and each joint is a series-elastic actuator (SEA) module with integrated electronics (an SEA puts a spring between motor and load on purpose, so that measuring its deflection measures the torque): a motor, a high-ratio gearbox, an elastic element, and two encoders, one for spring deflection and one for output position.

    Problem. A legged robot has to control joint torque precisely and also survive the impacts of running and landing.

    How it’s controlled. One joint contains the bottom half of the figure above (as described by Hwangbo et al. 2019): a joint PD turns the position command into a desired torque; a torque PID, working from the torque measured as spring deflection, computes the desired current; an FOC current loop turns that current into phase voltages; the motor winds the spring through the gearbox, and the spring’s deflection finally produces the joint torque. On top sits a whole-body controller, or a learned policy running at 200 Hz.

    Key numbers. Joint torque-control bandwidth above 70 Hz (about 440 rad/s); less than 280 W even when running at full speed, for more than 2 hours of autonomy.

    Lessons. (1) Every layer closes its loop on its own measurement: the torque loop on spring deflection, the position loop on the output encoder. (2) 70 Hz is a bandwidth; 200 Hz is how often the policy runs — different things. By the 1/5–1/10 rule of thumb, an outer loop that treats this joint as an ideal torque source tops out at roughly 7–14 Hz of bandwidth. (3) The spring is deliberate compliance: it turns torque sensing into measuring a deflection, and it cushions impacts. The price is that the softer the spring, the further the motor must turn to produce the same torque, so the bandwidth reachable at large torques drops.

    出处：Sources: Hutter, M., Gehring, C., Jud, D., Lauber, A., Bellicoso, C. D., Tsounis, V., Hwangbo, J., Bodie, K., Fankhauser, P., Bloesch, M., Diethelm, R., Bachmann, S., Melzer, A., & Hoepflinger, M. (2016). ANYmal – a highly mobile and dynamic quadrupedal robot. 2016 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), 38–44. doi:10.1109/IROS.2016.7758092 · Hwangbo, J., Lee, J., Dosovitskiy, A., Bellicoso, C. D., Tsounis, V., Koltun, V., & Hutter, M. (2019). Learning agile and dynamic motor skills for legged robots. Science Robotics, 4(26), eaau5872. doi:10.1126/scirobotics.aau5872

    “模型”到底指什么What “model” actually means

    后面每一节都绕不开“模型”。问一个方法“有没有模型”太粗了，不如拆成三个问题：

    1. 运行时，控制律里有没有模型？
    2. 设计或整定时，要不要模型？
    3. 怎样对待模型误差？

    PID 的控制律里没有模型，整定却离不开对对象的粗略认识；MPC 每个周期都用模型向前算；强化学习把模型搬进了仿真器。现在不必记答案：每节读完可以回来对一下，最后一节有答案表。

    “Model” comes up in every section that follows. Asking whether a method “uses a model” is too coarse; split it into three questions:

    1. At run time, does the control law contain a model?
    2. Do you need a model to design or tune it?
    3. How does it deal with model error?

    PID’s control law contains no model, yet tuning it relies on a rough picture of the plant; MPC runs its model forward every cycle; reinforcement learning moves the model into a simulator. No need to memorize the answers now: come back after each section and check, and the last section collects them in one table.

    外骨骼视角Exoskeleton lens下图是一种气动肩部外骨骼：腋下的织物气囊充气撑开，把上臂往上托。这类设备的回路里还有第二个控制器：穿戴者。人的神经肌肉系统有延迟、会学习、阻抗随时在变（放松时软、绷紧时硬），并且和设备作用在同一个关节上。所以人施加的力矩对设备来说往往不是要抑制的扰动，而是要跟随的信号；做得好不好，看透明性（人穿着设备活动时，几乎感觉不到它的存在）。后面几节会反复碰到它。The figure below shows one kind of pneumatic shoulder exoskeleton: a fabric bladder under the armpit inflates and props the upper arm up. A device like this has a second controller in its loop: the wearer. The human neuromuscular system has delay, learns, changes its impedance from moment to moment (soft when relaxed, stiff when tensed), and acts on the same joint as the device. So the torque a person applies is usually not a disturbance to reject but a signal to follow, and the yardstick is transparency (how little the wearer feels the device when it isn’t meant to help). We’ll return to it in later sections.

    反过来想Flip it around

    只有前馈：模型的任何误差都会被积分成漂移；有人推一下，它根本不知道。

    只有反馈：必须先有误差才动作。要靠它压住重力、惯量这些已知的大力，就得把增益开得很高，而增益被噪声、延迟和饱和封了顶。

    忽略分层：外环按“内环理想”来设计，内环却带宽不够或延迟太大，外环怎么调都调不好。

    卡在哪里：开环卡在“算不准、看不见扰动”；反馈能兜底，却要先有误差，还受带宽和延迟限制。前馈要的模型从哪来、要多准，是后面几节的事。先假装什么都不知道，看只靠误差能走多远：它的极限，就是后面每一节的出发点。

    Feedforward alone: any model error integrates into drift, and a push goes completely unnoticed.

    Feedback alone: nothing happens until an error exists. Holding down large, known forces such as gravity and inertia this way takes high gain, and noise, delay and saturation put a ceiling on gain.

    Ignore the layers: design the outer loop as if the inner loop were ideal when it lacks bandwidth or carries too much delay, and the outer loop won’t tune no matter what you try.

    Where it gets stuck: open loop fails because it can’t compute exactly and can’t see disturbances. Feedback catches both, but only after an error appears, and only within its bandwidth and delay. Where a feedforward model comes from, and how good it must be, is the business of later sections. First, pretend we know nothing and see how far the error alone can go; its limits are where every later section starts.

    开头那个问题，可以直接动手试。场景是俯视图：三只一样的水平摆臂并排，都要在 0.6 s 内从 0 转到 1 rad：一只只按模型出力（开环），一只只看误差（反馈），一只两者相加；t = 2 s 时有一只手推它们一下。先看这一推之后谁歪过去就回不来；再把反馈自然频率调到 40 rad/s，只把延迟 td 从 10 ms 加到 20 ms，盯住那个空心小三角（控制器“看到”的位置），看带反馈的两只怎么开始来回甩。先猜：模型完全准确、又没人推时，谁的误差最小？You can test the opening question directly. The scene is a top view of three identical horizontal arms side by side, each asked to turn from 0 to 1 rad in 0.6 s: one sends torques precomputed from the model (open loop), one reacts to the error (feedback), one does both; at t = 2 s a hand pushes all three. First watch which one gets knocked off by the push and never comes back. Then set the feedback natural frequency to 40 rad/s, raise only the delay td from 10 ms to 20 ms, and keep an eye on the hollow marker (where the controller “sees” the arm) as the two feedback arms start to whip back and forth. Predict first: with an exact model and no push, which one has the smallest error?

    你应该看到：模型完全准确、没人推时，开环和“前馈＋反馈”在运动段的误差都很小（约 0.002 和 0.001 rad），只靠反馈则差得多（约 0.25 rad）。外力一加回来，开环被推偏约 0.5 rad，而且回不来（阻尼让它慢慢停在约 0.6 rad），两种带反馈的做法都回到 0。再把反馈自然频率 ωn 调到 40 rad/s，此时穿越频率约 62 rad/s：延迟 10 ms 吃掉约 0.62 rad（约 36°）的相位，回路还稳；加到 20 ms 吃掉约 1.24 rad，超过了这个回路原有的约 65° 相位裕度，两条带反馈的曲线在约 2.3 s 时发散。What you should see: with an exact model and no push, open loop and feedforward + feedback both have tiny errors during the move (about 0.002 and 0.001 rad), while feedback alone does far worse (about 0.25 rad). Bring the push back and open loop is knocked about 0.5 rad off and never returns (damping lets it coast to a stop near 0.6 rad), while both feedback versions return to zero. Now set the feedback natural frequency ωn to 40 rad/s, which puts the crossover near 62 rad/s: 10 ms of delay eats about 0.62 rad (about 36°) of phase and the loop stays stable; 20 ms eats about 1.24 rad, more than the loop’s original phase margin of about 65°, and both feedback curves diverge at about t = 2.3 s.

    深入一层Going deeper 测量有延迟时，参考信号要不要也延迟？If the measurement arrives late, should the reference be delayed too?

    前置知识 方框图化简：会从方框图写出误差 E 和参考 R 的关系就够了。

    思路 比较器做减法，两边必须是同一时刻的量。测量晚到 td，参考却用当前值，反馈看到的就是“现在的目标”减去“td 之前的位置”。关节明明跟得很好，也会被判成落后了约 q̇d·td，于是反馈去补这段并不存在的误差，和完美的前馈互相拉扯。

    推导 设前馈完美（GF = 1），比较两种写法：前两行是不对齐（参考用当前值），后两行是对齐（参考也推迟 td）。

    U=FR+C(R−e−stdY)⇒E=GC(e−std−1)1+GCe−stdR≠0U=FR+Ce−std(R−Y)⇒E=1−GF1+GCe−stdR=0

    不对齐时，在带宽以内（GC 很大）误差约为 E ≈ −td·q̇d：关节被推到目标前面约 q̇d·td。本页轨迹的最大角速度约 3.1 rad/s，乘 10 ms 正好约 0.03 rad。注意，对齐只消掉了这个“假误差”，分母里的延迟还在：延迟对稳定性和抗扰的限制（本节第一个“深入一层”）一点没少。

    工程上 多轴、多传感器的系统给每个测量打时间戳，用同步的时钟（例如工业总线的分布式时钟）对齐；再把参考按已知延迟推迟，或者用模型把测量外推到“现在”（Smith 预估器就是这个思路）。外骨骼里的 IMU、压力传感器和编码器常挂在不同的总线上，延迟各不相同，要先对齐再求误差。

    自己验证

    本页实验的比较器已按“对齐”的方式实现：把模型比例 κ 调到 1.00、“外力推一下”调到 0，“前馈＋反馈”在运动段的误差应和开环（约 0.002 rad）一样小，读数约 0.001 rad。如果不对齐，按同一模型复现，这个数会变成约 0.032 rad（ωn = 6 和 40 rad/s 时都是），恰好是最大角速度乘延迟。

    Background. Block-diagram algebra: enough to write the error E in terms of the reference R.

    Idea. A comparator subtracts, so both sides must refer to the same instant. If the measurement arrives td late but the reference is current, feedback sees “the target now” minus “the position td ago”. A joint that is tracking perfectly gets judged about q̇d·td behind, so feedback pushes to close an error that doesn’t exist — and fights a perfect feedforward.

    Derivation. Assume perfect feedforward (GF = 1) and compare the two ways of wiring the comparator: the first two lines leave the reference current (unaligned); the last two delay it by td as well (aligned).

    U=FR+C(R−e−stdY)⇒E=GC(e−std−1)1+GCe−stdR≠0U=FR+Ce−std(R−Y)⇒E=1−GF1+GCe−stdR=0

    Unaligned, and within the bandwidth (large GC), the error reduces to E ≈ −td·q̇d: the joint is pushed ahead of the target by about q̇d·td. The trajectory on this page peaks at about 3.1 rad/s, and times 10 ms that is about 0.03 rad. Note that aligning removes only this phantom error; the delay in the denominator is still there, so its limits on stability and disturbance rejection (the first “Going deeper” in this section) are untouched.

    In practice. Multi-axis, multi-sensor systems timestamp every measurement and align them with synchronized clocks (fieldbus distributed clocks, for example), then delay the reference by the known latency or use a model to extrapolate the measurement to “now” — the idea behind the Smith predictor. In an exoskeleton the IMU, pressure sensors and encoders often sit on different buses with different latencies; align them before you form an error.

    Check it yourself

    The experiment’s comparator is wired the aligned way: set the model scale κ to 1.00 and the push to 0, and feedforward + feedback should be as accurate during the move as open loop (about 0.002 rad) — the readout shows about 0.001 rad. Without alignment, the same model gives about 0.032 rad (at ωn = 6 and 40 rad/s alike) — exactly the peak velocity times the delay.

    一句话Takeaway

    已知的交给前馈，未知的交给反馈：开环离不开完美的模型，反馈离不开误差，也逃不出带宽和延迟的限制。

    Give the known to feedforward and the unknown to feedback: open loop needs a perfect model, and feedback needs an error to act on and lives within its bandwidth and delay.

    下一个问题：先只用反馈——只知道误差，能把一个关节控到多好？Next question: start with feedback alone — knowing only the error, how well can you control a joint?

    入门读物Where to start

    1. Åström, K. J., & Murray, R. M. (2008). Feedback Systems: An Introduction for Scientists and Engineers. Princeton University Press. doi:10.1515/9781400828739 (2nd ed. 2021)

      为什么值得读：反馈、稳定性、裕度和延迟的最好入门，从物理直觉讲起，数学门槛低；作者提供免费电子版。

      Why read it: the best way into feedback, stability, margins and delay — built on physical intuition, with a low mathematical bar, and free from the authors.

    2. Lynch, K. M., & Park, F. C. (2017). Modern Robotics: Mechanics, Planning, and Control. Cambridge University Press. doi:10.1017/9781316661239

      为什么值得读：写给本科生的机器人教材；第 8 章（开链动力学）和第 11 章（机器人控制）正好接上本文 01、02、05 节。作者提供免费预印本和配套视频课。

      Why read it: a robotics text written for undergraduates; Chapter 8 (dynamics of open chains) and Chapter 11 (robot control) connect directly to Sections 01, 02 and 05. The authors offer a free preprint and video lectures.

    3. Siciliano, B., Sciavicco, L., Villani, L., & Oriolo, G. (2009). Robotics: Modelling, Planning and Control. Springer (Advanced Textbooks in Control and Signal Processing). doi:10.1007/978-1-84628-642-1

      为什么值得读：第 8 章“运动控制”和第 9 章“力控制”是本文 01、02、05 节的标准参考，推导比上一本更完整。

      Why read it: Chapter 8 (motion control) and Chapter 9 (force control) are the standard reference for Sections 01, 02 and 05, with fuller derivations than the book above.

    4. Siciliano, B., & Khatib, O. (Eds.). (2016). Springer Handbook of Robotics (2nd ed.). Springer. doi:10.1007/978-3-319-32552-1

      为什么值得读：各章由相应方向的一线研究者撰写，适合读完本文后按主题查找。

      Why read it: each chapter is written by active researchers in that area — the place to look things up by topic once you’ve finished this article.

    01经典反馈：只看误差能走多远Classical feedback: how far can the error alone take you?

    用已知的物理Use the physics you know

    问题The question

    一条机械臂托着一个你不知道多重的砝码，要转到 1 rad 停住。假如控制器只按测得到的东西出力：关节现在在哪、离目标差多少。只靠这个误差，能把它控到多好？卡在哪里？

    A robot arm is holding a weight of unknown mass and has to turn to 1 rad and stop there. Suppose the controller acts only on what it can measure: where the joint is and how far it is from the target. Using that error alone, how well can you control it, and where does it get stuck?

    本节要点（5 分钟版）This section in brief

    • 只用 P（一根虚拟弹簧）顶恒定负载，会留下 d₀/Kp 的静差；D 是作用在测得速度上的虚拟阻尼器，阻尼比 ζ 大致决定超调；I 能把静差消掉，而且必须放在控制器里，对象自己的积分帮不上忙。
    • 真实世界给增益封了顶：执行器饱和引起积分饱和（最直接的办法是饱和时暂停积分），编码器量化让 D 项出力矩毛刺，采样和延迟从相位裕度里扣。整定规则（Ziegler–Nichols、继电反馈、SIMC）里其实藏着对象的模型。
    • 有线性模型时，状态反馈 u = −Kx 对这个关节就是换一种方式挑 PD 的两个增益；LQR 用 Q（多在乎误差）和 R（多在乎用力）写一笔账，让数学去挑。R 缩小 10 倍，这个关节快不到 2 倍，起步那一下的力矩却大约 3 倍。
    • 全状态 LQR 白送很宽的稳定裕度；改用观测器估速度，这份保证就没了（不是一定变差，是不能再打包票）。多关节耦合强不强主要看减速比：连杆惯量折到电机侧要除以 N2，减速比大时，随构型变化的惯量和耦合都被大大削弱，独立关节 PID 加前馈往往就够。
    • P alone (a virtual spring) against a constant load leaves a steady-state error of d₀/Kp; D is a virtual damper acting on the measured velocity, and the damping ratio ζ roughly sets the overshoot; I removes the offset, and it has to live in the controller — the plant’s own integrations can’t help.
    • The real world caps the gains: actuator saturation causes integrator windup (the simplest fix is to pause the integrator while saturated), encoder quantization turns the D term into torque spikes, and sampling and delay eat into the phase margin. Tuning rules (Ziegler–Nichols, relay feedback, SIMC) quietly contain a model of the plant.
    • With a linear model, state feedback u = −Kx is, for this joint, just another way to pick the two PD gains; LQR writes a bill — Q for how much you care about error, R for how much you care about effort — and lets the math pick. Cut R by 10× and this joint gets less than 2× faster, while the initial torque roughly triples.
    • Full-state LQR comes with wide stability margins for free; estimate the velocity with an observer and that guarantee is gone (not necessarily worse, just no longer promised). How strongly joints couple depends mainly on the gear ratio: link inertia reflected to the motor side is divided by N2, so with high ratios the configuration-dependent inertia and the coupling are greatly weakened, and independent-joint PID plus feedforward is often enough.

    第一次读可以跳过：整定规则那一小段的公式、外骨骼视角、各处“深入一层”、实验说明里的一长串数字。

    Safe to skip on a first read: the formulas in the tuning-rules passage, the exoskeleton lens, the “Going deeper” boxes, and the long strings of numbers in the experiment notes.

    本节符号　误差 e = r − q（目标减实际）；Kd 是微分增益（05 节的 Kd 另有含义）；“P 项”指比例项，LQR 公式里另有一个矩阵 P，读到那一段再解释；N 是减速比。

    Symbols in this section Error e = r − q (target minus actual); Kd is the derivative gain (the Kd of Section 05 means something else); “the P term” is the proportional term, while the LQR formulas use a matrix P that is explained when we get there; N is the gear ratio.

    从一根虚拟弹簧开始Start with a virtual spring

    先说结论：只靠误差，能把关节拉回目标，积分还能消掉恒定负载；卡住它的是增益。要扛的力越大、变得越快，需要的增益越高，而增益被饱和、噪声和延迟封了顶。

    先把关节写成最简单的样子，然后只让控制器看误差 e=r−q。经典的 PID 由三项组成：比例、积分、微分（分别按误差本身、误差的累积、误差变化的快慢出力）。其中 P 和 D 就是开头游乐场里那根虚拟弹簧和那个阻尼器。下面一项一项加上去，看每一项解决了什么、又带来了什么。

    Short answer: the error alone can pull the joint back, and integral action even removes a constant load. What stops it is gain: the larger and faster-changing the forces, the more gain you need, and saturation, noise and delay cap the gain.

    Write the joint in its simplest form and let the controller see only the error e=r−q. Classic PID has three terms — proportional, integral and derivative (they act on the error, its accumulation, and how fast it changes). P and D are the virtual spring and damper from the playground at the top of the page. Add the terms one at a time and watch what each one fixes and what it costs.

    1. 理想模型Ideal model

      Jq¨+bq˙=τ−d0

      J 是惯量，b 是阻尼，d₀ 是一个恒定负载，比如手臂托着的砝码。控制器不知道这三个数。

      J is the inertia, b the damping, and d₀ a constant load — the weight the arm is holding, say. The controller knows none of the three.

    2. 只用比例 PProportional only

      τ=Kpe⇒ess=d0Kp

      比例项像一根把关节拉向目标的虚拟弹簧。要顶住负载，弹簧得一直被拉长一点，就像挂了重物的弹簧秤总要伸长一截：弹簧力 Kp·e 必须等于 d₀，于是留下稳态误差（系统安静下来以后还剩的误差） d₀/Kp。没有负载时，弹簧不用伸长就能停在目标，误差为零。Kp 越大，这段伸长越短，但永远不为零。

      The proportional term acts like a virtual spring pulling the joint toward the target. To hold up the load, the spring must stay stretched a little, the way a spring scale always stretches under a weight: the spring force Kp·e has to equal d₀, which leaves a steady-state error (the error left once everything settles) of d₀/Kp. With no load, the spring can rest at the target unstretched and the error is zero. A larger Kp shortens the stretch but never removes it.

    3. 加微分 DAdd derivative

      τ=Kpe−Kdq˙ζ=b+Kd2KpJ,ωn=KpJMp=exp(−πζ/1−ζ2)ts≈4ζωn

      微分项像一个虚拟阻尼器，始终阻碍运动；最要紧的是关节冲向目标、误差快速变小时，它在越过目标之前就开始刹车。它作用在测得的速度上，不对误差求导，免得目标突变时猛踢一下（微分冲击）。

      阻尼比 ζ 近似决定超调 Mp（第一次冲过目标的幅度）和调节时间 ts（进入并留在目标 ±2% 以内所需的时间）：ζ 越大，冲过头越少。

      这是二阶近似：真实系统还有别的极点（决定自由响应快慢和振荡的特征根）和零点，它们会修正这个估计。

      The derivative term acts like a virtual damper that always resists motion, and it matters most when the joint is rushing toward the target: it starts braking before the target is crossed. It acts on the measured velocity rather than differentiating the error, so a setpoint step doesn’t produce a sudden kick (derivative kick).

      The damping ratio ζ roughly sets the overshoot Mp (how far it first shoots past the target) and the settling time ts (time to enter and stay within ±2%): the larger ζ, the less it overshoots.

      It’s a second-order approximation: the real system has other poles (the characteristic roots that set how fast and how oscillatory the free response is) and zeros, and they shift the estimate.

    4. 加积分 IAdd integral

      τ=Kpe+Ki∫0tedt−Kdq˙

      静止时 D 项为零；若误差也为零，P 项也为零，能顶住 d₀ 的只剩积分项。积分器会一直累加到误差归零——不用知道 d₀ 多大。

      对象自己也在“积分”（力矩积两次才变成角度），为什么帮不上忙？看下面的方框图里负载从哪里进来。电机力矩和负载先在同一个加法点相减，得到“力不平衡”τ − d₀；对象的两个积分器在这个点之后，只会把不平衡变成越来越快、越走越远的运动。它们记住的是“走到了哪、走得多快”，不是“该出多大力”。

      关节要停住，不平衡必须正好为零，也就是电机力矩要一直等于 d₀，而电机力矩只能来自控制器。误差为零时 P 项是零，静止时 D 项也是零；能一直输出 d₀ 的只剩控制器里的积分。它像一只拧螺丝的手：误差还在，就一点点拧紧；误差没了，就停在拧紧的位置不松手。

      这是内模原理（要一直抵消某种扰动，控制器里就得有一个能在输入为零时自己产生这种信号的环节）最简单的例子：抵消常值要积分器，抵消正弦要一个同频的振荡环节（见下面的“深入一层”）。代价是多一份相位滞后（总慢半拍），超调变大。

      At rest the D term is zero; if the error is zero too, so is the P term, and only the integral is left to hold up d₀. The integrator keeps accumulating until the error is gone — without knowing how big d₀ is.

      The plant integrates too (torque becomes angle through two integrations), so why can’t it help? Look at where the load enters in the block diagram below. The motor torque and the load meet at the same summing point, leaving a force imbalance τ − d₀, and the plant’s two integrators come after that point: all they can do is turn an imbalance into ever faster, ever larger motion. What they remember is where the joint is and how fast it is moving, not how much torque is needed.

      For the joint to stay put, the imbalance must be exactly zero, so the motor torque must keep equaling d₀ — and motor torque can only come from the controller. With zero error the P term is zero, and at rest the D term is zero too; the only thing left that can keep supplying d₀ is an integral in the controller. Think of a hand tightening a screw: while there is error it turns a little more; once the error is gone it stops and holds, without letting go.

      This is the simplest case of the internal model principle (to cancel a disturbance indefinitely, the controller must contain an element that can generate that signal by itself with zero input): a constant needs an integrator, a sinusoid needs an oscillator at the same frequency (see the “Going deeper” block below). The price is extra phase lag (it always reacts a beat late) and more overshoot.

    把真实世界加回来Put the real world back

    前四步假设执行器要多大力就给多大力、传感器读数无限精确、计算不花时间。下面把这些假设逐个去掉。

    The first four steps assume the actuator delivers any torque you ask for, the sensor is infinitely precise, and computation takes no time. Now remove those assumptions one at a time.

    1. ＋ 执行器饱和+ Actuator saturation

      τ=sat(u),|τ|≤umax

      执行器出力有上限。执行器顶满、关节还没追上时，积分照样累加；等关节到了，攒下的积分很久才放得掉，于是大幅超调，这叫积分饱和。积分器像一只一直在接水的桶：电机顶满时桶还在接水，关节到位后，多出来的水只能靠冲过头倒掉。最直接的抗饱和办法是：饱和、且误差还往同一方向推时，暂停积分（条件积分）；另一种做法叫反算法，见下面的“深入一层”。

      The actuator has a limit. While it is maxed out and the joint is still catching up, the integral keeps growing; by the time the joint arrives, the stored-up integral takes a long time to unwind, and the joint overshoots badly. This is integrator windup. Picture the integrator as a bucket that keeps filling: while the motor is maxed out, water keeps pouring in, and once the joint arrives the surplus can only be poured out by overshooting. The simplest anti-windup is to pause integration while the actuator is saturated and the error still pushes into the limit (conditional integration); another method, back-calculation, is in the “Going deeper” block below.

    2. ＋ 测量：编码器量化+ Measurement: encoder quantization

      Δ=2π214,ΔT≈0.38rad/s

      编码器把角度切成台阶。相邻读数相减再除以周期 T 来测速，速度只能取台阶的整数倍：14 位、1 kHz 时是 0.38 rad/s。它乘上 Kd 就直接变成力矩毛刺。所以 D 项要先过一个低通滤波器，把台阶造成的跳动抹平，并且只对测量值求导。滤得越狠，噪声越小，D 带来的“提前刹车”也越少。

      An encoder chops the angle into steps. Difference consecutive readings and divide by the period T, and velocity can only take multiples of one step: 0.38 rad/s for 14 bits at 1 kHz. Multiplied by Kd, that step lands on the torque as spikes. So the D term first goes through a low-pass filter that smooths out the jumps, and it differentiates only the measurement. Heavier filtering means less noise — and less of the early braking D was there to provide.

    3. ＋ 采样与延迟+ Sampling and delay

      Δφ=ωc(T2+td)

      数字控制器还带来两份延迟：零阶保持（把一个采样值一直保持到下一个采样）约等于半个周期，再加上计算和通信延迟 td。

      它们在穿越频率 ωc（回路增益降到 1 的频率，大致就是闭环带宽）处吃掉上式那么多相位，直接从相位裕度里扣。示意：1 kHz 采样、1 ms 延迟、穿越频率 50 Hz（ωc = 2π × 50 ≈ 314 rad/s），约损失 27°。这也是采样频率常取闭环带宽 10–30 倍的原因，这个倍数是经验值。

      A digital controller adds two delays: the zero-order hold (holding each sample until the next) is worth about half a period, and computation and communication add td.

      At the crossover frequency ωc (where the loop gain drops to one, roughly the closed-loop bandwidth) these delays cost the phase given above, taken straight out of the phase margin. For illustration: 1 kHz sampling, 1 ms of delay and a 50 Hz crossover (ωc = 2π × 50 ≈ 314 rad/s) cost about 27°. It is also why sampling rates are usually 10–30 times the closed-loop bandwidth, a ratio that comes from experience.

    4. 整定里藏着模型Tuning hides a model

      G(s)≈ke−θsτ1s+1

      控制律里没有模型，整定规则里有。经典的 Ziegler–Nichols 法用纯比例控制把增益一路加到关节等幅振荡，记下这时的增益 Ku 和振荡周期 Tu。这是回路“刚好自己振起来”的那个点，相当于测了对象频率响应上的一个点，再按表从这两个数算出 PID 参数。可在真实关节上，尤其是和人接触的设备上，把回路推到失稳边缘很危险。

      工业自整定常用继电反馈（Åström & Hägglund 1984）代替：把控制器临时换成一个开关，误差为正就输出 +h，为负就输出 −h。回路会自己进入一个小幅、稳定的振荡，而且正好振在同一个频率上（对象相位落后 180° 的地方，按描述函数近似），周期就是 Tu。开关输出的是方波，它的基波幅值是 4h/π；关节的振幅记作 a，两者之比 4h/(πa) 就近似等于 Ku。振幅由 h 决定，可以设得很小；整个试验里振荡始终有界，不必像 Ziegler–Nichols 那样把线性回路的增益推到临界点。

      SIMC 法假设对象是“一阶惯性加一段延迟”，即上式：k 是增益，τ1 是时间常数，θ 是延迟。三个数都能从一次阶跃试验里读出来：给输入一个台阶，看输出过多久才开始动（θ），最后变了多少（k = 输出变化 ÷ 输入台阶），从开始动算起走完约 63% 用了多久（τ1）。然后按公式直接算 PI 参数，例如比例增益 Kc = τ1/[k(τc + θ)]，常取 τc = θ：延迟越长，增益就得越小。（关节的速度环大致就是这种对象；位置环本身带积分，SIMC 另有一组公式。）所以负载、减速比、供气压力或穿戴者一变，就得重新整定，或做增益调度（按工况查表切换增益）。

      The control law has no model in it, but the tuning rule does. Classic Ziegler–Nichols tuning runs proportional-only control, raises the gain until the joint oscillates steadily, and records that gain Ku and the period Tu. That is the point where the loop just starts oscillating on its own — in effect one measured point on the plant’s frequency response — and a table turns the two numbers into PID settings. But pushing a real joint to the edge of instability is risky, especially on a device in contact with a person.

      Industrial auto-tuners use relay feedback instead (Åström & Hägglund 1984): temporarily replace the controller with a switch that outputs +h when the error is positive and −h when it is negative. The loop settles into a small, steady oscillation at the very same frequency (where the plant lags by 180°, to a describing-function approximation), so its period is Tu. The switch puts out a square wave whose fundamental has amplitude 4h/π; call the joint’s oscillation amplitude a, and the ratio 4h/(πa) approximates Ku. The amplitude is set by h and can be made small; the oscillation stays bounded throughout, and the linear loop never has to be pushed to its critical gain as in Ziegler–Nichols.

      SIMC tuning assumes the plant is first order plus dead time — the formula above, with k the gain, τ1 the time constant and θ the delay. All three come from a single step test: step the input and note how long the output waits before it starts to move (θ), how much it finally changes (k = output change ÷ input step), and how long it takes, once moving, to cover about 63% of the way (τ1). Formulas then give the PI settings directly — for example the proportional gain Kc = τ1/[k(τc + θ)], often with τc = θ: the longer the delay, the lower the gain must be. (A joint’s velocity loop looks roughly like this; a position loop contains an integrator and SIMC has separate formulas for it.) So when the load, the gear ratio, the supply pressure or the wearer changes, you retune — or use gain scheduling (switching gains from a table according to the operating condition).

    深入一层Going deeper 积分器：为什么必须放在控制器里，又为什么会“饱和”？The integrator: why it has to live in the controller, and why it winds up

    前置知识 ①要用终值定理（自动控制原理里学过）；②③只用到积分。

    ① 积分器该放在哪 单位负反馈、闭环稳定，回路增益为 G(s)C(s)。对阶跃参考 r₀，以及从对象输入端进来的恒定负载 d₀，终值定理给出：

    ess=r0+G(0)d01+G(0)C(0)→G(0)=∞d0C(0)

    关节 G = 1/(s(Js + b)) 自带积分器，G(0) = ∞，所以纯 P 跟踪阶跃参考本来就没有静差；正文里的 d₀/Kp 完全来自负载。负载那一项只剩 d₀/C(0)：对象的积分器在负载进入点之后，帮不上忙；只有 C(0) = ∞，也就是控制器里有积分，才能把它消掉。一般规则是：从误差到扰动进入点之间，要有积分器。

    驱动器工作在速度模式时，位置环只用 P 也没有静差，靠的是速度环自己的积分器：负载在速度环里面就被它顶住了。速度环若只有 P，静差是 d₀/(KvKp)。这个道理还能推广（内模原理，Francis & Wonham 1976）：要无差地抵消斜坡扰动，需要两个积分器；要抵消频率为 ω₀ 的正弦扰动（偏心、步态周期），控制器里要有 1/(s² + ω₀²)。谐振控制器和重复控制就是这么来的，06 节的 ILC 是它们的近亲。

    ② 为什么会饱和 积分器其实在记账。只要它从 0 开始、从未被冻结、最后安静下来，终值时它必须正好输出 d₀（P、D 两项都已归零），所以：

    ∫0∞edt=d0Ki

    这本账与过程无关。执行器顶满时关节爬得慢，正的误差面积越攒越多；到达目标以后，多出来的只能靠一段反号误差还回去：∫t₁∞ e dt = (d₀ − I(t₁))/Ki，t₁ 是第一次到达目标的时刻，I 是积分项的输出。本页默认参数下，t₁ ≈ 0.41 s 时积分项已攒到约 26.6 N·m，而顶住负载只要 5 N·m，要还的面积约 −0.22 rad·s：这就是 34% 的超调。

    ③ 抗饱和改了什么 条件积分：饱和且误差与控制量同号时停止累加，这段时间不记账。反算法：让积分器跟踪“实际给出”与“想要”之差，

    I˙=Kie+sat(u)−uTt

    Tt 越小，积分状态越快被拉回到与实际输出一致的值；经验上取在 Td 与 Ti 之间，太小会被噪声反复触发，太大等于没加。穿戴设备上，积分饱和的后果是限幅解除瞬间的力矩突跳，所以切换模式时要把积分清零，或做无扰切换。

    自己验证

    PID 实验默认（限幅、无抗饱和）超调约 34%，读数“积分器最大值 / 托住砝码所需”是 26.6 / 5.0 N·m；换成“限幅＋积分抗饱和”，超调降到约 4%。再展开“更多参数”，把力矩上限调到 6 N·m：只剩 1 N·m 用来加速，饱和段很长，不抗饱和时到 3 s 还在晃（状态栏显示“未稳定”），抗饱和后几乎没有超调。把 Ki 调小，d₀/Ki 这本账变宽，超调随之变小：Ki = 50 时约 13%，20 时约 2%。Ki = 20 时调节时间反而缩短，是因为饱和段攒下的积分（约 5.6 N·m）碰巧和托住砝码所需的 5 N·m 差不多；别因此以为 Ki 越小越好：积分作用变慢了，负载若在运动中途变化，要更久才能把误差消掉。

    Background. Part (1) uses the final-value theorem from a first controls course; parts (2) and (3) need only integrals.

    (1) Where the integrator has to be. For a stable unity-feedback loop with loop gain G(s)C(s), the final-value theorem gives, for a reference step r₀ and a constant load d₀ entering at the plant input:

    ess=r0+G(0)d01+G(0)C(0)→G(0)=∞d0C(0)

    The joint G = 1/(s(Js + b)) already contains an integrator, so G(0) = ∞ and pure P tracks a reference step with no steady error; the d₀/Kp in the main text comes entirely from the load. The load term reduces to d₀/C(0): the plant’s integrators sit downstream of where the load enters and can’t help. Only C(0) = ∞ — an integrator in the controller — removes it. The general rule: there must be an integrator between the error and the point where the disturbance enters.

    A drive in velocity mode lets a P-only position loop reach zero error thanks to the velocity loop’s own integrator, which holds the load inside that loop; with a P-only velocity loop the error is d₀/(KvKp). The idea generalizes (the internal model principle, Francis & Wonham 1976): a ramp disturbance needs two integrators, and a sinusoid at ω₀ — an eccentric load, the gait cycle — needs 1/(s² + ω₀²) in the controller. That is where resonant controllers and repetitive control come from; ILC in Section 06 is a close relative.

    (2) Why it winds up. The integrator keeps books. If it starts at zero, is never frozen, and the loop settles, it must end up supplying exactly d₀ (the P and D terms are back to zero), so:

    ∫0∞edt=d0Ki

    The balance doesn’t care about the path. While the actuator is saturated the joint climbs slowly and positive error area piles up; once the joint reaches the target, the surplus can only be repaid with error of the opposite sign: ∫t₁∞ e dt = (d₀ − I(t₁))/Ki, where t₁ is when the joint first reaches the target and I is the integral term’s output. With this page’s defaults the integral term holds about 26.6 N·m at t₁ ≈ 0.41 s, while the load needs only 5 N·m; the area to repay is about −0.22 rad·s — that is the 34% overshoot.

    (3) What anti-windup changes. Conditional integration stops accumulating while the actuator is saturated and the error has the same sign as the control, so those seconds never enter the books. Back-calculation makes the integrator track the gap between what was delivered and what was requested:

    I˙=Kie+sat(u)−uTt

    The smaller Tt, the faster the integral state is pulled back to a value consistent with the actual output. A common rule of thumb puts it between Td and Ti: too small and noise keeps triggering it, too large and it does nothing. On a wearable device, windup shows up as a torque jump the moment the limit releases, so reset the integrator or use bumpless transfer whenever the mode changes.

    Check it yourself

    The PID experiment’s default (limited, no anti-windup) overshoots by about 34%, and the “Integrator peak / needed to hold” readout shows 26.6 / 5.0 N·m; switching to “Limited + anti-windup” brings the overshoot down to about 4%. Now open “More parameters” and lower the torque limit to 6 N·m: only 1 N·m is left for accelerating, the saturated stretch is long, and without anti-windup the joint is still swinging at 3 s (the status reads “Not settled”), while with it there is essentially no overshoot. Lower Ki and the budget d₀/Ki loosens, so the overshoot shrinks — about 13% at Ki = 50 and about 2% at 20. At Ki = 20 the settling time even gets shorter, because the integral stored during saturation (about 5.6 N·m) happens to be close to the 5 N·m the weight needs. Don’t conclude that a smaller Ki is always better: integral action is now slower, and if the load changed mid-motion it would take longer to clear the error.

    先说清：什么叫“线性”First: what “linear” means

    状态反馈要用线性模型。线性的准确含义是满足叠加原理：输入的任意加权和，产生输出的同一加权和（下式）。PID 本身也是线性控制器（饱和、量化除外）。

    State feedback needs a linear model. Linear means precisely this: the system obeys superposition, so any weighted sum of inputs produces the same weighted sum of outputs (below). PID itself is a linear controller, saturation and quantization aside.

    u1↦y1,u2↦y2⇒au1+bu2↦ay1+by2

    线性不等于“输出与输入成正比”：带惯性、带纯延迟、多个变量相互耦合的系统都可以是线性的。“参数不随时间漂移”说的是时不变，是另一回事。

    Linear doesn’t mean “output proportional to input”. Systems with inertia, pure delay, or several coupled variables can all be linear. “Parameters that don’t drift” is a different property: time invariance.

    机器人关节本身并不线性：重力随 sin q 变化，还有摩擦和饱和。线性控制器照样能用，是因为可以在工作点附近线性化，或者高减速比加高增益把这些非线性压成了小扰动。对线性时不变系统，稳定的判据很干脆：连续时间要求全部闭环极点的实部严格为负。数字控制器每一步都把状态乘上一个“放大系数”（离散极点 z），只有 |z| < 1 才会越乘越小，这就是“极点落在单位圆内”。

    A robot joint isn’t linear: gravity varies with sin q, and there is friction and saturation. Linear controllers still work because the plant can be linearized around an operating point, or because a high gear ratio plus high gain shrinks the nonlinearities into small disturbances. For linear time-invariant systems the stability test is clean: in continuous time, every closed-loop pole must have a strictly negative real part. A digital controller multiplies the state by a “growth factor” (a discrete pole z) at every step, and only |z| < 1 makes it shrink step after step — that is what “every pole inside the unit circle” means.

    从 PID 到状态反馈From PID to state feedback

    到这里，控制律只用了误差。手里有线性模型时，还可以用它来挑增益；模型只在设计时出场，控制律本身仍然只是反馈（00 节“三问”里的第二问）。

    先花 30 秒把本节的关节写成状态空间形式。状态 x = (q, q̇)，就是 00 节说的那张“快照”。第一行：q 的变化率就是 q̇。第二行：由牛顿定律 J q̈ = τ − b q̇ 得到 q̈ = −(b/J) q̇ + τ/J。把力矩 τ 记作输入 u，两行合起来是：

    So far the control law has used only the error. With a linear model in hand, you can also use it to choose the gains. Note that the model appears only at design time; the law itself is still pure feedback (the second of the three questions in Section 00).

    First, thirty seconds to write this section’s joint in state-space form. The state is x = (q, q̇) — the “snapshot” from Section 00. Row one: the rate of change of q is q̇. Row two: Newton’s law J q̈ = τ − b q̇ gives q̈ = −(b/J) q̇ + τ/J. Call the torque τ the input u, and the two rows together read:

    x˙=Ax+BuA=[010−b/J],B=[01/J]

    A 描述“不去管它时，状态自己怎么变”，B 描述“输入往哪个方向推”。负载 d₀ 先不写进去，后面用 ū 处理。有了这个模型，就可以用 u=−Kx 直接反馈全部状态，这叫状态反馈。对这个关节，K = (k₁, k₂)，u = −k₁q − k₂q̇ 正是前面的 PD（目标取 0 时）：k₁ 是弹簧，k₂ 是阻尼器。所以在这里，状态反馈就是换一种方式挑 PD 的两个增益。状态空间方法也不只属于多变量系统：这里只有一个输入。

    极点决定自由响应有多快、晃不晃（加 D 那一步说过）。对这个关节，闭环的特征方程是 J s² + (b + k₂) s + k₁ = 0：k₁ 定 ωn，k₂ 定 ζ，想要哪两个极点，都能反解出对应的 k₁、k₂。这叫极点配置。推广到一般系统，条件是 (A, B) 具有可控性（从任意起点出发，输入都能在有限时间内把全部状态一起推到任意指定值。这里力矩先改变速度，速度再改变角度，角度和速度都能独立摆布。注意，光是“每个状态都推得到”还不够：两个一模一样的关节接在同一个电机上，就没法让它们停在不同位置），这时总能选出 K，把全部闭环极点放到想要的位置（复数极点要成对）。

    极点配置要求全部状态都测得到。测不到的可以推算：在控制器里并行跑一个关节模型，喂给它同样的指令，再用测到的位置不断纠正它，从模型里读出速度。做这件事的叫观测器。代价是：极点越靠左，增益越大，越容易饱和、放大噪声、激发没建模的谐振；极点位置本身也不告诉你离失稳还有多远。

    与其一个一个挑极点，不如写下一笔账，让数学去找增益。线性二次调节器（LQR）就是这样做的：

    A says how the state evolves when left alone; B says which way the input pushes it. The load d₀ stays out for now; ū will handle it later. With this model you can feed back the whole state, u=−Kx: state feedback. For this joint K = (k₁, k₂), and u = −k₁q − k₂q̇ is exactly the PD from above (with the target at 0): k₁ is the spring and k₂ the damper. So here, state feedback is simply another way of choosing the two PD gains — and state-space methods aren’t only for multivariable systems; this one has a single input.

    Poles set how fast the free response dies out and whether it oscillates (as in the derivative step above). For this joint the closed-loop characteristic equation is J s² + (b + k₂) s + k₁ = 0: k₁ sets ωn, k₂ sets ζ, and whatever pair of poles you want, you can solve back for the k₁ and k₂ that give it. That is pole placement. For a general system the condition is that (A, B) be controllable (from any starting point, the input can drive the whole state to any target in finite time; here torque moves velocity and velocity moves angle, and both can be set independently. Merely reaching every state is not enough: two identical joints on one motor can never be parked at different angles); then some K always puts every closed-loop pole wherever you like (complex poles in conjugate pairs).

    Pole placement needs every state measured. The ones you can’t measure can be estimated: run a model of the joint inside the controller alongside the real one, feed it the same commands, keep correcting it with the measured position, and read the velocity off the model. The thing that does this is called an observer. There are costs: the further left you push the poles, the larger the gains, and the sooner you hit saturation, amplify noise and excite resonances you never modeled. And pole locations alone don’t tell you how far you are from instability.

    Rather than picking poles one by one, write down a cost and let the math find the gain. That is what the linear–quadratic regulator (LQR) does:

    minu∫0∞(x⊤Qx+u⊤Ru)dtu=−Kx,K=R−1B⊤PA⊤P+PA−PBR−1B⊤P+Q=0

    xᵀQx 记“偏离目标有多严重”，uᵀRu 记“用了多大的力”。好比开车赶路：Q 大是急着到，R 大是不想猛踩油门。Q、R 是设计者手里的旋钮，不是物理常数；两者同乘一个数，增益不变。

    xᵀQx scores how far the state strays; uᵀRu scores how hard you push. Think of driving somewhere: a large Q means you’re in a hurry, a large R means you’d rather not floor the pedal. Q and R are knobs the designer chooses, not physical constants; scaling both by the same factor leaves the gain unchanged.

    P 由一个叫代数 Riccati 方程的矩阵方程（上面第三行）解出，数值软件一行就能解；它把“这笔账”折算成增益（06 节 MPC 的终端代价用的也是这个 P）。要记住，“最优”只相对于你写下的这笔账、线性化模型、没有约束、全部状态可测这几个前提。

    最简单的情形可以手算一次。对象 q̇ = u（驱动器工作在速度模式时，关节近似如此），代价 ∫(Qqq² + R u²)dt。这时 A = 0、B = 1，Riccati 方程只剩一行：

    P comes from a matrix equation called the algebraic Riccati equation (the third line above), which numerical software solves in one line; it converts the cost into a gain (Section 06’s MPC uses this same P as its terminal cost). Keep in mind that “optimal” means optimal for the cost you wrote down, the linearized model, no constraints, and every state measured.

    The simplest case can be worked by hand. Take the plant q̇ = u (roughly what a joint looks like when its drive runs in velocity mode) and the cost ∫(Qqq² + R u²)dt. Now A = 0 and B = 1, and the Riccati equation shrinks to one line:

    −P2R+Qq=0⇒P=QqRK=PR=QqR

    闭环是 q̇ = −Kq，K 就是它回去的快慢。R 缩小 10 倍，K 只放大 √10 ≈ 3.2 倍：“用力更便宜”并不等于“快 10 倍”。换成力矩驱动的关节，速度涨得还要更慢。

    The closed loop is q̇ = −Kq, so K is how fast it returns. Make R ten times smaller and K grows only by √10 ≈ 3.2: cheaper effort does not buy ten times the speed. For a torque-driven joint, speed grows even more slowly.

    深入一层Going deeper 把 R 缩小 10 倍，关节为什么不会快 10 倍？Why doesn’t a 10× smaller R make the joint 10× faster?

    前置知识 会解一元二次方程，就能跟上“推导”的前半段；讲“相对阶”的那几句可以跳过。

    思路 先忽略阻尼 b。关节 J q̈ = u、Q = diag(Qq, Qv) 时，Riccati 方程可以手解；解出增益，就能直接看出 R 怎样同时改变速度和力。

    推导

    K1=QqRK2=2JK1+QvRωn=(QqRJ2)1/4ζ=121+Qv2JQqR

    速度权重 Qv 很小时 ζ ≈ 0.71（二阶 Butterworth），带宽 ∝ R−1/4：R 小 10 倍只快 101/4 ≈ 1.8 倍；起步那一下的力矩约为 K₁ 乘阶跃，∝ R−1/2，大 √10 ≈ 3.2 倍。这不是 LQR 的毛病，是牛顿第二定律：用 1/ω 的时间走完 Δq，加速度就是 ω²Δq 的量级，力矩随速度的平方涨。不解 Riccati 也能估出这个指数，只要比两笔账：让关节快 ω 倍，用时约 1/ω，误差账 ∫Qqq²dt 约 ∝ Qq/ω；力矩约 ∝ Jω²，持续 1/ω，用力账 ∫Ru²dt 约 ∝ RJ²ω³。两者之和在 ω⁴ ∝ Qq/(RJ²) 处最小，正是上面的 ωn。一般地，只罚位置时，从输入到位置隔了几次积分（相对阶 n），R → 0 时极点就沿 Butterworth 方向、按 R−1/(2n) 往外走：速度模式的关节（q̇ = u）n = 1，所以是 R−1/2；力矩驱动的关节 n = 2，是 R−1/4。

    Qv 不小时还有第二个效应。R → 0 时两个极点分道扬镳：快极点约为 −√(Qv/R)/J，跑向无穷远；慢极点停在 −√(Qq/Qv)。速度权重在惩罚“快”，代价最低的走法就是以时间常数 √(Qv/Qq) 慢慢靠拢。本实验默认 Qq = 100、Qv = 1，慢极点钉在 −10 rad/s，调节时间的下限约 4/10 = 0.4 s，正是读数卡住的地方。

    工程上 Q、R 的起点可以用 Bryson 规则：Qii=1/xi,max2、Rjj=1/uj,max2，也就是“每个量允许的最大值”的倒数平方，再按响应微调。另外，uᵀRu 惩罚的是控制量的大小，一般不是电能；只有低速、铜损主导时，它才可当发热的代理。

    自己验证

    先在“更多参数”里把 Qv 调到 0.01，再让 R 取 0.1、0.01、0.001：极点模长约 7.95、14.1、25.1 rad/s，都在 45° 线附近；峰值力矩约 36、100、295 N·m，每档乘近 3。再把 Qv 调回 1 重复一遍：极点从一对复数（约 −6.5 ± 4.6j）变成几乎重合的两个实根（约 −14），再分成约 −10 和 −62，调节时间停在约 0.4 s。

    Background. If you can solve a quadratic, you can follow the first half of the derivation; the sentences about relative degree can be skipped.

    Idea. Neglect the damping b. For the joint J q̈ = u with Q = diag(Qq, Qv), the Riccati equation can be solved by hand, and the resulting gains show directly how R trades speed against torque.

    Derivation.

    K1=QqRK2=2JK1+QvRωn=(QqRJ2)1/4ζ=121+Qv2JQqR

    With a small velocity weight Qv, ζ ≈ 0.71 (a second-order Butterworth pattern) and bandwidth scales as R−1/4: a 10× smaller R buys only 101/4 ≈ 1.8× the speed, while the initial torque kick — about K₁ times the step — scales as R−1/2, about 3.2× larger. That isn’t a flaw of LQR; it is Newton’s second law. Covering Δq in a time of about 1/ω takes an acceleration of order ω²Δq, so torque grows with the square of speed. You can even get the exponent without solving the Riccati equation, just by comparing the two bills. Make the joint ω times faster, so the move takes about 1/ω: the error bill ∫Qqq²dt scales like Qq/ω, while the torque scales like Jω² for a time 1/ω, so the effort bill ∫Ru²dt scales like RJ²ω³. Their sum is smallest where ω⁴ ∝ Qq/(RJ²) — exactly the ωn above. More generally, when only position is penalized and the input reaches position through n integrations (the relative degree), the poles move out along a Butterworth pattern at a rate R−1/(2n) as R → 0: a joint in velocity mode (q̇ = u) has n = 1, hence R−1/2; a torque-driven joint has n = 2, hence R−1/4.

    A velocity weight that isn’t small adds a second effect. As R → 0 the two poles part ways: the fast one, about −√(Qv/R)/J, heads off to infinity, while the slow one stops at −√(Qq/Qv). The velocity weight penalizes speed, so the cheapest way to comply is a slow first-order approach with time constant √(Qv/Qq). With the defaults Qq = 100 and Qv = 1, the slow pole is pinned at −10 rad/s, putting a floor of about 4/10 = 0.4 s under the settling time — exactly where the readout gets stuck.

    In practice. A reasonable starting point for Q and R is Bryson’s rule, Qii=1/xi,max2 and Rjj=1/uj,max2 — the inverse square of the largest value you’ll tolerate — refined by looking at the response. Also, uᵀRu penalizes the size of the control, not electrical energy in general; only at low speed, when copper losses dominate, is it a fair proxy for heating.

    Check it yourself

    Under “More parameters”, set Qv to 0.01, then R to 0.1, 0.01 and 0.001: the pole magnitudes come out near 7.95, 14.1 and 25.1 rad/s, all close to the 45° line, and the peak torque goes from about 36 to 100 to 295 N·m, nearly 3× per step. Repeat with Qv = 1: the poles go from a complex pair (about −6.5 ± 4.6j) to two nearly coincident real poles (about −14), then split into about −10 and −62, and the settling time stalls near 0.4 s.

    LQR 是调节器：它把状态拉回线性化时的那个平衡点。直接用 u = −Kx 去“跟踪” 1 rad，它会把关节拉回 0。要跟踪非零目标，就在偏差坐标里用它，并补上维持目标所需的标称输入 ū：

    LQR is a regulator: it drives the state back to the equilibrium it was linearized about. Use u = −Kx as is to “track” 1 rad and it pulls the joint back to 0. To hold a nonzero target, apply it in deviation coordinates and add the nominal input ū that holds the target:

    u=u¯−K(x−x¯)

    ū 负责“站得住”（这里就是顶住负载的 d₀），反馈只管偏差。常值扰动未知时，也可以用 LQI（把误差的积分也当成一个状态，让 LQR 自带积分作用）。

    ū does the holding (here, it cancels the load d₀); the feedback only handles deviations. If the constant disturbance is unknown, use LQI instead (treat the integral of the error as one more state, so LQR comes with integral action built in).

    全状态 LQR 还白送一样东西：很宽的稳定裕度（真实系统和模型不一样时，还能差多少而不失稳）。最常见的“不一样”，是执行器实际给出的力矩和指令不成比例：电机常数估错了、电压掉了、气压变了，相当于回路里多乘了一个未知的倍数 g。连续时间、全部状态都直接测到时，全状态 LQR 保证：g 放大任意倍、缩小到一半，回路都稳；在执行器处再多落后 60° 的相位，也稳。

    这份保证有前提。改用观测器估计速度，它就不再成立。原因很直观：观测器是按“发出的指令”去推算速度的，执行器实际多给或少给了力，模型并不知道，要等位置测量慢慢把它纠正过来；这段迟钝就像在回路里加了一段延迟，吃掉相位。名义情况（g = 1）下完全看不出差别，所以“没有保证”不是说一定变差，而是说不能再打包票，要把观测器、延迟和滤波放进去，重新算一遍裕度。采样不够快也会削弱这份保证。完整的推导见下面的“深入一层”。下面的实验是 200 Hz 的离散 LQR。

    Full-state LQR also throws in something for free: wide stability margins (how different the real system can be from the model before the loop goes unstable). The most common difference is an actuator whose real torque isn’t the torque that was commanded — a misestimated motor constant, a sagging supply voltage, a change in air pressure — which amounts to an unknown factor g multiplying the loop. In continuous time, with every state measured directly, full-state LQR guarantees that the loop stays stable if g grows by any amount or drops to one half, and also if the actuator adds up to 60° of extra phase lag.

    That guarantee has conditions. Estimate the velocity with an observer and it no longer holds. The reason is intuitive: the observer works out the velocity from the commanded torque, so if the actuator delivers more or less than commanded, the model doesn’t know until the position measurement slowly corrects it — and that sluggishness acts like extra delay in the loop, eating phase. Nominally (g = 1) you can’t see any difference, so “no guarantee” doesn’t mean “worse”; it means nobody can promise anything, and you have to recompute the margins with the observer, delays and filters in place. Sampling too slowly also erodes the guarantee. The full derivation is in the “Going deeper” block below. The experiment below is a 200 Hz discrete-time LQR.

    深入一层Going deeper 为什么 LQR 一加观测器，裕度就“没有保证”了？Why does LQR lose its guaranteed margins once you add an observer?

    前置知识 Nyquist 判据和传递函数矩阵，超出一般本科课程。只想知道“为什么”，读“加观测器以后”那段里以“直觉上”开头的几句就够了。

    先看保证本身 连续时间、全部状态可测、R 为对角阵时，全状态 LQR 的每个输入通道都能承受增益放大任意倍或缩小到一半（增益裕度 [1/2, ∞)），相位裕度不少于 60°（Safonov & Athans 1977）。它来自一个不等式（Kalman 1964）：在对象输入端断开，回路增益 L = K(sI − A)⁻¹B 满足

    |1+L(jω)|≥1对所有ωGM≥MsMs−1PM≥2arcsin12Ms

    也就是说，Nyquist 曲线永远不进入以 −1 为圆心的单位圆，灵敏度峰值 Ms ≤ 1。后两行是对任何回路都成立的换算（缩小方向：增益降到原来的 Ms/(Ms + 1) 倍仍然稳定），代入 Ms = 1 正好得到 ∞、60° 和 1/2。这是连续时间的结论：采样加零阶保持以后，能放大的倍数变成有限的，采样越慢、增益越高，上限越低；采样相对带宽不够快时，直接在离散模型上设计（下面的实验就是 200 Hz 的离散 LQR）。

    加观测器以后 记 M = A − BK − LC，同一个断点上的回路增益变成

    Lobs=K(sI−M)−1L·C(sI−A)−1B

    它不再是 LQR 优化出来的那个回路，Kalman 不等式不再成立，裕度也就没有下限了。Doyle（1978）用一个例子说明它可以任意小；那篇只有两页的短文，摘要只有一句：“There are none.”（没有任何保证裕度。）直觉上，观测器是用发出的指令 u 驱动的，而不是执行器真正给出的 g·u。执行器增益变了，模型看不见，只能等它反映到位置测量上，再经过 L 慢慢修正；这段迟钝就是被吃掉的相位。名义情况（g = 1）下一切正常：分离原理只保证名义闭环极点是 eig(A − BK) ∪ eig(A − LC)，不保证鲁棒性。

    怎么补救 回路传递恢复（LTR，Doyle & Stein 1979）：对最小相位的对象，按特定方式把观测器加快（在对象输入端加虚拟过程噪声来设计卡尔曼滤波器），回路增益会逐渐逼近全状态版本，代价是噪声放大。工程上最可靠的做法，是连同观测器、延迟和滤波一起，在对象输入端重新算一遍裕度，不沿用 LQR 的保证。

    自己验证

    LQR 实验里，g = 1 时勾不勾“只测位置，用观测器估计速度”（在“更多参数”里），响应曲线完全重合：估计误差从零开始，一直是零。差别在读数“执行器增益最多可放大到”：全状态约 34 倍（1/Ms ≈ 0.97）；勾上观测器（默认“观测器快慢”×3，极点约为控制器的 3 倍快）约 5.3 倍（1/Ms ≈ 0.66）。把“观测器快慢”拉到 ×10，它回升到约 8.9 倍；拉到 ×1，只剩约 4.3 倍。实验里没有调观测器阻尼的旋钮；按同一模型另算：观测器极点保持 ×3 的快慢、换成欠阻尼的（ζ = 0.05），名义响应依旧不变，这个倍数却掉到约 1.2。

    Background. The Nyquist criterion and transfer-function matrices, beyond most undergraduate courses. If you only want the “why”, the sentences starting with “Intuitively” in the “With an observer” paragraph are enough.

    The guarantee itself. In continuous time, with every state measured and a diagonal R, full-state LQR tolerates, in each input channel, any gain increase or a cut to one half (gain margin [1/2, ∞)) with at least 60° of phase margin (Safonov & Athans 1977). It all rests on one inequality (Kalman 1964): break the loop at the plant input, and the loop gain L = K(sI − A)⁻¹B satisfies

    |1+L(jω)|≥1for allωGM≥MsMs−1PM≥2arcsin12Ms

    In words: the Nyquist curve never enters the unit disk centered at −1, so the sensitivity peak is Ms ≤ 1. The last two lines hold for any loop (downward, the gain can drop to Ms/(Ms + 1) of its value and the loop stays stable); at Ms = 1 it yields exactly ∞, 60° and 1/2. This is a continuous-time result. After sampling and a zero-order hold the upward gain margin becomes finite, and it shrinks as sampling slows or gains rise; when sampling isn’t fast relative to the bandwidth, design on the discrete model directly (the experiment below is a 200 Hz discrete LQR).

    With an observer, and writing M = A − BK − LC, the loop gain at the same break point becomes

    Lobs=K(sI−M)−1L·C(sI−A)−1B

    That is no longer the loop LQR optimized, Kalman’s inequality no longer applies, and the margins have no floor. Doyle (1978) showed by example that they can be arbitrarily small; the abstract of his two-page note reads, in full, “There are none.” Intuitively, the observer is driven by the commanded u, not by what the actuator actually delivers, g·u. A change in actuator gain is invisible to the model until it shows up in the measured position and gets corrected, slowly, through L — and that sluggishness is the phase you lose. Nominally (g = 1) nothing is wrong: the separation principle only guarantees the nominal closed-loop poles eig(A − BK) ∪ eig(A − LC); it says nothing about robustness.

    The remedy. Loop transfer recovery (LTR; Doyle & Stein 1979): for a minimum-phase plant, speeding up the observer in a particular way — designing a Kalman filter with fictitious process noise injected at the plant input — makes the loop gain approach the full-state one, at the cost of more noise. The most dependable engineering practice is simply to recompute the margins at the plant input with the observer, delays and filters in place, rather than inheriting the LQR guarantee.

    Check it yourself

    In the LQR experiment, with g = 1 the response is identical with and without “Measure position only; estimate velocity with an observer” (under “More parameters”): the estimation error starts at zero and stays there. The difference shows up in the “Actuator gain can grow up to” readout: about 34× with full state (1/Ms ≈ 0.97), about 5.3× with the observer at its default speed of ×3, i.e. poles about 3× faster than the controller’s (1/Ms ≈ 0.66). Drag “Observer speed” to ×10 and the figure recovers to about 8.9×; at ×1 only about 4.3× is left. The experiment has no knob for observer damping, but the same model, computed separately, shows that keeping the observer at ×3 while making its poles lightly damped (ζ = 0.05) leaves the nominal response untouched yet drops that figure to about 1.2×.

    外骨骼视角Exoskeleton lens上臂水平时，整条手臂的重力矩约 11 N·m（示意估算）。纯 PD 下它留下 d₀/Kp 的静差：Kp = 60 N·m/rad 时约 0.18 rad，约 10°。不过助力型外骨骼本来就不做位置伺服——运动由人决定，它更像一个力矩源或阻抗源。With the upper arm horizontal, the whole arm’s gravity torque is roughly 11 N·m (an illustrative estimate). Under pure PD that leaves an offset of d₀/Kp: about 0.18 rad, or 10°, at Kp = 60 N·m/rad. Then again, an assistive exoskeleton usually isn’t a position servo at all — the wearer decides the motion, and the device acts more like a torque or impedance source.

    反过来想Flip it around

    不要积分：恒定负载留下 d₀/Kp 的误差。只加大 Kp：很快碰到饱和、噪声和延迟引起的振荡——增益有上限。

    PID 为什么到处都是：电流环、速度环、压力环几乎都是它（外骨骼的压力环常是 PI 加阀的前馈）。它失效，从来不是因为“不够先进”，原因见最后一条。

    多关节就一定要换方法吗？耦合强不强，主要看减速比，不看自由度数。把关节 i 折算到电机侧：

    Drop the integral and a constant load leaves an error of d₀/Kp. Just raise Kp and you soon run into saturation, noise, and oscillation caused by delay — gain has a ceiling.

    Why PID is everywhere: current loops, velocity loops and pressure loops are almost all PID (an exoskeleton’s pressure loop is typically PI plus a valve feedforward). When it fails, it is never for being “not advanced enough” — the last point below says why it does.

    Do more joints force a different method? How strongly joints couple depends mainly on the gear ratio, not on how many joints there are. Referred to the motor side, joint i obeys

    (Jm+Mii(q)N2)q¨m+bq˙m=τm−diN

    Jm 是电机转子惯量，Mii(q) 是连杆惯量里随构型变化的部分，di 汇总了其他关节的耦合和重力。为什么是 1/N²：电机比关节转得快 N 倍，同样的动能 ½Mq̇² 折到电机侧是 ½(M/N²)q̇m²；而按功率相等，力矩折过去只除以 N。
