    所以减速比大时，随构型变化的惯量和耦合都被大大削弱，独立关节 PID 加前馈往往就够了。谐波减速器（靠柔性齿圈变形实现大减速比、几乎没有背隙，协作臂关节里常见）常见的减速比是 30–160，这是经验范围。直驱、QDD（准直驱，减速比约 6–10:1）或高速运动时，这些非线性才必须在反馈里处理。

    卡在哪里：积分顶得住恒定负载，是因为它有时间慢慢攒。可一动起来，重力随姿态变，惯性力随加速度变，关节之间还互相推，这些力比积分器攒得快，只能靠加大 Kp、Kd 硬顶；而增益早被饱和、噪声、延迟和传动部件的弹性封了顶，与人接触时还要加上稳定性的约束。LQR 也跑不出这个上限，它只是把同一个反馈的增益选得更系统。

    Here Jm is the rotor inertia, Mii(q) the configuration-dependent link inertia, and di collects coupling from the other joints and gravity. Why 1/N²: the motor turns N times faster than the joint, so the same kinetic energy ½Mq̇² becomes ½(M/N²)q̇m² on the motor side, while conservation of power divides a torque by only N.

    So with a large gear ratio, the configuration-dependent inertia and the coupling are both greatly weakened, and independent-joint PID plus feedforward is often enough. A harmonic drive (a gearbox that gets a high ratio with almost no backlash by flexing a thin toothed ring; common in collaborative-arm joints) typically runs 30:1 to 160:1, a range from experience. Only with direct drive, quasi-direct drive (QDD, a ratio of about 6–10:1) or high speeds do these nonlinearities have to be handled inside the feedback.

    Where it gets stuck: the integrator can hold a constant load because it has time to build up. Once the joint moves, gravity changes with posture, inertial torque changes with acceleration, and the joints push on each other, all faster than an integrator can accumulate. The only feedback answer left is more Kp and Kd, and saturation, noise, delay and the compliance of the drivetrain have already capped them — with stability in contact with a person on top. LQR can’t get past that limit either; it just picks the same feedback gains more systematically.

    深入一层Going deeper 为什么真实伺服的带宽上限，常常是传动共振而不是电机？Why is a real servo’s bandwidth usually capped by drivetrain resonance rather than by the motor?

    前置知识 传递函数的零点、极点和 Bode 图。只想要结论，读“由此有三件事”和“对策”两段。

    思路 前面一直把关节当成一块刚体。真实关节里，电机和负载之间隔着一段有弹性的传动：谐波减速器的柔轮、同步带、长轴、SEA 的弹簧。最简单的模型是两块惯量中间夹一根扭簧：电机侧惯量 Jm（已折算到关节侧，即 N² 乘转子惯量）、负载惯量 JL、传动刚度 k。

    推导 从电机力矩到电机角度（同位测量）和到负载角度（非同位测量）的传递函数分别是：

    Gm=JLs2+ks2[JmJLs2+k(Jm+JL)]GL=ks2[⋯]ωar=kJLωr=ωar1+JL/Jm

    由此有三件事。① 反谐振 ωar 是 Gm 的零点：电机侧的回路越硬，电机越像被钉住，负载就在 ωar 上自己晃，电机编码器却什么也看不见，电机侧的反馈也就压不住它。② 高于 ωr，电机只“感到” Jm，回路增益比按总惯量 Jm + JL 设计时高出 1 + JL/Jm 倍。再叠上采样、延迟和滤波的相位滞后，这段被抬高的高频增益就会穿过 0 dB，关节开始啸叫；Kd 越大，高频增益越大，越早出事。③ 改用负载侧测量闭环时，过了 ωr 相位再掉 180°，穿越频率必须留在 ωar 以下相当远。05 节的力控失稳是同一个机制（Eppinger & Seering 1987）。

    示意算例：k = 10⁴ N·m/rad、JL = 0.5 kg·m²、Jm = 0.1 kg·m²，得 ωar ≈ 141 rad/s（约 23 Hz）、ωr ≈ 346 rad/s（约 55 Hz），高频增益抬高 6 倍。所以这类关节的位置环带宽要取在 ωar 以下若干倍（经验值），远低于电流环的约 1 kHz。

    对策 带宽留在 ωar 以下若干倍；在 ωr 处加陷波滤波器削掉共振峰（它在陷波频率以下会带来相位滞后，而且 JL 随姿态和负载变，陷波要够宽或能自适应）；给 D 项加低通，uD=−Kds1+sTd/Nfy（Td = Kd/Kp，Nf 常取 2–20，经验值），把 D 项的高频增益封顶在 NfKp；加负载侧编码器做状态反馈；或者对指令做整形，不去激发 ωar（输入整形，Singer & Seering 1990）。同一个机制在 02 节限制计算力矩控制的外环增益（Spong 1987 的柔性关节模型），在 03 节是滑模抖振的来源之一：切换信号激发了没建模的高频动态。

    自己验证

    本页 PID 实验里的关节是刚体，没有传动柔性，所以看不到共振本身，只能看到它的前奏：展开“更多参数”，打开“编码器量化（14 位）”，把 Kd 从 8 调到 20，读数“最后 1 s 力矩波动”从约 0.26 升到约 1 N·m。高 Kd 把高频成分放大后送进执行器；在真实关节上，这些高频力矩正好去敲传动共振。顺带一提，实验的测速低通是 100 Hz，按上式相当于 Nf ≈ 84（Kd = 8、Kp = 60 时），比经验范围宽松得多，毛刺也就明显。

    Background. Zeros and poles of a transfer function, and Bode plots. For the conclusions alone, read the “Three things follow” and “Countermeasures” paragraphs.

    Idea. So far the joint has been a single rigid body. In a real joint an elastic transmission sits between motor and load — a harmonic drive’s flexspline, a belt, a long shaft, an SEA’s spring. The simplest model is two inertias joined by a torsional spring: motor-side inertia Jm (referred to the joint, i.e. N² times the rotor inertia), load inertia JL, and transmission stiffness k.

    Derivation. From motor torque to motor angle (collocated sensing) and to load angle (non-collocated sensing):

    Gm=JLs2+ks2[JmJLs2+k(Jm+JL)]GL=ks2[⋯]ωar=kJLωr=ωar1+JL/Jm

    Three things follow. (1) The anti-resonance ωar is a zero of Gm: the stiffer the motor-side loop, the more the motor behaves as if clamped, and the load then rings at ωar on its own while the motor encoder sees nothing — so motor-side feedback can’t damp it. (2) Above ωr the motor feels only Jm, so the loop gain is 1 + JL/Jm times higher than a design based on the total inertia Jm + JL assumed. Add the phase lag of sampling, delay and filtering, and that raised high-frequency gain pushes through 0 dB — the joint starts to sing. The larger Kd, the higher that gain and the sooner it happens. (3) Close the loop on the load side instead and the phase drops a further 180° past ωr, so the crossover has to stay well below ωar. Force-control instability in Section 05 is the same mechanism (Eppinger & Seering 1987).

    An illustrative case: k = 10⁴ N·m/rad, JL = 0.5 kg·m² and Jm = 0.1 kg·m² give ωar ≈ 141 rad/s (about 23 Hz) and ωr ≈ 346 rad/s (about 55 Hz), with the high-frequency gain raised 6×. So the position-loop bandwidth of such a joint has to sit several times below ωar (a rule of thumb) — far below the current loop’s roughly 1 kHz.

    Countermeasures. Keep the bandwidth several times below ωar. Put a notch filter at ωr to cut the peak (it adds phase lag below its center frequency, and JL changes with posture and payload, so the notch must be wide or adaptive). Low-pass the D term, uD=−Kds1+sTd/Nfy with Td = Kd/Kp and Nf typically 2–20 (a rule of thumb), which caps the D term’s high-frequency gain at NfKp. Add a load-side encoder and use state feedback. Or shape the command so it doesn’t excite ωar (input shaping, Singer & Seering 1990). The same mechanism caps the outer-loop gains of computed-torque control in Section 02 (Spong’s 1987 flexible-joint model), and it is one source of sliding-mode chattering in Section 03, where the switching excites unmodeled high-frequency dynamics.

    Check it yourself

    The joint in this page’s PID experiment is rigid — no transmission compliance — so you won’t see the resonance itself, only its prelude: open “More parameters”, turn on “Encoder quantization (14-bit)” and raise Kd from 8 to 20, and the “Torque ripple, last 1 s” readout grows from about 0.26 to about 1 N·m. A high Kd amplifies high-frequency content and hands it to the actuator; in a real joint, that is exactly what rings the drivetrain resonance. Incidentally, the experiment’s velocity low-pass sits at 100 Hz, which by the formula above corresponds to Nf ≈ 84 at Kd = 8 and Kp = 60 — far looser than the usual range, which is why the spikes are so visible.

    上面每一步都能在这个关节上验证。场景里，指针关节同轴的绕绳鼓吊着一个砝码（恒定负载 5 N·m），P、D 画成弹簧和阻尼器，右边一列力矩条显示 P、D、I 三项和它们的合计；执行器最多出 12 N·m。先只在“执行器”一栏切换“限幅，无抗饱和”和“限幅＋积分抗饱和”。先猜：默认参数下超调为什么这么大？Every step above can be checked on this joint. In the scene, a drum on the joint’s shaft carries a hanging weight (a constant 5 N·m load), P and D are drawn as a spring and a damper, and gauges on the right show the P, D and I torques and their total; the actuator tops out at 12 N·m. At first, change only the Actuator setting, between “Limited, no anti-windup” and “Limited + anti-windup”. Predict: why is the default overshoot so large?

    你应该看到：默认（限幅、无抗饱和）超调约 34%，“I 积分”那格一直涨到 26.6 N·m，远超托住砝码所需的 5 N·m；换成“限幅＋积分抗饱和”，超调降到约 4%，调节时间从 1.8 s 缩到 0.9 s。Ki 调到 0，稳态误差正好是 5/60 ≈ 0.083 rad。展开“更多参数”，打开“编码器量化（14 位）”，把 Kd 从 8 调到 20，读数“最后 1 s 力矩波动”从约 0.26 升到约 1 N·m。这里的负载是恒定的，积分有时间慢慢攒；负载随姿态和运动变化时，就只能靠增益去扛——下一节的两连杆实验里，同样带宽的“仅 PD”比加了重力补偿的误差大一倍多。What you should see: by default (limited, no anti-windup) the overshoot is about 34%, and the “I integral” gauge climbs to 26.6 N·m, far beyond the 5 N·m needed to hold the weight. With anti-windup the overshoot drops to about 4%, and settling time falls from 1.8 s to 0.9 s. With Ki = 0 the steady-state error is exactly 5/60 ≈ 0.083 rad. Open “More parameters”, turn on “Encoder quantization (14-bit)” and raise Kd from 8 to 20: the “Torque ripple, last 1 s” readout rises from about 0.26 to about 1 N·m. The load here is constant, so the integrator has time to build up; when the load changes with posture and motion, only gain is left to fight it. In the two-link experiment of the next section, “PD only” at the same bandwidth has more than twice the error of PD with gravity compensation.

    同一个关节，现在假设我们知道它的线性模型，让 LQR 来挑增益：Q 说“多在乎误差”，R 说“多在乎用力”，场景右边的两只“代价水箱”（跟踪、用力）会把这两笔账边动边累计出来；水箱是对数刻度，下面直接标着这一次的账是上一次的几倍。先只动 R。先猜：把 R 缩小 10 倍，响应会快 10 倍吗？看图时记住三点：极点图里，点越往左，关节回得越快，越过“稳定边界”就发散；取舍曲线上每个点对应一个 R，想往下走（误差的账小），就得往右走（用力的账大）；读数里最直观的是“执行器增益最多可放大到”，也就是执行器实际力矩比指令大几倍时回路还稳，越大越安全。旁边的“离失稳多远 1/Ms”从另一个角度量同一类问题：回路离“信号绕一圈回来，大小不变、方向正好反了”这个会自己振起来的状态还有多远，最大是 1，低于 0.5 就要警惕。Same joint, but now we know its linear model and let LQR pick the gains: Q says how much you care about error, R how much you care about effort, and the two “cost tanks” on the right of the scene (tracking and effort) tally both bills as the motion unfolds; the tanks use a log scale, so each one is labeled with how many times the previous run’s bill this one is. Move only R at first. Predict: cut R by 10× — does the response get 10× faster? Three reading tips. In the pole plot, the further left a point sits, the faster the joint returns, and a point past the “stability boundary” means divergence. On the trade-off curve each point is one value of R: to move down (a smaller tracking bill) you have to move right (a larger effort bill). Among the readouts, the most intuitive is “Actuator gain can grow up to”: how many times more torque than commanded the actuator could deliver with the loop still stable — bigger is safer. The neighboring “Distance to instability, 1/Ms” looks at the same question from another angle: how far the loop is from the state where a signal comes back around the loop at the same size but exactly reversed, which makes it oscillate on its own. It is 1 at best; below 0.5 you should worry.

    你应该看到：R 从 0.1 降到 0.01，调节时间只从 0.48 s 缩到 0.41 s，峰值力矩却从约 36 涨到约 98 N·m。快不起来有两个原因。一是“越快越贵”，根子在牛顿第二定律：想用一半的时间转过同样的角度，加速度要大 4 倍，力矩也要大 4 倍。用力的账涨得比误差的账快得多，LQR 算完账只肯提速一点：R 小 10 倍，最多快不到 2 倍，起步那一下的力矩却大约 3 倍（推导见前面“R 缩小 10 倍”那个“深入一层”）。二是这组默认参数特有的：速度权重 Qv = 1 在罚“转得快”，R 再便宜，LQR 也宁可慢慢靠过去；R 继续减小时，最慢的那个极点停在 −10 rad/s 附近（时间常数 0.1 s），调节时间卡在约 0.4 s。展开“更多参数”把 Qv 调到 0.01 再比一次，就能单独看到第一条。What you should see: cutting R from 0.1 to 0.01 only shortens the settling time from 0.48 s to 0.41 s, while peak torque rises from about 36 to about 98 N·m. Two things hold it back. One is the general price of speed, and it comes straight from Newton’s second law: turning through the same angle in half the time takes four times the acceleration, and so four times the torque. The effort bill grows much faster than the error bill, so after doing the accounting LQR speeds up only a little: ten times cheaper control buys less than 2× the speed, while the initial torque kick grows about 3× (the derivation is in the earlier “Going deeper” block on a 10× smaller R). The other is specific to these defaults: the velocity weight Qv = 1 penalizes moving fast, so however cheap effort gets, LQR prefers to ease in; as R keeps shrinking, the slowest pole settles near −10 rad/s (a 0.1 s time constant) and the settling time gets stuck around 0.4 s. Open “More parameters”, set Qv to 0.01 and compare again to see the first effect on its own.

    换成 u = −Kx，关节被拉回 0 附近（负载还把它压到 0 以下），根本不去 1 rad；选“偏差坐标，无前馈”，则留下约 d₀/K₁ ≈ 0.16 rad 的静差。再看读数“执行器增益最多可放大到”：全状态版本约 34 倍（不是无穷大，因为实验是 200 Hz 的离散实现，采样让这个上限变成了有限值）；在“更多参数”里勾上观测器，只剩约 5 倍，把“执行器增益偏差”拉过这个值就发散。注意勾上观测器前后，响应曲线完全一样，变差的只是“执行器出了偏差时还稳不稳”。5 倍也不是底线：观测器设计得差一些（极点欠阻尼），名义响应照样一点不变，这个倍数却可以掉到 1.2 倍左右（按本页模型另算）。这就是“没有保证”的意思：看响应看不出来，只能算。Switch to u = −Kx and the joint is pulled back toward 0 (the load pushes it slightly below) and never heads for 1 rad; with deviation coordinates but no feedforward, an offset of about d₀/K₁ ≈ 0.16 rad remains. Now watch the “Actuator gain can grow up to” readout: about 34× for the full-state version (not infinite, because the experiment is a 200 Hz discrete implementation and sampling makes the limit finite); enable the observer under “More parameters” and only about 5× is left — push the “Actuator gain error” slider past that and the loop diverges. Notice that the response curve is identical with and without the observer; what got worse is only whether the loop survives an actuator that doesn’t match the model. And 5× isn’t a floor: design the observer a little worse (lightly damped poles) and the nominal response still doesn’t change at all, yet this figure can fall to about 1.2× (computed separately with this page’s model). That is what “no guarantee” means: you can’t see it in the response; you can only compute it.

    一句话Takeaway

    反馈不用模型就能把误差拉回来，积分还能消掉恒定负载；但随运动变化的已知力只能靠更大的增益去扛，而增益被饱和、噪声和延迟封了顶。

    Feedback pulls the error back without a model, and integral action even removes a constant load, but known forces that change with the motion can only be fought with more gain, and saturation, noise and delay cap the gain.

    下一个问题：LQR 只用模型来挑增益。重力、惯量、耦合随运动变化，却都写得出公式，为什么不直接用模型把这些力矩算出来，而要等它们变成误差？Next question: LQR uses the model only to pick gains. Gravity, inertia and coupling change with the motion, yet we can write them all down. Why not compute those torques directly instead of waiting for them to show up as error?

    延伸阅读Further reading

    1. Åström, K. J., & Hägglund, T. (2001). The future of PID control. Control Engineering Practice, 9(11), 1163–1175. doi:10.1016/S0967-0661(01)00062-4

      为什么值得读：从这里开始。两位作者写过 PID 的标准教材；这篇综述梳理 PID 控制的现状（指标、稳定性、设计、应用和性能），最后讨论 PID 的替代方案和今后的方向。

      Why read it: start here — a survey by the authors of the standard PID texts that reviews the state of the art (specifications, stability, design, applications, performance) and closes with the alternatives to PID and where it is heading.

    2. Åström, K. J., & Rundqwist, L. (1989). Integrator windup and how to avoid it. Proceedings of the 1989 American Control Conference, 1693–1698. doi:10.23919/ACC.1989.4790464

      为什么值得读：抗饱和的经典。先梳理各种临时办法，再给出一个能统一它们的通用做法，并配有算例。

      Why read it: the classic on anti-windup — it surveys the ad hoc fixes, then gives a general procedure that unifies them, with worked examples.

    3. Åström, K. J., & Hägglund, T. (1984). Automatic tuning of simple regulators with specifications on phase and amplitude margins. Automatica, 20(5), 645–651. doi:10.1016/0005-1098(84)90014-1

      为什么值得读：继电反馈自整定的原始论文。用继电器诱发一个小幅极限环，读出临界点，再按相位或幅值裕度整定，不必把回路推到失稳边缘。

      Why read it: the original relay-feedback auto-tuning paper — a relay induces a small limit cycle that reveals the critical point, and the controller is tuned to phase or amplitude margin specifications without pushing the loop to the edge of instability.

    4. Skogestad, S. (2003). Simple analytic rules for model reduction and PID controller tuning. Journal of Process Control, 13(4), 291–309. doi:10.1016/S0959-1524(02)00062-8

      为什么值得读：SIMC 规则的原始论文。先用“半规则”把高阶模型化简成“一阶或二阶加延迟”，再用几行公式算出 PI 或 PID 参数，快慢只由一个参数（闭环时间常数 τc）调。

      Why read it: the source of the SIMC rules — use the “half rule” to reduce a higher-order model to first or second order plus delay, then compute PI or PID settings from a few formulas, with a single parameter (the closed-loop time constant τc) setting the speed.

    5. Safonov, M. G., & Athans, M. (1977). Gain and phase margin for multiloop LQG regulators. IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control, 22(2), 173–179. doi:10.1109/TAC.1977.1101470

      为什么值得读：证明多回路 LQ 状态反馈对大幅度的线性摄动和无记忆非线性摄动都鲁棒，并用经典的增益、相位裕度来解释；LQR 裕度 [1/2, ∞) 与 60° 的出处。

      Why read it: shows that multiloop LQ state feedback is robust to large linear and memoryless nonlinear perturbations and states the result as classical gain and phase margins — the source of LQR’s [1/2, ∞) and 60°.

    6. Doyle, J. C. (1978). Guaranteed margins for LQG regulators. IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control, 23(4), 756–757. doi:10.1109/TAC.1978.1101812 · Doyle, J. C., & Stein, G. (1979). Robustness with observers. IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control, 24(4), 607–611. doi:10.1109/TAC.1979.1102095

      为什么值得读：前者是两页的反例，说明 LQG 没有保证裕度；后者给出回路传递恢复（LTR），让基于观测器的系统渐近取回全状态反馈的回路特性。

      Why read it: the first is a two-page counterexample showing LQG has no guaranteed margins; the second introduces loop transfer recovery, which asymptotically gives an observer-based design back the loop properties of full-state feedback.

    02模型补偿：把算得出的力先算出来Model compensation: compute what you already know

    用已知的物理Use the physics you know

    问题The question

    机械臂抬起前臂要顶住多大的重力矩、加速时要多大的力，事先都算得出来。与其等它们造成误差再去纠正，为什么不提前把需要的力矩算出来？

    How much gravity torque an arm must hold as it lifts its forearm, how much force it takes to accelerate — you can work these out beforehand. Instead of waiting for them to cause errors, why not compute the torque they need in advance?

    本节要点（5 分钟版）This section in brief

    • 机械臂的动力学只有四类项：惯性、离心与科氏、重力、摩擦，事先都算得出来。与其等它们造成误差再纠正，不如先把这部分力矩算好送出去。
    • 模型抵掉非线性之后，剩下的是没有弹簧、也没有阻尼的纯惯性；弹簧和阻尼要靠外环 PD 装回去，也就是开头游乐场里那根虚拟弹簧＋阻尼器。
    • 模型放在反馈里（计算力矩控制，按实测状态算）还是前馈里（按期望轨迹算），PD 增益的定法不同。模型不准时，性能是逐渐变差，不会一失配就失效。
    • 腿足和人形的躯干和地面之间没有电机，只能靠脚底的力去推，所以要用全身控制在约束下分配力；外骨骼只拿模型做补偿（自重、摩擦、按比例托住手臂）。
    • A rigid arm’s dynamics have only four kinds of terms — inertia, centrifugal and Coriolis effects, gravity, friction — and all of them can be computed in advance. Rather than wait for them to cause errors, compute that torque and send it out first.
    • Once the model cancels the nonlinearity, what remains is pure inertia, with no spring and no damper; an outer PD has to put them back — the virtual spring and damper from the opening playground.
    • Whether the model sits in the feedback path (computed-torque control, evaluated at measured states) or in the feedforward (evaluated along the desired trajectory) changes how the PD gains are set. With an imperfect model, performance degrades gradually rather than failing outright.
    • Nothing motorized connects a legged robot’s torso to the ground; it can be pushed only through the feet, so whole-body control allocates forces under constraints. An exoskeleton uses its model only to compensate — its own weight, friction, a share of the arm’s weight.

    第一次读可以跳过：两种结构的对比表、各处“深入一层”、实验说明里的一长串数字。

    Safe to skip on a first read: the comparison table, the “Going deeper” boxes, and the long strings of numbers in the experiment notes.

    本节符号：从本节起按机器人学惯例写 e=q−qd（实际减期望），和 01 节 PID 的 e=r−q 符号相反，所以控制律里是 −Kpe；N 是减速比。

    Notation: from here on we use the robotics convention e=q−qd (actual minus desired), the opposite sign of Section 01’s e=r−q; that is why the control laws carry −Kpe. N is the gear ratio.

    先把方程写全First, write the whole equation

    可以算，而且要算的东西并不多：刚体机械臂的动力学模型（从力矩到运动的方程）只有四类项。

    You can, and there is less to compute than you might fear: the dynamics model (the equations from torque to motion) of a rigid arm has only four kinds of terms.

    M(q)q¨+C(q,q˙)q˙+G(q)+τf(q˙)=τ+τext

    左边依次是惯性、离心与科氏、重力、摩擦；右边是电机给的力矩，以及外界（包括人）施加的力矩。

    On the left: inertia, centrifugal and Coriolis effects, gravity, friction. On the right: the motor torque and whatever the world — a person included — applies.

    要分清“项”和“参数”：项是方程里这四块，参数是质量、质心、惯性张量、摩擦系数、转子惯量这些数。方程对惯性参数是线性的：可以写成已知信号组成的矩阵 Y(q,q˙,q¨) 乘上参数列 θ。拿最简单的单摆举例：Jq¨+mglsinq=τ 就是 [q¨sinq] 乘上 [Jmgl]T：左边那一行全是测得到或算得出的信号，未知的只是右边那列数。第 04 节靠这一点在线估参数。带减速器的关节上，摩擦常是最大的模型误差来源之一。

    关节之间的“耦合”就藏在这些项里。M(q) 的非对角元让一个关节的加速度推动另一个关节。Cq˙ 里有两种力：离心力，是肩关节转快了，前臂会被甩出去，大小与 q˙j2 成正比；科氏力，是两个关节同时转，彼此会被横向推一把，大小与 q˙jq˙k 成正比，就像在转盘上沿直线走会被推偏。G(q) 则让肘关节的重力矩取决于肩关节的角度。

    耦合对单个关节影响多大，主要看减速比 N。转子惯量 Jm 在关节侧被放大成反射惯量 N2Jm（电机转子惯量经减速器放大 N² 倍后，在关节侧感觉到的惯量），加在 M(q) 的对角线上。这和 01 节说的“随构型变化的惯量折到电机侧被削弱为 1/N²”是同一件事，只是从关节这一侧看。N 大时它是个近乎不变的大常数，冲淡了构型相关的部分和耦合；直驱或 QDD（N 约 6–10）时，完整模型才显出价值。

    Keep terms and parameters apart: the terms are the four pieces of the equation, the parameters are the numbers inside them — masses, centers of mass, inertia tensors, friction coefficients, rotor inertia. The dynamics are linear in the inertial parameters: they can be written as a matrix of known signals, Y(q,q˙,q¨), times a column of parameters θ. Take the simplest case, a pendulum: Jq¨+mglsinq=τ is just [q¨sinq] times [Jmgl]T. Everything in the row is a signal you can measure or compute; the only unknowns are the numbers in the column. Section 04 uses exactly this to estimate parameters online. In geared joints, friction is often among the largest sources of model error.

    The coupling between joints lives in these terms. Off-diagonal entries of M(q) let one joint’s acceleration push on another. Cq˙ holds two kinds of force. Centrifugal: spin the shoulder fast and the forearm gets flung outward, in proportion to q˙j2. Coriolis: turn two joints at once and each gets shoved sideways, in proportion to q˙jq˙k — the same push that deflects you when you walk in a straight line across a turntable. And G(q) makes the elbow’s gravity torque depend on the shoulder angle.

    How much the coupling matters to a single joint depends mainly on the gear ratio N. The rotor inertia Jm shows up at the joint as the reflected inertia N2Jm (the rotor inertia as felt at the joint, amplified by N²), which adds to the diagonal of M(q). This is Section 01’s “configuration-dependent inertia shrinks by 1/N² at the motor”, seen from the joint side. With a large N it is a big, nearly constant term that swamps the configuration-dependent part and the coupling; with direct drive or a QDD (N around 6–10), the full model starts to pay off.

    抵消之后，剩下的是什么What is left after the cancellation

    先说结论：模型抵掉的是非线性，剩下的是一个没有弹簧、也没有阻尼的纯惯性系统；弹簧和阻尼要靠外环 PD 另外加上去。

    Short answer: the model cancels the nonlinearity and leaves pure inertia behind — no spring, no damper. The spring and the damper have to be added by an outer PD loop.

    1. 理想模型 · 用实测状态把模型力矩算出来Ideal model: compute the model torques from measured states

      τ=M^(q)v+C^(q,q˙)q˙+G^(q)

      q、q˙ 是实测值，带尖帽的是模型算出的估计，v 是新的“输入”。模型精确（M^=M，C^=C，G^=G）时代入方程，非线性项全部抵掉。这就是反馈线性化（用测得的状态把非线性项算出来抵掉，让剩下的系统看起来是线性的）。

      Here q and q˙ are measured, the hatted terms are the model’s estimates, and v is a new input. With an exact model (M^=M, C^=C, G^=G) every nonlinear term cancels. This is feedback linearization (cancel the nonlinear terms using measured states so what remains looks linear).

    2. 剩下的是双积分器What remains: double integrators

      q¨=v

      得到 n 个互不相干的双积分器（力直接变成加速度，再积两次才是位置——没有弹簧也没有阻尼）。就像开头游乐场里把弹簧和阻尼都拆掉的小车：推一下，它就一直滑下去。s=0 处的二重极点让它不稳定：一点初速度误差，就会让位置误差随时间线性增长，不会自己回来。

      You get n independent double integrators (force becomes acceleration, integrated twice to position — no spring, no damper). Think of the playground cart at the top of the page with both spring and damper removed: give it a push and it just keeps sliding. The double pole at s=0 makes this unstable: any initial velocity error makes the position error grow linearly in time, and nothing brings it back.

    3. 再加外环 PDAdd the outer PD

      v=q¨d−Kde˙−Kpee=q−qd⟹e¨+Kde˙+Kpe=0

      弹簧和阻尼在这一步才出现：Kp 相当于单位质量上的弹簧，Kd 相当于阻尼器，正是游乐场里那根虚拟弹簧和阻尼器。取 Kp=ωn2、Kd=2ζωn，误差就按设计好的二阶系统收敛。增益是加速度量纲，每个关节可以共用同一组 (ωn,ζ)。

      The spring and the damper appear only here: Kp acts as a spring per unit mass and Kd as a damper — the playground’s virtual spring and damper. Choose Kp=ωn2 and Kd=2ζωn and the error follows a second-order response of your choosing. The gains carry units of acceleration, so every joint can share one pair (ωn,ζ).

    4. ＋ 模型误差+ Model error

      Mq¨+h=M^v+h^⟹q¨=v+ηη=(M−1M^−I)v+M−1(h^−h)⟹e¨+Kde˙+Kpe=η

      记 h=Cq˙+G（先不管摩擦），把第 ① 步的 τ=M^v+h^ 代回方程，两边左乘 M−1，就得到第二行：q¨ 等于 v 加上一个残差 η。再把第 ③ 步的 v 代进去，误差方程右边就多出这个 η。η 的第一项里，M−1M^−I 衡量惯量算错了几成：算准时为 0，多算一成（M^=1.1M）时就是 0.1I；第二项是其余各力算错的部分，除以惯量折算成了加速度。所以模型不准时，线性部分还在，只是多了一个扰动；误差不大时，跟踪精度逐渐变差，不是一失配就失效。

      若 M^=κM，外环的 Kp、Kd 都被乘上 κ，等效带宽和阻尼比都按 κ 变化。高估惯量（κ>1）等于加大增益、带宽升高，最怕延迟和传动柔性；低估惯量（κ<1）带宽和阻尼比一起下降，跟踪变差、超调可能变大，但对延迟和柔性更宽容。

      Write h=Cq˙+G (ignore friction for now), substitute step 1’s τ=M^v+h^ into the dynamics and multiply through by M−1: q¨ equals v plus a residual η. Put step 3’s v back in and that η lands on the right-hand side of the error equation. In the first term of η, the factor M−1M^−I measures how far off the inertia is: zero for an exact model, 0.1I if it is 10% too high (M^=1.1M); the second term is whatever the other forces get wrong, divided by the inertia to make it an acceleration. So with an imperfect model the linear part survives and a disturbance simply appears; for moderate errors, tracking degrades gradually rather than failing outright.

      If M^=κM, both outer-loop gains are multiplied by κ, so the effective bandwidth and damping ratio both scale with κ. Overestimating the inertia (κ>1) raises the gain and the bandwidth and is the first to suffer from delay and transmission compliance; underestimating it (κ<1) lowers bandwidth and damping together — worse tracking, possibly more overshoot — but tolerates delay and compliance better.

    5. ＋ 执行器不是理想力矩源+ The actuator is not an ideal torque source

      τout=sat(NεKti)−τf(q˙)

      控制律算出的只是“想要的力矩”。真正到达关节的，要经过电流环、力矩常数 Kt、减速比 N 和传动效率 ε（正向驱动和被外力反向驱动时，ε 并不相同），再减去摩擦。高减速比又没有力矩传感器时，这一步的误差可能和要补偿的科氏项同量级；一旦饱和，q¨=v 就不再成立。

      The control law only produces a torque request. What reaches the joint passes through the current loop, the torque constant Kt, the gear ratio N and the transmission efficiency ε (which differs between driving and being back-driven), minus friction. On a high-ratio joint without a torque sensor, this step alone can rival the Coriolis terms you meant to cancel; once the actuator saturates, q¨=v no longer holds.

    把第 ①–③ 步合起来，就是计算力矩控制（CTC，按实测状态算出模型力矩，先抵消非线性再加外环 PD；多数教材里与“逆动力学控制”同义）：

    Steps 1–3 together give computed-torque control (CTC: use the measured state to compute the model torques, cancel the nonlinearity, then close an outer PD loop; most textbooks treat it as a synonym for inverse-dynamics control):

    τ=M^(q)(q¨d−Kde˙−Kpe)+C^(q,q˙)q˙+G^(q)

    注意外环 PD 的输出要先乘上 M^(q) 才变成力矩，它不是叠加在模型力矩外面的一条独立通道。

    Note that the PD output is multiplied by M^(q) before it becomes a torque; it is not a separate channel added on top of the model torque.

    深入一层Going deeper 为什么 PD 加重力补偿就能让机械臂在任意目标点停稳，而且根本不需要知道 M(q)？Why does PD plus gravity compensation park an arm at any setpoint — without knowing M(q) at all?

    前置知识 矩阵转置、正定矩阵、对时间求导。LaSalle 原理不熟也没关系：“思路”一段和“自己验证”就能带你看到结论。

    Background. Transposes, positive-definite matrices and time derivatives. LaSalle’s principle need not be familiar: “The idea” and “Check it yourself” carry the conclusion.

    思路　不去抵消惯性，改看能量。把 PD 当成装在每个关节上的一根弹簧和一个阻尼器：弹簧势能加手臂动能是一个只减不增的量，重力是唯一会往里“灌”能量的力。所以只补重力就够了。

    The idea. Don’t cancel the inertia; look at energy instead. Treat the PD as a spring and a damper at every joint. Spring energy plus the arm’s kinetic energy can only go down, and gravity is the one force pumping energy in. So compensate gravity and nothing else.

    τ=G(q)−Kpe−Kdq˙V=12q˙TM(q)q˙+12eTKpeV˙=−q˙TKdq˙+12q˙T(M˙−2C)q˙=−q˙TKdq˙≤0

    推导　e = q − qd，qd 是常数。把控制律代进 M q̈ + C q̇ + G = τ 再对 V 求导：G 正好抵掉，Kp 项和势能的导数抵掉，只剩阻尼项和 ½q̇ᵀ(Ṁ − 2C)q̇。后者恒为零，它说的是“离心力和科氏力不做功”，对任何满足运动方程的 C 都成立。V̇ ≤ 0 只说明能量不增。要证明手臂真的停在目标上，还要 LaSalle 不变集原理：V̇ = 0 意味着 q̇ ≡ 0，于是 q̈ ≡ 0，代回运动方程只剩 Kp e = 0，所以 e = 0（Takegaki & Arimoto 1981）。整个证明里 M(q) 只以“正定”的身份出现，从没被算出来。

    前提与工程后果

    • 只对定点成立。目标在动时还缺 M(q)q̈d 这类惯性力矩：要么加前馈，要么用 PD+（Paden & Panja 1988 把这个控制器推广到了跟踪，稳定性改用 Matrosov 定理证明），要么用 04 节的结构。
    • 重力算错多少，手臂就停在 Kp e = Ĝ(q) − G(q) 那里，静差约为“重力误差 ÷ Kp”。积分项能消掉它，代价是 01 节讲过的积分饱和。只用目标点的重力 G(qd)（一个常数）去补也行，但 Kp 至少要大于重力矩对角度的最大斜率，否则平衡点可能不止一个。
    • 有库仑摩擦时，手臂会停在 |Kp e| ≤ 静摩擦 的一条带里。这不是失稳，是弹簧推不动了。

    04 节会用同一种能量函数，把“边干边估参数”也装进来；那里目标在动，要换一个工具（Barbalat 引理）。

    Derivation. Here e = q − qd with qd constant. Substitute the law into M q̈ + C q̇ + G = τ and differentiate V. Gravity cancels, the Kp term cancels the derivative of the spring energy, and what remains is the damping term plus ½q̇ᵀ(Ṁ − 2C)q̇. That last term is identically zero: it just says centrifugal and Coriolis forces do no work, which holds for any C consistent with the equations of motion. V̇ ≤ 0 on its own only shows that energy never grows. To show the arm actually stops at the target, use LaSalle’s invariance principle: V̇ = 0 forces q̇ ≡ 0, hence q̈ ≡ 0, and the equations of motion leave only Kp e = 0, so e = 0 (Takegaki & Arimoto 1981). Nowhere is M(q) computed; it enters the proof only as “positive definite”.

    Assumptions and consequences

    • Setpoints only. A moving target also needs inertial torques such as M(q)q̈d: add feedforward, use PD+ (Paden & Panja 1988 extended this controller to tracking, proving stability with a theorem of Matrosov), or use the structure of Section 04.
    • A gravity error parks the arm where Kp e = Ĝ(q) − G(q), so the offset is roughly the gravity error divided by Kp. An integrator removes it, at the price of the windup covered in Section 01. Compensating with the constant G(qd) also works, provided Kp exceeds the steepest slope of gravity torque versus angle; otherwise there can be more than one equilibrium.
    • With Coulomb friction the arm stops anywhere inside the band |Kp e| ≤ static friction. That is not instability; the spring simply can’t push hard enough.

    Section 04 reuses the same kind of energy function to fold parameter estimation in. There the target moves, and a different tool (Barbalat’s lemma) replaces LaSalle.

    自己验证Check it yourself

    • 开头的小车游乐场就是这个证明的一维版：在 PD 模式下，左上角的能量条只降不升；勾上“挂上重物”，小车停在 0.05 m 处（重物拉力 2 N ÷ Kp = 40 N/m），这就是“外力没补偿就留静差”；切到 PID，积分器替你把这 2 N 慢慢学出来，静差逐渐消失（读数“挂重物时停在哪”从 0.050 m 降到约 0.003 m，还在往回拉）。
    • 在本节实验里选“PD＋重力补偿”：默认 ωn = 15 rad/s 时，关节 1 的误差仍有约 3°。原因是实验追的是正弦轨迹而不是定点，缺的正是惯性力矩；切到“计算力矩前馈”，误差就降到 0.01° 量级。
    • The cart playground at the top of the page is the one-dimensional version of this proof. In PD mode the energy bar at the top left only ever goes down. Tick “Hang a weight” and the cart settles at 0.05 m (the 2 N pull divided by Kp = 40 N/m): an uncompensated force leaves an offset. Switch to PID and the integrator gradually learns those 2 N for you, so the offset fades — the “Where it settles with the weight” readout drops from 0.050 m to about 0.003 m and is still closing.
    • In this section’s experiment, pick “PD + gravity compensation”. At the default ωn = 15 rad/s joint 1 still misses by about 3°, because the experiment tracks a sine rather than a setpoint and the missing piece is the inertial torque. Switch to computed-torque feedforward and the error drops to the 0.01° level.

    文中引用Cited here: Paden, B., & Panja, R. (1988). Globally asymptotically stable “PD+” controller for robot manipulators. International Journal of Control, 47(6), 1697–1712. doi:10.1080/00207178808906130

    模型放在哪：反馈，还是前馈Where the model goes: feedback or feedforward

    计算力矩控制虽然“用模型算力矩”，却是反馈：它的模型项按实测的 q、q˙ 计算，是一种非线性状态反馈。真正属于“前馈 + 反馈”的是另一种结构，计算力矩前馈（只按期望轨迹算模型力矩，可以提前算好）：

    Computed-torque control uses a model, but it is feedback: its model terms are evaluated at the measured q and q˙, which makes it a nonlinear state feedback. The genuine feedforward-plus-feedback structure is a different one, computed-torque feedforward (model torques computed from the desired trajectory only, so they can be precomputed):

    τ=M^(qd)q¨d+C^(qd,q˙d)q˙d+G^(qd)−Kpe−Kde˙

    两者的 PD 增益要换一种定法。在计算力矩控制里，外环 PD 的输出要乘上 M^(q)，每个关节自动按自己的惯量放大；前馈方案里的 PD 直接出力矩，没有谁替你乘惯量。惯量大的关节就得给大增益，惯量小的给小增益，否则各关节快慢不一。

    前馈项不碰测量，不会形成新的反馈回路（线性情形下它完全不影响闭环稳定性，见第 00 节）。但它只在期望轨迹上精确抵消非线性，实际状态偏离时，差额要靠 PD 去扛，所以 PD 增益通常要足够大。

    The two structures need their PD gains set differently. In computed-torque control the PD output is multiplied by M^(q), so each joint is scaled by its own inertia automatically. In the feedforward scheme the PD outputs torque directly and nothing multiplies by inertia for you: a heavy joint needs large gains and a light one small gains, or the joints end up responding at different speeds.

    The feedforward never touches a measurement, so it creates no new feedback loop (in the linear case it has no effect on closed-loop stability at all — Section 00). But it cancels the nonlinearity exactly only on the desired trajectory; once the actual state drifts off it, the PD has to absorb the difference, which is why its gains usually need to be reasonably high.

    对比Compare计算力矩控制Computed-torque control计算力矩前馈Computed-torque feedforward
    模型项按什么算Model terms evaluated at实测 q、q˙measured q, q˙期望 qd、q˙d、q¨ddesired qd, q˙d, q¨d
    PD 增益怎么定How the PD gains are set加速度量纲，各关节共用一组 (ωn,ζ)Acceleration units; one (ωn,ζ) for all joints力矩量纲，按各关节惯量分别定Torque units; tuned to each joint’s inertia
    能否离线预计算Precomputable offline?否，每个周期在线算No — computed online every cycle能（轨迹已知时）Yes, when the trajectory is known
    速度噪声从哪进来Where velocity noise enters多一条通路：q˙ 除了进 D 项，还进 C^(q,q˙)q˙（高速、直驱或强耦合时才显著）One more path: q˙ enters C^(q,q˙)q˙ as well as the D term (it matters at high speed, on direct-drive or strongly coupled arms)只经 D 项Only through the D term
    深入一层Going deeper 第三种放法：不把非线性“算掉”，只把能量“整形”——它为什么对模型误差更宽容？A third place for the model: shape the energy instead of cancelling the nonlinearity — why is that more forgiving of model error?

    前置知识 上一个“深入一层”的能量论证、反对称矩阵。不熟的话，读“思路”和“结论”里列的三点区别就够了。

    Background. The energy argument of the previous “going deeper” and skew-symmetric matrices. Otherwise, read “The idea” and the three differences listed under “What you get”.

    思路　计算力矩控制把 M̂(q) 乘在反馈外面，想把机械臂变成双积分器。另一种写法保留机械臂自己的 M、C 结构，只要求它“朝着参考轨迹耗能”：

    The idea. Computed-torque control wraps M̂(q) around the feedback and tries to turn the arm into double integrators. The alternative keeps the arm’s own M and C structure and only asks it to dissipate energy relative to the reference:

    q˙r=q˙d−Λe,s=e˙+Λeτ=M^q¨r+C^q˙r+G^−KDsM^=M,C^=C,G^=G⟹Ms˙+Cs+KDs=0

    结论　取 V = ½sᵀMs，利用 Ṁ − 2C 反对称，得 V̇ = −sᵀKD s。闭环是一个“带着真实惯量的阻尼器”，不是抵消之后的双积分器。和计算力矩控制相比有三点不同：

    1. 主反馈增益 KD、KDΛ 直接是力矩量纲，不被 M̂ 乘。惯量估错 κ 倍时，只有经 q̈r、q̇r 带进来的那一小部分反馈（−M̂Λė，多关节时还有 −ĈΛe）跟着缩放，主反馈不变；其余的模型误差变成一个力矩残差，期望轨迹和误差有界时它也有界。计算力矩控制则是整个外环增益一起乘上 κ。
    2. 不需要 M̂⁻¹，也不需要测加速度：q̈r 由期望轨迹和测得的速度算出。
    3. 外力矩到 s 的映射是无源的（储能函数就是 ½sᵀMs），所以它能和 04 节的自适应、05 节的交互控制用同一套能量论证拼起来。

    代价是误差动态随构型变化，不再是每个关节都一样的二阶系统。Paden & Panja（1988）的 PD+ 属于同一族：惯量矩阵放在位置、速度反馈回路之外，内层 PD 可以跑得比动力学补偿更快。把 M̂、Ĉ、Ĝ 换成在线估计的参数，就是 04 节的 Slotine–Li 自适应控制（Slotine & Li 1987）。

    一个细节：这里要求 Ṁ − 2C 对任意向量 s 都是反对称的，C 必须按 Christoffel 符号构造；上一个“深入一层”只用到 q̇ᵀ(Ṁ − 2C)q̇ = 0，任何合法的 C 都行。

    What you get. With V = ½sᵀMs and the skew symmetry of Ṁ − 2C, V̇ = −sᵀKD s. The closed loop is a damper that still carries the real inertia, not a double integrator left over after cancellation. Three differences from computed-torque control:

    1. The main feedback gains KD and KDΛ are torque gains; M̂ does not multiply them. With the inertia off by a factor κ, only the small pieces of feedback that enter through q̈r and q̇r (−M̂Λė, plus −ĈΛe with several joints) scale with it, and the main feedback is untouched; the rest of the model error becomes a torque residual, bounded whenever the desired trajectory and the error are. In computed-torque control the whole outer-loop gain is multiplied by κ.
    2. No M̂⁻¹ and no measured acceleration: q̈r comes from the desired trajectory and the measured velocity.
    3. The map from external torque to s is passive (the storage function is ½sᵀMs), so the same energy argument extends to adaptation in Section 04 and to interaction control in Section 05.

    The price is error dynamics that vary with configuration instead of one identical second-order system per joint. Paden and Panja’s PD+ (1988) belongs to the same family: the inertia matrix sits outside the position and velocity loops, so the inner PD can run faster than the dynamic compensation. Replace M̂, Ĉ and Ĝ with online estimates and you have the Slotine–Li adaptive controller of Section 04 (Slotine & Li 1987).

    One detail: here Ṁ − 2C must be skew-symmetric as a matrix, acting on an arbitrary vector s, so C has to be built from Christoffel symbols. The previous “going deeper” only needed q̇ᵀ(Ṁ − 2C)q̇ = 0, which any valid C satisfies.

    自己验证Check it yourself

    • 04 节实验里的灰线，就是这个控制律的单关节版，参数固定、没算负载。拿起负载后，模型的惯量少算三成多、重力少算一半，误差变大（最后 3 s 约 0.025 rad），但一直有界、不会失稳：模型误差只变成了一个有界的力矩残差。
    • The gray line in Section 04’s experiment is the single-joint version of this law, with fixed parameters that ignore the payload. After pickup the model is short by over a third of the inertia and half the gravity torque; the error grows (about 0.025 rad RMS over the last 3 s) but stays bounded. The model error has become a bounded torque residual, nothing worse.

    文中引用Cited here: Paden, B., & Panja, R. (1988). Globally asymptotically stable “PD+” controller for robot manipulators. International Journal of Control, 47(6), 1697–1712. doi:10.1080/00207178808906130; Slotine, J.-J. E., & Li, W. (1987). On the adaptive control of robot manipulators. The International Journal of Robotics Research, 6(3), 49–59. doi:10.1177/027836498700600303

    它在哪里成立Where it holds

    不是任何系统都能这样把非线性“算掉”：执行器比自由度少的系统（比如小车上的倒立摆），就只能算掉一部分。具体条件见下面的深入一层。

    Not every system lets you “compute away” its nonlinearity like this: with fewer actuators than degrees of freedom (a pole balanced on a cart, say), only part of it can be cancelled. The exact conditions are in the “going deeper” below.

    深入一层Going deeper 反馈线性化什么时候做得到？“相对阶”和“零动态”到底在说什么？When can feedback linearization be done at all — and what are “relative degree” and “zero dynamics” really about?

    前置知识 状态方程、对输出反复求导。不熟的话，小车倒立摆和 7 自由度臂这两个例子照样能看懂。

    Background. State equations and repeated differentiation of the output. Without them, the two examples — the cart-pole and the 7-DOF arm — still make sense.

    相对阶　输出 y 要对时间求几次导数，输入 u 才第一次出现，这个次数 r 就是相对阶。若第 r 次导数写成下式且 b(x) ≠ 0，就可以用 u 把 a(x) 算掉，让 v 到 y 变成 r 个串联的积分器：

    Relative degree. Differentiate the output y until the input u first appears; the number of differentiations, r, is the relative degree. If the r-th derivative has the form below with b(x) ≠ 0, u can cancel a(x) and leave r integrators in series from v to y:

    y(r)=a(x)+b(x)uu=v−a(x)b(x)⟹y(r)=v

    刚性机械臂以关节角为输出、力矩为输入，r = 2，b(x) 就是 M(q)⁻¹，处处可逆。这就是计算力矩控制。

    零动态　系统有 n 个状态，输出这条积分器链只用掉 r 个，剩下 n − r 个状态的运动从 y 上看不见。把 y 钳在 0 时它们怎么动，就叫零动态。零动态不稳定时，输出跟得再好，内部也在跑掉。两个直观的例子：小车倒立摆只盯摆角，摆角稳住了，小车却带着初速度一直跑下去（零动态是双积分器）；7 自由度的臂只控末端 6 维位姿，肘部的“自运动”就是零动态，要在零空间里另加阻尼。

    全状态线性化　r = n 时没有零动态，整个系统都被换成线性的。能否找到这样的输出，有一组可以逐项检验的条件：一个可控性的秩条件，加一个对合条件，大意是“能不能靠换坐标把全部非线性挤进输入所在的那一个通道”。柔性关节（Spong 1987）值得手算一遍：

    For a rigid arm with joint angles as outputs and torques as inputs, r = 2 and b(x) is M(q)⁻¹, invertible everywhere. That is computed-torque control.

    Zero dynamics. The system has n states; the chain of integrators behind the output uses only r of them, and the remaining n − r states move invisibly as far as y is concerned. How they move when y is clamped at zero is the zero dynamics. If the zero dynamics are unstable, the output can track perfectly while the inside runs away. Two concrete cases: control only the pole angle of a cart-pole and, once the pole is balanced, the cart keeps rolling with whatever speed it had (its zero dynamics are a double integrator); control only the 6-D end-effector pose of a 7-DOF arm and the elbow’s self-motion is the zero dynamics, which needs its own damping in the null space.

    Full-state linearization. When r = n there are no zero dynamics and the whole system becomes linear. Whether such an output exists is settled by checkable conditions: a controllability rank condition plus an involutivity condition — roughly, whether a change of coordinates can squeeze all of the nonlinearity into the one channel where the input enters. The elastic joint (Spong 1987) is worth working through by hand:

    Jlq¨l+mglsinql=k(qm−ql)Jmq¨m=τ−k(qm−ql)y=ql⟹y(4)=a(x)+kJlJmτ

    以连杆角为输出，要求导四次才见到 τ：r = 4 = n，所以这个模型可以全局反馈线性化（Spong 1987 证明了这一点）。但控制律里要用连杆的加速度和加加速度。它们可以由四个状态经模型算出，却对刚度 k 的误差和测量噪声非常敏感，所以工程上更常见的是“力矩内环＋按刚性臂设计的外环”这种分层做法；同一篇文章里的奇异摄动、积分流形方法，就是它的理论版本。

    欠驱动　执行器少于自由度时，只能线性化一部分：线性化有驱动的那部分，或者在“惯性耦合足够强”时线性化没驱动的那部分，剩下的都成了零动态，系统的整体表现就取决于它（Spong 1994，Acrobot 这类两连杆欠驱动机器人是典型例子）。腿足机器人的浮动基座有 6 个没有电机的自由度，只能通过脚底接触力间接去推，而接触力又受摩擦锥和“只能推不能拉”约束——这就是正文里全身控制要在线解 QP 的原因。

    With the link angle as output, τ first shows up in the fourth derivative: r = 4 = n, so this model is globally feedback linearizable, as Spong (1987) showed. The control law, however, needs link acceleration and jerk. Both can be computed from the four states through the model, but they are very sensitive to errors in the stiffness k and to measurement noise. Practice therefore favors a hierarchy — an inner torque loop, then an outer loop designed as if the arm were rigid — and the singular-perturbation and integral-manifold approach in the same paper is the theory behind it.

    Underactuation. With fewer actuators than degrees of freedom only part of the system can be linearized: the actuated part, or, under “strong inertial coupling”, the unactuated part. Whatever is left becomes zero dynamics, and it decides how the whole system behaves (Spong 1994; two-link underactuated robots such as the Acrobot are the standard examples). A legged robot’s floating base has six degrees of freedom with no motor at all. They can be pushed only indirectly through foot contact forces, which are themselves limited by friction cones and by the fact that a foot can push but not pull — hence the online QP in whole-body control.

    自己验证Check it yourself

    • 本节实验里选计算力矩控制，勾选“关闭外环 PD”：两连杆臂被精确地变成了双积分器（r = 2，没有零动态），误差带着初速度一路线性漂走——这就是 v = 0 时 ÿ = 0 的样子。
    • 拿纸笔：对上面的柔性关节写出 ÿ、y⁽³⁾，确认 τ 第一次出现在 y⁽⁴⁾ 里，系数是 k/(Jl Jm)。
    • In this section’s experiment, pick computed-torque control and turn off the outer PD. The two-link arm has been turned exactly into double integrators (r = 2, no zero dynamics), and the error drifts off linearly with its initial velocity — what ÿ = 0 looks like when v = 0.
    • With pen and paper: write out ÿ and y⁽³⁾ for the elastic joint above and confirm that τ first appears in y⁽⁴⁾, with coefficient k/(Jl Jm).

    文中引用Cited here: Spong, M. W. (1994). Partial feedback linearization of underactuated mechanical systems. Proc. IEEE/RSJ IROS ’94, vol. 1, 314–321. doi:10.1109/IROS.1994.407375

    全驱动的刚性机械臂恰好是最友好的情形：M(q) 处处正定（往任何方向推它，都有正的惯量），每个关节从力矩到位置恰好积分两次，条件在全局成立。计算力矩控制就是这个特例。人形和四足就没这么友好：躯干和地面之间没有任何电机，只能靠脚踩地的反作用力去推躯干，而脚只能推不能拉，推得太斜还会打滑。所以不能像机械臂那样“想要什么加速度，就算出什么力矩”，而要把各关节力矩和每只脚的着地力一起定下来：在脚不打滑、力不超限这些约束下，让躯干、重心、摆动腿的动作尽量接近各自的目标。这叫全身控制（WBC），通常写成每个控制周期（毫秒级）都要解一次的二次规划（QP：在一组线性等式和不等式约束下，找出让一个二次代价最小的解，比如让各项任务误差的平方和最小；这类问题有成熟的快速解法）。它和计算力矩控制是什么关系，见下面的深入一层。

    工厂里也少见完整的计算力矩控制：高减速比工业臂多用关节级串级 PID 加模型前馈（常按期望轨迹算）；完整的计算力矩控制更多见于直驱臂、力矩控制型协作臂和研究平台。

    A fully actuated rigid arm is the friendliest case: M(q) is positive definite (positive inertia in every direction) everywhere and each joint sits exactly two integrations from its torque, so the conditions hold globally. Computed-torque control is this special case. Humanoids and quadrupeds are less friendly: no motor connects the torso to the ground, so the only way to push the torso is through the reaction forces at the feet — and a foot can push but not pull, and slips if it pushes too far sideways. You can no longer pick whatever acceleration you like and compute the torque for it. Instead, the joint torques and every foot’s contact force are chosen together: subject to feet that must not slip and forces that must stay within limits, bring the motion of the torso, the center of mass and the swinging legs as close as possible to their targets. That is whole-body control (WBC), usually posed as a quadratic program (QP: minimize a quadratic cost — the sum of squared task errors, say — subject to linear equalities and inequalities; fast, mature solvers exist) solved afresh every control cycle, on the order of a millisecond. How it relates to computed-torque control is in the “going deeper” below.

    Nor is full computed-torque control what most factories run. High-ratio industrial arms typically use cascaded PID at each joint plus model-based feedforward, often evaluated along the desired trajectory; full computed-torque control is more common on direct-drive arms, torque-controlled collaborative arms and research platforms.

    深入一层Going deeper 全身控制每毫秒到底在解什么？它和计算力矩控制是什么关系？What does whole-body control actually solve every millisecond — and how does it relate to computed-torque control?

    前置知识 雅可比矩阵（把关节速度换算成任务速度）、上面计算力矩控制的推导。不熟的话，读“思路”和“和计算力矩控制的关系”两段就够了。

    Background. Jacobians (which map joint velocities to task velocities) and the computed-torque derivation above. Otherwise, “The idea” and “Relation to computed-torque control” are enough.

    思路　计算力矩控制对固定在地上的机械臂管用，是因为每个自由度都有电机：想要什么加速度 v，τ = M v + h 一步就算出来。腿足机器人多了躯干在空中的 6 个自由度（3 个平移、3 个转动），它们没有电机，只能靠接触力间接去推。把运动方程按“躯干那 6 行”和“关节那 n 行”拆开来看：

    The idea. Computed-torque control works on an arm bolted to the ground because every degree of freedom has a motor: pick the acceleration v you want and τ = M v + h delivers it in one step. A legged robot adds the torso’s six degrees of freedom in space (three translations, three rotations). None of them has a motor; they can be pushed only indirectly, through contact forces. Split the equations of motion into the six torso rows and the n joint rows:

    M(q)q¨+h(q,q˙)=STτ+JcTfcST=[0I]⟹Mbq¨+hb=Jc,bTfc

    推导　h 是离心、科氏和重力项；S 把 n 个关节力矩放进“关节那 n 行”；Jc 是接触点的雅可比，fc 是脚底受的力。第三行是躯干那 6 行（下标 b），里面根本没有 τ：躯干怎么加速，只能由脚底的力决定。所以全身控制的决策变量是 (q̈, τ, fc) 三样一起，约束有四类：

    • 运动方程（上面第一行）；
    • 支撑脚不动：Jc q̈ + J̇c q̇ = 0；
    • 摩擦锥与单边性：法向力 ≥ 0（只能推不能拉），切向力 ≤ μ × 法向力（通常用多棱锥近似，写成线性不等式）；
    • 力矩上限、关节限位。

    代价是各项任务误差的加权平方和。每项任务 i（重心、躯干姿态、摆动脚……）都像计算力矩控制的外环一样，先用 PD 算出想要的任务加速度 ẍi*，再要求 Ji q̈ + J̇i q̇ 尽量等于它：

    Derivation. Here h holds the centrifugal, Coriolis and gravity terms; S places the n joint torques in the joint rows; Jc is the contact Jacobian and fc the force on the feet. The third line is the six torso rows (subscript b), and τ does not appear in it at all: how the torso accelerates is decided by the foot forces alone. So whole-body control decides (q̈, τ, fc) together, under four kinds of constraint:

    • the equations of motion (the first line above);
    • stance feet that stay put: Jc q̈ + J̇c q̇ = 0;
    • friction cones and unilaterality: normal force ≥ 0 (push, never pull) and tangential force ≤ μ × normal force (usually approximated by a pyramid, which makes it linear);
    • torque and joint limits.

    The cost is a weighted sum of squared task errors. Each task i (center of mass, torso orientation, swing foot…) works like the outer loop of computed-torque control: a PD sets the desired task acceleration ẍi*, and Ji q̈ + J̇i q̇ should come as close to it as possible:

    min∑iwi‖Jiq¨+J˙iq˙−x¨i*‖2x¨i*=x¨i,d−Kde˙i−Kpei

    约束是线性的，代价是二次的，这就是正文说的 QP。任务之间还有轻重：平衡和接触必须满足，姿态只能在剩下的自由度里尽量满足。一种做法是加权（重要的权重大）；另一种是严格分层：高优先级任务的最优解不许被低优先级破坏，按优先级逐层解 QP，或者把低优先级任务投影到高优先级任务的零空间里。Khatib（1987）的操作空间方法奠定了“在任务空间里写动力学、在任务空间里设计控制”的做法；Sentis & Khatib（2005）把它推广到整机，分成“约束 > 任务 > 姿态”几层优先级；Escande、Mansard & Wieber（2014）给出能在任意一层同时处理等式和不等式的分层 QP 解法，快到能在整机规模的问题上按控制频率运行。

    和计算力矩控制的关系　把“固定基座、没有接触、唯一的任务是关节加速度 = v”代进去：躯干那 6 行和 Jc 都不存在了，QP 的最优解就是 τ = M v + h，正是计算力矩控制。所以全身控制可以看成计算力矩控制的推广：接触力进了决策变量；欠驱动的 6 个自由度靠接触力去推；做不到的任务按权重或优先级取舍，而不是假装都能精确实现。它也继承了计算力矩控制的前提：要模型，要能按指令出力矩的关节（所以这类基于逆动力学的全身控制多用在力矩控制的腿足和人形机器人上），模型误差同样会留成残差。06 节和 09 节会看到它在整个控制栈里的位置：上层 MPC 算出脚该踩多大的力，这里的 QP 再把它们分成关节力矩。

    Linear constraints and a quadratic cost: that is the QP of the main text. Tasks also differ in importance: balance and contact must hold, while posture is pursued only with whatever freedom is left. One approach is weighting (important tasks get large weights). The other is a strict hierarchy, in which no lower-priority task may degrade the optimum of a higher-priority one — solve one QP per priority level, or project lower-priority tasks into the null space of higher-priority ones. Khatib’s operational space formulation (1987) established the practice of writing the dynamics, and designing the control, in task space; Sentis and Khatib (2005) extended it to the whole body, with priority levels for constraints, tasks and posture; Escande, Mansard and Wieber (2014) gave a hierarchical QP solver that handles equalities and inequalities at any level and runs at control rates on whole-body-sized problems.

    Relation to computed-torque control. Plug in a fixed base, no contacts and a single task, “joint acceleration = v”. The six torso rows and Jc disappear, and the optimum of the QP is τ = M v + h — computed-torque control exactly. Whole-body control is therefore computed-torque control generalized: contact forces become decision variables, the six unactuated degrees of freedom are pushed through those contact forces, and tasks that cannot all be met are traded off by weight or priority instead of pretending every one is achieved exactly. It inherits computed-torque control’s premises, too: it needs a model and joints that deliver commanded torque (which is why this inverse-dynamics style of whole-body control mostly runs on torque-controlled legged robots and humanoids), and model error still stays behind as a residual. Sections 06 and 09 show where it sits in the stack: an MPC above it decides how hard each foot should push, and this QP turns those forces into joint torques.

    自己验证Check it yourself

    • 拿纸笔：把整台机器人看成质量 m，写出质心的水平和竖直方程 m ẍ = Σfx、m(z̈ + g) = Σfz，再加上每只脚的 |fx| ≤ μ fz。你会得到 |ẍ| ≤ μ(g + z̈)：μ = 0.6、不做竖直加速时，质心的水平加速度最多约 5.9 m/s²。关节电机再强也突破不了这条线——这正是躯干那 6 行在说的事。
    • 把上面的 QP 退化成“固定基座、没有接触、一个任务 q̈ = v”，确认它的解就是本节第 ① 步的 τ = M̂v + Ĉq̇ + Ĝ。
    • With pen and paper: treat the whole robot as a mass m and write the center-of-mass equations m ẍ = Σfx and m(z̈ + g) = Σfz, plus |fx| ≤ μ fz at each foot. You get |ẍ| ≤ μ(g + z̈): with μ = 0.6 and no vertical acceleration, the center of mass can accelerate sideways by at most about 5.9 m/s². No joint motor, however strong, gets past that line — which is exactly what the six torso rows say.
    • Reduce the QP above to a fixed base, no contacts and one task q̈ = v, and confirm that its solution is τ = M̂v + Ĉq̇ + Ĝ from step 1 of this section.

    文中引用Cited here: Khatib, O. (1987). A unified approach for motion and force control of robot manipulators: The operational space formulation. IEEE Journal on Robotics and Automation, 3(1), 43–53. doi:10.1109/JRA.1987.1087068; Sentis, L., & Khatib, O. (2005). Synthesis of whole-body behaviors through hierarchical control of behavioral primitives. International Journal of Humanoid Robotics, 2(4), 505–518. doi:10.1142/S0219843605000594; Escande, A., Mansard, N., & Wieber, P.-B. (2014). Hierarchical quadratic programming: Fast online humanoid-robot motion generation. The International Journal of Robotics Research, 33(7), 1006–1028. doi:10.1177/0278364914521306

    外骨骼视角Exoskeleton lens外骨骼一般不做轨迹跟踪（运动由人决定），模型用来“补偿”：抵消设备自重和摩擦，按比例 α 托住手臂，再叠加助力（见下式）。只做重力和摩擦补偿时，穿戴者感觉到的只剩设备的惯性（起步时要推一把、停下时要拉一把），外加没补净的那一点摩擦：推它就动，停手后它留在哪里就是哪里，不会像弹簧那样把手臂拉回某个位置。气动执行器带宽低，只适合补偿静态、低频的项（按角度的重力支撑曲线），不要用它去抵消惯性项。An exoskeleton usually doesn’t track a trajectory — the wearer decides the motion — so the model is used for compensation: cancel the device’s own weight and friction, carry a fraction α of the arm’s weight, then add assistance (below). With gravity and friction compensation alone, what the wearer still feels is the device’s inertia — a push to get it moving, a pull to stop it — plus whatever friction was not fully compensated: push and it moves; stop, and it stays wherever you left it — nothing pulls the arm back to a set position the way a spring would. Pneumatic actuators are slow, so give them the static, low-frequency terms (a gravity-support curve over joint angle) and don’t ask them to cancel inertia.

    τcmd=G^exo(q)+αG^arm(q)+τ^f(q˙)+τassist0≤α≤1

    反过来想Flip it around

    不做模型补偿：回到上一节，重力和惯量全靠反馈增益去扛。只做模型补偿、不要外环：剩下的是双积分器，没有回复力，初始误差会一直漂——下面实验里的“关闭外环 PD”就是这个情形。

    边界在哪：它依赖模型、依赖理想力矩源、依赖全驱动。抵消是代数抵消，模型错多少，残差就留多少；高估惯量等于加大增益；执行器一饱和，线性等价就不成立。

    卡在哪里：模型永远有误差，而抵消之后留在闭环里的恰恰是这份误差。如果我们只知道它“最多有多大”，该怎么设计？

    Skip the model and you are back in Section 01, carrying gravity and inertia on feedback gain alone. Keep the model but drop the outer loop and you are left with double integrators: no restoring force, so any initial error keeps drifting — the “turn off the outer PD” switch in the experiment below.

    Limits: it needs a model, an ideal torque source and full actuation. The cancellation is algebraic, so whatever the model gets wrong stays behind; overestimated inertia acts like extra gain; and a saturated actuator breaks the linear equivalence.

    Where it gets stuck: the model is never exact, and what remains in the loop after cancellation is precisely that error. If all we know is how large it can get, how should we design?

    场景里是一条在竖直面里摆动的两连杆臂：虚线画的“影子臂”是期望轨迹，实体臂是实际位置，四种控制器的外环带宽相同。先只把控制器从“仅 PD”切到“PD＋重力补偿”，看手臂被重力拖着往下坠的那一截怎么消失（误差图是对数轴，每格差十倍）。先猜：模型算错一半（κ = 0.5），计算力矩控制会失稳吗？The scene shows a two-link arm swinging in a vertical plane: the dashed “shadow arm” is the desired trajectory, the solid arm is where the arm really is, and all four controllers share the same outer-loop bandwidth. Switch only the controller from “PD only” to “PD + gravity compensation” and watch the sag caused by gravity disappear (the error axis is logarithmic: each gridline is ten times the last). Predict: with the model off by half (κ = 0.5), does computed-torque control go unstable?

    你应该看到：关节 1 的 RMS 误差从约 7°（仅 PD）降到约 3°（加重力补偿），再到 0.01° 以下（两种计算力矩方案），实体臂和影子臂几乎重合。选计算力矩控制、勾选“关闭外环 PD”：没有回复力，误差一路漂走。打开“更多参数”，把模型比例 κ 拉到 0.5：计算力矩控制不会失稳，但关节 1 的误差回到约 7°，和“仅 PD”差不多。少算一半的模型，等于同时少补了一半的力、又把外环增益砍了一半。κ = 1.5 时约 3°。What you should see: joint 1’s RMS error falls from about 7° (PD only) to about 3° (with gravity compensation), and both computed-torque schemes bring it below 0.01° — the solid arm and its shadow nearly coincide. Pick computed-torque control and tick “Turn off the outer PD”: with no restoring force, the error drifts away. Open “More parameters” and drag the model scale κ to 0.5: computed-torque control does not go unstable, but joint 1’s error climbs back to about 7°, roughly the PD-only level. A model off by half compensates only half the forces and halves the outer-loop gain at the same time. At κ = 1.5 the error is about 3°.

    再加一点速度测量噪声：计算力矩控制的“力矩噪声”随 κ 成比例变化（带宽 40 rad/s、噪声 0.5 rad/s 时，κ = 0.5 / 1 / 1.5 分别约 5.6 / 11.4 / 17.4 N·m），因为 κ 乘在整个外环增益上，高估惯量就是加大增益（第 ④ 步）；前馈方案始终约 11.4 N·m。在这台臂上，C^ 项多带进来的噪声只有约 0.2 N·m，被 D 项淹没了。最后把未建模库仑摩擦加到 1 N·m、外环带宽调到 40 rad/s：计算力矩控制并不比计算力矩前馈好，关节 1 的误差反而更大（约 0.5° 对 0.12°）。一句话原因：同样的带宽下，计算力矩控制对“没算到的力矩”更软。没建模的摩擦力矩要先乘上 M−1 变成加速度，外环 PD 才去顶它；而 M−1 的对角元总不小于 1/Mii，同一个关节被推得更偏，非对角元还会把关节 2 的摩擦搬到关节 1。前馈方案的 PD 直接出力矩，按各关节自己的惯量定增益，没有这层搬运。推导见下面的深入一层。Now add some velocity noise: computed-torque control’s torque noise scales with κ (at 40 rad/s bandwidth and 0.5 rad/s noise, about 5.6 / 11.4 / 17.4 N·m for κ = 0.5 / 1 / 1.5), because κ multiplies the whole outer-loop gain — overestimating inertia is raising the gain (step 4). The feedforward scheme stays near 11.4 N·m. On this arm the extra noise through the C^ term is only about 0.2 N·m, buried under the D term. Finally, set the unmodeled Coulomb friction to 1 N·m and the outer-loop bandwidth to 40 rad/s: computed-torque control does no better than computed-torque feedforward — joint 1’s error is actually larger (about 0.5° against 0.12°). The short reason: at the same bandwidth, computed-torque control is softer against torque it didn’t compute. An unmodeled friction torque is first multiplied by M−1 and turned into an acceleration before the outer PD pushes back; the diagonal of M−1 is never smaller than 1/Mii, so each joint gets pushed further, and the off-diagonal terms carry joint 2’s friction over to joint 1. The feedforward scheme’s PD outputs torque directly, with gains set to each joint’s own inertia, so there is no such cross-talk. The derivation is in the “going deeper” below.

    深入一层Going deeper 计算力矩控制买到了什么、没买到什么？为什么一有摩擦，它反而不如前馈？What does computed-torque control buy you, and what doesn’t it? Why does it lose to feedforward once there is friction?

    前置知识 矩阵求逆；Schur 补只用到它的结论，不需要会证。只读“思路”和“自己验证”里的四组数，也能抓住要点。

    Background. Matrix inversion; only the result of the Schur-complement argument is used, not its proof. “The idea” plus the four sets of numbers in “Check it yourself” capture the point.

    思路　抗扰能力看的是“力矩层面的刚度”：一个没建模的关节力矩 τf 能把关节推偏多少。模型只改变这份刚度在各关节之间怎么分配，并不凭空增加它。频率远低于 ωn 时，下式前两行是计算力矩控制，后两行是按对角惯量 M̄ii 整定 PD 的计算力矩前馈：

    The idea. Disturbance rejection is about stiffness at the torque level: how far an unmodeled joint torque τf can push the joint. A model only changes how that stiffness is distributed across joints; it doesn’t create more of it. Well below ωn, the first two lines below describe computed-torque control and the last two describe computed-torque feedforward with its PD tuned to the diagonal inertias M̄ii:

    e¨+Kde˙+Kpe=−M−1τf⟹e≈−M−1τf/ωn2Kp,i=M‾iiωn2⟹e≈−diag(1/M‾ii)τf/ωn2

    推导　对任何正定的 M 都有 (M⁻¹)ii ≥ 1/Mii（Schur 补；两关节时 (M⁻¹)₁₁ = 1/[M₁₁(1 − ρ²)]，ρ² = M₁₂²/(M₁₁M₂₂)）。所以同样的 ωn 下，计算力矩控制对每个关节的力矩扰动都至少一样“软”，非对角元还会把关节 2 的扰动搬到关节 1。本实验的臂在 q₂ = 0.8 rad 附近 ρ² ≈ 0.54：对角元软了约 2.2 倍，(M⁻¹)₁₂ 的大小还是 (M⁻¹)₁₁ 的两倍。按 ±1 N·m 的库仑摩擦粗算（两个关节换向的时刻相差 1 rad 相位），ωn = 40 rad/s 时关节 1 的 RMS 误差是：计算力矩控制约 0.54°，前馈约 0.13°——和实验读数几乎一样。

    所以计算力矩控制买到的是“加速度层面的解耦和一致性”：每个构型、每个关节都是同一个 (ωn, ζ) 的二阶系统，好整定、可预测。它没有买到更强的抗力矩扰动能力。Khosla & Kanade（1988）在直驱臂上的实验强调，力矩计算里必须包含惯量矩阵的非对角项；同一个非对角项放进前馈是好事，放在计算力矩控制的反馈里，却会把摩擦从一个关节搬到另一个关节。Craig、Hsu & Sastry（1987）说得更直接：模型差的时候，这类解耦线性化方案可能还不如简单的固定增益方案。

    增益上限在哪　真正作用在关节上的力矩增益是 M̂(q)ωn²。若 M̂ = κM，等效 ωn 和 ζ 都乘上 √κ：高估惯量等于悄悄调高了带宽。关节有传动柔性时（01 节的双质量模型），负载侧在反谐振频率附近几乎不受控，√κ·ωn 一靠近它就会激起共振；延迟也一样吃掉相位。这个实验没有模拟柔性和延迟，所以只看得到 κ 对力矩噪声的放大，看不到共振。

    Derivation. For any positive-definite M, (M⁻¹)ii ≥ 1/Mii (a Schur-complement fact; with two joints, (M⁻¹)₁₁ = 1/[M₁₁(1 − ρ²)] with ρ² = M₁₂²/(M₁₁M₂₂)). So at the same ωn, computed-torque control is at least as soft against a torque disturbance at every joint, and the off-diagonal entries also carry joint 2’s disturbance over to joint 1. For this experiment’s arm near q₂ = 0.8 rad, ρ² ≈ 0.54: the diagonal is softer by about 2.2×, and (M⁻¹)₁₂ is twice (M⁻¹)₁₁ in size. A rough estimate with ±1 N·m of Coulomb friction (the two joints reverse 1 rad of phase apart) gives joint-1 RMS errors at ωn = 40 rad/s of about 0.54° for computed-torque control and 0.13° for feedforward — almost exactly what the experiment reads.

    What computed-torque control buys, then, is decoupling and uniformity at the acceleration level: every joint in every configuration behaves as the same second-order system with the same (ωn, ζ), which makes it easy to tune and predict. It does not buy better rejection of torque disturbances. Khosla and Kanade’s direct-drive experiments (1988) stress that the off-diagonal inertia terms must be in the torque computation; the same off-diagonal terms that help in the feedforward move friction from one joint to another once they sit in computed-torque feedback. Craig, Hsu and Sastry (1987) put it bluntly: with a poor model, such a decoupling-and-linearizing scheme can do worse than a simple fixed-gain one.

    Where the gain ceiling is. The torque gain actually applied at the joint is M̂(q)ωn². If M̂ = κM, the effective ωn and ζ are both multiplied by √κ: overestimating the inertia quietly raises the bandwidth. With a compliant transmission (the two-mass model of Section 01) the load is nearly uncontrolled near the antiresonance, and once √κ·ωn approaches it a resonance gets excited; delay eats phase the same way. This experiment models neither compliance nor delay, so you see κ amplify torque noise but not any resonance.

    自己验证Check it yourself

    • 把外环带宽 ωn 调到 40 rad/s、未建模库仑摩擦 Fc 调到 1 N·m，依次切四种控制器，读关节 1 / 关节 2 的 RMS 误差：仅 PD 约 1.05° / 2.82°，PD＋重力补偿约 0.45° / 1.78°，计算力矩前馈约 0.12° / 0.95°，计算力矩控制约 0.52° / 1.98°。
    • 再把 Fc 调回 0：两种计算力矩方案都回到 0.01° 以下。差距完全来自那个没建模的力矩。
    • Set the outer-loop bandwidth ωn to 40 rad/s and the unmodeled Coulomb friction Fc to 1 N·m, then step through the four controllers and read the joint-1 / joint-2 RMS errors: PD only about 1.05° / 2.82°, PD + gravity about 0.45° / 1.78°, computed-torque feedforward about 0.12° / 0.95°, computed-torque control about 0.52° / 1.98°.
    • Set Fc back to 0 and both computed-torque schemes return below 0.01°. The whole gap comes from that one unmodeled torque.

    文中引用Cited here: Craig, J. J., Hsu, P., & Sastry, S. S. (1987). Adaptive control of mechanical manipulators. The International Journal of Robotics Research, 6(2), 16–28. doi:10.1177/027836498700600202

    一句话Takeaway

    模型把已知的那部分力从反馈的肩上卸下来；但抵消是代数抵消，模型差多少，残差就留多少——误差不大时性能是逐渐变差，而不是一失配就失效。

    A model takes the known forces off feedback’s shoulders. But the cancellation is algebraic: whatever the model gets wrong stays behind as a disturbance — for moderate errors, performance degrades gradually rather than falling off a cliff.

    下一个问题：模型总会有误差。如果只知道误差最多有多大，能不能设计一个在这个范围内怎么都稳的控制器？Next question: the model is never exact. If all you know is how big the error can be, can you design a controller that works for every case inside that bound?

    延伸阅读Further reading

    1. Khosla, P. K., & Kanade, T. (1988). Experimental evaluation of nonlinear feedback and feedforward control schemes for manipulators. The International Journal of Robotics Research, 7(1), 18–28. doi:10.1177/027836498800700102

      从这里开始：在 CMU 直驱臂 II 上以 2 ms 采样实时对比计算力矩控制与前馈补偿，模型参数由辨识得到；实验强调力矩计算必须包含惯量矩阵的非对角项。本节实验的真机版。

      Start here: a real-time comparison of computed-torque control and feedforward compensation on the CMU DD Arm II at a 2 ms sample period, with identified model parameters. The experiments stress that off-diagonal inertia terms belong in the torque computation — this section’s experiment, on hardware.

    2. Luh, J. Y. S., Walker, M. W., & Paul, R. P. C. (1980). Resolved-acceleration control of mechanical manipulators. IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control, 25(3), 468–474. doi:10.1109/TAC.1980.1102367

      在手部直接指定加速度、用牛顿–欧拉方程实时算力矩的早期经典。当年在 PDP-11/45 上算一次平均不到 11.5 ms，只够 87 Hz 采样：读它能体会“算得动”曾经是最大的一道坎。

      An early classic that specifies accelerations at the hand and computes joint torques with the Newton–Euler equations in real time. On a PDP-11/45 one evaluation averaged under 11.5 ms, enough for only 87 Hz — a reminder that “can we even compute it?” was once the main obstacle.

    3. Takegaki, M., & Arimoto, S. (1981). A new feedback method for dynamic control of manipulators. Journal of Dynamic Systems, Measurement, and Control, 103(2), 119–125. doi:10.1115/1.3139651

      从力学的角度证明：广义坐标及其导数的线性反馈（加重力补偿）就足以做大范围运动控制。本节“深入一层”里那个能量证明的出处。

      Argues from mechanics that linear feedback of the generalized coordinates and their derivatives (plus gravity compensation) suffices for motion control in the large — the source of the energy proof in this section’s first “going deeper”.

    4. Spong, M. W. (1987). Modeling and control of elastic joint robots. Journal of Dynamic Systems, Measurement, and Control, 109(4), 310–318. doi:10.1115/1.3143860

      柔性关节的标准模型：在两条假设下推出简化模型，证明它可以全局反馈线性化，并给出奇异摄动与积分流形这条更实用的路。用谐波减速器的人必读。

      The standard elastic-joint model: a simplified model derived under two stated assumptions, a proof that it is globally feedback linearizable, and the more practical singular-perturbation and integral-manifold route. Required reading if your joints have harmonic drives.

    5. Gautier, M., & Khalil, W. (1990). Direct calculation of minimum set of inertial parameters of serial robots. IEEE Transactions on Robotics and Automation, 6(3), 368–373. doi:10.1109/70.56655
      Swevers, J., Ganseman, C., Tükel, D. B., De Schutter, J., & Van Brussel, H. (1997). Optimal robot excitation and identification. IEEE Transactions on Robotics and Automation, 13(5), 730–740. doi:10.1109/70.631234

      想把模型补偿做准，先读这两篇：前者给出串联机器人最小惯性参数集（基参数）的直接算法；后者用有限项傅里叶级数设计周期激励轨迹，以参数估计的不确定度为优化准则，配合最大似然估计，并在工业机器人上验证。

      Read these two before trying to make model compensation accurate. The first gives a direct method for the minimal set of inertial parameters (the base parameters) of serial robots; the second designs periodic excitation trajectories as finite Fourier series, optimizes the uncertainty of the estimates, pairs this with maximum-likelihood estimation, and validates it on an industrial robot.

    6. Featherstone, R. (2008). Rigid Body Dynamics Algorithms. Springer. doi:10.1007/978-1-4899-7560-7

      递推动力学算法的标准参考：实时计算 M、C、G 的办法都在这里。计算力矩控制并不需要显式求 M⁻¹，拿 q̈ = v 调用一次递推牛顿–欧拉算法就得到力矩。

      The standard reference for recursive dynamics algorithms and how to evaluate M, C and G in real time. Computed-torque control never needs M⁻¹ explicitly: one call of the recursive Newton–Euler algorithm with q̈ = v returns the torque.

    03鲁棒控制：为一整族对象设计一个固定控制器Robust control: one fixed controller for a whole family of plants

    面对未知与接触Cope with uncertainty and contact

    问题The question

    同一台协作臂，每天装的工具重量都不一样。如果不去修模型，只承认“真实对象在某个范围里”，能不能设计一个对整个范围都管用的固定控制器？要付出什么？

    The same collaborative arm carries a different tool, of a different weight, every day. What if, instead of improving the model, we admit that the real plant lies somewhere in a set — can one fixed controller work for every plant in it? And what does that cost?

    本节要点（5 分钟版）This section in brief

    • 不去修模型，而是承认“真实对象落在某个范围里”，为整个范围设计一个固定控制器：拿一个误差上界换一个保证，代价是保守。
    • 滑模控制把跟踪问题变成“把 s 推到 0”：切换增益盖过扰动上界，就对从控制入口进来的扰动不敏感。实际要加边界层，而采样周期给边界层定了下限，太薄就会抖振。
    • 在频域里，反馈逃不出“水床效应”：某段频率压下去，别处就鼓起来；在模型误差大的高频，回路必须收着。
    • 工程上更常用的是把所有没建模的东西合成一个“总扰动”，在线估出来抵掉（DOB、ADRC）。外骨骼里人的力也从控制入口进来，所以鲁棒工具只放在执行器内环。
    • Instead of improving the model, admit that the real plant lies somewhere in a set and design one fixed controller for all of it: an error bound buys a guarantee, and the price is conservatism.
    • Sliding mode turns tracking into “drive s to zero”: with a switching gain above the disturbance bound, disturbances entering through the control’s own entry point stop mattering. In practice a boundary layer is added, and the sample period puts a floor under it — too thin and you get chattering.
    • In the frequency domain, feedback cannot escape the waterbed effect: push disturbances down in one band and they bulge up in another; where the model is poor, at high frequency, the loop has to back off.
    • More common in practice: lump everything unmodeled into one disturbance, estimate it online and cancel it (DOB, ADRC). In an exoskeleton the wearer’s torque also enters through the control’s entry point, so robust tools belong in the actuator’s inner loop only.

    第一次读可以跳过：两个工程实例、各处“深入一层”。

    Safe to skip on a first read: the two field examples and the “Going deeper” boxes.

    本节符号：s 主要指滑模变量 s=e˙+λe，只有 DOB 公式里的 s 是拉普拉斯变量；e=q−qd；Q(s) 是一个低通滤波器，与 LQR 的权重 Q 无关。

    Notation: s is mostly the sliding variable s=e˙+λe; only in the DOB formula is it the Laplace variable. e=q−qd. Q(s) is a low-pass filter, unrelated to the LQR weight Q.

    把“不知道”写成一个集合Write down what you don’t know as a set

    能，前提是说清楚模型“最多错多少”。鲁棒控制的设计对象从一个模型变成一族模型，也就是不确定性集合（我们承认真实对象可能落在的那一族模型）。最常见的写法是：真实对象 = 名义模型 ×（1 + 相对误差），相对误差在每个频率上都不超过一条已知的曲线 WΔ。

    “每个频率上”怎么理解？想象用快慢不同的正弦去摇这个关节，每次都拿实测响应和模型的预测比一比。摇得慢时，两者只差百分之几到几十，主要来自负载惯量这类参数不准；摇到没建模的传动共振附近，或者快到延迟开始起作用，实测和模型的相对误差可以超过 100%，连相位都对不上。把每个频率上“最多差多少”连成一条曲线，就是 WΔ（下图上半）：低频小，高频大。

    鲁棒稳定的要求说成大白话就是：在模型误差大的频率上，闭环不要去放大信号，要“收着点”。就像在摸不准抓地力的冰面上开车，方向盘要打得轻。落到公式上，就是闭环从指令到输出的增益 |T| 在每个频率上都要低于 1/|WΔ|（下图下半）：模型只错两成的低频，回路可以放开去跟；错到 100% 以上的高频，回路必须已经降下来。为什么是这条线，见后面讲水床效应的深入一层。

    鲁棒控制仍然需要名义模型，只是把对“精度”的要求换成了对“误差上界”的要求：集合内的对象都保证稳定，集合外没有任何保证。集合画得越大，控制器越保守：频域设计里带宽要更窄；滑模里切换增益要更大，抖振也更重。

    It can — provided you can say how wrong the model might be. Robust control designs for a family of models rather than one: an uncertainty set (the family of models the real plant might belong to). The most common description is: real plant = nominal model × (1 + relative error), where the relative error stays below a known curve WΔ at every frequency.

    What does “at every frequency” mean? Imagine shaking the joint with sine waves of different speeds and comparing the measured response with the model’s prediction each time. Shaken slowly, the two differ by a few percent to a few tens of percent, mostly because parameters such as the payload inertia are off. Shaken near an unmodeled transmission resonance, or fast enough for delay to matter, the relative error can exceed 100% and even the phase no longer matches. Join up the worst mismatch at each frequency and you have WΔ (top of the figure below): small at low frequency, large at high frequency.

    In plain words, robust stability asks this: at frequencies where the model is poor, the closed loop must not amplify anything — it has to back off, the way you steer gently on ice when you can’t tell how much grip you have. As a formula, the closed-loop gain from command to output, |T|, must stay below 1/|WΔ| at every frequency (bottom of the figure): where the model is off by only 20%, the loop is free to follow closely; where it is off by 100% or more, the loop must already have rolled off. Why this particular line is explained in the “going deeper” on the waterbed effect further down.

    Robust control still needs a nominal model; it trades a demand for accuracy for a demand for an error bound. Every plant inside the set is guaranteed stable, and outside it there is no guarantee at all. The larger the set, the more conservative the controller: a narrower bandwidth in a frequency-domain design, a larger switching gain — and more chattering — in sliding mode.

    滑模控制：从一个愿望推出控制律Sliding mode: a control law from a single wish

    以单关节为例，写成加速度的形式：f 是重力、摩擦这类随状态变化的项，b 是力矩到加速度的增益（大致是惯量的倒数），u 是电机力矩，d 是外扰。f 只知道估计值 f^；f 的误差和 d 各有已知上界 F、D：

    Take a single joint and write it in acceleration form: f collects state-dependent terms such as gravity and friction, b is the gain from torque to acceleration (roughly one over the inertia), u is the motor torque and d an external disturbance. Only an estimate f^ of f is known, and the error in f and the disturbance d come with known bounds F and D:

    q¨=f(q,q˙)+bu+d(t)|f−f^|≤F,|d|≤D

    1. 愿望：误差按指数衰减The wish: exponential error decay

      e˙=−λe⟹s=e˙+λee=q−qd

      只要让 s 一直等于 0，误差就按时间常数 1/λ 衰减。二阶的跟踪问题于是变成“把一个量推到 0”的一阶问题。把误差 e 当横轴、误差变化率 e˙ 当纵轴画一张图，叫相平面；s=0 在上面是一条过原点的斜线，叫滑模面：状态一旦落到线上，误差就按设计的速度衰减。

      Hold s at zero and the error decays with time constant 1/λ. A second-order tracking problem becomes a first-order one: drive a single quantity to zero. Plot the error e horizontally and its rate e˙ vertically — the phase plane — and s=0 is a straight line through the origin, the sliding surface: once the state is on it, the error decays at the designed rate.

    2. 让 s² 一直变小Make s² keep shrinking

      12ddts2=ss˙≤−η|s|⟺ddt|s|≤−η⟹tr≤|s(0)|η

      要求 s2 以不低于 η|s| 的速度下降。为什么这样就能在有限时间内到达？12ddts2=ss˙，要求它 ≤−η|s|，两边除以 |s|，就是第二行：|s| 每秒至少减小 η。从 |s(0)| 出发，最多 |s(0)|/η 秒就减到 0，这就是“有限时间到达”。对比一下 PD：它让误差按比例衰减，越接近越慢，理论上永远差一点。到了 s=0，任何偏离都会被同一个不等式推回来，所以“到了就离不开”。

      Ask s2 to shrink at least as fast as η|s|. Why does that guarantee arrival in finite time? Since 12ddts2=ss˙, requiring it to be at most −η|s| and dividing both sides by |s| gives the second line: |s| shrinks by at least η every second. Starting from |s(0)|, it reaches zero within |s(0)|/η seconds: finite-time reaching. Compare a PD, which shrinks the error in proportion to itself — the closer it gets, the slower it goes, and in theory it never quite arrives. And once s=0, any departure is pushed back by the same inequality, so the state cannot leave.

    3. 控制律The control law

      u=b^−1[−f^+q¨d−λe˙−ksgn(s)]k≥F+D+η

      先假设输入增益 b 准确已知（b^=b）。前几项用名义模型把能算的算掉；最后一项不管残差是什么，只看 s 的正负往回推（sgn 就是取正负号）。k 盖过上界 F+D 再留出余量 η，第 ② 步就成立。到达滑模面后，误差按 e˙=−λe 衰减，与 f、d 无关——这就是滑模的“不变性”。

      输入增益 b 也不确定时，k 还要再加大，公式见下面的深入一层；实验里的“所需 k”已经算上了这一部分。

      Assume for now that the input gain is known exactly (b^=b). The first terms use the nominal model to cancel what can be computed; the last term ignores what the residual is and pushes back by the sign of s alone (sgn just takes the sign). With k above the bound F+D plus a margin η, step 2 holds. Once on the surface, the error decays as e˙=−λe regardless of f and d — the invariance sliding mode is known for.

      If the input gain b is uncertain too, k must be larger still; the formula is in the “going deeper” below, and the experiment’s “required k” already includes that part.

    4. ＋ 边界层+ Boundary layer

      sgn(s)→sat(s/Φ)⟹|e|≤Φ/λ

      理想的 sgn 要求无限快的切换，工程上几乎总把它换成连续的 sat(s/Φ)：|s| 小于 Φ 时按比例出力，超过 Φ 才用满 k。这条宽 Φ 的带就是边界层，用精度换平滑。层内其实就是一个增益为 k/Φ 的高增益 PD，只保证误差最终落进 Φ/λ 以内，不再有不变性。

      The ideal sgn needs infinitely fast switching, so in practice it is almost always replaced by the continuous sat(s/Φ): proportional while |s| is below Φ, the full k beyond it. That band of width Φ is the boundary layer, and it trades accuracy for smoothness. Inside it the controller is simply a high-gain PD with gain k/Φ; it guarantees only that the error ends up within Φ/λ, and invariance is gone.

    5. ＋ 采样+ Sampling

      |s|≲kT⟹|e|≲kT/λΦ>bb^·kT2

      数字控制器每隔 T 才能切换一次，状态只能在滑模面附近一条宽约 kT 的带里来回，这叫准滑模。这也给边界层定了下限：它必须比采样造成的这条带更宽。为什么？在层里，控制器按 s 的大小成比例往回推，但推力每隔 T 才更新一次，中间保持不变。打个比方：你要把水箱的水位调到刻度线，却只能每隔 T 秒看一眼——看到高出多少，就按比例开阀放水（低了就按比例加水），然后不再看，保持 T 秒。阀门给得太猛（k/Φ 大）或看得太少（T 大），一次就调过了线。一步能纠正的量约是当前 s 的 kT/Φ 倍：这个比值小于 1，一步过不了线；在 1 和 2 之间，会过线，但过头的比原来偏的少，来回几次也能停下；超过 2，每次过头都比上次偏得更远，越调越乱。所以层内那台高增益 PD 要在离散时间里稳定，需要满足第三行的条件（b^=b 时就是 kT/Φ<2，即 Φ>kT/2），工程上取 Φ≳kT，让它一步过不了线。实验里 k=60 rad/s²、T=1 ms，kT = 0.06 rad/s，默认的 Φ = 0.3 rad/s 离这条线很远；读数“离散稳定性”显示的就是这个比值（已乘上惯量偏差带来的 Jn/J）。再薄，边界层在离散时间里就形同虚设：层内的高增益 PD 会失稳，滑模退化成抖振。

      A digital controller can switch only once every T, so the state rattles inside a band of width about kT around the surface: quasi-sliding mode. This also puts a floor under the boundary layer: it must be thicker than the band that sampling creates. Why? Inside the layer the controller pushes back in proportion to s, but it updates the push only once every T and holds it in between. Picture bringing a tank’s water level to a mark when you may only glance at it every T seconds: you see how far above the mark it is and open the drain in proportion (or the fill valve, if it is below), then hold that setting, eyes shut, for T seconds. Too aggressive a valve (large k/Φ) or too rare a glance (large T), and a single step overshoots the mark. Each step corrects about kT/Φ times the current s. Below 1, one step never crosses the line; between 1 and 2, it crosses, but the overshoot is smaller than the original error, so it still settles, flipping sides each step; above 2, every overshoot is larger than the last and things get worse. Hence the high-gain PD inside the layer is stable in discrete time only if the third line holds (with b^=b, kT/Φ<2, i.e. Φ>kT/2); in practice, take Φ≳kT so that one step cannot cross the line. In the experiment k=60 rad/s² and T=1 ms, so kT = 0.06 rad/s, and the default Φ = 0.3 rad/s is far from the line; the “Discrete stability” readout shows exactly this ratio (times the factor Jn/J from the inertia error). Make it thinner and, in discrete time, the layer might as well not be there: the high-gain PD inside it goes unstable and the sliding mode degenerates into chattering.

    6. ＋ 执行器上限+ Actuator limit

      |ueq|+k/|b^|≤umax

      ueq 是切换项以外的控制量。整个工作区都要给切换项留出余量；一旦饱和，可用的切换幅值盖不住误差，滑动条件就失效。碰撞恰恰最容易让执行器饱和。

      ueq is everything in the control law except the switching term. The actuator needs headroom for the switching term everywhere in the workspace; once it saturates, the switching effort left over no longer covers the uncertainty and the sliding condition fails. Collisions are exactly when saturation is most likely.

    深入一层Going deeper 切换增益 k 和边界层 Φ 怎么定？为什么采样周期给 Φ 定了下限？How do you choose the switching gain k and the boundary layer Φ — and why does the sample period put a floor under Φ?

    前置知识 代数运算，以及“一个量每一步都乘上同一个数，这个数的绝对值小于 1 它才会越来越小”。第 ② 条正文第 ⑤ 步已经用大白话讲过；第 ③ 条读每段第一句就够了。

    Background. Algebra, plus the fact that a quantity multiplied by the same number every step shrinks only if that number’s magnitude is below 1. Step 5 of the main text already covers item 2 in plain words; for item 3, the first sentence of each point is enough.

    ① 输入增益也不准时的 k　设 ρ = b/b̂（真实与名义输入增益之比），û 是切换项以外的名义控制（加速度量纲）。把控制律代回对象：

    1. k when the input gain is uncertain too. Let ρ = b/b̂ (true over nominal input gain) and let û be the nominal control apart from the switching term (in acceleration units). Substituting the control law back into the plant gives

    s˙=(f−f^)+d+(ρ−1)u^−ρksgn(s)ρ−1∈[β−1,β]⟹k≥β(F+D+η)+(β−1)|u^|

    切换项只发挥 ρ 倍的力，名义项本身也被放大或缩小了 ρ 倍，所以 k 要按最坏的 ρ 加码。对关节来说，β 就是惯量可能被低估的倍数；实验里的“所需 k”就是按本次的实际偏差这样算出来的。Slotine（1984）把这类“精度对鲁棒性”的折中写成了显式关系：精度由参数不确定性的大小和未建模动态的频率范围共同决定。

    ② 边界层的采样下限　层内的切换项是 −ρ(k/Φ)s，零阶保持下它在一个周期 T 内不变，于是

    The switching term acts at only ρ times its nominal strength, and the nominal terms are scaled by ρ as well, so k must cover the worst ρ. For a joint, β is the factor by which the inertia might be underestimated; the experiment’s “required k” is computed exactly this way from the actual mismatch. Slotine (1984) made this precision-versus-robustness trade-off explicit: achievable accuracy is set jointly by the size of the parametric uncertainty and the frequency range of the unmodeled dynamics.

    2. The sampling floor under the boundary layer. Inside the layer the switching term is −ρ(k/Φ)s, held constant over each sample period T by the zero-order hold, so

    s[n+1]≈(1−ρkTΦ)s[n]|1−ρkTΦ|<1⟺Φ>ρkT2

    Φ 比 ρkT/2 还薄时，层内那台“高增益 PD”在离散时间里已经失稳，边界层形同虚设，滑模退化成准滑模抖振；Φ 在 ρkT/2 和 ρkT 之间时虽然稳定，s 却每一步都翻号。所以工程上取 Φ ≳ kT（b 不准时再乘上 ρ 的上界），让边界层一步穿不过去；Φ 还要大于 s 的噪声水平，因为 s 里含速度，编码器差分出来的速度噪声往往最大。误差界 Φ/λ 再和精度要求比一比，λ 本身又受未建模共振和延迟限制——这几条一起把“最多能多准”钉死了。

    ③ 其他减抖办法各管什么　趋近律 ṡ = −ε sgn(s) − ks 让比例项负责“走近”，切换幅值 ε 可以取小。超螺旋这类二阶滑模把不连续藏到积分器后面，控制量本身是连续的，前提是扰动的变化率有界；采样实现下，r 阶滑模的精度最高可达 T 的 r 次方量级，普通滑模只有一次方（Levant 2003）。但有执行器动态时，超螺旋仍会收敛到一个周期振荡：控制量连续，并不等于没有抖振（Boiko & Fridman 2005）。终端滑模（滑模面里含误差的分数次幂）主要是为了让误差在有限时间内收敛。有的资料把它当成减抖的办法，但真正减抖的是让控制量变连续（边界层、高阶滑模这类改法），不是“终端”这一项本身。

    最后一个把滑模和下面的扰动观测器连起来的事实：理想滑动时，切换项经过低通滤波后的平均值，恰好等于总的不确定性（所谓“等效控制”）。滑模其实也在估扰动，只是用开关的方式。

    Once Φ is thinner than ρkT/2, the high-gain PD inside the layer is already unstable in discrete time: the layer might as well not exist, and sliding degenerates into quasi-sliding chatter. Between ρkT/2 and ρkT the layer is stable but s flips sign every step. In practice, then, take Φ ≳ kT (times the upper bound on ρ when b is uncertain), so that one step cannot carry the state across the layer. Φ must also exceed the noise level of s, which contains velocity — and velocity differenced from an encoder is usually the noisiest signal you have. Compare the error bound Φ/λ with your accuracy target, remember that λ itself is capped by unmodeled resonances and delay, and together these pin down how accurate the loop can possibly be.

    3. What the other anti-chattering tools actually do. A reaching law ṡ = −ε sgn(s) − ks lets the proportional term cover the distance, so the switching amplitude ε can stay small. Second-order sliding modes such as super-twisting hide the discontinuity behind an integrator, so the control itself is continuous; they assume the disturbance has a bounded rate of change. Under sampling, an r-th-order sliding mode can reach precision of order T^r, against order T for the standard sliding mode (Levant 2003). With actuator dynamics, though, super-twisting still settles into a periodic oscillation: a continuous control signal is not the same as no chattering (Boiko & Fridman 2005). Terminal sliding mode, with fractional powers of the error in the surface, is mainly about finite-time convergence of the error. Some sources present it as a chattering remedy, but what reduces chattering is making the control continuous (a boundary layer, higher-order sliding modes), not the terminal surface itself.
