    One last fact that links sliding mode to the disturbance observer below: during ideal sliding, the low-pass-filtered average of the switching term equals the lumped uncertainty (the “equivalent control”). Sliding mode is estimating the disturbance too — by switching.

    自己验证Check it yourself

    • 采样周期保持 1 ms、负载偏差 +50%，此时 ρ = Jn/J ≈ 0.67，推导给出的下限 ρkT/2 ≈ 0.02 rad/s。把边界层 Φ 从 0.03 调到 0.02：误差仍在 10⁻⁴ rad 量级，抖振指标却从约 31 跳到约 3×10⁴ N·m/s，正好落在推导给的那条线上。
    • Φ 放回 0.3，把采样周期拉到 15–20 ms：这时 ρkT/Φ ≥ 2，“等效高增益 PD”在离散时间下失稳，只是被 30 N·m 的力矩上限困住（读数“饱和时间占比”的中间一项显示，它约有一半到七成的时间顶在上限上）；滑模的抖振指标也从 25 左右涨到上千。
    • Keep the sample period at 1 ms and the load error at +50%, so ρ = Jn/J ≈ 0.67 and the derived floor ρkT/2 ≈ 0.02 rad/s. Move the boundary layer Φ from 0.03 to 0.02: the error stays at the 10⁻⁴ rad level, but the chattering index jumps from about 31 to about 3×10⁴ N·m/s — right on the line the derivation draws.
    • Put Φ back to 0.3 and stretch the sample period to 15–20 ms. Now ρkT/Φ ≥ 2: the equivalent high-gain PD is unstable in discrete time and survives only because the 30 N·m limit traps it (the middle entry of the “Time saturated” readout shows it on the limit roughly half to seven-tenths of the time), and the sliding-mode chattering index climbs from about 25 into the thousands.

    文中引用Cited here: Boiko, I., & Fridman, L. (2005). Analysis of chattering in continuous sliding-mode controllers. IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control, 50(9), 1442–1446. doi:10.1109/TAC.2005.854655

    公式外还有两条前提。第一，不变性只对匹配型不确定性成立。匹配型，指扰动和控制量从同一个“入口”进来，比如两者都是直接作用在关节上的力矩，控制量就能正面把它顶回去。要是扰动绕开了控制量的入口，切换项就推不动它。例如控制的是电机电压，负载力矩却从机械那一头进来，中间隔着电流和力矩的动态。

    第二，不变性只在滑动阶段成立，到达滑模面之前，系统对扰动照样敏感；上界也必须真的罩得住，碰撞冲击可能远超设计时的 D。

    Two more conditions hide outside the formulas. First, invariance applies only to matched uncertainty. Matched means the disturbance comes in through the same “entry point” as the control — both are torques acting directly on the joint, say — so the control can push straight back against it. If the disturbance bypasses the control’s entry point, the switching term cannot reach it. Example: you command a motor’s voltage, but the load torque arrives from the mechanical side, with the current and torque dynamics in between.

    Second, invariance holds only while sliding: before the state reaches the surface, the system is as sensitive to disturbances as any other. The bound must also really hold — an impact can far exceed the D you designed for.

    深入一层Going deeper 滑模为什么推不动“不匹配”的扰动？电压驱动的电机、SEA 的负载侧、气腔该怎么办？Why can’t sliding mode push back on “unmatched” disturbances — and what do you do about voltage-driven motors, the load side of an SEA, or an air chamber?

    前置知识 电机的电压—电流—转速方程（电工学）。只读“思路”和三种做法的名字，也能抓住要点。

    Background. A motor’s voltage–current–speed equations (basic electrical engineering). “The idea” and the names of the three remedies carry the point.

    思路　切换项只能沿着控制量进入的方向使劲。把系统写成 ẋ = f(x) + B(x)[u + dm] + du：dm 和 u 走同一个入口，k 盖过它就行；du 不在 B 的方向上，k 再大也碰不到它。以电压 u 为输入的电机就是最小的例子：

    The idea. The switching term can only push along the direction in which the control enters. Write the system as ẋ = f(x) + B(x)[u + dm] + du. The matched part dm shares the input’s entry point, so a large enough k covers it; the unmatched part du lies outside the direction of B, and no k can reach it. A motor driven by its voltage u is the smallest example:

    Lai˙=u−Rai−KeωJω˙=Kti−τL

    u 进的是电流方程，负载力矩 τL 进的是机械方程，中间隔着电流的动态，所以对 u 来说 τL 是不匹配的。SEA 控负载位置时也一样：负载侧的扰动直接作用在连杆上，电机力矩却要隔着弹簧才到得了（电机力矩到连杆角是四阶，扰动到连杆角是二阶）。

    三种做法

    1. 分层（最常用）：让内环快到可以当成理想执行器，比如电流环把电机变成力矩源、SEA 的力矩环把弹簧变成力源，于是扰动在外环那一层就“匹配”了。前提是内外环带宽拉得足够开（00 节的 5–10 倍）。
    2. 反步法：把第一级需要的“理想中间量”（比如想要的电流 i*）当作虚拟控制，逐级往回设计，每一级都带自己的鲁棒项。
    3. 逐级估计：在扰动进入的那一级用观测器把它估出来，并把估计值写进滑模面（Yang、Li & Yu 2013）。这样切换增益只需盖过估计误差，不必盖过扰动本身，抖振也跟着变小。

    外骨骼　气腔以质量流量为输入时，压力方程里同时出现流量和容积变化：

    The voltage enters the current equation while the load torque τL enters the mechanical one, with the current dynamics in between, so τL is unmatched with respect to u. An SEA under load-position control is the same story: a load-side disturbance acts on the link directly, while motor torque reaches the link only through the spring (motor torque to link angle is fourth order; the disturbance to link angle is second order).

    Three ways out

    1. Hierarchy (the usual answer): make the inner loop fast enough to count as an ideal actuator — a current loop turns the motor into a torque source, an SEA torque loop turns the spring into a force source — and the disturbance becomes matched at the outer level. This requires well-separated bandwidths (the 5–10× of Section 00).
    2. Backstepping: treat the ideal intermediate quantity the first stage needs (a desired current i*, say) as a virtual control and design stage by stage back to the real input, each stage with its own robust term.
    3. Stage-wise estimation: estimate the disturbance with an observer at the stage where it enters and build the estimate into the sliding surface (Yang, Li & Yu 2013). The switching gain then needs to cover only the estimation error, not the disturbance itself, and chattering shrinks with it.

    Exoskeletons. For an air chamber driven by mass flow, the pressure equation contains both the flow and the volume change:

    P˙=nRTVm˙−nPVV˙

    （n 是多变指数，R 是气体常数，T 是气体温度。）泄漏、容积变化 V̇ 和流量同在一个方程里，对压力环是匹配的，所以 s = P − Pd 的一阶滑模很自然。可手臂的角度由人和负载在机械那一侧决定，对阀来说是不匹配的。不要试图隔着气腔用滑模去“钉住”手臂角度：压力环用滑模，外面用助力曲线或阻抗，才各得其所。用开关阀时，“充气 / 保持 / 排气”三态本身就是带死区的 sgn。但死区内只是“保持”、不施加控制，并不是边界层；用 PWM 让占空比随 s 线性变化才是。

    (n is the polytropic index, R the gas constant, T the gas temperature.) Leakage and the volume change V̇ sit in the same equation as the flow, so they are matched for the pressure loop, and a first-order sliding surface s = P − Pd is natural. The arm angle, however, is set by the wearer and the load on the mechanical side and is unmatched as far as the valve is concerned. Don’t try to pin the arm angle with sliding mode through the air chamber: sliding mode for the pressure loop, an assistance curve or an impedance outside it. With on/off valves, the fill / hold / vent states already form a sgn with a dead zone. But inside the dead zone the valve simply holds, applying no control at all, so it is not a boundary layer; a PWM duty cycle proportional to s is.

    自己验证Check it yourself

    • 本页的滑模实验里，负载偏差和外扰都是直接作用在关节上的力矩，全是匹配型——你看到的“不变性”是在最有利的条件下得到的。
    • 拿纸笔：对上面的电机模型，数一数从 u 到 ω 要积分几次（2），从 τL 到 ω 几次（1）。两个数不一样，就是不匹配。
    • In this page’s sliding-mode experiment the load error and the disturbance are both torques acting directly on the joint — all matched. The invariance you see there is the best case.
    • With pen and paper: for the motor model above, count the integrations from u to ω (two) and from τL to ω (one). Different counts mean unmatched.

    文中引用Cited here: Yang, J., Li, S., & Yu, X. (2013). Sliding-mode control for systems with mismatched uncertainties via a disturbance observer. IEEE Transactions on Industrial Electronics, 60(1), 160–169. doi:10.1109/TIE.2012.2183841

    抖振，是切换项在有限频率下来回跳造成的高频振荡，就像只有“开 / 关”两档的恒温器，温度总在设定值附近上下跳。它来自有限的切换频率和没建模的快动态（电流环、阀、传动柔性），幅度随 k 增大，未必微小：会发热、磨损、产生噪声，甚至激发结构共振。对策有三条：加边界层；先用模型或扰动观测器补掉大部分不确定性，让 k 变小；换更平滑的切换律（如超螺旋：把开关藏到一个积分器后面，电机收到的力矩本身是连续的；见上面讲 k 和 Φ 怎么定的深入一层）。

    Chattering is the high-frequency oscillation caused by a switching term flipping back and forth at a finite rate — like a thermostat with only “on” and “off”, whose temperature keeps bobbing around the setpoint. It comes from the finite switching rate and from fast dynamics nobody modeled (the current loop, a valve, a flexible transmission). It grows with k and need not be small: it heats motors, wears gears, makes noise and can excite structural resonances. Three remedies: add a boundary layer; remove most of the uncertainty first with a model or a disturbance observer, so k can shrink; or switch more smoothly (super-twisting, for instance, which hides the switch behind an integrator so that the torque the motor receives is continuous — see the “going deeper” on choosing k and Φ above).

    工程实例From the field

    气动力执行器的滑模控制：被忽略的阀和管路决定能做多快Sliding-mode control of a pneumatic force actuator: the valve and tubing you leave out set the speed limit

    系统是双作用气缸加比例滑阀构成的力执行器，目标是精确跟踪力指令。Richer 与 Hurmuzlu 先建了一个详细的非线性模型，考虑阀的非线性流量、腔内空气的可压缩性、两腔之间的泄漏、行程末端的死容积，以及连接管路的延迟和衰减，并用两种气缸、不同长度的管路做了辨识和验证。在此基础上，他们设计了两种滑模力控制器：一种用完整模型；另一种忽略阀动态和连接管造成的延迟，计算简单得多。

    The system is a force actuator built from a double-acting cylinder and a proportional spool valve, and the goal is accurate tracking of a force command. Richer and Hurmuzlu first built a detailed nonlinear model — nonlinear valve flow, air compressibility in the chambers, leakage between chambers, dead volume at the end of stroke, and delay and attenuation in the connecting lines — and identified and validated it on two cylinder types with several tube lengths. On top of it they designed two sliding-mode force controllers: one using the full model, and a simpler one that ignores the valve dynamics and the tube delay.

    简化版仍只轻微变差的范围Where the simplified law loses only a little
    较短管路、≤ 20 Hzshort tubes, ≤ 20 Hz
    超出这个范围Beyond that
    简化版明显变差markedly worse
    完整模型版Full-model law
    仿真与实验都更好，在线计算复杂better in simulation and on hardware, heavier to compute

    学到什么　滑模的“不变性”只盖得住模型和切换项覆盖到的东西。被忽略的快动态（阀、管路延迟）决定了带宽上限，这正是上面说的抖振来源。对气动外骨骼的直接含义：管长就是延迟（气压波按声速传播，约 340 m/s，1 m 管约 3 ms），与其加大切换增益，不如把阀和管路写进名义模型。

    Lesson. Sliding-mode invariance covers only what the model and the switching term account for. The fast dynamics left out — the valve and the tube delay — set the bandwidth ceiling, which is exactly the source of chattering described above. For a pneumatic exoskeleton the message is direct: tube length is delay (pressure waves travel at roughly the speed of sound, about 340 m/s, so a 1 m tube costs about 3 ms), and putting the valve and tubing into the nominal model beats raising the switching gain.

    出处Sources: Richer, E., & Hurmuzlu, Y. (2000). A high performance pneumatic force actuator system: Part I — Nonlinear mathematical model. Journal of Dynamic Systems, Measurement, and Control, 122(3), 416–425. doi:10.1115/1.1286336; Part II — Nonlinear controller design, 122(3), 426–434. doi:10.1115/1.1286366

    换到频域看：反馈不能处处都好In the frequency domain: feedback can’t win everywhere

    另一条经典路线在频域里设计，叫 H∞ 设计。可以把它理解成按频率写一张需求表：每个频率上扰动要压到多低、控制量最多多大、模型误差大的高频要收到多低；然后让优化程序去找一个控制器，使所有频率上“实际做到的 ÷ 允许的”这个比值里最坏的那个尽量小。这个最坏比值就是 H∞ 范数，∞ 指的是“取所有频率里的最大值”；它压到 1 以下，所有需求就同时满足了。不管用哪种方法，反馈都逃不出一条守恒律，叫水床效应：把某段频率的扰动压下去，别的频率上一定鼓起来，就像按水床。用反馈做主动降噪的耳机就是例子：低频的轰鸣压得很低，稍高一点的频段反而会被放大一些。带宽又被延迟卡住时，鼓包没法摊宽，只能变高。

    The other classic route designs in the frequency domain: H∞ design. Think of it as a requirements table by frequency — how far disturbances must be pushed down at each frequency, how large the control effort may get, how firmly the loop must back off at the high frequencies where the model is poor. An optimizer then searches for the controller that makes the worst ratio of “achieved ÷ allowed”, over all frequencies, as small as possible. That worst ratio is the H∞ norm (the ∞ just means “take the maximum over frequency”); push it below 1 and every requirement is met at once. Whatever the method, feedback cannot escape a conservation law known as the waterbed effect: press disturbances down in one frequency band and they bulge up in another, like pressing on a waterbed. Feedback-type active noise-cancelling headphones are an example: the low-frequency rumble is pushed far down, while a band just above it is actually amplified a little. When delay also caps the bandwidth, the bulge can’t spread out; it can only grow taller.

    深入一层Going deeper 水床效应从哪来？H∞ 设计到底在优化什么？Where does the waterbed effect come from — and what is an H∞ design actually optimizing?

    前置知识 传递函数、Bode 图、Nyquist 图。第 ① 条，以及第 ③ 条末尾的两个数值例子，不需要这些也能读懂。

    Background. Transfer functions, Bode and Nyquist plots. Item 1, and the two numerical examples at the end of item 3, read fine without them.

    ① 两个灵敏度　回路增益 L = G₀K（G₀ 是名义对象，K 是控制器）。S 是扰动经过反馈后还剩几成；T 叫互补灵敏度：在单自由度结构里，它是指令到输出的传递函数，同时（差一个负号）也是测量噪声到输出的传递函数。两者之和恒为 1，所以同一频率上不可能都小：想把扰动压下去（S 小）的频段，传感器噪声就会原样进来（T ≈ 1）。

    1. Two sensitivities. Let the loop gain be L = G₀K (G₀ the nominal plant, K the controller). S is the fraction of a disturbance that survives the feedback; T, the complementary sensitivity, is the command-to-output transfer function in a one-degree-of-freedom loop and, up to a sign, the transfer function from sensor noise to output. They always add up to one, so they cannot both be small at the same frequency: wherever you push disturbances down (small S), sensor noise comes straight through (T ≈ 1).

    S=11+L,T=L1+LS+T=1

    ② 鲁棒稳定　把真实对象写成 G = G₀(1 + WΔΔ)，‖Δ‖∞ ≤ 1。闭环特征式可以拆成两个因子：

    2. Robust stability. Write the real plant as G = G₀(1 + WΔΔ) with ‖Δ‖∞ ≤ 1. The closed-loop characteristic expression factors as

    1+L(1+WΔΔ)=(1+L)(1+TWΔΔ)⟹‖WΔT‖∞<1

    名义回路稳定时，“对所有允许的 Δ 都稳定”的充要条件就是第二行：模型误差大的频率上 T 必须小，回路要“收着点”。WΔ 不是拍脑袋画的：在不同负载、姿态、温度下（外骨骼还要换人、换穿戴松紧）各扫一次频响 Gi(jω)，取包络 |WΔ(jω)| ≥ maxᵢ |Gi/G₀ − 1|。它通常在低频很小，到第一个没建模的共振或延迟对应的频率附近升到 1 以上，穿越频率就得放在那之前。

    ③ 守恒律　开环稳定、相对阶 ≥ 2（输入到输出至少隔着两次积分，高频衰减得够快）时，∫₀^∞ ln|S(jω)| dω = 0；开环有不稳定极点 pi 时右边变成 π Σ Re pi，只会更糟（Freudenberg & Looze 1985）。由此可以推出一个粗略但很有用的界：想在 [0, ωb] 里把扰动压到 ε 以下，而 ωa 以上回路增益必须很小（延迟、共振、WΔ > 1），那么正面积只能挤进 [ωb, ωa] 里：

    If the nominal loop is stable, the second line is necessary and sufficient for stability under every admissible Δ: wherever the model is poor, T must be small — the loop has to back off. WΔ is not drawn by hand-waving. Measure frequency responses Gi(jω) under different loads, postures and temperatures (for an exoskeleton, different wearers and strap tightness too) and take the envelope |WΔ(jω)| ≥ maxᵢ |Gi/G₀ − 1|. It is usually small at low frequency and rises past 1 near the first unmodeled resonance or the frequency set by the delay; the crossover has to sit below that.

    3. The conservation law. With a stable open loop of relative degree at least 2 (two or more integrations between input and output, so the loop rolls off fast enough), ∫₀^∞ ln|S(jω)| dω = 0; unstable open-loop poles pi make the right-hand side π Σ Re pi, which only makes things worse (Freudenberg & Looze 1985). A rough but useful consequence: if disturbances must be held below ε over [0, ωb] while the loop gain must be small above ωa (delay, resonance, WΔ > 1), the positive area has nowhere to go but [ωb, ωa]:

    ∫0∞ln|S(jω)|dω=0⟹lnMs≳ωbln(1/ε)ωa−ωb

    （Ms = max|S|，忽略了 ωa 以上那一小截。）在 ωb = 0.3ωa 以内压 10 倍（ε = 0.1），Ms 至少约 2.7；把 ωb 推到 0.5ωa，Ms 至少 10。这就是“带宽被延迟卡住时，鼓包只能变高”的定量说法；Stein（2003）对这件事的讲法最透。

    ④ H∞ 在优化什么　混合灵敏度设计把三条愿望写成频率权：

    (Ms = max|S|; the small tail above ωa is neglected.) Suppressing disturbances tenfold (ε = 0.1) up to ωb = 0.3ωa forces Ms ≥ 2.7 or so; push ωb to 0.5ωa and Ms ≥ 10. That is the quantitative form of “when delay caps the bandwidth, the bulge can only grow taller”; Stein (2003) tells this story best.

    4. What H∞ optimizes. A mixed-sensitivity design turns three wishes into frequency weights:

    minK‖[W1SW2KSW3T]‖∞

    W₁ 规定低频扰动压多低，W₂ 限制控制量，W₃ 取成 WΔ 就覆盖了模型误差。H∞ 范数是所有频率里最坏的放大倍数，也等于信号能量的最坏放大倍数，所以它给的是能量或频域意义上的界，不是“误差永远不超过某个值”的硬约束。“最优”也只相对于这组权：换一组权，就是另一个“最优”控制器。如果知道不确定性长在哪几个位置（比如负载惯量和摩擦各自独立地变），用结构化奇异值 μ 来分析和综合，比把误差揉成一块更不保守；它的优势在不确定性有结构，不在自由度多。

    ⑤ 裕度与 Ms　1/Ms 就是奈奎斯特曲线到 −1 点的最近距离。一个数同时管住两种裕度：

    W₁ sets how hard low-frequency disturbances are rejected, W₂ limits control effort, and choosing W₃ = WΔ covers the model error. The H∞ norm is the worst-case gain over frequency and also the worst-case gain in signal energy, so it bounds energy or frequency response — not the error at every instant. “Optimal” is relative to the weights: pick others and you get a different “optimal” controller. If you know where the uncertainty enters (load inertia and friction varying independently, say), the structured singular value μ supports analysis and synthesis that are less conservative than lumping everything into one block; its advantage is structure, not the number of degrees of freedom.

    5. Margins and Ms. 1/Ms is the closest approach of the Nyquist curve to −1, and that single number bounds both classic margins:

    GM≥MsMs−1,PM≥2arcsin12Ms

    自己验证Check it yourself

    • 01 节 LQR 实验的“离失稳多远 1/Ms”读数：全状态时约 0.97（Ms ≈ 1.03），上式保证增益裕度 ≥ 33 倍、相位裕度 ≥ 58°，实测约 34 倍、70°；在“更多参数”里勾上观测器（快慢保持默认的 ×3）后约 0.66（Ms ≈ 1.53），保证 ≥ 2.9 倍、≥ 38°，实测约 5.3 倍、47°。下界都成立，而且 Ms 一变差，两种裕度一起往下掉：把观测器调慢到 ×1，1/Ms 再降到约 0.61，实测增益裕度只剩约 4.3 倍。
    • The “distance to instability, 1/Ms” readout in Section 01’s LQR experiment: with full state it reads about 0.97 (Ms ≈ 1.03), which guarantees a gain margin of at least 33× and a phase margin of at least 58° — the experiment shows about 34× and 70°. Under “More parameters”, tick the observer (leaving its speed at the default ×3) and the readout drops to about 0.66 (Ms ≈ 1.53): guaranteed ≥ 2.9× and ≥ 38°, measured about 5.3× and 47°. The bounds hold, and when Ms worsens both margins fall together: slow the observer to ×1 and 1/Ms sinks to about 0.61, with a measured gain margin of only about 4.3×.

    更常走的一条路：把总扰动估出来The road more traveled: estimate the lumped disturbance

    工程上更常见的不是按最坏情况硬扛，而是在线把“所有没建模的东西”估出来抵掉。打个比方：开车上坡时，你不必知道坡有多陡、风有多大，只要发现“油门踩了这么多，车却没加速到该有的程度”，就知道有一股总阻力，多踩一点把它补上。扰动观测器（DOB，把所有没建模的东西合成一个“总扰动”估出来再抵消）做的就是这件事，是运动控制里的标准做法（Ohnishi 等 1996）：

    Rather than brace for the worst case, practice more often estimates everything unmodeled online and cancels it. Think of driving uphill: you don’t need to know how steep the slope is or how strong the headwind. If the car isn’t accelerating as much as the pedal says it should, there is some total resistance, and you press a little harder to cover it. The disturbance observer (DOB: lump everything unmodeled into one disturbance, estimate it and cancel it) does exactly this, and is a staple of motion control (Ohnishi et al. 1996):

    τ^dis=Q(s)[Ktniref−Jnsω]Q(s)=gs+g

    用名义参数 Jn、Ktn 算出“指令本该产生的力矩”与“实测加速度对应的力矩”之差，就是总扰动；ω 是关节速度；这里的 s 是拉普拉斯变量，Jnsω 就是“Jn 乘以角加速度”。Q 是截止频率为 g 的一阶低通：变化慢的扰动估计照单全收，变化快的部分（多半是噪声）被滤掉。在 g 以内，对象被“名义化”成 1/(Jns)。

    Compute, with nominal Jn and Ktn, the torque the command should have produced minus the torque implied by the measured acceleration: that difference is the lumped disturbance. Here ω is the joint velocity and s the Laplace variable, so Jnsω simply means Jn times the angular acceleration. Q is a first-order low-pass filter with cutoff g: slowly varying disturbance estimates pass through, while fast wiggles (mostly noise) are filtered out. Below g the plant looks like the nominal 1/(Jns).

    深入一层Going deeper 扰动观测器的 Q 滤波带宽为什么不能无限高？Why can’t the disturbance observer’s Q-filter bandwidth go arbitrarily high?

    前置知识 传递函数、小增益定理（两个环节本身都稳定时，绕一圈的增益在每个频率上都小于 1，闭环就稳定）。只读三条限制各自的第一句，也能抓住要点。

    Background. Transfer functions and the small-gain theorem (if both parts are stable and the gain around the loop stays below 1 at every frequency, the loop is stable). The first sentence of each of the three limits carries the point.

    思路　Q 越宽，被“名义化”的频段越宽；但 Q 也同时把模型误差和测量噪声放进了回路。设真实对象 G = Gn(1 + Δ)，Δ 是相对模型误差；uref 是加补偿之前的力矩指令，d 是折算到输入端的总扰动。把 DOB 的回路解开：

    The idea. A wider Q nominalizes the plant over a wider band — and lets model error and sensor noise into the loop over that same band. Let the real plant be G = Gn(1 + Δ) with Δ the relative model error, uref the torque command before compensation, and d the lumped disturbance referred to the input. Solving the DOB loop gives

    y=G1+QΔuref+G(1−Q)1+QΔdG=Gn(1+Δ),‖QΔ‖∞<1

    推导　Q ≈ 1 的低频，y ≈ Gn uref，扰动被乘上 1 − Q ≈ 0；Q ≈ 0 的高频，DOB 等于没开。内环的特征式是 1 + QΔ，所以鲁棒稳定的充分条件是第二行（小增益定理）：在模型误差大的频段，Q 必须已经降下来。三条限制都从这里来：

    • 延迟：只差一段没建模的延迟 τ 时，|Δ(jω)| = 2|sin(ωτ/2)|，在 ωτ = π/3 处就到了 1。对一阶 Q = g/(s + g)，小增益条件算出来是 gτ ≲ 1.5；想留余量（|QΔ| ≤ 0.5）大约是 gτ ≈ 0.6。τ = 1 ms 时，g 也就几百 rad/s。
    • 共振：传动柔性让 Δ 在反谐振附近变得很大，Q 必须在那之前衰减。这和 01 节“带宽被共振封顶”是同一件事。
    • 噪声：估计式里有 Gn⁻¹y。用速度测量、一阶 Q 时，高频噪声到估计力矩的增益约为 Jn g，力矩噪声随 g 线性增长。

    自抗扰控制的扩张状态观测器面对的是同样三条限制。Gao（2003）提出的带宽参数化把控制器参数归结为一个变量——回路带宽；线性 ADRC 里的扩张状态观测器也常这样只用一个观测器带宽来参数化，并取控制带宽的 3–5 倍。这是经验值，上限同样由噪声和延迟决定。

    一个延伸　同一个观测器反过来用，就是不用力矩传感器的外力估计：每个关节放两个 DOB，一个做鲁棒的运动控制，另一个估反作用力矩（Murakami、Yu & Ohnishi 1993）。估计值里混着“惯量误差 × 加速度”，快速运动时会变差——05 节讲碰撞检测时还会碰到这个问题。

    Derivation. At low frequency, where Q ≈ 1, y ≈ Gn uref and the disturbance is multiplied by 1 − Q ≈ 0; at high frequency, where Q ≈ 0, the DOB might as well be off. The inner loop’s characteristic expression is 1 + QΔ, so the second line is a sufficient condition for robust stability (small gain): wherever the model error is large, Q must already have rolled off. All three limits follow from this:

    • Delay. If the only mismatch is an unmodeled delay τ, |Δ(jω)| = 2|sin(ωτ/2)|, which reaches 1 at ωτ = π/3. For a first-order Q = g/(s + g), the small-gain condition works out to gτ ≲ 1.5; leaving margin (|QΔ| ≤ 0.5) gives roughly gτ ≈ 0.6. With τ = 1 ms, g ends up at a few hundred rad/s.
    • Resonance. Transmission compliance makes Δ large around the antiresonance, and Q has to roll off before it — the same “bandwidth capped by resonance” story as in Section 01.
    • Noise. The estimate contains Gn⁻¹y. With a velocity measurement and a first-order Q, the high-frequency gain from sensor noise to estimated torque is about Jn g, so torque noise grows linearly with g.

    ADRC’s extended state observer faces the same three limits. Gao’s bandwidth parameterization (2003) reduces the controller’s parameters to a single variable, the loop bandwidth; in linear ADRC the extended state observer is commonly parameterized the same way by one observer bandwidth, set to 3–5× the control bandwidth. That is a rule of thumb, and noise and delay cap it just the same.

    An extension. Run the same observer the other way and you get force estimation without a torque sensor: two DOBs per joint, one for robust motion control and one to estimate the reaction torque (Murakami, Yu & Ohnishi 1993). The estimate is contaminated by inertia error times acceleration and degrades during fast motion — a problem that returns with collision detection in Section 05.

    自己验证Check it yourself

    • 手算一遍：τ = 1 ms、g = 600 rad/s，在 ω ≈ 1050 rad/s 处 |Δ| = 1、|Q| ≈ 0.5，乘积 0.5，正好是上面说的余量。把 g 提到 1500 rad/s 再算：同一频率上 |Q| ≈ 0.82，扫一遍频率，|QΔ| 的最大值约为 1，小增益条件刚好失效。
    • 下面的硬盘伺服实例是这张权衡表的真实版：它报告的振动抑制数字针对的是 100 Hz 以下的低频段。
    • Do it by hand: with τ = 1 ms and g = 600 rad/s, at ω ≈ 1050 rad/s |Δ| = 1 and |Q| ≈ 0.5, so the product is 0.5 — exactly the margin above. Raise g to 1500 rad/s: at the same frequency |Q| ≈ 0.82, and sweeping over frequency the peak of |QΔ| is about 1, so the small-gain condition just fails.
    • The hard-disk servo case below is this trade-off on real hardware: its reported vibration-rejection figures are for frequencies below 100 Hz.

    文中引用Cited here: Gao, Z. (2003). Scaling and bandwidth-parameterization based controller tuning. Proc. American Control Conference, vol. 6, 4989–4996. doi:10.1109/ACC.2003.1242516; Murakami, T., Yu, F., & Ohnishi, K. (1993). Torque sensorless control in multidegree-of-freedom manipulator. IEEE Transactions on Industrial Electronics, 40(2), 259–265. doi:10.1109/41.222648

    自抗扰控制（ADRC）做的是同一件事：把总扰动当成一个额外的状态，和其他状态一起估出来，再抵消掉。于是，对待不确定性有三条路：

    • 按最坏情况设计固定控制器：H∞ 设计、固定增益的滑模、按裕度整定的 PID；
    • 在线估计集总扰动并抵消：DOB、ADRC；
    • 在线更新参数：下一节。

    实际系统常常三者叠加。再补一个容易混的区分：“鲁棒”问的是“模型错了，还行不行”；“抗扰”问的是“模型完全准确时，外面推一把能不能扛住”。后者叫名义性能，哪怕模型一点不差，也得靠反馈去做。行走机器人被推一把还能站稳，主要靠迈步和平衡策略，不是本节意义上的鲁棒控制。

    Active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) does the same job: treat the lumped disturbance as one extra state, estimate it together with the others, and cancel it. That leaves three ways to handle uncertainty:

    • design a fixed controller for the worst case: H∞ design, fixed-gain sliding mode, PID tuned for margin;
    • estimate the lumped disturbance online and cancel it: DOB, ADRC;
    • update parameters online: the next section.

    Real systems often stack all three. One distinction that is easy to blur: “robust” asks whether the loop still works when the model is wrong; “disturbance rejection” asks whether, with a perfect model, it can take a shove from outside. The latter is nominal performance, and feedback has to provide it even when the model is exact. A walking robot that stays up after a shove owes that mainly to stepping and balance strategies — not robust control in this section’s sense.

    工程实例From the field

    硬盘磁头伺服里的扰动观测器A disturbance observer in a hard-disk head servo

    系统是硬盘读写磁头的磁道跟随伺服。唯一可用的测量是位置误差信号，产品对成本极其敏感，不可能为了控制再加传感器。问题是内部和外部的冲击、振动会把磁头推离磁道，而磁头定位精度直接限制了磁道能做多密、容量能做多大。做法是在原有的反馈回路上加一个 DOB：用位置误差信号和名义模型估出扰动，再补偿回去；在仿真和摇台实验里验证了对冲击和振动的抑制。

    The system is the track-following servo of a disk drive’s read/write head. The only measurement is the position error signal, and the product is so cost-sensitive that adding a sensor for control is out of the question. Internal and external shock and vibration push the head off track, and head positioning directly limits how densely tracks can be packed — and so the drive’s capacity. The fix: augment the existing feedback loop with a DOB that estimates the disturbance from the position error signal and a nominal model, then compensates for it. Shock and vibration rejection was demonstrated in simulation and on a shake table.

    100 Hz 以下的位置误差（振动实验）Position error below 100 Hz (vibration tests)
    降低 61%–96%down 61%–96%
    实验冲击下的最大位置误差Peak position error under an experimental shock
    降低 59%down 59%
    新增传感器Additional sensors
    0 个none

    学到什么　DOB 只要一个名义模型，不要新传感器，这正是它在低成本产品里站得住的原因。按上面“深入一层”的分析，收益只能落在低频、Q 的带宽以内（论文报告的振动抑制数字也都在 100 Hz 以下）；作者还专门讨论了位置误差信号里的噪声会带来什么影响——Q 放宽的代价就在这里。

    Lesson. A DOB needs only a nominal model and no new sensor, which is exactly why it survives in low-cost products. By the analysis in “going deeper” above, its benefit can only come at low frequency, inside Q’s bandwidth (the paper’s vibration figures are all for below 100 Hz), and the authors also discuss the effect of noise in the position error signal — the price of widening Q.

    出处Source: White, M. T., Tomizuka, M., & Smith, C. (2000). Improved track following in magnetic disk drives using a disturbance observer. IEEE/ASME Transactions on Mechatronics, 5(1), 3–11. doi:10.1109/3516.828584

    外骨骼视角Exoskeleton lens人的力矩和电机力矩都直接作用在同一个关节上。对控制器来说，这正是从“同一个入口”进来的匹配型扰动，所以以跟踪为目标的高增益鲁棒控制器会把它顶回去，穿戴者觉得在和机器较劲。鲁棒工具应放在内环，对付执行器自己的扰动（摩擦、阀的非线性）。气动执行器的压力环怎样用滑模，见上面讲“不匹配扰动”的深入一层。The wearer’s torque and the motor’s torque act directly on the same joint. To the controller, that is a matched disturbance coming in through the same entry point, so a high-gain robust controller built for tracking will push it right back, and the wearer feels like they are fighting the machine. Keep robust tools in the inner loops, aimed at the actuator’s own disturbances (friction, valve nonlinearity). How to use sliding mode on a pneumatic pressure loop is in the “going deeper” on unmatched disturbances above.

    反过来想Flip it around

    不做鲁棒设计：名义模型一偏，性能跟着偏，而且没有事先给定的保证——下面实验里的灰色实线就是这样。上界估小了，保证是假的；估大了，增益高、抖振大、偏保守。

    边界在哪：保证只在假定的集合之内，滑模的不变性只对匹配型不确定性；离散实现和边界层下只能保证误差有界。“对碰撞不敏感”在人机交互里也不是优点：控制器会用最大力矩坚持原轨迹，相当于接触刚度极高；协作场景要的是检测到碰撞后顺应（第 05 节）。

    卡在哪里：为了最坏情况，一直付出高增益和抖振。如果不确定的只是几个不变或慢变的参数，一直硬扛很浪费。

    Skip robust design and performance drifts with every departure from the nominal model, with no guarantee given in advance — the solid gray line in the experiment below. Underestimate the bound and the guarantee is fiction; overestimate it and you pay in gain, chattering and conservatism.

    Limits: the guarantee lives only inside the assumed set, and sliding-mode invariance covers only matched uncertainty; with sampling and a boundary layer, all you get is a bounded error. Being “insensitive to collisions” is no virtue around people, either: the controller spends full torque holding its trajectory, which amounts to an extremely stiff contact. Collaborative robots should detect the collision and yield (Section 05).

    Where it gets stuck: you pay for the worst case all the time, in gain and chattering. If the uncertainty is really just a few constant or slowly varying parameters, bracing forever is wasteful.

    场景里并排的两根摆臂分别由滑模和同带宽的 PD 控制，追同一条虚线画的期望摆动；真实误差只有几毫弧度，所以臂尖外侧的粗弧把误差放大 10 倍画出来（旁标 ×10），两根臂同一比例。图里的相平面横轴是误差 e、纵轴是误差变化率 ė，那条斜线就是滑模面 s = 0，状态点先被推到线上，再沿着它滑向原点。先只把边界层 Φ 调到 0，看力矩怎样开始高频来回跳，这就是抖振。先猜：负载偏差从 +50% 加到 +200%，滑模的误差会大几倍？In the scene, two pendulum arms side by side — one under sliding mode, one under a PD of the same bandwidth — follow the same dashed target swing. The real errors are only a few milliradians, so a thick arc just outside each tip draws the error magnified 10× (marked ×10), on the same scale for both arms. In the phase-plane plot the horizontal axis is the error e and the vertical axis its rate ė; the slanted line is the sliding surface s = 0, and the state is first pushed onto it, then slides along it to the origin. Set only the boundary layer Φ to 0 and watch the torque start flipping back and forth at high frequency: that is chattering. Predict: raise the load error from +50% to +200% — how many times larger does the sliding-mode error get?

    你应该看到：图里灰色实线是同一名义模型、两个极点都放在 −λ 的 PD，橙线是滑模，灰色虚线是“等效高增益 PD”。默认设置下，滑模的最大误差约 0.003 rad，低增益 PD 约 0.037 rad；可要是把 PD 的增益提到与边界层等效（Kp = λk/Φ，Kd = λ + k/Φ，即虚线），它和滑模完全重合。记住这一点：边界层里的滑模就是增益为 k/Φ 的高增益 PD，默认设置下它的优势来自增益更高，而不是切换。负载偏差从 +50% 拖到 +200%，滑模的最大误差只从约 0.003 rad 涨到 0.004 rad，这也是高增益的功劳。What you should see: in the plots, the solid gray line is a PD with the same nominal model and both poles at −λ, the orange line is sliding mode, and the dashed gray line is the “equivalent high-gain PD”. With the defaults, sliding mode keeps the peak error near 0.003 rad against about 0.037 rad for the low-gain PD — yet a PD raised to the boundary layer’s equivalent gain (Kp = λk/Φ, Kd = λ + k/Φ; the dashed line) produces exactly the same curve. Keep this in mind: inside the boundary layer, sliding mode is simply a high-gain PD with gain k/Φ, so with the defaults its edge comes from higher gain, not from switching. Dragging the load error from +50% to +200% raises the sliding-mode peak error only from about 0.003 rad to 0.004 rad — again, high gain at work.

    把边界层调到 0，才看得到真正的切换：误差又小了六七倍，代价是力矩抖振，抖振指标涨了一千多倍。再把边界层放回默认的 0.3，在“更多参数”里把采样周期拉到 15–20 ms：第 ⑤ 步的那条线被跨过了，边界层比采样造成的带还薄，等效高增益 PD 在离散时间下失稳（力矩图上会标出“失稳（被限幅困住）”，它只是被 30 N·m 的力矩上限困住才没有飞出去），滑模本身也退化成剧烈抖振。Set the boundary layer to 0 to see real switching: the error shrinks another six- to sevenfold, paid for in torque chatter, with the chattering index up more than a thousandfold. Now put the boundary layer back to its default 0.3 and, under “More parameters”, stretch the sample period to 15–20 ms, crossing the line from step 5: the layer is thinner than the band sampling creates, the equivalent high-gain PD goes unstable in discrete time (the torque plot labels it “unstable (trapped by the limit)”; only the 30 N·m torque limit keeps it from flying off), and sliding mode itself degenerates into violent chattering.

    勾上“碰撞冲击”（或者直接点一下摆臂），所需 k 升到约 75，超过实际的 k = 60：保证已不成立。注意，这个实验没有模拟执行器带宽和测量噪声，你看到的抖振只来自 1 kHz 的采样切换；真机上，电流环、阀和传动柔性会把它放大。Tick “Impact” (or just tap an arm) and the required k jumps to about 75, above the actual k = 60: the guarantee is gone. One caveat: this experiment models neither actuator bandwidth nor measurement noise, so the chattering you see comes only from switching at the 1 kHz sample rate; on real hardware the current loop, valves and transmission compliance amplify it.

    一句话Takeaway

    鲁棒控制拿“最坏情况”换来保证：它要一个误差上界，偏保守，而且在假定的集合之外什么也不保证。

    Robust control buys its guarantees by designing for the worst case: it needs an error bound, it tends to be conservative, and outside the assumed set it promises nothing.

    下一个问题：如果未知的只是几个慢变参数（比如手里多拿了一个工件），能不能边干边估？Next question: if the unknowns are just a few slowly varying parameters (a tool you just picked up, say), can we estimate them as we go?

    延伸阅读Further reading

    1. Stein, G. (2003). Respect the unstable. IEEE Control Systems Magazine, 23(4), 12–25. doi:10.1109/MCS.2003.1213600
      Freudenberg, J. S., & Looze, D. P. (1985). Right half plane poles and zeros and design tradeoffs in feedback systems. IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control, 30(6), 555–565. doi:10.1109/TAC.1985.1104004

      从这里开始：Stein 这篇把灵敏度的根本限制、输入饱和与不稳定对象放在一起讲，也提醒读者这类控制缺陷曾经导致人员死亡；Freudenberg 与 Looze 用 S、T 满足的积分关系给出右半平面极点、零点带来的设计限制，是水床效应的经典出处。

      Start here. Stein ties fundamental sensitivity limits, input saturation and instability together, and reminds readers that such control inadequacies have cost lives. Freudenberg and Looze express the limits imposed by right-half-plane poles and zeros as integral relations on S and T — a classic source on the waterbed effect.

    2. Sariyildiz, E., Oboe, R., & Ohnishi, K. (2020). Disturbance observer-based robust control and its applications: 35th anniversary overview. IEEE Transactions on Industrial Electronics, 67(3), 2042–2053. doi:10.1109/TIE.2019.2903752

      DOB 提出 35 年的综述：起源、主要结果、线性与非线性系统在同一框架下的分析与综合，以及工程应用。想系统学 DOB，读这一篇。

      A 35-year survey of the DOB: its origins, the main results, analysis and synthesis for linear and nonlinear systems in one framework, and engineering applications. The one paper to read for a systematic view.

    3. Ohnishi, K., Shibata, M., & Murakami, T. (1996). Motion control for advanced mechatronics. IEEE/ASME Transactions on Mechatronics, 1(1), 56–67. doi:10.1109/3516.491410

      把运动控制的鲁棒性表述为“刚度”，用扰动估计把控制器变成加速度控制器，再在上面按任务自由设定刚度。DOB 在运动控制里的经典读物。

      Frames the robustness of motion control as stiffness, uses disturbance estimation to turn the controller into an acceleration controller, and then sets task stiffness freely on top of it. The classic account of the DOB in motion control.

    4. Slotine, J.-J. E. (1984). Sliding controller design for non-linear systems. International Journal of Control, 40(2), 421–434. doi:10.1080/00207178408933284

      滑模设计的经典：显式给出跟踪精度与参数不确定性大小、未建模动态频率范围之间的折中。边界层的工程意义就是从这里来的。

      The sliding-control classic: an explicit trade-off between tracking precision, the extent of parametric uncertainty and the frequency range of unmodeled dynamics. This is where the boundary layer gets its engineering meaning.

    5. Utkin, V. I. (1977). Variable structure systems with sliding modes. IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control, 22(2), 212–222. doi:10.1109/TAC.1977.1101446
      Levant, A. (2003). Higher-order sliding modes, differentiation and output-feedback control. International Journal of Control, 76(9–10), 924–941. doi:10.1080/0020717031000099029

      前者是变结构系统与滑模设计、分析的经典综述；后者讲高阶滑模：摆脱“相对阶必须为 1”的限制，采样下精度最高可达 T 的 r 次方量级，并给出有限时间收敛的鲁棒精确微分器。

      The first is the classic survey of design and analysis for variable-structure systems with sliding modes. The second covers higher-order sliding modes: no more “relative degree must be one”, precision up to order T^r under sampling, and robust exact differentiators with finite-time convergence.

    6. Han, J. (2009). From PID to active disturbance rejection control. IEEE Transactions on Industrial Electronics, 56(3), 900–906. doi:10.1109/TIE.2008.2011621

      ADRC 的提出者韩京清本人写的英文综述：点出 PID 的四个弱点，并对应提出过渡过程、抗噪跟踪微分器、非线性反馈、总扰动估计与抑制四项措施。

      ADRC summarized in English by its originator, Jingqing Han: four weaknesses of PID, answered by a transient-profile generator, a noise-tolerant tracking differentiator, nonlinear feedback, and estimation and rejection of the total disturbance.

    04自适应控制：边干活边估参数Adaptive control: estimate the parameters while you work

    面对未知与接触Cope with uncertainty and contact

    问题The question

    协作臂从桌上拿起一个没登记过重量的扳手，还想跟得一样准。如果不确定的只是几个参数，比如这个负载的质量，能不能一边干活一边把它们估出来，让控制器自己变准？

    A collaborative arm picks up a wrench whose weight nobody entered, and it still has to track just as accurately. If what’s uncertain is just a handful of parameters — this payload’s mass, say — can the controller estimate them while it works and get better on its own?

    本节要点（5 分钟版）This section in brief

    • 如果未知的只是几个不变或慢变的参数（比如刚拿起的工件的质量），可以一边干活一边估：方程对这些参数是线性的，τ = Yθ。
    • 用一个像能量一样的函数推出参数更新律，可以证明跟踪误差收敛；但跟踪变准不等于参数估对。要估对，运动得足够“丰富”（持续激励）。
    • 模型里有没写进去的快动态或外扰时，标准自适应律可能把参数越调越偏，甚至失稳；工程上要加 σ 修正、投影、死区，执行器饱和时暂停更新。
    • 分工：慢变的交给自适应，突变的交给扰动观测器，能测到的交给增益调度。外骨骼只自适应机器侧的参数，不在线辨识人。
    • If the unknowns are just a few constant or slowly varying parameters — the mass of a part you just picked up, say — you can estimate them while you work: the equations are linear in those parameters, τ = Yθ.
    • An energy-like function yields an update law that provably makes the tracking error converge. Tracking well is not the same as estimating correctly, though; that takes sufficiently rich motion (persistent excitation).
    • Fast dynamics or disturbances missing from the model can make the standard adaptive law drift further and further, even into instability; in practice add σ-modification, projection or a dead zone, and freeze adaptation while the actuator saturates.
    • Division of labor: slow changes go to adaptation, abrupt ones to a disturbance observer, anything measurable to gain scheduling. An exoskeleton adapts only machine-side parameters and never identifies the wearer online.

    第一次读可以跳过：工程实例、各处“深入一层”、“两类自适应”一段里的各种方法名称。

    Safe to skip on a first read: the field example, the “Going deeper” boxes, and the method names in “Two kinds of adaptation”.

    本节符号：s 是滑动变量（同 03 节）；θ^ 是参数估计值，θ~=θ^−θ 是估计误差；Γ 是自适应增益，决定估计值随误差改得多快，实验里用一个旋钮 γ 统一调它的大小。

    Notation: s is the sliding variable (as in Section 03); θ^ is the parameter estimate and θ~=θ^−θ the estimation error; Γ is the adaptation gain, which sets how fast the estimates respond to the error; the experiment scales it with a single knob, γ.

    从方程的“形状”出发Start from the shape of the equation

    能，而且可以证明跟踪误差会收敛；但“参数估对”是另一回事，要另外付代价。以一个带重力的单关节为例：

    Yes — and you can prove that the tracking error converges. Getting the parameters right is a separate matter with its own price. Take a single joint under gravity:

    1. 理想模型 · 对参数线性Ideal model: linear in the parameters

      Jq¨+bq˙+mglsinq=[q¨q˙sinq][Jbmgl]T=Yθ

      方程对 q 是非线性的（有 sinq），对未知数 J、b、mgl 却是线性的：已知信号排成一行，乘上参数列 θ 就是力矩。这叫线性参数化（方程对未知参数是线性的），那一行叫回归矩阵 Y（只含已知信号、乘上参数就得到力矩的那部分）。第 02 节说过，多关节刚体动力学同样如此。

      The equation is nonlinear in q (there is a sinq) but linear in the unknowns J, b and mgl: a row of known signals times a column of parameters θ gives the torque. This is linear parameterization (the equation is linear in the unknown parameters), and the row is the regressor matrix Y (the matrix of known signals that multiplies the parameters). As Section 02 noted, multi-joint rigid-body dynamics share this property.

    2. 参考速度与滑动变量A reference velocity and a sliding variable

      q˙r=q˙d−λes=q˙−q˙r=e˙+λeτ=Yθ^−KDsY=[q¨rq˙rsinq]

      s 就是上一节滑模里的那个量：s=0 时误差按 λ 指数衰减。控制律用当前的估计 θ^ 算补偿力矩，再加一项阻尼 −KDs。

      为什么用 q˙r 而不直接用 q˙d？q˙r=q˙d−λe 把“还差多少位置”也折算成了速度，差得多就要求回来得快，于是 s=q˙−q˙r 同时管住速度误差和位置误差。就像开车跟车：落后得越远，你给自己定的目标车速就越高。另外，Y 里唯一的加速度是 q¨r，它由期望轨迹和测得的速度算出，所以不需要测加速度。

      s is the same quantity as in sliding mode: when s=0, the error decays at rate λ. The control law computes a compensation torque from the current estimate θ^ and adds damping −KDs.

      Why q˙r rather than q˙d? q˙r=q˙d−λe converts “how far off in position” into a velocity as well — the further behind, the faster it demands to catch up — so s=q˙−q˙r polices velocity error and position error at once. It is like following another car: the further you fall behind, the higher the speed you set yourself. And the only acceleration in Y is q¨r, computed from the desired trajectory and the measured velocity, so no acceleration measurement is needed.

    3. 让能量函数下降：先只看一个未知参数Make an energy-like function go down: one unknown first

      τ=Jq¨r+bq˙r+θ^sinq−KDsθ=mgl

      先看最简单的情形：J、b 已知，只有重力项 θ=mgl 未知（负载一换，它就变）。控制律用估计值 θ^ 补重力，再加阻尼。

      Start with the simplest case: J and b are known and only the gravity term θ=mgl is unknown (it changes whenever the payload does). The law compensates gravity with the estimate θ^ and adds damping.

      Js˙=−(KD+b)s+θ~sinq

      把控制律代进对象，用 q¨=s˙+q¨r、q˙=s+q˙r 换掉 q¨、q˙：能算的都抵掉了，只剩阻尼项和一个“估错造成的力矩” θ~sinq。

      Substitute the law into the plant and replace q¨ and q˙ by s˙+q¨r and s+q˙r. Everything computable cancels, leaving the damping term and one “torque from the wrong estimate”, θ~sinq.

      V=12Js2+θ~22γV˙=−(KD+b)s2+θ~(ssinq+θ^˙γ)

      V 是一个Lyapunov 函数（一个像能量一样、不会小于零的量；只要证明它一直不增，误差和估计误差就都跑不远）：前一半像跟踪误差的“动能”，后一半像参数误差的“势能”。求导时 θ 不变，所以 θ~ 的导数就是 θ^˙；把上一行的 Js˙ 代进 Jss˙，就得到第二、三行。

      V is a Lyapunov function (a non-negative, energy-like quantity; show it never increases and neither the error nor the estimation error can wander far): its first term acts like the kinetic energy of the tracking error, its second like the potential energy of the parameter error. Since θ is constant, the derivative of θ~ is just θ^˙; substituting the previous line for Js˙ in Jss˙ gives the second and third lines.

      θ^˙=−γssinqV˙=−(KD+b)s2≤0

      括号里的交叉项可正可负，没法保证 V 下降；把自适应律（参数估计怎么随误差更新）选成这样，括号正好为 0。直觉上：重力少算了，手臂就比期望位置低一点（sinq>0 时 s<0），这条律就把 θ^ 往上调。三个参数时一模一样：把 sinq 换成回归行 Y、把 θ~ 换成向量，就是 θ^˙=−ΓYTs（Slotine & Li 1987）。

      V 只减不增，所以 s 和 θ~ 都跑不远。但“跑不远”还不等于“误差最后归零”，中间差的这一步，用记账来想最好懂。把 V 当成一笔存款：它不会小于零，又从不增加，所以从头到尾最多只能花掉 V(0) 那么多。每一刻只要 s≠0，就要付一笔 (KD+b)s2 的“电费”。如果 s 一次又一次地冒出来，而它又不能瞬间冒出、瞬间消失（它变化的速度有上限，这里由 s、θ~ 和期望轨迹都有界来保证），那每冒一次头都至少要花掉一笔固定的钱；冒无穷多次，就得花无穷多钱，存款不够。所以 s 只能越来越小：s→0，e 也跟着趋于 0（s=e˙+λe 趋于 0，误差就按 λ 衰减下去）。把这个论证写严格，就叫 Barbalat 引理。注意推导里没有任何一步要求 θ~→0，这就是下一步要说的。

      The cross term in the bracket can take either sign, so nothing yet guarantees that V falls. Choose the adaptation law (how the estimates update from the error) like this and the bracket is exactly zero. Intuitively: if gravity is underestimated, the arm sags a little below where it should be (s<0 while sinq>0), and the law nudges θ^ upward. With three parameters it is exactly the same: replace sinq by the regressor row Y and θ~ by a vector, and you get θ^˙=−ΓYTs (Slotine & Li 1987).

      Since V never increases, s and θ~ cannot wander far. But “not far” is not yet “the error goes to zero”, and the missing step is easiest to see as bookkeeping. Treat V as a bank balance: it can’t go below zero and never grows, so the total ever spent is at most V(0). Every moment that s≠0 costs a fee of (KD+b)s2. If s kept popping up again and again — and it cannot pop up and vanish instantly, because its rate of change is capped (guaranteed here because s, θ~ and the desired trajectory are all bounded) — each pop would cost at least some fixed amount, infinitely many pops would cost an infinite amount, and the balance can’t cover that. So s must fade: s→0, and e follows (with s=e˙+λe near zero, the error decays at rate λ). Made rigorous, this argument is Barbalat’s lemma. Notice that nothing in the derivation requires θ~→0; that is the next step.

    4. 证明没有给出的东西What the proof does not give you

      ∫tt+T0φφTdτ≥αI

      证明只保证跟踪误差收敛、估计值有界，并不保证 θ^→θ。要让参数也收敛，回归量 φ（这里就是 YT）必须满足持续激励（运动得足够“丰富”，让每个参数都有机会单独显形）：在任何一段长度为 T0 的时间里，运动都要让每个参数“单独露脸”。上面的式子就是这句话的数学写法：只有一个参数时，它要求这段时间里回归量的平方积分不小于 α，也就是这个信号不能一直是零；有多个参数时，要求对参数的每一种组合方式都如此——不管从哪个方向去看，数据里都得看得到它。反例正是实验里的窄带运动：只做一个固定频率的来回挥动时，角加速度和 sinq 几乎按固定比例一起变化（q¨≈−ω2q，小角度时 sinq≈q），惯量 J 和重力项 mgl 的作用混在一起，估计器很难分清谁是谁。所以 J^ 可以停在错的值上，跟踪照样很好；精确的说法见本节最后一个深入一层。

      窄带、重复的动作——外骨骼的周期动作、两点之间的搬运——通常都做不到这一点，估计值可能停在错的值上，或在噪声下慢慢走偏，叫参数漂移。多连杆机器人上还有一层限制：有些参数永远只以固定的组合出现在方程里，只能估出组合（叫基参数），单个分不开。

      The proof guarantees tracking and bounded estimates, not θ^→θ. For the parameters to converge too, the regressor φ (here YT) must satisfy persistent excitation (motion rich enough for every parameter to show itself): in every window of length T0 the motion has to let each parameter show its face on its own. The formula is that sentence in math: with one parameter, it says the integral of the regressor squared over the window is at least α — the signal can’t stay at zero; with several, the same must hold for every way of combining the parameters — whichever direction you look from, the data must show something. The experiment’s narrow-band motion is the counterexample. Swing back and forth at one fixed frequency and the angular acceleration and sinq move almost in fixed proportion (q¨≈−ω2q, and sinq≈q for small angles), so the effects of the inertia J and the gravity term mgl blur together and the estimator can hardly tell them apart. That is why J^ can stall at a wrong value while tracking stays excellent; the precise version is in this section’s last “going deeper”.

      Narrow-band, repetitive motion — an exoskeleton’s cyclic movements, pick-and-place between two points — usually fails this test, and the estimates may stall at wrong values or slowly wander off under noise, which is called parameter drift. Multi-link robots add one more limit: some parameters only ever appear in the equations in fixed combinations, so only the combinations (the base parameters) can be estimated, never the individual values.

    5. ＋ 未建模动态+ Unmodeled dynamics

      θ^˙=−Γ(YTs+σ(θ^−θ0))

      Rohrs 等（1985）给出过反例：对象名义上是一阶的，实际还带一对没写进模型的高频极点（比如执行器里一段很快、平时可以忽略的动态）。特定频率的正弦参考，或者任意频率（甚至常值）的小幅输出扰动，都能让标准自适应律把回路增益越调越大，直到激起那对高频极点而失稳。一句话原因：自适应律把看到的误差全都当成“参数没估对”，一直按误差去改参数，它不知道有一部分误差来自模型里根本没有的快动态或外扰。外扰造成的误差往往靠改参数消不干净，自适应律却一直对它积分，参数就朝一个方向慢慢漂；参考信号的频率高到快动态已经带来很大的相位滞后时，误差和回归量之间“同向 / 反向”的关系会颠倒，自适应律以为在减小误差，其实在把回路增益往上推。细节见下面讲参数漂移的深入一层。

      常用的修正是σ 修正（让估计值缓慢地向先验值 θ₀ 回拉，防止漂移），代价是理想情况下也会留下一点偏差。另外两种常用工具：参数投影，给估计值设物理上的上下界；死区，误差小于噪声时停止更新。Γ 要从小往大调；执行器饱和或安全限幅生效期间应暂停更新，否则会把饱和造成的误差当成参数误差去积分。

      Rohrs et al. (1985) gave the counterexample: a plant that is nominally first order but carries a pair of unmodeled high-frequency poles (a fast actuator lag you would normally ignore, say). A sinusoidal reference at particular frequencies, or a small output disturbance at any frequency — even a constant — can make the standard adaptive law keep raising the loop gain until it excites those poles and the loop goes unstable. The short reason: the adaptive law treats every bit of error it sees as a wrong parameter and keeps adjusting accordingly; it has no way of knowing that part of the error comes from fast dynamics the model doesn’t contain, or from an outside disturbance. Error caused by a disturbance often can’t be removed by retuning parameters, yet the law keeps integrating it, so the parameters creep off in one direction. And when the reference frequency is high enough for the fast dynamics to add a large phase lag, the in-step / out-of-step relation between error and regressor flips: the law believes it is reducing the error while it is actually pushing the loop gain up. Details are in the “going deeper” on parameter drift below.

      The usual fix is σ-modification (a slow leak of the estimates back toward the prior θ₀ to stop drift), at the cost of a small bias even in the ideal case. Two other common tools: parameter projection, which keeps the estimates within physical bounds, and a dead zone, which stops adapting when the error is below the noise. Raise Γ gradually, and freeze adaptation while the actuator saturates or a safety limit is active — otherwise the law integrates saturation-induced error as if it were parameter error.

    深入一层Going deeper V̇ ≤ 0 之后还差哪一步？Barbalat 引理，以及多关节时为什么既不用测加速度、也不用求 M̂⁻¹V̇ ≤ 0 — now what? Barbalat’s lemma, and why the multi-joint version needs neither measured acceleration nor M̂⁻¹

    前置知识 “一致连续”的概念、矩阵形式的 Lyapunov 推导。正文第 ③ 步的“记账”说法就是这里的直觉，这一块是它的严格版。

    Background. Uniform continuity and matrix-form Lyapunov arguments. The bookkeeping picture in step 3 of the main text is the intuition; this is the rigorous version.

    为什么不能直接用 LaSalle　02 节 PD＋重力补偿停在定点，闭环不显含时间，LaSalle 不变集原理一步到位。这里在跟踪随时间变化的 qd(t)，闭环显含时间，LaSalle 不适用，要换一个工具。

    Barbalat 引理（Lyapunov 形式）　若 V 有下界、V̇ ≤ 0，并且 V̇ 一致连续（V̈ 有界就够了），则 V̇ → 0。这里 V̈ = −2(KD + b)sṡ。V 不增，说明 s 和 θ̃ 都有界；期望轨迹及其导数有界时 ṡ 也有界，于是 V̈ 有界，得到 s → 0。最后，s = ė + λe 可以看成 e 经过一个稳定的一阶滤波器的“输入”，s → 0 推出 e → 0。整条链里，没有任何一步推出 θ̃ → 0。

    多关节　回归形式取 Y(q, q̇, q̇r, q̈r)θ = M(q)q̈r + C(q, q̇)q̇r + G(q)，控制律 τ = Yθ̂ − KD s 代回运动方程：

    Why not LaSalle? PD plus gravity compensation in Section 02 regulates to a fixed point, so the closed loop does not depend explicitly on time and LaSalle’s invariance principle settles it in one step. Here we track a time-varying qd(t); the closed loop depends on time, LaSalle does not apply, and we need a different tool.

    Barbalat’s lemma (Lyapunov form). If V is bounded below, V̇ ≤ 0, and V̇ is uniformly continuous (a bounded V̈ is enough), then V̇ → 0. Here V̈ = −2(KD + b)sṡ. Since V never increases, s and θ̃ stay bounded; with a bounded desired trajectory and derivatives, ṡ is bounded too, so V̈ is bounded and s → 0. Finally, s = ė + λe is the input to a stable first-order filter whose output is e, so s → 0 implies e → 0. Nothing in this chain implies θ̃ → 0.

    Several joints. Take the regressor form Y(q, q̇, q̇r, q̈r)θ = M(q)q̈r + C(q, q̇)q̇r + G(q) and substitute the law τ = Yθ̂ − KD s into the equations of motion:

    Ms˙+Cs+KDs=Yθ~V=12sTMs+12θ~TΓ−1θ~V˙=−sTKDs+12sT(M˙−2C)s+θ~T(YTs+Γ−1θ^˙)

    中间一项为零，最后一项被自适应律 θ̂̇ = −ΓYᵀs 消掉。一个容易忽略的细节：这里要求 Ṁ − 2C 对任意向量 s 都给出零，所以 C 必须按 Christoffel 符号构造；02 节那个证明只用到 q̇ᵀ(Ṁ − 2C)q̇ = 0（“科氏力不做功”），任何合法的 C 都行。

    Y 里只有 q̈r = q̈d − λė，由期望轨迹和测得的速度算出，所以不需要测加速度；整个控制律里也没有 M̂⁻¹，估计值哪怕暂时不正定，也不会出现除以零（Slotine & Li 1987）。对比同期 Craig、Hsu & Sastry（1987）的方案：把估计值直接代进计算力矩控制，就要测加速度，还要求 M̂ 始终可逆。这种“保留机械结构、只整形能量”的写法，就是 02 节“深入一层”里那个无源性控制律加上在线估参数。

    The middle term vanishes and the adaptation law θ̂̇ = −ΓYᵀs cancels the last one. An easily missed detail: here Ṁ − 2C must give zero for an arbitrary vector s, so C has to be built from Christoffel symbols. The Section 02 proof only needed q̇ᵀ(Ṁ − 2C)q̇ = 0 — “Coriolis forces do no work” — which any valid C satisfies.

    The only acceleration in Y is q̈r = q̈d − λė, computed from the desired trajectory and the measured velocity, so no acceleration measurement is needed; and M̂⁻¹ appears nowhere, so even a temporarily indefinite estimate never causes a division by zero (Slotine & Li 1987). Compare the contemporaneous scheme of Craig, Hsu and Sastry (1987), which plugs the estimates straight into computed-torque control and therefore needs measured acceleration and an M̂ that stays invertible. This structure-preserving, energy-shaping form is exactly the passivity-based law from Section 02’s “going deeper”, with online parameter estimates.

    自己验证Check it yourself

    • 保持单频运动，把自适应增益 γ 分别设为 1、3、10：最后 3 s 的 RMS 误差都在 0.0005 rad 左右，约为固定参数灰线（约 0.025 rad）的 1/50。证明保证的正是这一点；参数最后停在哪里，是另一回事（本节最后一个“深入一层”）。
    • Keep the single tone and set the adaptation gain γ to 1, 3 and 10 in turn. The RMS error over the last 3 s stays around 0.0005 rad each time, about 1/50 of the fixed-parameter gray line (about 0.025 rad). That is precisely what the proof guarantees; where the parameters end up is a separate question (the last “going deeper” of this section).

    两类自适应，以及 RLS 的位置Two kinds of adaptation, and where RLS fits

    自适应的方法名目很多，但按“拿什么误差来改参数”只分两类。一类用跟踪误差：手臂没跟上多少，就按这个去改参数。上面的 Slotine–Li 结构和多数模型参考自适应（MRAC，让闭环去追一个设计者指定的参考模型）属于这一类。另一类用预测误差：让模型算出“此刻应该需要多大力矩”，和实测力矩比，差多少就按差多少改；先用最小二乘辨识对象参数、再据此算控制器的自校正控制属于这一类。两者可以合用，叫复合自适应（Slotine & Li 1989）。它们和鲁棒控制的区别在于控制器在线变化，而不是固定不变。教科书里还常见“直接型／间接型”的叫法，它依赖约定（MRAC 和自校正控制各自都有两种写法），第一次读可以先不管。

    MRAC 里的参考模型由设计者指定，描述期望的闭环行为：它必须稳定、可实现，带宽要和执行器相容。理想假设下，MRAC 保证跟踪误差渐近趋于零。

    递推最小二乘（RLS，每来一个新数据就更新一次的最小二乘拟合）是估计器，不是控制律，用在预测误差驱动的自适应和参数辨识里；上面那种由 Lyapunov 证明导出的更新律则由跟踪误差驱动。RLS 靠遗忘因子 λf（越旧的数据权重越小；和滑模面斜率 λ 无关）跟踪慢变参数：

    Adaptive methods come under many names, but by what drives the parameter update there are only two kinds. One uses the tracking error: however far the arm falls behind, adjust the parameters by that. The Slotine–Li scheme above and most model reference adaptive control (MRAC: make the closed loop chase a reference model the designer chose) belong here. The other uses a prediction error: have the model predict the torque needed right now, compare it with the torque measured, and adjust by the gap. Self-tuning control, which identifies the plant by least squares and designs the controller from the estimates, belongs here. The two can be combined, which Slotine and Li (1989) call composite adaptive control. What separates all of them from robust control is that the controller changes online instead of staying fixed. Textbooks also split methods into “direct” and “indirect”, but those labels depend on convention (MRAC and self-tuning control each come in both forms); on a first reading you can ignore them.

    In MRAC the reference model is a design choice describing the closed-loop behavior you want: it must be stable and realizable, with a bandwidth the actuator can deliver. Under ideal assumptions MRAC drives the tracking error to zero asymptotically.

    Recursive least squares (RLS: a least-squares fit updated with every new sample) is an estimator, not a control law. It serves prediction-error-driven adaptation and parameter identification, whereas the Lyapunov-derived law above is driven by the tracking error. RLS tracks slow changes through a forgetting factor λf (older data counts less; unrelated to the sliding-surface slope λ):

    Neff≈11−λf

    等效记忆大约是这么多个采样：1 kHz、λf=0.999 时约 1 s。

    That is the effective memory in samples — about 1 s at 1 kHz with λf=0.999.

    深入一层Going deeper 有扰动时参数为什么会“漂”？σ 修正、投影、协方差管理各防的是什么？Why do the estimates drift once there is a disturbance — and what do σ-modification, projection and covariance management each guard against?

    前置知识 第 ③ 步的 Lyapunov 推导、不等式放缩。“三种修正，防的东西不同”这一段不需要推导，可以直接读。

    Background. The Lyapunov derivation of step 3 and bounding inequalities. The part on what the three fixes each guard against needs no derivation and can be read directly.

    漂移　加上一个有界扰动 d，第 ③ 步的结果变成

    Drift. Add a bounded disturbance d and step 3 becomes

    V˙=−(KD+b)s2+sd

    现在只有 |s| 大于 |d|max/(KD + b) 时才能保证 V̇ < 0；|s| 落进这条带里，V 就可能增长。V 里有 θ̃，V̇ 里却没有任何一项在惩罚 θ̃：在没被激励的方向上，θ̃ 会被噪声和扰动一点点推着走，没有力把它拉回来。这就是参数漂移（自适应控制的失稳分析与鲁棒性改进，见 Ioannou & Kokotovic 1984）。漂得够远，回路增益跟着变，最后可能激起没建模的快动态。

    Rohrs 反例的机理　Rohrs 等（1985）证明，自适应闭环里存在两个“无穷增益”的算子：特定频率的正弦参考，或者任意频率（包括常值）的正弦输出扰动，都能让回路增益无界地增长，直到激起对象里没建模的高频动态而失稳。正弦参考那一种可以这样理解：标准自适应律的收敛证明默认误差方程是“严格正实”的，也就是它在任何频率上的相位滞后都不超过 90°；没建模的高频极点在高频处加上额外的滞后，这个前提一被打破，梯度的方向就反了。常值扰动那一种，就是上面说的漂移。

    三种修正，防的东西不同

    • σ 修正：更新律里加 −Γσ(θ̂ − θ₀)，V̇ 就多出 −σθ̃ᵀ(θ̂ − θ₀) ≤ −(σ/2)|θ̃|² + (σ/2)|θ − θ₀|²。θ̃ 一大就被拉回来，所有信号一致最终有界；代价是没有扰动时估计也偏向先验 θ₀。e 修正把 σ 换成 σ 乘以误差的大小（这里是 σ|s|），误差小时几乎不泄漏，偏差更小（Narendra & Annaswamy 1987）。
    • 投影：把 θ̂ 限制在一个包含真值的凸集里，只削掉“往外走”的那部分更新，不破坏 V̇ ≤ 0 的论证。最该投影的是物理约束：质量为正，惯性张量物理上可实现。Wensing、Kim & Slotine（2018）把这些约束写成线性矩阵不等式（用质量分布的协方差而不是转动惯量来表达），可以直接放进辨识或更新里。实验里 Ĵ 估成负数，正是缺了这一步。
    • 协方差管理（RLS）：没被激励的方向上，协方差每步乘以 1/λf。1 kHz、λf = 0.999 时约每秒放大 e ≈ 2.7 倍，静止 10 s 就是约 2×10⁴ 倍；激励一回来，估计值就猛跳。限迹、方向遗忘、重置防的就是这个。

    Now V̇ < 0 is guaranteed only while |s| exceeds |d|max/(KD + b); once |s| is inside that band, V can grow. V contains θ̃, but no term in V̇ penalizes it: in unexcited directions, noise and disturbances nudge θ̃ along with nothing pulling it back. That is parameter drift (for instability analysis of adaptive control and robustness fixes, see Ioannou & Kokotovic 1984). Drift far enough and the loop gain changes with it, until unmodeled fast dynamics get excited.

    How the Rohrs counterexample works. Rohrs et al. (1985) showed that the adaptive loop contains two infinite-gain operators: a sinusoidal reference at specific frequencies, or a sinusoidal output disturbance at any frequency including DC, can make the loop gain grow without bound until it excites the plant’s unmodeled high-frequency dynamics and the loop goes unstable. The sinusoidal-reference case can be understood like this: the convergence proof of the standard adaptive law assumes the error equation is strictly positive real — its phase lag never exceeds 90° at any frequency. Unmodeled high-frequency poles add extra lag at high frequency; once that assumption breaks, the gradient points the wrong way. The constant-disturbance case is the drift described above.

    Three fixes, three different jobs

    • σ-modification adds −Γσ(θ̂ − θ₀) to the update, which contributes −σθ̃ᵀ(θ̂ − θ₀) ≤ −(σ/2)|θ̃|² + (σ/2)|θ − θ₀|² to V̇. A large θ̃ gets pulled back and every signal is uniformly ultimately bounded; the cost is a bias toward the prior θ₀ even without disturbances. The e-modification scales σ by the size of the error (here σ|s|), so the leak nearly stops when the error is small and the bias shrinks (Narendra & Annaswamy 1987).
    • Projection confines θ̂ to a convex set that contains the true value, removing only the outward-pointing part of the update, so the V̇ ≤ 0 argument survives. Physical constraints are the ones most worth projecting onto: positive mass and a physically realizable inertia tensor. Wensing, Kim and Slotine (2018) write these as linear matrix inequalities — in terms of the covariance of the mass distribution rather than the rotational inertia — ready to drop into identification or adaptation. The negative Ĵ in the experiment is exactly what happens without this step.
    • Covariance management (RLS). In unexcited directions the covariance is multiplied by 1/λf every step. At 1 kHz with λf = 0.999 that is a factor of about e ≈ 2.7 per second, or roughly 2×10⁴ after 10 s at rest — and when excitation returns, the estimates jump. Trace limits, directional forgetting and resets exist to stop exactly this.

    自己验证Check it yourself

    • 负载调到 3 kg、保持单频：Ĵ 最后是负的（约 −0.03 kg·m²），跟踪却依然很好。给 Ĵ 加一条“不小于空载手臂惯量 0.3 kg·m²”的投影，这种事就不会发生。
    • 打开 σ 修正：ĝ 被拉回先验值附近；为了让被激励的那个组合仍然对得上，Ĵ 反而离真值更远，误差略大。实验里没有未建模动态，所以只看得到它的代价，看不到它防漂移的好处。
    • Set the payload to 3 kg and keep the single tone: Ĵ ends up negative (about −0.03 kg·m²) while tracking stays good. Project Ĵ onto “no less than the unloaded arm’s 0.3 kg·m²” and this cannot happen.
    • Turn on σ-modification: ĝ is pulled back toward its prior, Ĵ moves further from the truth so that the excited combination still matches, and the error grows a little. The experiment has no unmodeled dynamics, so you see the cost but not the protection against drift.

    文中引用Cited here: Narendra, K. S., & Annaswamy, A. M. (1987). A new adaptive law for robust adaptation without persistent excitation. IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control, 32(2), 134–145. doi:10.1109/TAC.1987.1104543

    分工可以这样记：慢变的交给自适应，突变的交给观测器（上一节的 DOB），能测到的交给增益调度。

    A useful division of labor: slow changes go to adaptation, abrupt ones to an observer (the DOB of Section 03), and anything you can measure to gain scheduling.

    工程实例From the field

    给末端负载“称重”：从 MIT 直驱臂到 1.5 秒在线辨识Weighing the payload: from the MIT direct-drive arm to online identification in 1.5 seconds

    系统是装有腕部六维力/力矩传感器的机械臂，末端抓着一个惯性参数未知的负载；力控、前馈、碰撞检测都需要知道它的质量、质心和惯量。Atkeson、An 与 Hollerbach（1986）把牛顿–欧拉方程改写成“测得的力/力矩 = 回归量 × 惯性参数”，这正是正文第 ① 步的线性参数化；再用一般运动的数据做最小二乘，在 PUMA 600 和 MIT 串联直驱臂上实现了负载辨识；还辨识了直驱臂的连杆参数，用它预测的关节力矩与由电机电流估出的关节力矩吻合得很好。二十多年后，Kubus、Kröger 与 Wahl（2008）把负载辨识做成在线的：设计专门的估计轨迹，用递推总体最小二乘显式考虑数据矩阵里的噪声，并和普通 RLS、递推工具变量法做了实验比较。

    The system is an arm with a six-axis wrist force/torque sensor holding a load of unknown inertial parameters; force control, feedforward and collision detection all need its mass, center of mass and inertia. Atkeson, An and Hollerbach (1986) recast the Newton–Euler equations as “measured force/torque = regressor × inertial parameters” — the linear parameterization of step 1 — and estimated the parameters by least squares from general movement, implementing load estimation on a PUMA 600 and on the MIT Serial Link Direct Drive Arm. They also estimated the direct-drive arm’s link parameters, and the joint torques those parameters predicted matched the torques estimated from motor currents closely. Over two decades later, Kubus, Kröger and Wahl (2008) made load identification an online process: dedicated estimation trajectories, a recursive total-least-squares estimator that explicitly accounts for noise in the data matrix, and an experimental comparison with ordinary RLS and recursive instrumental variables.

    每个刚体负载的惯性参数Inertial parameters per rigid load
    10 个10
    在线估计用时（2008）Online estimation time (2008)
    约 1.5 sabout 1.5 s
    好估 / 难估（1986）Easy / hard (1986)
    质量、质心 / 转动惯量mass, center of mass / moments of inertia

    学到什么　① 质量和质心好估、转动惯量难估：和本节实验里 J 与 mgl 分不开，是同一个激励问题，所以要专门设计估计轨迹。② 1986 年那篇里，用运动数据辨识出的连杆参数，预测关节力矩比 CAD 模型给出的参数还准：别太信 CAD。③ 回归量里有噪声时，普通最小二乘和 RLS 是有偏的，要用考虑这一点的估计器（本节最后一个“深入一层”会在实验里看到这个偏差）。④ 这与正文“先走一段激励动作把参数估好、再固定下来用”的做法一脉相承。

    Lesson. (1) Mass and center of mass are easy, moments of inertia hard — the same excitation problem as the J-versus-mgl confusion in this section’s experiment, which is why estimation trajectories are designed on purpose. (2) In the 1986 work, link parameters identified from motion predicted joint torques better than parameters derived from CAD: don’t trust CAD too far. (3) With noise in the regressor, ordinary least squares and RLS are biased, and an estimator that accounts for it is needed (the last “going deeper” of this section shows the bias in the experiment). (4) It is the same practice the main text describes: run a dedicated excitation motion, estimate, then freeze.

    出处Sources: Atkeson, C. G., An, C. H., & Hollerbach, J. M. (1986). Estimation of inertial parameters of manipulator loads and links. The International Journal of Robotics Research, 5(3), 101–119. doi:10.1177/027836498600500306; Kubus, D., Kröger, T., & Wahl, F. M. (2008). On-line estimation of inertial parameters using a recursive total least-squares approach. Proc. IEEE/RSJ IROS, 3845–3852. doi:10.1109/IROS.2008.4650672

    外骨骼视角Exoskeleton lens不要在线辨识人体参数。穿戴者主动抬臂时，估计出的“手臂重量”会变小；向下用力时又会变大。人和估计器互相追逐，没有唯一的平衡点。适合自适应的是机器侧的慢变参数：供气压力到力矩的映射、阀的流量特性、摩擦、气囊材料的蠕变。Don’t identify the wearer’s parameters online. When the wearer lifts actively, the estimated arm weight drops; when they push down, it rises. Person and estimator end up chasing each other with no unique equilibrium. Adapt the slow, machine-side parameters instead: the supply-pressure-to-torque map, valve flow characteristics, friction, creep in the bladder material.

    深入一层Going deeper 运动天生不够丰富（外骨骼的周期动作、两点之间的搬运），还有办法把参数估准吗？If the motion is inherently poor in excitation — cyclic exoskeleton motion, point-to-point transfers — can the parameters still be estimated correctly?

    前置知识 矩阵的秩。“思路”和“工程上的前提”两段用不到它。

    Background. Matrix rank — though “The idea” and the engineering preconditions don’t need it.

    思路　梯度律只看“此刻”的数据，所以要求往后每一段时间都有足够的激励。换个思路：把过去某段激励丰富的数据存下来，和当前数据一起用。

    The idea. A gradient law uses only the data of the moment, which is why it needs rich excitation in every future window. Instead, store a stretch of well-excited data from the past and use it alongside the current data.

    θ^˙=−ΓYTs−Γ∑jWjT(Wjθ^−τj)

    (Wj, τj) 是存下的（滤波后的）回归量和实测力矩。第二项是“拿存下的数据做预测，按预测误差修正”。对这种同时使用记录数据和当前数据的自适应律，Chowdhary & Johnson（2010）证明：只要存下的数据线性无关（Σ WjᵀWj 满秩，这是一个随时可以检查的条件），跟踪误差和参数误差就都指数收敛，不再需要当前信号持续激励。他们称之为 concurrent learning。只用当前的滤波预测误差、和跟踪误差一起驱动更新，就是 Slotine & Li（1989）的复合自适应：它把正文里“跟踪误差驱动”和“预测误差驱动”两条路合在了一起。

    工程上的前提

    • 预测误差需要实测力矩（或由电流估出的力矩）；Wj 要用滤波形式构造，避免对位置做数值二次微分。
    • 存下的数据必须来自同一组参数：负载一换就得清空重录，否则旧数据会把估计拉回旧负载。
    • 回归量含噪带来的偏差（本节最后一个“深入一层”）不会因此消失。
    • 外骨骼：数据可以在标定阶段录，让机器（不是人）走一段丰富的运动，只用于机器侧的参数；人体参数仍然不要在线估（见上面的外骨骼视角）。

    (Wj, τj) are the stored (filtered) regressors and measured torques. The second term predicts with the stored data and corrects by the prediction error. For adaptive laws that use recorded and current data concurrently, Chowdhary and Johnson (2010) showed that linear independence of the recorded data (Σ WjᵀWj of full rank, a condition you can check at any time) is enough for both the tracking error and the parameter error to converge exponentially — no persistent excitation of the current signal required. They call this concurrent learning. Driving the update with the current filtered prediction error together with the tracking error is Slotine and Li’s composite adaptation (1989), which merges the two routes of the main text: updates driven by tracking error and updates driven by prediction error.

    Engineering preconditions

    • The prediction error needs measured torque (or torque estimated from current), and Wj should be built in filtered form to avoid differentiating position twice numerically.
    • The stored data must come from the same parameter set: change the payload and the stack must be cleared and re-recorded, or the old data drags the estimate back toward the old load.
    • The bias from a noisy regressor (the last “going deeper” of this section) does not go away.
    • For an exoskeleton, record the data during calibration, with the machine — not the wearer — running a rich motion, and use it for machine-side parameters only. The wearer’s parameters still shouldn’t be estimated online (see the exoskeleton note above).

    自己验证Check it yourself

    • 实验里的“激励充分度”就是 ∫YYᵀdt（9–12 s）最小与最大特征值之比，正是 concurrent learning 要检查满秩的那类矩阵：多频激励下约 1×10⁻³，单频约 6×10⁻⁶，几乎奇异。按上面的条件，先用多频运动录一段数据存起来，之后即使只做单频动作，估计也能收敛到真值。
    • The experiment’s “excitation richness” is the ratio of the smallest to the largest eigenvalue of ∫YYᵀdt over 9–12 s — the same kind of matrix whose rank concurrent learning checks. It reads about 1×10⁻³ with the multi-tone motion and about 6×10⁻⁶, nearly singular, with the single tone. By the condition above, recording a stretch of multi-tone data first would let the estimates converge to the truth even if only the single tone followed.

    文中引用Cited here: Chowdhary, G., & Johnson, E. (2010). Concurrent learning for convergence in adaptive control without persistency of excitation. Proc. 49th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control, 3674–3679. doi:10.1109/CDC.2010.5717148

    反过来想Flip it around

    不自适应：固定参数的控制器一直带着负载造成的误差（下面实验里的灰线），只能靠加大增益或按最坏情况设计去扛。

    边界在哪：激励不够时，跟踪很好，参数却停在错的值上——若别处还要用这些估计（前馈、安全判断），就会出问题。参数突变要经历收敛暂态，快变参数超出它的能力。回归矩阵写错或有未建模的快动态时，自适应无能为力，未加修正甚至会失稳（第 ⑤ 步）。下面的实验没有未建模动态，所以只看得到 σ 修正的代价，看不到它的好处。工业产品里常见的做法是：抓取后先走一段激励动作把负载参数估好，再固定下来用；在线自适应的暂态和漂移很难事先验证，这是它在产品里用得不多的原因之一。

    卡在哪里：自适应能把自由空间里的运动补准，前提是未知量不变或慢变。一碰到桌面或人的手臂，最大的未知量变成了环境刚度，它一点也不慢：一碰一松，就在零和 105 N/m 之间跳。而且 01–04 的目标都是“跟住轨迹”，位置误差乘上这个刚度，就是一个不受控的接触力。

    Skip adaptation and a fixed-parameter controller carries the payload-induced error forever (the gray line in the experiment below), unless you raise the gain or design for the worst case.

    Limits: with poor excitation, tracking is excellent while the parameters stall at wrong values — a problem if anything else, such as feedforward or a safety check, relies on those estimates. A sudden change triggers a convergence transient, and fast-varying parameters are out of reach. A wrong regressor or fast unmodeled dynamics leave adaptation helpless, and without modification it can even go unstable (step 5). The experiment below simulates no unmodeled dynamics, so there you will see σ-modification’s cost but not its benefit. In industrial products the common practice is to run a dedicated excitation motion after grasping, estimate the payload parameters, then freeze them; the transients and drift of online adaptation are hard to verify in advance, which is one reason products seldom use it.

    Where it gets stuck: adaptation can make free-space motion accurate, provided the unknowns are constant or slow. On contact with a table or a person’s arm, the biggest unknown becomes the environment’s stiffness, and it is anything but slow: it jumps between zero and 105 N/m every time contact is made or broken. And Sections 01–04 all aim to track a trajectory, so position error times that stiffness is an uncontrolled contact force.

    场景里的两条手臂在 t = 2 s 各从小台子上抓起一个它们不知道多重的重物，一条参数固定，一条在线自适应。每条手臂旁都写着控制器“以为”负载有多重，自适应那一侧还用一个半透明虚框画出它估计的重物。窄带和多频只是手臂挥动的方式不同，先只切换“多频激励 / 窄带单频”。先猜：跟踪误差已经很小了，控制器心里的那个重量也对了吗？In the scene, two arms each pick up a weight they know nothing about from a little stand at t = 2 s — one keeps its parameters fixed, the other adapts online. Beside each arm is how heavy the controller believes the load to be, and the adaptive side also draws its estimate as a translucent dashed box. Multi-tone and single tone differ only in how the arm swings; switch only between “Multi-tone (rich)” and “Single tone (repetitive)” first. Predict: once the tracking error is tiny, has the controller got the weight right too?

    你应该看到：证明保证的是第 ③ 步的跟踪收敛，不是参数收敛。默认的单频运动下，最后 3 s 的误差只有固定参数版本的约 1/50，但 Ĵ 停在真值的四成左右，ĝ 也只有 5.1 N·m（真值 7.9）；换成多频激励后，Ĵ 和 ĝ 都回到真值附近，“激励充分度”读数也大了两个数量级以上。（这个读数可以这样看：它拿数据在“最难看清的那个参数组合”方向上的信号，和“最容易看清的方向”上的信号相比；1 表示各方向一样清楚，越接近 0，就越有某个组合几乎看不见。）把负载调到 3 kg、保持单频：Ĵ 甚至会估成负数，跟踪照样很好，这就是第 ⑤ 步说要做参数投影的原因。在“更多参数”里打开测量噪声、把 γ 调大，Ĵ 会被推高，看起来像“估得更准了”，其实是回归量含噪造成的偏差：把负载设成 0 kg 再看一次就知道（见下面的深入一层）。What you should see: the proof guarantees tracking (step 3), not parameter convergence. With the default single tone, the error over the last 3 s is about 1/50 of the fixed controller’s, yet Ĵ stalls at roughly 40% of its true value and ĝ reaches only 5.1 N·m (true value 7.9). Switch to the multi-tone motion and both Ĵ and ĝ settle near their true values, while the excitation-richness readout rises by more than two orders of magnitude. (Read it like this: it compares how much signal the data carry along the hardest-to-see combination of parameters with the easiest-to-see one; 1 means every direction is equally clear, and the closer to 0, the more some combination is nearly invisible.) Set the payload to 3 kg and keep the single tone: Ĵ even goes negative while tracking stays fine — the reason step 5 calls for parameter projection. Under “More parameters”, turn on measurement noise and raise γ, and Ĵ is pushed up until it looks “more accurate” — but that is a bias from noise in the regressor: set the payload to 0 kg and watch it happen again (the “going deeper” below explains why).

    深入一层Going deeper 实验里的两个现象：单频运动时参数为什么停在错的值上？加了测量噪声，参数为什么“看起来”反而估得更准？Two things the experiment shows: why do the estimates stall at wrong values under a single tone — and why does adding measurement noise seem to make them more accurate?

    前置知识 傅里叶级数的概念；贝塞尔函数只贡献一个数（0.956），可以直接信。第 ③ 条只要会把平方展开。

    Background. The idea of a Fourier series; the Bessel function contributes a single number (0.956) you can take on trust. Item 3 needs nothing beyond expanding a square.

    ① 单频只照亮两个方向　对线性回归量，m 个不同频率的正弦最多激励 2m 个参数方向（每个频率一个正弦方向、一个余弦方向）。本例 qd = A sin ωt，A = 0.6 rad，ω = π rad/s。跟踪好了以后 q̈ ≈ −ω²q，而 sin q 的基波也正比于 q，只是小一点（A = 0.6 rad 时是 q 的 0.956 倍，系数来自贝塞尔函数）：

    1. A single tone lights up only two directions. For a linear regressor, m sinusoids of distinct frequencies excite at most 2m parameter directions (a sine and a cosine direction per frequency). Here qd = A sin ωt with A = 0.6 rad and ω = π rad/s. Once tracking is good, q̈ ≈ −ω²q, and the fundamental of sin q is also proportional to q, only slightly smaller (0.956 q at A = 0.6 rad; the factor comes from a Bessel function):

    τ≈(0.956mgl−ω2J)q+bq˙=0.956(mgl−10.3J)q+bq˙

    力矩里 J 和 mgl 只以“mgl − 10.3J”这一个组合出现。sin q 的三次谐波能把它们分开，但幅度只有基波的约 1.5%，所以单频时“激励充分度”读数只有 10⁻⁶ 量级。

    ② 停在哪，可以预先算出来　梯度律 θ̂̇ = −ΓYᵀs 只能沿 ΓYᵀ 的方向移动估计值：被激励的那个组合很快被纠正，没被激励的方向（按 Γ⁻¹ 加权）一直保持初值。本实验的初值是“拿起负载之前”的参数，Γ 里 J 与 mgl 的增益之比是 1 : 100。两条直线一交，算出 Ĵ/J ≈ 0.41、按 ĝ 折算的负载 ≈ 0.28 kg（真值 1 kg），和仿真读数一致。停靠点由初值和 Γ 的“形状”决定，真值只通过被激励的那个组合进来，没被激励的那个分量一点也不向真值靠拢；γ 的大小只决定走得多快。

    ③ 噪声不是激励，是偏差　γ = 30 时加上测量噪声，Ĵ 从约 0.2 升到约 0.42 kg·m²，离真值 0.46 近了，“激励充分度”也涨了约 60 倍。但这是巧合。速度噪声 nv 同时出现在回归量 q̈r = q̈d − λė 和滑动变量 s = ė + λe 里，两者相乘有一项 −λnv²，它的均值不为零：

    J and mgl enter the torque only through the combination mgl − 10.3J. The third harmonic of sin q could tell them apart, but it is only about 1.5% of the fundamental, which is why the excitation-richness readout sits around 10⁻⁶ under the single tone.

    2. Where it stalls can be computed in advance. The gradient law θ̂̇ = −ΓYᵀs moves the estimates only along ΓYᵀ: the excited combination is corrected quickly, while the unexcited direction (weighted by Γ⁻¹) keeps its initial value. Here the initial values are the pre-pickup parameters, and Γ weights J and mgl in the ratio 1 : 100. Intersecting the two lines gives Ĵ/J ≈ 0.41 and a payload implied by ĝ of about 0.28 kg (true value 1 kg), matching the simulation. The stall point is set by the initial guess and the shape of Γ; the truth enters only through the excited combination, and the unexcited component never moves toward it. The size of γ only sets how fast the estimates get there.

    3. Noise is not excitation; it is bias. At γ = 30, turning on measurement noise lifts Ĵ from about 0.2 to about 0.42 kg·m², closer to the true 0.46, and the excitation readout climbs about sixtyfold. That is a coincidence. Velocity noise nv appears both in the regressor q̈r = q̈d − λė and in the sliding variable s = ė + λe, and their product contains a term −λnv² whose mean is not zero:

    q¨rs=⋯−λnv2+⋯⟹ΔE[J^˙]=ΓJλσv2

    也就是说，Ĵ 的平均变化率多出了 ΓJλσv² 这一项（ΓJ 是 Γ 里对应 J 的增益）：不管真值是多少，Ĵ 都被持续往上推。γ = 30 时这一项约 0.04 kg·m²/s，十秒就是 0.4，和看到的上移量同一个量级。把负载设成 0（此时初值就是真值）再加噪声，Ĵ 会被推到真值的 1.7 倍左右；负载 2 kg 时停在真值的 0.6 倍左右。这就是“回归量含噪”（变量含误差）问题。正确的做法是设计激励（多频激励下，同样的噪声只让 Ĵ/J 变了约 0.7%）、把回归量和力矩过同一个滤波器，或者用总体最小二乘、工具变量这类考虑回归量噪声的估计器（上面的工程实例）。真实编码器差分测速的噪声往往比这里的 0.05 rad/s 大得多：14 位编码器在 1 kHz 下，跳一个码就是 0.38 rad/s。这个坑只会更深。

    In other words, the mean rate of change of Ĵ picks up an extra ΓJλσv² (ΓJ being the entry of Γ for J): whatever the true value, Ĵ is pushed steadily upward. At γ = 30 the term is about 0.04 kg·m²/s, or 0.4 over ten seconds — the same order as the rise you see. Set the payload to 0 (so the initial guess is the truth) and add noise: Ĵ is pushed to about 1.7 times the true value; with a 2 kg payload it stops near 0.6 times. This is the errors-in-variables problem. The real remedies are designed excitation (under the multi-tone motion the same noise moves Ĵ/J by only about 0.7%), passing the regressor and the torque through the same filter, or estimators that account for regressor noise, such as total least squares and instrumental variables (the case study above). Velocity differenced from a real encoder is usually far noisier than the 0.05 rad/s used here — one count of a 14-bit encoder at 1 kHz is already 0.38 rad/s — so in practice the hole is deeper.

    自己验证Check it yourself

    • 单频下把 γ 分别设为 1、3、10，各读一次 Ĵ：都停在真值的四成左右（约 0.41、0.41、0.42），γ 只改变收敛快慢。
    • 打开测量噪声，γ 调到最大（30），负载设为 0 kg：Ĵ 会明显超过真值 0.30 kg·m²。再把负载换回 1 kg，它“碰巧”落在真值附近。
    • Under the single tone, set γ to 1, 3 and 10 and read Ĵ each time: it stalls near 40% of the truth every time (about 0.41, 0.41, 0.42). γ only changes how fast it gets there.
    • Turn on measurement noise, push γ to its maximum (30) and set the payload to 0 kg: Ĵ ends well above the true 0.30 kg·m². Switch back to 1 kg and it lands near the truth — by coincidence.

    一句话Takeaway

    自适应在线补上模型里缺的参数，但只对结构已知、慢变的参数有效；跟踪变准不等于参数估对，要估对还得有足够丰富的运动。

    Adaptation fills in missing parameters online, but only for a known structure with slowly varying parameters. Tracking well is not the same as estimating correctly; that takes sufficiently rich motion.

    下一个问题：到这里，我们一直在让关节“跟住一个位置”。可当机器人碰到桌面、碰到人的手臂时，还应该死死跟住位置吗？Next question: so far we have always asked the joint to hold a position. When the robot touches a table — or a person’s arm — should it still insist on that position?

    延伸阅读Further reading

    1. Ortega, R., & Spong, M. W. (1989). Adaptive motion control of rigid robots: A tutorial. Automatica, 25(6), 877–888. doi:10.1016/0005-1098(89)90054-X

      从这里开始：刚性机器人自适应运动控制的教程式综述，适合先建立全局图景，再去读下面各篇原始论文。

      Start here: a tutorial on adaptive motion control of rigid robots — the place to get the big picture before reading the original papers below.

    2. Slotine, J.-J. E., & Li, W. (1987). On the adaptive control of robot manipulators. The International Journal of Robotics Research, 6(3), 49–59. doi:10.1177/027836498700600303

      本节推导的出处：PD 反馈加全动力学前馈补偿，在线估计机械臂和负载参数；既不需要反馈关节加速度，也不需要求估计惯量矩阵的逆，还可以直接用在笛卡尔空间。

      The source of this section’s derivation: PD feedback plus full-dynamics feedforward, with manipulator and payload parameters estimated online. It needs neither joint-acceleration feedback nor the inverse of the estimated inertia matrix, and it applies directly in Cartesian space.

    3. Craig, J. J., Hsu, P., & Sastry, S. S. (1987). Adaptive control of mechanical manipulators. The International Journal of Robotics Research, 6(2), 16–28. doi:10.1177/027836498700600202

      同期的另一条路：给计算力矩控制配自适应律，在 Adept One 工业机器人上做了实验。摘要里就指出，模型差时这类解耦线性化方案可能不如简单的固定增益方案。和上一篇对比着读，才看得出 Slotine–Li 省掉了什么。

      The contemporaneous alternative: adaptive laws added to computed-torque control, with data from an Adept One industrial robot. Its abstract already warns that with a poor model such decoupling-and-linearizing schemes can do worse than a simple fixed-gain one. Read it next to the previous paper to see what Slotine–Li saves.

    4. Rohrs, C. E., Valavani, L., Athans, M., & Stein, G. (1985). Robustness of continuous-time adaptive control algorithms in the presence of unmodeled dynamics. IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control, 30(9), 881–889. doi:10.1109/TAC.1985.1104070
      Ioannou, P. A., & Kokotovic, P. V. (1984). Instability analysis and improvement of robustness of adaptive control. Automatica, 20(5), 583–594. doi:10.1016/0005-1098(84)90009-8

      前者证明自适应闭环里存在两个无穷增益算子：特定频率的参考或任意频率（含常值）的输出扰动，都能让回路增益无界增长、激起未建模动态而失稳；后者分析失稳机理并提出改善鲁棒性的修正，σ 修正就源自这一脉工作。

      The first proves that adaptive loops contain two infinite-gain operators: a reference at specific frequencies, or an output disturbance at any frequency including DC, can grow the loop gain without bound and excite unmodeled dynamics into instability. The second analyzes the instability mechanisms and proposes robustness fixes; σ-modification comes from this line of work.

    5. Slotine, J.-J. E., & Li, W. (1989). Composite adaptive control of robot manipulators. Automatica, 25(4), 509–519. doi:10.1016/0005-1098(89)90094-0

      复合自适应：同时用跟踪误差和预测误差更新参数，把“直接”和“间接”两条路合在一起，改善参数收敛。

      Composite adaptation: update the parameters with both tracking and prediction errors, merging the direct and indirect routes and improving parameter convergence.

    6. Wensing, P. M., Kim, S., & Slotine, J.-J. E. (2018). Linear matrix inequalities for physically consistent inertial parameter identification: A statistical perspective on the mass distribution. IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters, 3(1), 60–67. doi:10.1109/LRA.2017.2729659

      把惯性参数的物理一致性写成线性矩阵不等式（用质量分布的协方差表达），能加速收敛、提高对噪声数据的鲁棒性，并在 MIT Cheetah 3 的腿上同时辨识了连杆和传动部件的参数。解决“Ĵ 估成负数”的现代答案。

      Writes physical consistency of inertial parameters as linear matrix inequalities in terms of the covariance of the mass distribution, which speeds convergence and adds robustness to noisy data; demonstrated by identifying link and transmission parameters of an MIT Cheetah 3 leg. The modern answer to a negative Ĵ.

    05交互控制：碰到东西之后该控制什么Interaction control: what to control once you touch something

    面对未知与接触Cope with uncertainty and contact

    问题The question

    打磨机器人要压着工件走，协作臂难免碰到桌面。一碰到硬物，1 毫米的位置误差就可能意味着上百牛的接触力。这时“把位置误差压到零”还是对的目标吗？该控制什么？

    A grinding robot has to press on the workpiece as it moves; a collaborative arm will sooner or later bump into a table. Against something stiff, one millimeter of position error can mean a hundred newtons of contact force. Is driving position error to zero still the right goal? What should we control instead?

    本节要点（5 分钟版）This section in brief

    • 一碰到硬东西，位置误差乘上未知的环境刚度，就是一个不受控的力。所以要换被控量：规定力与运动的关系（阻抗），也就是开头游乐场里那根“虚拟弹簧＋阻尼器”。
    • 同一个目标阻抗有两种实现：阻抗控制测运动、出力，适合力矩输出准、最好能背驱的关节；导纳控制测力、挪位置，适合刚性伺服，但碰硬物、遇上绷紧的手臂时容易振。
    • 碰撞的峰值力几毫秒内就形成，控制器来不及管；主要靠降低惯量、加被动柔顺，软件能做的是限速接近。
