    • 和事先不知道的环境或人接触时，保证稳定的办法是让设备在接触点“自己不产生能量”（无源）。采样和滞后都会偷偷产生能量：所以虚拟墙做不到任意硬，外骨骼的助力曲线斜率乘上滞后就是一个等效阻尼。
    • Against anything stiff, position error times an unknown environment stiffness is an uncontrolled force. So change the controlled quantity: prescribe how force relates to motion (an impedance) — the “virtual spring plus damper” from the opening playground.
    • One target impedance, two implementations. Impedance control measures motion and outputs force, and suits joints with accurate torque output, ideally backdrivable; admittance control measures force and moves the position, and suits stiff servos — but tends to oscillate against hard objects or a tensed arm.
    • An impact’s force peak forms within a few milliseconds, before any controller can act; the main remedies are lower inertia and passive compliance, and software can slow the approach.
    • Coupled to an environment or a person you don’t know in advance, a device stays stable if it never generates energy at the contact point (passivity). Sampling and lag quietly generate energy — which is why a virtual wall can’t be arbitrarily stiff, and why an exoskeleton’s assist-curve slope times its lag acts as a damper.

    第一次读可以跳过：两个工程实例、直接力控的公式、各处“深入一层”。

    Safe to skip on a first read: the two field examples, the direct-force-control formula, and the “Going deeper” boxes.

    本节符号：Kd、Bd、Md 是目标（desired）刚度、阻尼、惯量，下标 d 表示“期望”，不是 PID 的微分增益；x˜=x−xd 是位置偏差；ke 是环境刚度，kh 是人手刚度。

    Notation: Kd, Bd and Md are the desired (target) stiffness, damping and inertia — the subscript d means “desired”, not PID’s derivative gain; x˜=x−xd is the position deviation; ke is the environment’s stiffness and kh the hand’s.

    一毫米有多贵What a millimeter costs

    先说结论：一旦接触，要换的是被控量，不是算法。

    接触面可以粗看成一根很硬的弹簧：桌面、硬塑料的等效刚度在 105 N/m 量级，金属更硬。位置控制器也像一根弹簧（刚度 Kp），把机器人拉向目标。目标只要设进表面一点，两根弹簧就串在一起互相顶着；位置环比环境硬得多时，机器人几乎一定“到位”，被压缩的是环境那根弹簧，接触力就由我们不知道的 ke 决定。位置环越硬、越“准”，力反而越不受控。

    Short answer: once the robot touches something, what has to change is the controlled quantity, not the algorithm.

    To first order, a contact surface is a very stiff spring: a tabletop or hard plastic comes in around 105 N/m, and metal is stiffer still. A position controller acts like a spring too (stiffness Kp), pulling the robot toward its target. Put the target even slightly inside the surface and the two springs end up in series, pushing on each other; when the position loop is much stiffer than the surface, the robot gets essentially where it was told, the environment’s spring takes up the difference, and the contact force is set by the ke you don’t know. The stiffer and more “accurate” the position loop, the less say you have over the force.

    F=keΔx105 N/m×1 mm≈100 N

    位置误差乘上一个未知的刚度，就是一个不受控的力。表面越硬，同样的误差对应的力越大。

    Position error times an unknown stiffness is an uncontrolled force. The harder the surface, the bigger the force for the same error.

    接触任务因此要把被控量从“位置”换成“力”，或者“力与运动之间的关系”，这类方法统称交互控制。换的是“控什么”，不是“怎么算”：内部的控制律仍然可以是 PID、自适应、鲁棒、MPC，甚至 RL。

    交互控制大体分两支。间接力控不直接盯着力，而是规定力与运动之间的关系，力随之被管住，阻抗控制和导纳控制属于这一支。直接力控拿测到的力误差直接做反馈，其中最常用的是按方向分工的混合位置 / 力控制：被表面挡住的方向控力，自由的方向控位置。

    So contact tasks swap the controlled quantity: from position to force, or to the relation between force and motion. The umbrella term is interaction control. It changes what you control, not how you compute it — the law inside can still be PID, adaptive, robust, MPC or even RL.

    The family has two branches. Indirect force control doesn’t chase the force itself; it prescribes how force and motion relate, and the force is kept in check as a consequence — impedance and admittance control belong here. Direct force control feeds the measured force error straight back; its best-known form is hybrid position/force control, which splits the work by direction: force along directions the surface blocks, position along the free ones.

    目标阻抗：规定力与运动的关系Target impedance: prescribe how force and motion relate

    间接力控里最一般的形式是 Hogan（1985）提出的阻抗控制。阻抗说的是“给定一个运动，会产生多大的力”。弹簧就是最简单的阻抗：压进去多少，就顶回来多少。阻抗控制要的目标行为比弹簧多两项：惯量、阻尼、刚度三项都在。

    The most general indirect scheme is Hogan’s (1985) impedance control. An impedance tells you how much force a given motion produces. A spring is the simplest one: push it in so far, and it pushes back so hard. The target behavior in impedance control has two more terms than a spring — inertia, damping and stiffness are all there.

    Mdx˜¨+Bdx˜˙+Kdx˜=Fextx˜=x−xdZ(s)=Mds+Bd+Kds

    这就是理论力学里的“质量—阻尼—弹簧”，和开头游乐场里那辆弹簧阻尼小车是同一类方程。推它一下，Kd 决定它退多远，Bd 决定退得多慢，Md 决定起步有多“沉”。三者都是矩阵，可以一个方向软、另一个方向硬：打磨时法向软（保持接触力）、切向硬（跟住路径）。

    最后一行是同一件事的频域写法。阻抗 Z 按惯例定义为“力 ÷ 速度”：阻尼器的力正比于速度，所以是常数 Bd；弹簧的力正比于位移，位移是速度的积分，而在拉普拉斯变换里“积分”就是除以 s，所以弹簧写成 Kd/s；质量的力正比于加速度，也就是速度的导数（乘 s），所以是 Mds。

    This is the mass–damper–spring of a first mechanics course — the same kind of equation as the spring-damper cart in the opening playground. Push it, and Kd sets how far it gives, Bd how slowly, Md how heavy it feels getting started. All three are matrices, so one direction can be soft while another is stiff — for grinding, soft along the normal to hold the contact force, stiff along the surface to hold the path.

    The last line says the same thing in the frequency domain, where by convention impedance Z is force divided by velocity. A damper’s force is proportional to velocity, so it contributes the constant Bd. A spring’s force is proportional to displacement, which is the integral of velocity — and in the Laplace domain integrating means dividing by s — so the spring becomes Kd/s. A mass’s force is proportional to acceleration, the derivative of velocity (multiply by s), giving Mds.

    这个式子直接带出两个工程事实。第一，只调 Kd、Bd，把惯量留成机器人自身的惯量时，控制律只需要测运动，不需要力传感器。想让机器人“感觉更轻”，也就是改变表观惯量（从外面推它时感觉到的惯量），就必须测出外力 Fext：惯量管的是“受多大的力、有多大的加速度”，要改这层关系，控制器得知道外面到底推了多大的力。

    第二，同一个目标阻抗有两种因果方向相反的实现（下图）。阻抗控制测运动、输出力：知道自己被推开了多远，就按弹簧和阻尼的规律顶回去。导纳控制测力，算出该挪多少位置，交给一个刚性的位置内环去执行：先“听到”推力，再决定往哪挪，于是设备表现出的是导纳（给定力时会怎么动）。借触觉设备的说法，用控制律让设备在接触点上表现出指定的力学特性，叫作渲染。

    Two engineering facts fall straight out of this equation. First, if you tune only Kd and Bd and leave the inertia equal to the robot’s own, the control law needs motion measurements only — no force sensor. To make the robot feel lighter, that is, to change its apparent inertia (the inertia you feel when you push it), you have to measure Fext: inertia is the rule that links how hard you are pushed to how fast you accelerate, and to change that rule the controller has to know how hard the outside is actually pushing.

    Second, the same target impedance can be implemented with opposite causality (figure below). Impedance control measures motion and outputs force: it knows how far it has been pushed and pushes back the way the spring and damper would. Admittance control measures force, works out how far to move, and hands that to a stiff inner position loop: it “hears” the push first and then decides where to go, so what the device presents is an admittance (how the device moves under a given force). Borrowing the haptics term, making a device behave at the contact point like a chosen mechanical system is called rendering it.

    对比项Aspect阻抗控制Impedance control导纳控制Admittance control
    适合的硬件Suited hardwareQDD、SEA、带关节力矩传感器的关节QDD, SEA, joint torque sensing高减速比刚性伺服 + 力传感器Stiff geared servo + force sensor
    擅长Good at低阻抗、透明，碰硬物稳定Low impedance, transparency, stable on hard contact高刚度、精确定位High stiffness, precise positioning
    风险Risk难以渲染很高的刚度Hard to render very high stiffness碰硬物、人绷紧手臂或虚拟惯量很小时易振荡Oscillates on hard contact, against a tensed arm, or with a very small virtual inertia

    把理想阻抗搬到真机上From the ideal impedance to real hardware

    目标阻抗写起来容易，难在让真机在接触时真的表现成那样。下面从理想情况出发，一项一项加上硬件的限制。

    Writing down a target impedance is easy; the hard part is getting real hardware to behave that way in contact. Start from the ideal and add the hardware’s limitations one at a time.

    1. 理想模型：每个频率都按目标渲染Ideal model: rendered exactly at every frequency

      Z(jω)=Bd+j(ωMd−Kdω)

      把 s 换成 jω，就是看设备被频率为 ω 的正弦来回推拉时怎么反应。实部 Bd 是耗能的部分。虚部里，弹簧项 −Kd/ω 在慢变化时占主导，惯量项 ωMd 在快变化时占主导：慢慢推，你感到的是弹簧；快速抖，你感到的是质量。只要 Bd≥0，理想阻抗自己不会产生能量。

      Replacing s with jω asks how the device responds when it is pushed back and forth sinusoidally at frequency ω. The real part Bd dissipates energy. In the imaginary part, the spring term −Kd/ω dominates slow motion and the inertia term ωMd dominates fast motion: push slowly and you feel the spring; shake it quickly and you feel the mass. As long as Bd≥0, the ideal impedance never generates energy on its own.

    2. ＋ 碰撞：比控制环更快+ Impact: faster than the loop

      Fmax=vkemtpeak≈π2mkem=mlink+N2Jmr2

      质量 m 以速度 v 撞上硬环境（ke 远大于 Kd），就像撞上一根极硬的弹簧。峰值力用能量守恒就能推出来：动能 12mv2 全部压进环境这根“弹簧”时，12kex2=12mv2，峰值力 F=kex=vkem。到达峰值只要这个质量—弹簧振动周期的四分之一：1 kg 撞 105 N/m，约 5 ms，和控制周期加上传感、通信延迟是同一量级。公式里没有 Kd：峰值力由表观惯量和接近速度决定，调低 Kd 几乎没用，它只能减小之后持续推挤的力。

      m 里藏着减速器：mlink 是连杆折算到接触点的等效质量（转动连杆为 Ilink/r2，r 是到接触点的力臂），转子的反射惯量 N2Jm 则按减速比的平方放大。这个式子假设传动是刚性的。真实传动有柔性时，碰撞最初的几毫秒里转子来不及参与，峰值力会比式子给的小：在传动里有意串一根弹簧（SEA），或用低减速比把转子惯量做小，都是在这上面做文章，见深入一层和 MIT Cheetah 的例子。

      所以主要对策在硬件：降惯量，加被动柔顺（弹簧、软垫、可压缩的气体）；软件能做的是限速接近、检测到碰撞后切换策略。冲击靠被动柔顺，低频行为才交给控制器。第一个实验可以亲手验证。

      A mass m hitting a stiff environment (ke ≫ Kd) at speed v is a mass hitting a very hard spring. Energy conservation gives the peak: once all the kinetic energy 12mv2 has gone into compressing the environment’s “spring”, 12kex2=12mv2, so the peak force is F=kex=vkem. Getting there takes a quarter of that mass–spring oscillation period: about 5 ms for 1 kg against 105 N/m — the same order as the control period plus sensing and communication delays. Kd isn’t in the formula: the peak is set by the apparent inertia and the approach speed, and lowering Kd barely helps, though it does soften the sustained push afterward.

      The gearbox hides inside m. Here mlink is the link’s mass referred to the contact point (Ilink/r2 for a rotating link, with r the lever arm to the contact), and the rotor’s reflected inertia N2Jm grows with the square of the gear ratio. The formula assumes a rigid transmission. When the transmission is compliant, the rotor can’t take part in the first few milliseconds of the impact, and the peak is lower than the formula says. Putting a spring in the drivetrain on purpose (an SEA), or using a low gear ratio to make the rotor inertia small in the first place, both play on this — see Going deeper and the MIT Cheetah example.

      So the main fixes are in hardware — less inertia, plus passive compliance such as springs, padding or compressible air; software can slow the approach and switch strategy once it detects a collision. Passive compliance takes the impact; the controller shapes the low-frequency behavior. The first experiment lets you check this.

    3. ＋ 执行器：因果方向由硬件决定+ The actuator picks the causality

      MdΔx¨+BdΔx˙+KdΔx=Fextxr=xd+Δx

      阻抗实现要求力矩输出准，最好还能背驱（从输出端推，能轻松推动电机）。合适的硬件有三类：QDD 是低减速比的准直驱关节；SEA 在电机和负载之间串一根弹簧，靠弹簧变形测力矩；还有带关节力矩传感器的关节。它擅长低阻抗和透明，碰硬物也稳，但难以渲染很高的刚度。

      导纳实现把上式在线积分成位置指令 xr，适合高减速比的刚性伺服加力传感器。它擅长高刚度和精确定位，但碰到硬表面、人绷紧手臂、或要渲染很小的虚拟惯量时容易振荡。

      为什么会振？导纳相当于“先听到力，再挪位置”。对面越硬，同样的位置修正引起的力变化越大，这个“力 → 位置 → 力”的回路增益就越高；虚拟惯量越小，它反应越快。一旦快过里面那个位置环跟得上的速度，就开始振。经验规则：√(对面的刚度 ÷ 虚拟惯量) 要低于位置内环的自然频率，并留出裕度。第二个实验可以验证。

      Impedance control needs accurate torque output and, ideally, a backdrivable drive (one you can easily turn by pushing on the output). Three kinds of hardware fit: a QDD, a quasi-direct-drive joint with a low gear ratio; an SEA, which puts a spring between motor and load and reads the torque from its deflection; and a joint with a built-in torque sensor. Impedance control excels at low impedance and transparency and stays stable on hard contact, but struggles to render very high stiffness.

      Admittance control integrates the equation above online into a position command xr, which suits a stiff, high-ratio servo with a force sensor. It excels at high stiffness and precise positioning, but tends to oscillate on hard contact, against a tensed arm, or when asked for a very small virtual inertia.

      Why does it oscillate? Admittance “hears the force first, then moves”. The stiffer the other side, the more the force changes for the same position correction, so the gain around the force → position → force loop goes up; the smaller the virtual inertia, the faster that loop wants to respond. Once it wants to move faster than the inner position loop can follow, it starts to oscillate. Rule of thumb: keep √(stiffness of the other side ÷ virtual inertia) below the natural frequency of the inner position loop, with margin. The second experiment lets you check it.

    4. ＋ 对象未知：耦合稳定性+ An unknown partner: coupled stability

      ReZ(jω)≥0∀ω

      机器人单独稳定，不代表接上环境或人以后还稳定，而这两者的阻抗事先都不知道。为什么“无源”就够？用能量记账：弹簧只能把你给它的能量存起来再还给你，阻尼器只会把能量变成热，它们都不会凭空多出能量。两个都不会凭空产生能量的东西接在一起，总能量只能减少或不变，不可能越振越大。

      所以只要设备在接触点上表现得无源（自己不产生能量，只能储存或耗散），接上任何无源的环境都稳定。Colgate 与 Hogan（1988）还证明，对线性系统这个条件也是必要的：设备在接触点上一旦不是无源的，总能找到某个无源的环境让它失稳。人通常可以当成无源的，但这只是工程假设（见深入一层），所以设计目标是让设备在接触点上无源。

      落到频域，“不产生能量”要求上式成立：阻抗的实部，也就是第 ① 步里“耗能”的那一项，在所有频率都不小于零。为什么看实部？让设备以某个频率被正弦地来回推拉，力里只有和速度同步（同相）的那一部分，一个周期平均下来才做净功；它就是实部，平均吸收的功率是 12ReZ·|V|2（V 是速度的幅值）。和速度差 90° 的弹簧力、惯性力，一个周期里先存后还，净功为零。所以“实部 ≥ 0”就是说：不管按什么频率推拉，设备平均下来都在吸收能量，不往外吐。完整的判据叫“正实”，另外还有两条关于极点的技术要求（大意是设备单独放着时自己不会跑掉、储能的部分要像真实的弹簧和质量那样，刚度和质量都是正的），第一次读可以跳过，见深入一层。

      A robot that is stable on its own may not stay stable once it is coupled to the world or to a person, and neither impedance is known in advance. Why is “passive” enough? Keep an energy ledger. A spring can only store the energy you give it and hand it back; a damper can only turn energy into heat. Neither can create energy out of nothing. Connect two things that can’t create energy, and the total energy can only fall or stay put — it can’t oscillate its way upward.

      So as long as the device is passive at the contact point (it never generates energy, only stores or dissipates it), coupling it to any passive environment is stable. Colgate and Hogan (1988) also showed that for linear systems the condition is necessary: if the device isn’t passive at the contact point, there is always some passive environment that destabilizes it. People can usually be treated as passive, but that is an engineering assumption (see Going deeper) — which is why the design goal is a device that is passive at the contact point.

      In the frequency domain, “generates no energy” requires the inequality above: the real part of the impedance — the “dissipative” term of step 1 — must be non-negative at every frequency. Why the real part? Shake the device sinusoidally at some frequency. Only the part of the force that moves in step (in phase) with the velocity does net work over a cycle; that part is the real part, and the average power absorbed is 12ReZ·|V|2, with V the velocity amplitude. Spring and inertial forces sit 90° away from the velocity: they store energy and hand it back within each cycle, for zero net work. So “real part ≥ 0” means that at whatever frequency you push and pull, the device absorbs energy on average and never gives any out. The full criterion, called positive realness, adds two technical requirements on the poles — roughly, that the device left alone doesn’t run away, and that its energy-storing parts behave like real springs and masses, with positive stiffness and mass. You can skip them on a first read; they are in Going deeper.

    5. ＋ 采样：能渲染的刚度有上限（Z-width）+ Sampling: a ceiling on stiffness (Z-width)

      b>KT2+|B|⟹Kmax≈2(b−|B|)T

      数字控制器每隔 T 才更新一次力，零阶保持加上差分测速，让一面虚拟墙（用控制律“画”出来的墙）每个周期都多吐出一点能量。为什么会吐能量？墙的力平均晚半个周期。你往里压时，力还没长起来，挡你挡得少；你往外退时，力还没降下去，推你推得多。一进一出，墙对你做的净功是正的，凭空吐出了能量。这相当于一个大小约 KT/2 的负阻尼：设备自身的物理阻尼 b 每个来回耗掉的能量要比这多，墙才不会往外吐能量。

      Colgate 与 Schenkel（1997）给出的无源条件就是上式，其中 B 是墙的虚拟阻尼。加阻尼为什么反而让上限变低？因为虚拟阻尼的力也是晚到的：用差分算速度要晚半个周期，零阶保持再晚半个周期，一共晚一个采样周期。对慢动作，这点延迟无所谓，虚拟阻尼照样在耗能；可对频率接近采样频率一半的快速抖动来说，晚一个采样周期就等于晚了半个振动周期，阻尼力的方向正好反过来，从“刹车”变成“推一把”。无源条件要求在所有频率都不吐能量，所以按这种最坏情况给 B 记了一笔 |B|（推导见深入一层）。示意：b = 0.05 N·m·s/rad、T = 1 ms 时，墙的刚度上限约 100 N·m/rad。设备在保持无源的前提下能渲染的阻抗范围，叫作 Z-width（Colgate & Brown 1994）。

      提高上限靠更快的环路、更小的测速延迟或更多物理阻尼。这个条件偏保守：人手推不出那么快的抖动，所以与人耦合时，实际失稳点往往更高，少量虚拟阻尼 B 还可能帮助稳定，但 B 不是越大越安全。第三个实验就是这面墙。

      A digital controller updates the force only once every T. Zero-order hold plus a differenced velocity makes a virtual wall (a wall rendered by the control law) inject a little energy every cycle. Why? On average the wall’s force is half a sample late. As you press in, the force hasn’t built up yet, so it resists you too little; as you back out, it hasn’t dropped yet, so it pushes you too hard. Over one in-and-out, the wall does net positive work on you: energy out of nowhere. That acts like a negative damper of about KT/2, and the wall stops pumping out energy only if the device’s own physical damping b burns more than that on every cycle.

      Colgate and Schenkel (1997) give the passivity condition above, where B is the wall’s virtual damping. Why would adding damping lower the ceiling? Because the virtual damper’s force arrives late too: differencing the position to get velocity costs half a sample, and the zero-order hold another half — one full sample in all. For slow motion that delay hardly matters and the virtual damper still dissipates energy. But for a fast shake near half the sampling frequency, one sample of delay is half an oscillation period, so the damping force points the wrong way: instead of braking, it gives a push. Passivity has to hold at every frequency, so the condition books this worst case as |B| (derivation in Going deeper). Illustratively, with b = 0.05 N·m·s/rad and T = 1 ms, the wall tops out around 100 N·m/rad. The range of impedances a device can render while staying passive is called its Z-width (Colgate & Brown 1994).

      Raising the ceiling takes a faster loop, less velocity-estimation delay or more physical damping. The condition is conservative: a hand can’t produce shaking that fast, so coupled to a hand, the real onset of instability is often higher, and a little virtual damping B can even help — but more B is not automatically safer. The third experiment is this wall.

    工程实例From the field

    MIT Cheetah：靠“推得动”的腿扛住落地冲击MIT Cheetah: taking landing impacts on legs you can push back

    系统　为高速奔跑和跳跃设计的四足机器人。关节电机经低减速比传动驱动腿，从脚上推，能把电机推着转（可背驱）。

    System　A quadruped built for high-speed running and jumping. The joint motors drive the legs through low-ratio transmissions, so a push at the foot turns the motor: the joints are backdrivable.

    问题　奔跑时每一次落地都是一次碰撞，峰值力在控制环来得及反应之前就已形成。常见的办法是在腿里串一根弹簧（SEA）来缓冲，但弹簧又会限制力控的带宽。

    Problem　Every touchdown is a collision whose force peak forms before any control loop can react. The usual fix is a series spring in the leg (an SEA), but the spring in turn caps force-control bandwidth.

    怎么做　不串弹簧，也不装力传感器：力在关节处产生，也在关节处测量（同位力控，力矩由电机电流估计），这叫本体感知执行器。冲击的第一瞬间靠低表观惯量和背驱性扛住，随后由控制器接管接触力。论文还提出“冲击缓解系数”（IMF），量化碰撞瞬间的背驱性，让不同机器人可以放在一起比较。

    Approach　No series spring and no force sensor: force is produced and measured at the joint itself (collocated force control, with torque estimated from motor current) — a proprioceptive actuator. Low apparent inertia and backdrivability ride out the first instant of the impact; the controller takes over the contact force after that. The paper also defines an impact mitigation factor (IMF) that quantifies backdrivability at impact, so different robots can be compared on one scale.

    学到什么　碰撞公式 Fmax=vkem 里的 m 是可以设计的：把表观惯量做小，和串一根弹簧一样能压低冲击峰值。力在同一个关节处测、在同一个关节处出，还避开了“末端传感器和执行器之间隔着柔性”的非同位问题。第一个实验里把减速比从 100 调到 9，就是这件事的缩小版。

    Lesson　The m in Fmax=vkem is a design variable: shrinking the apparent inertia lowers the impact peak just as a series spring does. Sensing and producing force at the same joint also sidesteps the non-collocation problem of a tip sensor separated from the actuator by compliance. Dropping the gear ratio from 100 to 9 in the first experiment is this idea in miniature.

    着地时间Contact time
    短至 85 msdown to 85 ms
    峰值接触力Peak contact force
    超过 450 Nover 450 N
    冲击缓解系数 IMFImpact mitigation factor
    与带串联弹簧的四足相当on par with spring-legged quadrupeds

    出处Source　Wensing, P. M., Wang, A., Seok, S., Otten, D., Lang, J. H., & Kim, S. (2017). Proprioceptive actuator design in the MIT Cheetah: Impact mitigation and high-bandwidth physical interaction for dynamic legged robots. IEEE Transactions on Robotics, 33(3), 509–522. doi:10.1109/TRO.2016.2640183

    直接控制力，以及按方向分工Controlling force directly, and splitting by direction

    最直观的办法是直接对力误差闭环：测到的力比想要的小，就再往里推一点。它结构最简单，却最难稳定。给一个位置 / 速度伺服的机器人外面套一个力环，指令每多走 1 mm，接触力就多出 ke × 1 mm，所以环路增益和环境刚度成正比：软表面上调好的增益，换到硬表面上可能大几十倍。

    还有两个坑。一是非同位：力传感器装在末端，出力的电机在关节，中间隔着会变形的减速器和连杆；测量和出力不在同一处，增益一高，这段“弹簧”两端就各振各的。二是一旦脱离接触，测得的力为零，力误差一直等于 Fd，积分项一路累积，再撞回去时更狠。实用的形式是“力前馈 + 积分力反馈 + 速度阻尼”：

    The most obvious route is to close a loop on the force error: if the measured force is too small, push in a little more. It is the simplest structure and the hardest to stabilize. Wrap a force loop around a position- or velocity-servoed robot, and every extra millimeter of command adds ke × 1 mm of contact force, so the loop gain is proportional to the environment’s stiffness: gains tuned on a soft surface can be tens of times too high on a hard one.

    There are two more traps. One is non-collocation: the force sensor sits at the tip and the motor that produces the force sits at the joint, with a flexible gearbox and link in between. Sensing and actuation aren’t in the same place, and at high gain the two ends of that “spring” start oscillating against each other. The other: the moment contact is lost, the measured force drops to zero, the error sits at Fd, and the integrator winds up — so the robot comes back harder. The practical form is force feedforward plus integral force feedback plus velocity damping:

    τ=JT[Fd+KI∫(Fd−F)dt]−JTKvx˙+g^(q)

    Fd 先按需要的力直接给出去，积分项慢慢消掉残差，速度阻尼防止工具冲出去。JT 是雅可比矩阵的转置，把末端的力换算成各关节力矩：雅可比 J 把关节速度换成末端速度（x˙=Jq˙），而末端力的功率 FTx˙ 必须等于关节力矩的功率 τTq˙，于是 τ=JTF。单个转动关节时，它就是“力 × 力臂 = 力矩”。g^(q) 是模型重力。增益按最硬的环境整定，接近阶段限速，脱离接触时冻结积分。

    Fd goes straight out as feedforward, the integral trims the residual, and velocity damping keeps the tool from lunging. JT, the transpose of the Jacobian, maps a force at the tip to torques at the joints. The Jacobian J turns joint velocities into tip velocity (x˙=Jq˙), and the power of the tip force, FTx˙, must equal the power of the joint torques, τTq˙; hence τ=JTF. For a single revolute joint this is just force times lever arm. g^(q) is the model’s gravity. Tune for the stiffest environment you expect, slow down on approach, and freeze the integrator when contact is lost.

    混合位置 / 力控制则按自然约束（由接触的几何形状决定：哪些方向动不了，哪些方向不受力）给每个方向分配模式：被表面挡住的方向控力，自由的方向控位置。前提是知道表面朝哪：法向估偏几度，“控位置”的方向就会顶着表面用力。插销装配是典型例子：找孔时 Z 向控接触力、XY 做位置搜索；销进孔后反过来，XY 侧向柔顺，Z 向推进。

    Hybrid position/force control instead assigns a mode to each direction from the task’s natural constraints (set by the contact geometry: which directions can’t move, which can’t carry force): force along directions the surface blocks, position along the free ones. It relies on knowing which way the surface faces — misjudge the normal by a few degrees and the nominally position-controlled direction starts pushing into the surface. Peg-in-hole is the classic case: while searching for the hole, Z controls contact force and XY runs a position search; once the peg is in, the roles flip — XY goes compliant sideways and Z advances.

    工程实例From the field

    DLR 轻型臂与 KUKA：关节力矩传感，加上一以贯之的无源性The DLR Lightweight Robot and KUKA: joint torque sensing, with passivity all the way down

    系统　德国航空航天中心（DLR）研制的轻型机械臂（LWR）。每个关节都装有力矩传感器，负载与自重之比 1:1；技术后来转让给了 KUKA。

    System　The Lightweight Robot (LWR) from the German Aerospace Center (DLR): a torque sensor in every joint and a 1:1 load-to-weight ratio. The technology was later transferred to KUKA.

    问题　要在环境部分未知、身边有人的场合工作。关节减速器既有摩擦又有柔性；碰撞可能发生在手臂的任何位置，末端力传感器根本测不到。

    Problem　It has to work where the environment is partly unknown and people are close by. The joint gearboxes add friction and compliance, and a collision can happen anywhere along the arm, where a tip force sensor sees nothing.

    怎么做

    Approach

    • 关节力矩内环：把力矩反馈解释成“把电机惯量变小”（惯量整形），于是这一层也能放进无源性分析。
    • 阻抗：只用电机角构造一个势能函数，同时实现重力补偿和期望的笛卡尔刚度。
    • 碰撞检测：只用关节自己的传感器（关节位置、由它得到的速度，以及关节力矩），就能估出外界加在每个关节上的力矩，既不需要加速度，也不需要求质量矩阵的逆（原理见本实例后面的深入一层）。估计值超过阈值就判定碰撞，它的方向还告诉机器人该往哪边退。
    • Joint torque loop: torque feedback is interpreted as shrinking the motor inertia (inertia shaping), which lets this layer enter the passivity analysis too.
    • Impedance: a potential function built from motor angles alone provides gravity compensation and the desired Cartesian stiffness at once.
    • Collision detection: from the joints’ own sensors alone (joint positions, the velocities derived from them, and joint torques), estimate the external torque acting at every joint — with no accelerations and no inverse of the mass matrix (how it works is in the Going deeper right after this example). An estimate above a threshold flags a collision, and its direction tells the robot which way to retreat.

    没建模的摩擦也会混进这个估计值，所以阈值要留余量；用减速器输出侧的关节力矩传感器读数来算这个估计值，就把减速器摩擦挡在了外面——这是关节力矩传感的又一个好处。伤害评估方面，他们在德国汽车俱乐部（ADAC）的标准汽车碰撞试验设施上做了人—机碰撞测试，比较了不同质量的工业机器人，研究了质量和速度的影响。

    Unmodeled friction leaks into this estimate as well, so the threshold needs margin; computing it from a torque sensor on the gearbox output keeps gearbox friction out — one more thing joint torque sensing buys you. On injury, the group ran human–robot impact tests on standard automobile crash-test facilities at the German Automobile Club (ADAC), compared industrial robots of different weights, and examined how robot mass and velocity matter.

    学到什么　关节力矩传感把减速器的摩擦和柔性变成了可以闭环压下去的东西，这正是正文表格里“带关节力矩传感器的关节”适合阻抗控制的原因。无源性是贯穿设计链的主线：位置、力矩和阻抗控制都在同一个无源性框架里分析，碰撞检测则复用同一套关节力矩传感。伤害研究还指出一个碰撞公式没有覆盖的情形：人被夹在机器人和环境之间时的准静态挤压，在某些情况下即使对低惯量的机器人也构成严重威胁——这时是控制器在持续推，所以“检测到碰撞后切换策略”不可省。

    Lesson　Joint torque sensing turns gearbox friction and compliance into something a loop can suppress — which is why the table above pairs “joints with torque sensors” with impedance control. Passivity is the thread through the design: position, torque and impedance control are analyzed in one passivity-based framework, and collision detection reuses the same joint torque sensing. The injury work also flags a case the impact formula doesn’t cover: quasi-static crushing of a person pinned against the environment can, in some circumstances, be a serious threat even for a low-inertia robot, because the controller keeps pushing. That is why “switch strategy once a collision is detected” is not optional.

    负载 : 自重Load-to-weight ratio
    1 : 1

    每个关节in every joint

    深入一层Going deeper 只靠关节里的传感器，机械臂怎么知道自己被撞了、被撞得多重？With only the sensors inside its joints, how does an arm know it has been hit — and how hard?

    前置知识 02 节的机械臂动力学方程 M(q)q¨+C(q,q˙)q˙+g(q)=τ+τext；一阶低通滤波。

    Background. Section 02’s manipulator dynamics, M(q)q¨+C(q,q˙)q˙+g(q)=τ+τext; a first-order low-pass filter.

    思路　像对账。广义动量 p=M(q)q˙ 的变化率，等于作用在关节上的全部力矩之和。自己给的电机力矩 τ 是知道的，重力、科氏这些项模型算得出来，唯一不知道的就是外力矩 τext。把“动量实际变了多少”和“按已知的力矩应该变多少”一比，差额就是外力的贡献：就像账户余额的变化减去所有已知的收支，剩下的就是一笔不明来款。关键在于比的是动量本身：对已知的力矩做积分，而不是对测量做微分，所以既不需要加速度，也不需要 M−1（De Luca 等 2006）。

    Idea　Balance the books. The rate of change of the generalized momentum p=M(q)q˙ equals the sum of all torques acting on the joints. You know the motor torque τ you applied, and the model gives you gravity and the Coriolis terms; the one unknown is the external torque τext. Compare how much the momentum actually changed with how much the known torques say it should have changed, and the difference is what the outside world contributed — like an account whose change in balance, minus every known deposit and withdrawal, leaves one unexplained transfer. The trick is to compare the momentum itself: integrate the known torques instead of differentiating the measurements, so you need neither accelerations nor M−1 (De Luca et al. 2006).

    推导　求导得 p˙=Mq¨+M˙q˙。用 Christoffel 符号定义科氏矩阵 C 时有 M˙=C+CT（和常说的“M˙−2C 反对称”是一回事），代入动力学方程，Cq˙ 抵掉一部分，得到 p˙=τ+CTq˙−g+τext。于是定义残差 r：

    Derivation　Differentiate: p˙=Mq¨+M˙q˙. With the Coriolis matrix C built from Christoffel symbols, M˙=C+CT (the same fact as the familiar “M˙−2C is skew-symmetric”). Substituting the dynamics, part of Cq˙ cancels, leaving p˙=τ+CTq˙−g+τext. Now define the residual r:

    p=M(q)q˙r=KO[p−p(0)−∫0t(τ+CTq˙−g+r)dt′]⟹r˙=KO(τext−r)

    对 r 求导，所有已知的项都消掉，只剩第三行：r 就是 τext 经过时间常数为 1/KO 的一阶低通滤波。

    Differentiate r and every known term cancels, leaving the third line: r is τext passed through a first-order low-pass with time constant 1/KO.

    工程上　KO 越大，r 跟得越紧、检测越快，但测量噪声和模型误差也漏进来得越多：和任何低通滤波一样，是速度与噪声的折中。r 的每个分量对应一个关节。外力矩 τext=JcTFc（Jc 是接触点的雅可比）只作用在从基座到接触点之间的关节上，所以看 r 的哪几个分量亮了，还能粗略判断撞在了哪一节连杆上。

    In practice　A larger KO makes r track faster and detect sooner, but lets in more measurement noise and model error — the usual speed-versus-noise trade of any low-pass filter. Each component of r belongs to one joint. The external torque τext=JcTFc (with Jc the contact-point Jacobian) only reaches the joints between the base and the contact point, so which components of r light up also tells you, roughly, which link was hit.

    想一想Think it through

    • 单关节、长 0.5 m 的连杆静止不动，有人在末端垂直于连杆推了 10 N。r 最后稳定在多少？KO=50s−1 时大约多久到位？（答：5 N·m；时间常数 20 ms，约 60 ms 到九成五。）
    • A single 0.5 m link sits still, and someone pushes on its tip with 10 N, perpendicular to the link. Where does r settle, and how long does it take with KO=50s−1? (Answer: 5 N·m; the time constant is 20 ms, so about 60 ms to reach 95%.)
    • 如果模型重力 g^ 少算了一成，没人碰它时 r 会显示什么？（答：把 g^ 代进推导，得 r→τext+(g^−g)，静止时 r 显示出重力力矩的 −10%。模型误差会直接冒充外力，所以阈值要比它大。）
    • If the model gravity g^ is 10% low, what does r read when nobody touches the arm? (Answer: carry g^ through the derivation and r→τext+(g^−g), so at rest r shows −10% of the gravity torque. Model error masquerades as external force, which is why the threshold must sit above it.)

    外骨骼视角一条只依赖肩角的助力曲线 τd(θ) 本身是一个保守场：抬上去再放下来，净功为零，它是无源的。问题出在压力环的滞后。把滞后近似成纯延迟 td，在低频（ωtd≪1）下，多出来的一项相当于一个阻尼器：

    Exoskeleton lensAn assist curve that depends only on shoulder angle, τd(θ), is a conservative field: raise the arm and lower it again and the net work is zero, so the curve by itself is passive. The trouble is the lag in the pressure loop. Treat it as a pure delay td; at low frequency (ωtd≪1) the extra term acts as a damper:

    τ(t)=τd(θ(t−td))≈τd(θ)−∂τd∂θtdθ˙beq=∂τd∂θtd

    阻尼系数由曲线斜率决定。重力补偿型曲线在 0–90° 斜率为正，等效正阻尼：抬臂时助力跟不上，放臂时残余助力还顶着手，人感到“拖滞”——损害透明性，但不危及稳定。斜率为负的区段等效负阻尼，会向人注入能量，可能引起过冲或振荡。第四个实验可以亲手拖动这条曲线。

    肩部同时助力两个方向时还多一个前提：助力场必须是某个势能的梯度（交叉偏导相等，也就是高数里“曲线积分与路径无关”的条件）；否则沿闭合路径抬臂一圈，即使没有滞后，净功也不为零。

    The damping coefficient is the slope of the curve. A gravity-compensation curve slopes upward from 0 to 90°, so the lag acts as positive damping: the assist trails behind as you raise the arm and lingers as you lower it, and the wearer feels drag — bad for transparency, harmless to stability. Where the slope turns negative, the damping turns negative and the device pumps energy into the person, which can cause overshoot or oscillation. The fourth experiment lets you drag this curve around.

    Assisting the shoulder in two directions at once adds one more condition: the assist field must be the gradient of a potential (equal cross-partials — the calculus condition for a line integral to be path-independent); otherwise moving the arm around a closed loop does net work even with zero lag.

    反过来想Flip it around

    不换被控量、坚持位置控制：接触力 = 位置误差 × 未知的环境刚度，碰到硬物 1 mm 就是上百牛。只有本体或末端有足够的被动柔顺（软垫、柔性工具、气动执行器）时，位置控制在接触中才照样能用。

    阻抗推到极端也会出事：做得太硬，墙面颤振（第 ⑤ 步）；把表观惯量做得比本体还小，就得靠力反馈，无源性很难再保证。阻抗放在高减速比、大摩擦的关节上，低刚度时手感“涩”：未补偿的摩擦 f 直接变成 f/Kd 的位置误差。

    人的阻抗可以在很大范围内变化：放松、用力、绷紧、顶住硬物时差别很大，具体差多少因关节、方向和任务而异。稳定裕度要按最硬的耦合状态来留。

    边界在哪：交互控制规定的是接触点上的动态关系，能渲染的范围由执行器（背驱性、反射惯量、带宽）、采样和延迟决定。

    卡在哪里：阻抗律和前面所有反馈律一样只看“此刻”。力矩上限和关节限位只能在执行时硬限幅；每天重复几百次的同一个助力动作，同样的滞后误差每一次都重来。

    Keep the controlled quantity and insist on position control, and the contact force is position error times an unknown environment stiffness — on something hard, one millimeter is a hundred newtons. Position control survives contact only when the robot or its tool carries enough passive compliance: padding, a flexible tool, a pneumatic actuator.

    Push impedance to the extremes and it breaks too. Make it too stiff and the wall chatters (step 5); make the apparent inertia smaller than the hardware’s own and you need force feedback, at which point passivity is hard to keep. Impedance on a high-ratio, high-friction joint feels “sticky” at low stiffness: uncompensated friction f turns directly into a position error of f/Kd.

    Human impedance varies over a wide range — relaxed, pushing, co-contracted, braced against something rigid — and how wide depends on the joint, the direction and the task. Leave stability margin for the stiffest coupling.

    Limits: interaction control prescribes a dynamic relation at the contact point, and how much of it you can render is set by the actuator (backdrivability, reflected inertia, bandwidth), the sampling and the delay.

    Where it gets stuck: an impedance law, like every feedback law before it, looks only at the present. Torque limits and joint stops can only be enforced after the fact, by clipping, and an assist motion repeated hundreds of times a day repeats the same lag error every single time.

    深入一层Going deeper “无源”的精确说法是什么？“人是无源的”什么时候不成立？What exactly does “passive” mean — and when does “the human is passive” break down?

    前置知识 功率 = 力 × 速度；复数与频率响应（把 s 换成 jω）。正实的三条还要用到传递函数的极点和留数，不熟可以只看第 ③ 条。

    Background. Power = force × velocity; complex numbers and frequency response (replace s with jω). The three positive-real conditions also use the poles and residues of a transfer function; if those are unfamiliar, condition 3 alone carries the idea.

    思路　无源是关于端口能量的说法。设接触点的力为 F、速度为 v，Fv 是流进设备的功率。不管外面怎么推，能从设备里取出的能量都不超过它一开始存着的 E0：

    Idea　Passivity is a statement about energy at a port. Let F be the force and v the velocity at the contact, so Fv is the power flowing into the device. However the outside pushes, you can never take out more energy than the device held at the start, E0:

    ∫0tF(t′)v(t′)dt′≥−E0∀t

    对线性时不变的端口，这等价于阻抗 Z(s)=F(s)/V(s) 正实：① 右半平面没有极点；② 虚轴上（含无穷远处）的极点都是单极点，留数为正实数；③ 所有频率上 ReZ(jω)≥0。弹簧 K/s 和质量 Ms 只存不耗：实部恒为零，刚好满足 ③ 的等号；它们的极点（弹簧在 s=0，质量在无穷远处）是单极点、留数为正，满足 ②。阻尼 B≥0 的实部为正，满足 ③。带延迟的弹簧就不行：

    For a linear time-invariant port this is equivalent to the impedance Z(s)=F(s)/V(s) being positive real: (1) no poles in the right half-plane; (2) any poles on the imaginary axis (including infinity) are simple, with positive real residues; (3) ReZ(jω)≥0 at every frequency. A spring K/s and a mass Ms store energy without dissipating it: their real part is identically zero, meeting (3) with equality, and their poles (the spring’s at s=0, the mass’s at infinity) are simple with positive residues, meeting (2). A damper B≥0 has a positive real part and meets (3). A delayed spring fails:

    Z(s)=Ke−stdsReZ(jω)=−Ksin⁡(ωtd)ω≈−Ktd

    低频里它就是一根弹簧加一个 Ktd 的负阻尼器，后面的虚拟墙和外骨骼实验讲的都是这件事。两个无源端口接在一起，总能量不会增加，所以不会越振越大；Colgate 与 Hogan（1988）证明，对线性系统，要保证与任意线性无源环境耦合都稳定，这个条件也是必要的。

    At low frequency that is a spring plus a negative damper of Ktd — the story behind both the virtual-wall and the exoskeleton experiments below. Connect two passive ports and the total energy cannot increase, so nothing can grow; Colgate and Hogan (1988) showed that for a linear system to be guaranteed stable against every linear passive environment, the condition is also necessary.

    “人是无源的”有前提　Hogan（1989）综述的测量表明：尽管有主动的神经肌肉反馈，人臂对扰动的响应像一个无源物体。（工程分析里的约定是：人自己想做的动作另作外部输入处理，它推动系统，但不构成会失稳的回路。）Dyck 等（2013）测了人臂的端点阻抗：放松地握着设备时是无源的；用力保持姿势、受到力扰动时，是否无源取决于扰动力的大小。Vallery 等（2008）在康复外骨骼 LOPES 上发现，实际渲染出的刚度高于无源理论给的上限，推测健康受试者在帮着稳定系统；患者未必如此，于是换了更硬的弹簧，不再依赖人的稳定作用。

    “The human is passive” comes with conditions　Measurements reviewed by Hogan (1989) show that, despite active neuromuscular feedback, the arm responds to perturbations like a passive object. (By convention, engineering analyses treat what the person intends to do as a separate external input: it drives the system without closing a loop that can go unstable.) Dyck et al. (2013) measured arm endpoint impedance: a relaxed grasp was passive, but whether a stiff, posture-holding arm was passive depended on the size of the force perturbation. On the LOPES rehabilitation exoskeleton, Vallery et al. (2008) rendered stiffer than the passivity bound allowed and suspected the healthy subjects were helping to stabilize the loop; patients might not, so they fitted stiffer springs instead of relying on the human.

    工程后果　“设备端口无源”是不指望人帮忙也成立的保证，所以偏保守。如果掌握人体阻抗大致的变化范围，可以按互补稳定性（Buerger & Hogan 2007）把耦合稳定问题变成对这个范围的鲁棒稳定问题，把性能换回来。

    Engineering consequence　A passive device port is a guarantee that asks nothing of the human, which is exactly why it is conservative. If you know roughly how the human’s impedance can vary, complementary stability (Buerger & Hogan 2007) recasts coupled stability as robust stability over that range and buys the performance back.

    自己验证Check it yourself

    • 虚拟墙实验里的“手指”选项（在“更多参数”里）就是人提供的阻尼。墙的刚度 K = 150 时，选“轻触”振荡幅度比约 0.80，选“正常”约 0.52：人给的阻尼越少，越要靠设备自己满足条件。
    • The “Finger” setting in the virtual-wall experiment (under More parameters) is the damping the human contributes. At K = 150 the oscillation ratio is about 0.80 with a light touch and about 0.52 with a normal grip: the less damping the person supplies, the more the device must satisfy the condition on its own.
    • 阻抗实验里把人手刚度调到最大（顶住硬物）：阻抗实现照样稳定。导纳为什么不行，见阻抗实验后面的“深入一层”。
    • In the impedance experiment, turn the hand stiffness all the way up (braced against something rigid): the impedance version stays stable. Why admittance doesn’t is the subject of the “Going deeper” after that experiment.

    文中其他出处Other sources cited　Hogan, N. (1989). Controlling impedance at the man/machine interface. Proc. IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation, 1626–1631. doi:10.1109/ROBOT.1989.100210 · Dyck, M., Jazayeri, A., & Tavakoli, M. (2013). Is the human operator in a teleoperation system passive? Proc. IEEE World Haptics Conference, 683–688. doi:10.1109/WHC.2013.6548491 · Vallery, H., Veneman, J., van Asseldonk, E., Ekkelenkamp, R., Buss, M., & van der Kooij, H. (2008). Compliant actuation of rehabilitation robots. IEEE Robotics & Automation Magazine, 15(3), 60–69. doi:10.1109/MRA.2008.927689

    下面四个实验对应上面的台阶：碰撞（第 ② 步）、因果方向（第 ③ 步）、采样上限（第 ⑤ 步），以及外骨骼里的“滞后即阻尼”。每个实验都配有一个由仿真驱动的场景：连杆撞墙、手推关节、手指按墙、肩外骨骼抬臂；其中飞轮、手和手臂可以在场景里直接拖。The four experiments below follow the steps above: impact (step 2), causality (step 3), the sampling limit (step 5), and lag acting as damping in the exoskeleton. Each comes with a scene driven by the simulation — a link hitting a wall, a hand pushing a joint, a finger pressing on a wall, a shoulder exoskeleton lifting an arm — and in three of them you can drag the flywheel, the hand or the arm right in the scene.

    碰撞公式里没有 Kd。场景里，电机经减速器带着一根连杆撞向硬墙（慢放）：接触的一瞬闪一下，右边放大窗里墙面被压进去，接触力和控制力两根箭头随力伸缩；转子飞轮画得越大，折算到连杆端的反射质量越大。先只拖控制刚度 Kd，先猜：调到 4 倍，峰值力会变多少？Kd isn’t in the impact formula. In the scene, a geared motor swings a link into a stiff wall, in slow motion: a flash at the moment of contact, the wall dents in the magnifier on the right, and the contact-force and control-force arrows stretch with the forces; the bigger the rotor flywheel is drawn, the more mass it reflects to the link. Move only the control stiffness Kd at first. Predict: quadruple it — how much does the peak force change?

    你应该看到：Kd 从 0 拉到 2000 N/m，峰值力只从约 120 N 变到约 124 N。再把减速比从 100 降到 9：关节后面的转子“变轻”，表观质量从 1.6 kg 降到 0.5 kg，峰值力从约 122 N 降到约 68 N。换成软表面（103 N/m），达峰时间拉长到约 48 ms（默认 Kd = 500 N/m 时；其他取值见深入一层），峰值力也开始低于公式值：控制器来得及插手了。What you should see: raising Kd from 0 to 2000 N/m moves the peak force only from about 120 N to about 124 N. Now drop the gear ratio from 100 to 9: the rotor behind the joint “gets lighter”, the apparent mass falls from 1.6 kg to 0.5 kg, and the peak force from about 122 N to about 68 N. Against a soft surface (103 N/m) the peak takes about 48 ms to arrive (at the default Kd = 500 N/m; other values are in Going deeper) and falls below the formula’s value: now the controller has time to matter.

    深入一层Going deeper 碰撞峰值力为什么几乎不听控制刚度的？转子的反射惯量为什么不一定全算进去？Why does the control stiffness barely move the peak impact force — and why doesn’t the rotor’s reflected inertia always count in full?

    前置知识 能量守恒；质量—弹簧振动的周期；惯量经减速比折算要乘 N2（01 节）。

    Background. Energy conservation; the period of a mass–spring oscillation; inertia reflected through a gear ratio scales with N2 (section 01).

    思路　比两个量级。先比力：接触后的 1/4 个振动周期里，墙的力从零涨到约 120 N；控制器的力这时才刚长起来，Kd = 2000 N/m 时到峰值那一刻也只有约 21 N（几乎全来自与 Kd 配套的阻尼项 Bd(x˙d−x˙)：实验里的参考点此刻还在以 0.3 m/s 往墙里走，连杆却几乎停住了，所以这一项此刻是往墙里推的，场景里控制力箭头也朝着墙；Kd 乘不到 1 mm 的位移只有 1 N 多）。再比时间：峰值在 (π/2)m/ke ≈ 6 ms 时到达（m = 1.6 kg，ke = 105 N/m），1 kHz 的控制器只来得及算 6 次，还要扣掉传感和通信延迟。所以控制器改变峰值只有两条路：接触前把 v 降下来（限速接近）；或者用力反馈“藏起”一部分惯量，但那要求力环带宽远高于接触频率 ke/m ≈ 250 rad/s，靠非同位的末端力传感器很难做到。

    Idea　Compare two magnitudes. Force first: within a quarter period of contact, the wall’s force climbs from zero to about 120 N, while the controller’s force is only just building up — even at Kd = 2000 N/m it is about 21 N at the moment of the peak, almost all of it from the damping term Bd(x˙d−x˙) that comes with Kd (in the experiment the reference is still moving into the wall at 0.3 m/s while the link has all but stopped, so at this moment the term pushes toward the wall — which is why the control-force arrow in the scene points at the wall; Kd times a sub-millimeter displacement is just over 1 N). Then time: the peak arrives after (π/2)m/ke ≈ 6 ms (m = 1.6 kg, ke = 105 N/m) — six ticks of a 1 kHz controller, before sensing and communication delays are subtracted. A controller therefore has two ways to change the peak: slow the approach (reduce v), or use force feedback to hide part of the inertia. The latter needs a force loop far faster than the contact frequency ke/m ≈ 250 rad/s, which a non-collocated tip sensor rarely allows.

    反射惯量　正文的 m=mlink+N2Jm/r2 假设传动是刚性的。如果转子经过一段刚度为 kt（折算到接触点）的传动与连杆相连，而且 kt≪ke，那么第一个 1/4 周期里转子几乎没参与：

    Reflected inertia　The main text’s m=mlink+N2Jm/r2 assumes a rigid transmission. If the rotor is coupled to the link through a transmission of stiffness kt (referred to the contact point) with kt≪ke, the rotor barely takes part in the first quarter period:

    F1≈vkemlink,t1≈π2mlinkketrot∼π2mrotkt,mrot=N2Jmr2

    转子的动量并没有消失，它要经过传动弹簧慢慢传到墙上，时间尺度是上面第二行。这部分力最后有多大，取决于这几十毫秒里控制器做了什么（例如 SEA 的力矩环让电机主动刹住转子），以及接触阻尼。所以串联柔性首先买到的是时间：把一部分冲击从控制环够不着的几毫秒，挪到来得及处理的几十毫秒。这就是 SEA（Pratt & Williamson 1995）缓解冲击的机理。本体感知执行器走的是另一条路：不加弹簧，直接用低减速比把 N2Jm/r2 做小（见本节的 MIT Cheetah 实例）；两者都是让转子惯量少参与碰撞，所以能用同一个冲击缓解系数比较。代价也要记住：要求端口无源时，SEA 能渲染的刚度不超过弹簧本身的刚度（Vallery 等 2008）。

    The rotor’s momentum hasn’t gone anywhere; it reaches the wall through the transmission spring on the slower time scale in the second line. How large that later force gets depends on what the controller does during those tens of milliseconds — an SEA’s torque loop, for instance, can have the motor brake its own rotor — and on contact damping. So what series compliance buys first is time: it moves part of the impact from the few milliseconds no loop can reach into the tens of milliseconds a loop can handle. That is how SEAs (Pratt & Williamson 1995) mitigate impacts. Proprioceptive actuators take the other route: no spring, just a low gear ratio that makes N2Jm/r2 small in the first place (see the MIT Cheetah case in this section). Both keep the rotor inertia out of the collision, which is why a single impact mitigation factor can compare them. Remember the price, too: if the port must stay passive, an SEA cannot render a stiffness higher than that of its own spring (Vallery et al. 2008).

    自己验证Check it yourself

    • Kd 从 0 拉到 2000 N/m：峰值从约 120.4 N 变到约 123.5 N，只变 2.6%。
    • Take Kd from 0 to 2000 N/m: the peak goes from about 120.4 N to about 123.5 N, a change of 2.6%.
    • 把减速比调到 9：表观质量约 0.51 kg，峰值约 68 N，3.6 ms 达峰。这正是“转子被传动弹簧完全隔开、只剩 0.5 kg 连杆”时第一个峰的样子。
    • Set the gear ratio to 9: the apparent mass is about 0.51 kg and the peak about 68 N, reached in 3.6 ms — exactly what the first peak looks like when a transmission spring fully isolates the rotor and only the 0.5 kg link remains.
    • 环境刚度调到 103 N/m（像软组织）：达峰时间在 Kd = 0 时约 63 ms，500 时约 48 ms，2000 时约 39 ms，峰值从 12 N 降到 7.7 N。接触慢到控制器插得上手，Kd 才开始起作用。
    • Set the environment to 103 N/m (soft-tissue-like): the peak arrives after about 63 ms at Kd = 0, 48 ms at 500 and 39 ms at 2000, and falls from 12 N to 7.7 N. Only when contact is slow enough for the controller to get a word in does Kd start to matter.

    文中其他出处Other sources cited　Vallery, H., Veneman, J., van Asseldonk, E., Ekkelenkamp, R., Buss, M., & van der Kooij, H. (2008). Compliant actuation of rehabilitation robots. IEEE Robotics & Automation Magazine, 15(3), 60–69. doi:10.1109/MRA.2008.927689

    场景里并排放着两根一样的杠杆，左边用阻抗、右边用导纳实现第 ③ 步，由同一只手隔着“手臂弹簧”推着：每根杠杆右边画着控制器算出来的虚拟弹簧和阻尼器，手可以直接左右拖。两者的 Kd、Bd 相同；导纳那根的轴上还有一个虚线圆盘，代表只有导纳才能单独设定的虚拟惯量 Md，它可以设得很小。先只把人手刚度调大（像绷紧手臂），先猜：哪种实现先出问题？In the scene, two identical levers stand side by side, implementing step 3 with impedance on the left and admittance on the right, both pushed by the same hand through an “arm spring”: to the right of each lever are the virtual spring and damper the controller computes, and you can drag the hand sideways. Both use the same Kd and Bd; the dashed disc on the admittance lever’s axle is the virtual inertia Md, which only admittance can set on its own, and which can be made very small. Turn up only the hand stiffness at first, as if the arm were tensing. Predict: which implementation fails first?

    你应该看到：推住不动时，稳态力矩 ÷ 稳态位移 = Kd（默认 3.333 N·m ÷ 0.1667 rad = 20 N·m/rad）。人手刚度调到最大、Md 调到最小，导纳实现发散，阻抗实现仍然稳定。导纳发散的边界大致就是 √(人手刚度 ÷ 虚拟惯量) ≈ 位置内环的自然频率（本实验约 173 rad/s）：比如人手刚度 2000 N·m/rad 时，虚拟惯量从 0.05 加到 0.1 kg·m²，导纳就由发散变为稳定。最后按“自动推拉”，让手来回推，看“交互力矩—设备角度”那张图里的实时轨迹。只有弹簧时，压进去和退回来走的是同一条线，一个来回不耗能；加大 Bd，同一个位置上往里推时力大、往外退时力小，这条线就张开成一个椭圆形的回线。回线围住的面积就是每个来回被阻尼吃掉的能量，也就是读数“实时回线：每周期耗散能量”。这正是第 ④ 步说的“耗能”在图上的样子。What you should see: once the hand holds still, steady torque ÷ steady displacement = Kd (by default 3.333 N·m ÷ 0.1667 rad = 20 N·m/rad). With the hand at its stiffest and Md at its smallest, the admittance version diverges while the impedance version stays stable. The admittance boundary sits roughly where √(hand stiffness ÷ virtual inertia) reaches the inner position loop’s natural frequency, about 173 rad/s here: at a hand stiffness of 2000 N·m/rad, for instance, raising the virtual inertia from 0.05 to 0.1 kg·m² takes the admittance version from diverging to stable. Finally, press Auto push so the hand pushes back and forth, and watch the live traces on the interaction-torque-versus-device-angle plot. With a spring alone, pressing in and backing out follow the same line, and a round trip costs no energy. Raise Bd and, at the same position, the force is larger going in than coming out, so the line opens into an elliptical loop. The area it encloses is the energy the damper eats per cycle — the “Live loop: energy dissipated per cycle” readout. This is what step 4’s “dissipation” looks like on a plot.

    深入一层Going deeper 为什么碰到硬物或绷紧的手臂时，阻抗实现比导纳实现稳？Why does impedance survive a stiff contact — or a tensed arm — that makes admittance oscillate?

    前置知识 回路增益、穿越频率和相位裕度（00、01 节）；二阶系统的自然频率 k/m。

    Background. Loop gain, crossover frequency and phase margin (sections 00 and 01); the natural frequency k/m of a second-order system.

    思路　看人手的刚度 kh 进了哪个回路。导纳实现里，力传感器测到 F=kh(xh−x)，经目标导纳算出位置指令，再由位置内环 Tpos(s) 去跟。沿“力 → 位置 → 力”走一圈，回路增益是：

    Idea　Follow the hand stiffness kh and see which loop it ends up in. With admittance, the force sensor reads F=kh(xh−x), the target admittance turns it into a position command, and the inner position loop Tpos(s) tracks it. Going once around force → position → force gives the loop gain

    L(s)=khTpos(s)Mds2+Bds+Kdkh/Md<ωin

    高频段分母由 Mds2 主导，|L|=1 的穿越频率约为 kh/Md。目标导纳 1/(Mds2+Bds+Kd) 在那里的相位已接近 −180°，只剩 Bd 给的一点超前；再叠上内环在这个频率附近的滞后，裕度就没了。物理图像：导纳要位置环“演”出一个挂在人手弹簧上的质量 Md，它的振动频率就是 kh/Md；位置环跟不上，演出来的就是一个带滞后的质量，而滞后等于负阻尼。于是有第二行的经验规则（ωin 是位置内环的自然频率，实际还要留裕度）：kh 越大、Md 越小越先出事，正好对应“碰硬物、绷紧手臂、渲染很小的惯量”这三个失稳场景。

    At high frequency the denominator is dominated by Mds2, so |L|=1 at roughly kh/Md. There the target admittance 1/(Mds2+Bds+Kd) already sits near −180°, with only a little lead from Bd; add the inner loop’s lag at that frequency and the margin is gone. Physically, admittance asks the position loop to act out a mass Md hanging on the hand’s spring, which oscillates at kh/Md. If the position loop can’t keep up, what it acts out is a lagging mass — and lag is negative damping. Hence the rule of thumb in the second line (ωin is the inner loop’s natural frequency; leave margin in practice): a larger kh or a smaller Md fails first — precisely the three failure cases of hard contact, a tensed arm and a tiny rendered inertia.

    阻抗实现里，人手弹簧直接作用在设备真实的惯量 m 上。kh 变大，只是抬高一个物理振动频率 (kh+Kd)/m；这个回路由物理本身“计算”，不经过采样，也不经过位置环。控制器只贡献 Kd、Bd 两项，而 m 又通常比导纳想渲染的 Md 大得多。代价正好反过来：阻抗难以渲染很高的刚度（第 ⑤ 步的 Z-width）；想把表观惯量做到比 m 小，又得靠力反馈，问题就回来了。Ott、Mukherjee 与 Nakamura（2010）把两者看成同一族控制器的两个极端，可以在中间连续插值，折中两者互补的稳定性与性能。

    With impedance, the hand’s spring acts directly on the device’s real inertia m. A larger kh merely raises a physical natural frequency (kh+Kd)/m, and physics itself “computes” that loop — no sampling, no position loop in the way. The controller contributes only Kd and Bd, and m is usually far larger than the Md an admittance controller tries to render. The price runs the other way: impedance struggles to render high stiffness (the Z-width of step 5), and making the apparent inertia smaller than m brings back force feedback — and the problem with it. Ott, Mukherjee and Nakamura (2010) treat the two as extremes of one controller family and interpolate continuously between them to trade off their complementary stability and performance.

    自己验证Check it yourself

    • 本实验的位置内环自然频率是 3000/0.1 ≈ 173 rad/s。
    • This experiment’s inner position loop has a natural frequency of 3000/0.1 ≈ 173 rad/s.
    • 人手刚度 2000 N·m/rad：虚拟惯量 0.05 kg·m²（kh/Md = 200 rad/s）导纳发散，0.1 kg·m²（141 rad/s）稳定。
    • Hand stiffness 2000 N·m/rad: with a virtual inertia of 0.05 kg·m² (kh/Md = 200 rad/s) the admittance version diverges; at 0.1 kg·m² (141 rad/s) it is stable.
    • 人手刚度 300 N·m/rad：0.005 kg·m²（245 rad/s）发散，0.01 kg·m²（173 rad/s）稳定。后一组正好压在经验规则的边界上，读数显示“≈ 内环：临界，留裕度”，这次仍稳定：经验规则只是大致的分界。以上各组里，阻抗实现都稳定。
    • Hand stiffness 300 N·m/rad: 0.005 kg·m² (245 rad/s) diverges, 0.01 kg·m² (173 rad/s) is stable. The second case sits right on the rule-of-thumb boundary — the readout says “≈ inner loop: marginal, leave margin” — and this run stays stable: the rule only marks the boundary roughly. In every one of these cases the impedance version stays stable.

    文中其他出处Other sources cited　Ott, C., Mukherjee, R., & Nakamura, Y. (2010). Unified impedance and admittance control. Proc. IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation, 554–561. doi:10.1109/ROBOT.2010.5509861

    第 ⑤ 步说墙的刚度上限约为 2(b−|B|)/T。场景里一根手指推着导轨上的旋钮去压一面虚拟墙。这面墙其实渲染在一个转动关节上，所以单位是 mrad 和 N·m/rad；为了看得清，场景把关节的转角画成了沿导轨的直线位移，穿透量只有几毫弧度，也放大了（看标注）。底部的台阶带画出墙的力每个采样周期才更新一次；场景里的两根能量条，一根是墙吐出的能量，一根是阻尼耗掉的能量，条下写着判读规则“吐出的比耗掉的多 → 越振越大”：前者追上后者，颤振就停不下来。先只把墙的刚度 K 拉过无源上限，先猜：采样快 5 倍，墙能做硬几倍？Step 5 says the wall tops out near 2(b−|B|)/T. In the scene a finger pushes a knob along a rail into a virtual wall. The wall is actually rendered on a rotary joint, hence the units of mrad and N·m/rad; for legibility the scene draws the joint angle as straight-line travel along the rail, and since the penetration is only a few milliradians it is magnified too (see the label). The staircase strip at the bottom shows the wall force updating only once per sample period; of the scene’s two energy bars, one is the energy the wall gives out and the other the energy the damping soaks up, and the rule printed under them reads “wall gives out more than damping soaks up → chatter grows”: once the first catches up with the second, the chatter can’t die out. Push only the wall stiffness K past the passivity limit at first. Predict: sample 5× faster — how much stiffer can the wall be?

    你应该看到：默认 K = 80（低于无源上限 100）时颤振衰减，K = 500 时变成持续颤振。采样周期缩到 0.2 ms，上限升到 500。加 0.02 的虚拟阻尼，上限降到 60，K = 80 已不满足无源条件，颤振反而衰减得更快（幅度比 0.58 → 0.36）：在人手能耦合进来的低频，虚拟阻尼确实在耗能，无源条件扣掉 |B| 是为了最坏的高频情形。K = 150 也违反无源条件，振荡却没有越振越大（幅度比约 0.8）：手指自己的阻尼也在耗能；墙又只能推、不能拉，手指时不时被弹开，弹开时墙不再注入能量。无源条件只看设备这一侧，所以偏保守（细节见深入一层）。What you should see: at the default K = 80 (below the passivity limit of 100) the chatter decays; at K = 500 it persists. Shrinking the sample period to 0.2 ms raises the limit to 500. Adding 0.02 of virtual damping lowers the limit to 60, so K = 80 is no longer passive, yet the chatter dies out faster (oscillation ratio 0.58 → 0.36): at the low frequencies a hand can couple into, virtual damping really does dissipate energy, and the passivity condition charges |B| to cover the worst case at high frequency. K = 150 also violates the passivity condition, yet the oscillation doesn’t grow (oscillation ratio about 0.8): the finger’s own damping dissipates energy, and the wall can only push, not pull — the finger keeps getting knocked off, and while it is off the wall injects nothing. The passivity condition looks only at the device side, so it is conservative (details in Going deeper).

    深入一层Going deeper 虚拟墙的刚度上限为什么是 2b/T？它和外骨骼的“滞后即阻尼”是同一件事吗？Why is a virtual wall capped near 2b/T — and is that the same thing as “lag acts as damping” in the exoskeleton?

    前置知识 一阶泰勒展开；零阶保持让输出平均晚半个采样周期；“|B| 从哪里来”一段还要用到奈奎斯特频率（采样频率的一半）。

    Background. A first-order Taylor expansion; the fact that a zero-order hold delays its output by half a sample on average; the part on where |B| comes from also uses the Nyquist frequency (half the sampling rate).

    思路　零阶保持让墙的力平均晚半个采样周期。把一个“斜率为 −K”的力晚 T/2 施加，做一阶展开：

    Idea　A zero-order hold delivers the wall force half a sample late on average. Apply a force of slope −K with a delay of T/2 and expand to first order:

    F(t)=−Kx(t−T2)≈−Kx(t)+KT2x˙(t)

    第二项和速度同号，是一个大小为 KT/2 的负阻尼，设备自身的物理阻尼 b 要把它盖住：b>KT/2，即 K<2b/T。这和外骨骼那一段是同一个式子：墙就是一条斜率 ∂τd/∂θ=−K 的“助力曲线”，滞后 td=T/2，所以 beq=−KT/2。第四个实验里斜率变负的那一段会向人注入能量，与墙的颤振是同一个机理。

    The second term has the sign of the velocity: a negative damper of size KT/2, which the device’s own physical damping b must cover: b>KT/2, that is, K<2b/T. It is the very formula from the exoskeleton passage: a wall is an “assist curve” of slope ∂τd/∂θ=−K with lag td=T/2, hence beq=−KT/2. The negative-slope stretch in the fourth experiment pumps energy into the person by the same mechanism that makes the wall chatter.

    |B| 从哪里来　它不是低频效应。按 Colgate 与 Schenkel（1997）的无源条件，对这个模型（零阶保持加后向差分测速）逐频率展开，得到：

    Where |B| comes from　Not from low frequencies. Expanding the Colgate–Schenkel (1997) passivity condition frequency by frequency for this model (zero-order hold, backward-difference velocity) gives

    b>KT2−Bcos⁡(ωT),0≤ω≤πT

    弹簧项在所有频率都占用 KT/2。虚拟阻尼在低频（cos⁡ωT≈1）确实在加阻尼；差分和保持合起来让它滞后 ωT 的相位，到奈奎斯特频率 π/T 正好滞后半圈而变号（cos=−1）。无源条件要求所有频率都成立，于是记成 b>KT/2+|B|。可人手能耦合进来的振动远低于奈奎斯特频率，那里又被设备惯量挡住：这就是无源条件保守的具体原因，也解释了正文里“加阻尼反而衰减更快”。

    The spring term claims KT/2 at every frequency. The virtual damper really does add damping at low frequency (cos⁡ωT≈1); differencing plus hold delay it by a phase of ωT, which at the Nyquist frequency π/T is half a cycle, so its sign flips (cos=−1). Passivity must hold at every frequency, hence the bookkeeping b>KT/2+|B|. But a hand couples in far below Nyquist, and the device inertia blocks that frequency anyway — which is concretely why the passivity condition is conservative, and why adding damping made the chatter die out faster in the main text.

    真正的耦合稳定边界还要算上手指的阻尼 bh 和额外的计算、通信延迟 td，低频近似为 b+bh+B>K(T/2+td)。Diolaiti 等（2006）把量化、计算延迟和库仑摩擦也算了进去，并指出许多常见设备违反无源判据仍能稳定工作。条件实在满足不了时，可以用时域无源观测器：实时累计从端口流出的能量，一旦为负，就加恰好够用的阻尼把它吸收掉（Hannaford & Ryu 2002 报告在刚度超过 100 N/mm、或延迟 15 ms 时仍稳定接触）。

    The actual coupled-stability boundary also counts the finger’s damping bh and any extra computation or communication delay td; to low-frequency order it is b+bh+B>K(T/2+td). Diolaiti et al. (2006) add quantization, computational delay and Coulomb friction, and observe that many common devices run stably while violating passivity criteria. When the condition simply can’t be met, a time-domain passivity observer helps: integrate the energy leaving the port in real time and, whenever it goes negative, add just enough damping to absorb it (Hannaford & Ryu 2002 report stable contact with stiffness above 100 N/mm or with 15 ms of delay).

    自己验证Check it yourself

    • 手指选“轻触”（bh = 0.01）时，低频稳定边界约为 2(b+bh)/T = 2 × 0.06 / 0.001 = 120 N·m/rad，比无源上限 100 高：手指也在耗能。
    • With a light touch (bh = 0.01) the low-frequency stability boundary is about 2(b+bh)/T = 2 × 0.06 / 0.001 = 120 N·m/rad, above the passivity limit of 100: the finger dissipates energy too.
    • 加虚拟阻尼 B = 0.02：无源上限降到 60，K = 80 的幅度比却从 0.58 降到 0.36。低频里 B 就是 +0.02 的阻尼，边界变成 2 × 0.08 / 0.001 = 160。（读数“算上手指阻尼”那一行照最坏的高频情形扣掉 |B|，显示的是 80。）
    • Add virtual damping B = 0.02: the passivity limit drops to 60, yet the oscillation ratio at K = 80 falls from 0.58 to 0.36. At low frequency B is simply +0.02 of damping, and the boundary moves to 2 × 0.08 / 0.001 = 160. (The “Counting finger damping” readout still charges |B| for the worst case at high frequency, so it shows 80.)
    • K = 150 已超过 120 的边界，幅度比约 0.80，却没有越振越大：墙只能推不能拉，手指大约一半时间被弹离墙面，离开墙时没有能量注入，振幅就被限住了。手指换成“正常”（bh = 0.05，边界 200），幅度比降到约 0.52。
    • K = 150 is past the 120 boundary and the ratio is about 0.80, yet the oscillation doesn’t keep growing: the wall can push but not pull, the finger is knocked off the surface roughly half the time, and no energy goes in while it is off, so the amplitude stays bounded. Switch the finger to a normal grip (bh = 0.05, boundary 200) and the ratio drops to about 0.52.

    文中其他出处Other sources cited　Hannaford, B., & Ryu, J.-H. (2002). Time-domain passivity control of haptic interfaces. IEEE Transactions on Robotics and Automation, 18(1), 1–10. doi:10.1109/70.988969

    外骨骼那一段说：助力曲线的斜率乘上压力环的滞后，就是一个等效阻尼。场景里穿着肩外骨骼的人上下摆臂，腋下气囊的鼓起和助力弧都跟着实际助力走；有滞后时，它们明显“慢半拍”地跟在手臂后面（虚线弧是没有滞后时应有的助力）。先只拖工作角度，先猜：同一条助力曲线，是不是在所有角度都在“拖”你？The exoskeleton passage says the slope of the assist curve times the pressure-loop lag acts as a damper. In the scene a person wearing a shoulder exoskeleton swings the arm up and down, and both the underarm bladder’s bulge and the assist arc follow the actual assist; with lag, they trail visibly half a beat behind the arm (the dashed arc is the assist you would get with no lag). Move only the operating angle at first. Predict: with one assist curve, does it drag you at every angle?

    你应该看到：工作角度 45° 时曲线斜率为正，每个来回装置吸收约 0.42 J，这是拖滞。拖到 120°，斜率变负，装置反过来每个来回注入约 0.26 J。滞后调到 0，功归零。“等效阻尼”读数是低频近似（ωtd ≪ 1）：频率和滞后都调得很大时，以“每个来回装置对人做的功”这个读数为准。What you should see: at 45° the curve’s slope is positive and the device absorbs about 0.42 J per cycle, felt as drag. At 120° the slope turns negative and the device injects about 0.26 J per cycle. With zero lag the work is zero. The equivalent-damping readout is a low-frequency approximation (ωtd ≪ 1): with a high frequency and a long lag, trust the “Work done on the person per cycle” readout instead.

    一句话Takeaway

    交互控制换的是“控什么”：规定力与运动的关系；它能渲染多硬、多透明，由执行器、采样和延迟决定，而不是由增益想调多大决定。

    Interaction control changes what is controlled: the relation between force and motion. How stiff or how transparent it can be is set by the actuator, the sampling and the delay — not by how high you’d like to turn the gain.

    下一个问题：如果力矩有上限、前面有限位，或者同一个动作要重复一千次，只看此刻还够吗？Next question: if torque is limited, a joint stop lies ahead, or the same motion repeats a thousand times, is reacting to the present still enough?

Journal of Robotic Systems, 14(1), 37–47. doi:10.1002/(SICI)1097-4563(199701)14:1<37::AID-ROB4>3.0.CO;2-V · Diolaiti, N., Niemeyer, G., Barbagli, F., & Salisbury, J. K. (2006). Stability of haptic rendering: Discretization, quantization, time delay, and Coulomb effects. IEEE Transactions on Robotics, 22(2), 256–268. doi:10.1109/TRO.2005.862487

      前者给出采样系统的无源条件，b>KT/2+|B| 就是它的特例；后者把量化、计算延迟和库仑摩擦也算进来，指出许多常见设备违反无源判据仍能稳定工作，并用能量方法分析了原因。

      The first gives the passivity condition for sampled-data systems, of which b>KT/2+|B| is a special case; the second adds quantization, computational delay and Coulomb friction, notes that many common devices run stably while violating passivity criteria, and uses an energy argument to show why.

    4. Eppinger, S. D., & Seering, W. P. (1987). Understanding bandwidth limitations in robot force control. Proc. IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation, 904–909. doi:10.1109/ROBOT.1987.1087932 · Pratt, G. A., & Williamson, M. M. (1995). Series elastic actuators. Proc. IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems, vol. 1, 399–406. doi:10.1109/IROS.1995.525827

      一对正反面：前者用简单模型分析力控闭环带宽被什么卡住——控制设计里常被忽略的结构动态（传感器与执行器之间隔着柔性，即非同位）、传动非线性、执行器与控制器动态；后者反其道而行，有意在传动里串一根弹簧，用弹簧变形测力，换来抗冲击能力和稳定的力控。

      Two sides of one coin: the first uses simple models to show what caps closed-loop force-control bandwidth — structural dynamics usually left out of the design (compliance between sensor and actuator, i.e. non-collocation), drive-train nonlinearities, and actuator and controller dynamics; the second deliberately puts a spring in the drivetrain and measures force through its deflection, trading bandwidth for shock tolerance and stable force control.

    5. Albu-Schäffer, A., Ott, C., & Hirzinger, G. (2007). A unified passivity-based control framework for position, torque and impedance control of flexible joint robots. The International Journal of Robotics Research, 26(1), 23–39. doi:10.1177/0278364907073776

      柔性关节（谐波减速加关节力矩传感）上的位置、力矩、阻抗控制，统一在一个无源性框架里；“力矩反馈等于电机惯量整形”这个视角值得每个做关节力控的人掌握。

      Position, torque and impedance control of flexible-joint robots (harmonic drives with joint torque sensing) in one passivity-based framework; the view of torque feedback as motor-inertia shaping is worth owning if you build joint-level force control.

    6. Keemink, A. Q. L., van der Kooij, H., & Stienen, A. H. A. (2018). Admittance control for physical human–robot interaction. The International Journal of Robotics Research, 37(11), 1421–1444. doi:10.1177/0278364918768950 · Buerger, S. P., & Hogan, N. (2007). Complementary stability and loop shaping for improved human–robot interaction. IEEE Transactions on Robotics, 23(2), 232–244. doi:10.1109/TRO.2007.892229

      前者系统分析了力信号滤波、内环带宽、机器人内部柔性和虚拟阻尼对导纳控制耦合稳定性的影响，最后给出七条设计准则；后者利用对人体阻抗的有限了解，突破“按无源性设计”的保守性。

      The first analyzes how force filtering, motion-loop bandwidth, internal robot flexibility and virtual damping affect coupled stability under admittance control, and ends with seven design guidelines; the second uses limited knowledge of human impedance to get past the conservatism of designing for passivity.

    06MPC 与 ILC：向前看，向后看MPC and ILC: looking ahead, looking back

    用预测与数据Use prediction and data

    问题The question

    关节要转到目标，目标后面 0.05 rad 就是机械挡块；外骨骼每天要重复几百次同一个抬臂动作。只看此刻的反馈，碰到硬约束只能事后限幅；遇到重复任务，每一次都重犯同样的错。能不能向前看一段，或者向后看上一次？

    A joint must swing to its target with a mechanical stop just 0.05 rad beyond it; an exoskeleton repeats the same arm raise hundreds of times a day. Feedback that looks only at the present can only clip after the fact when it meets a hard limit, and it repeats the same mistake on every trial of a repeated task. Can we look ahead a little — or look back at the last trial?

    本节要点（5 分钟版）This section in brief

    • MPC：用模型把未来一段“演”一遍，在约束下挑出最好的一串输入，只执行第一步，下一刻重新测量、重新规划，所以它本质上是反馈。没有约束（并带 LQR 的终端代价，或时域无限长）时它就是 LQR：在线优化的算力只买到两样东西，约束和预见。
    • MPC 的工程坑：预测时域要长到“看得见刹车”；硬的状态约束可能无解，要做成软约束；模型外的恒定扰动要估出来补掉；每个周期都得按时解完。
    • ILC：同一个动作一遍遍重复时，用上一遍的整段误差修正下一遍的前馈，就像练投篮。批内新来的扰动它看不见，所以要和实时反馈一起用。
    • ILC 要在每个频率上都一遍比一遍好，高频最危险（用 Q 滤波挡在学习之外）；它还会把不重复的噪声学进去，学得越快放大越多。
    • MPC plays the next stretch of the future forward with a model, picks the best input sequence that respects the constraints, applies only the first move, then measures and replans at the next step — so at heart it is feedback. Without constraints (and with the LQR terminal cost, or an infinite horizon) it is LQR: the online computation buys exactly two things, constraint handling and foresight.
    • MPC’s practical traps: the horizon must be long enough to see the braking; hard state constraints can become infeasible, so make them soft; unmodeled constant disturbances have to be estimated and cancelled; and every solve has to finish on time.
    • ILC: when the same motion repeats, use the whole error record of the last repetition to correct the next one’s feedforward — like practicing free throws. It can’t see disturbances that arrive mid-trial, so it runs alongside real-time feedback.
    • ILC has to improve trial over trial at every frequency, and high frequencies are the danger (a Q-filter keeps them out of the learning); it also learns non-repeating noise, and the faster it learns, the more noise it amplifies.

    第一次读可以跳过：MIT Cheetah 实例、外骨骼视角、各处“深入一层”。

    Safe to skip on a first read: the MIT Cheetah example, the exoskeleton lens, and the “Going deeper” boxes.

    本节符号：N 是预测步数（不是减速比）；MPC 里的 Q、R 是权重（同 01 节 LQR），ILC 里的 Q 是滤波器；P 是终端代价矩阵，就是 01 节的 Riccati 解；ILC 的对象写成 G（同 00 节），L 是学习增益。

    Notation: N is the number of prediction steps (not a gear ratio); in MPC, Q and R are weights (as in LQR, section 01), while in ILC Q is a filter; P is the terminal-cost matrix — the Riccati solution of section 01; the ILC plant is G (as in section 00), and L is the learning gain.

    两种方法都用到了“此刻之外”的信息，但方向相反。模型预测控制（MPC）在时间轴上向前看，像开车时盯着前面一段路：每一步用模型把未来一段演一遍，在约束下挑出最好的一串输入，只执行第一个，下一步再重新规划，所以它本质上是反馈律。迭代学习控制（ILC）在批次轴上向后看，像练投篮：每投一次，根据上一球偏在哪来调整下一球。它用上一次重复的整段误差修正下一次的前馈；在一次重复的内部，它给出的输入是事先定好的。

    Both methods use information from beyond the present moment, but in opposite directions. Model predictive control (MPC) looks ahead along the time axis, like a driver watching the stretch of road ahead: at every step it plays the next stretch forward with a model, picks the best input sequence that respects the constraints, applies only the first move, and replans at the next step — which makes it a feedback law. Iterative learning control (ILC) looks back along the trial axis, like practicing free throws: after each shot you adjust for where the last one missed. It uses the whole error record of the last repetition to correct the next repetition’s feedforward; within a repetition, its input is fixed in advance.

    MPC：向前看一段，只走一步MPC: plan a stretch ahead, take one step

    既然有模型，就先把未来一段“演”一遍，挑一串既满足约束、代价又最小的输入。先写理想情况，再逐项加上真机的偏差。

    If you have a model, rehearse the next stretch of the future and pick the input sequence that satisfies the constraints at the lowest cost. Ideal case first, then the real-world deviations one at a time.

    1. 理想模型：预测—优化—只执行第一步Ideal model: predict, optimize, apply the first move

      xk+1=Axk+Bukminu∑i(xiTQxi+uiTRui)x0=x^k|ui|≤umax,qi≤qlimuk=u0⋆

      在时刻 k，从实测（或估计）的状态出发，用模型预测未来 N 步（i = 0 … N − 1），求出代价最小又满足约束的一串输入，然后只执行第一个。下一刻重新测量、重新求解，窗口往前滚一步，这叫滚动时域；N 叫预测时域（每次向前预测多少步）。代价里的 Q、R 和 LQR 的权重一样：Q 罚偏差，R 罚用力。

      代价是二次的（偏差和用力的平方和），模型和约束都是线性的，这类优化问题叫二次规划（quadratic program，QP）：像在一圈直边篱笆围出的区域里，找一只碗的最低点。碗是凸的，直边篱笆围出的区域也没有凹进去的地方，所以只有一个最低点，不会卡在“半山腰”的局部解里；这正是 QP 有又快又可靠的专用求解器的原因。

      At time k, start from the measured (or estimated) state, predict N steps ahead with the model (i = 0 … N − 1), find the input sequence with the lowest cost that meets the constraints — and apply only its first move. At the next sample, measure again and re-solve, sliding the window forward one step: a receding horizon. N is the prediction horizon (how many steps ahead each plan looks). The weights Q and R play the same roles as in LQR: Q penalizes deviation, R penalizes effort.

      The cost is quadratic (sums of squared deviation and effort) and the model and constraints are linear, which makes this a quadratic program (QP): find the lowest point of a bowl inside a region fenced off by straight fences. The bowl is convex and a straight-fenced region has no inward dents, so there is exactly one lowest point and no ledge halfway down for a solver to get stuck on — which is why QPs have fast, reliable dedicated solvers.

    2. 对照：去掉约束，时域取无穷Sanity check: no constraints, infinite horizon

      N→∞:uk=−KLQRxk

      没有约束、时域无限长时，MPC 就是 LQR，也就是 01 节那个按权重 Q、R 折中出来的固定反馈增益：优化可以离线一次做完。有限时域再加上第 ④ 步的终端代价，结果也完全一样。所以在线优化花的算力，换来的其实只有两样东西：约束和预见。如果只有输入饱和、对象又开环稳定，PID 加抗饱和往往就够了。

      With no constraints and an infinite horizon, MPC is LQR — the fixed feedback gain of section 01 that trades off the weights Q and R — and the optimization can be done once, offline. A finite horizon plus the terminal cost of step 4 gives exactly the same result. So all the computation you spend on online optimization buys exactly two things: constraint handling and foresight. If all you have is input saturation on an open-loop-stable plant, PID with anti-windup is often enough.

    3. 三类约束Three kinds of constraints

      |ui|≤umax|Δui|≤Δumaxqmin≤qi≤qmaxfz≥0,‖ft‖≤μfz

      输入约束：力矩饱和、变化率。状态约束：关节限位、速度上限。接触约束：法向力只能推不能拉，切向力要落在摩擦锥（不打滑时，接触力方向能偏离法向的范围）里，零力矩点 ZMP（平地上就是脚底的压力中心）要落在支撑区域内。摩擦锥可以这样想：腿就像一根斜撑在地上的杆，杆越斜越容易打滑，和竖直方向的夹角超过 arctan⁡μ 就会滑。ZMP 跑到支撑区域外面，脚就会绕着脚掌边缘翻起来。

      避障也能写成状态约束，但它通常是非凸的：可行区域有洞或分成几块（比如绕过一根柱子：从左边绕、从右边绕都可行，两者的“折中”——正对着柱子走——却不可行），求解器容易卡在局部解，耗时也不可预测。所以腿足机器人通常把避障交给更上层的规划器，MPC 只管“脚下这几步怎么踩”。人形和四足用 MPC，主要为的是接触约束、欠驱动（机身只能靠有限的接触力间接推动）和对未来落脚点的预见。

      Input constraints: torque saturation and rate limits. State constraints: joint stops and speed limits. Contact constraints: normal forces can push but not pull, tangential forces must stay inside the friction cone (the range of force directions a contact can carry without slipping), and the zero-moment point (ZMP — on flat ground, the center of pressure under the feet) must stay inside the support area. Picture the friction cone this way: a leg is like a pole braced against the ground at an angle — the more it leans, the more easily it slips, and past arctan⁡μ from vertical it does. If the ZMP leaves the support area, the foot tips up about the edge of its sole.

      Obstacle avoidance can be written as a state constraint too, but it is usually non-convex: the feasible region has holes or separate pieces (to get past a pillar you can go left or go right, but the compromise between them — straight ahead — is infeasible), so the solver can get stuck in a local solution and its run time becomes unpredictable. Legged robots therefore usually leave obstacles to a higher-level planner and let MPC decide only how to place the next few steps. Humanoids and quadrupeds use MPC mainly for the contact constraints, the underactuation (the body can only be pushed indirectly, through limited contact forces) and preview of upcoming footholds.

    4. ＋ 有限时域不等于稳定+ A finite horizon is not a stability guarantee

      J=∑i(⋯)+xNTPxN

      时域太短时，优化器看不到窗口外面的后果，会把代价“推”到窗口之后：就像开车只看前方几米，看不见刹车距离，就不会提前刹车，甚至会来回振荡。常见补救是加终端代价（给预测末端之后剩下的“未来”估一个价），P 取无约束 LQR 的 Riccati 解。想要严格的稳定保证，还要再加一个终端约束（要求预测的最后一步落进一个“之后只用 LQR 就能安全收尾、不会碰到约束”的区域），见 MPC 实验后的深入一层；工程上常只留终端代价，把时域拉长到覆盖刹车过程或主导动态的调节时间。

      With a short horizon the optimizer can’t see consequences beyond the window and pushes cost past it — like driving while looking only a few meters ahead: if it can’t see the braking distance, it won’t brake early, and it may even oscillate. The usual fix is a terminal cost (a price on the future beyond the horizon), with P taken from the unconstrained LQR Riccati equation. A strict stability guarantee needs a terminal constraint as well (the last predicted state must land in a region from which plain LQR can finish the job without touching a constraint) — see Going deeper after the MPC experiment; in practice people often keep just the terminal cost and stretch the horizon to cover the braking or the settling time of the dominant dynamics.

    5. ＋ 问题可能无解+ The problem may have no solution

      qi≤qlim+εi,εi≥0J+ρ1∑εi+ρ2∑εi2

      有扰动或模型误差时，硬的状态约束可能根本满足不了，求解器返回“无解”，控制输出就没有定义——这是实机事故的常见来源。因此输入约束（物理饱和）保持硬约束；状态约束加松弛变量 εi，做成软约束（可以违反，但违反要付很高代价）；求解失败或超时，就沿用上一步的解平移一位，或者切到备用控制器。

      罚函数里要有一个线性项 ρ1∑εi。为什么？只用平方罚时，刚越界一点点的代价几乎为零（越界 0.001，平方只有百万分之一），优化器为了省一点力矩、早一点到位，就会“稍微越一下界”，哪怕完全可以不越。加上线性项，越界的第一点点就要按斜率 ρ1 付费；只要 ρ1 大过越界能换来的好处（严格说，是硬约束问题里这条约束的拉格朗日乘子），能满足约束时，解就和硬约束时完全一样，这叫精确罚函数。下面的实验为简单起见只用了平方罚。

      With disturbances or model error, a hard state constraint may be impossible to meet; the solver reports “infeasible” and the control output is undefined — a common root cause of real-robot incidents. So keep input constraints (physical saturation) hard, add slack εi to state constraints to make them soft constraints (they may be violated, at a steep price), and if the solver fails or times out, shift the previous solution by one step or hand over to a backup controller.

      The penalty needs a linear term ρ1∑εi. Why? With a squared penalty alone, a tiny violation costs next to nothing (overshoot by 0.001 and the square is a millionth), so the optimizer will happily graze past the limit to save a little torque or arrive a little sooner, even when it needn’t. The linear term charges the very first sliver of violation at slope ρ1; once ρ1 exceeds whatever the violation would buy (strictly, the Lagrange multiplier of that constraint in the hard-constrained problem), the solution is exactly the hard-constrained one whenever the constraint can be met. This is called an exact penalty. The experiment below uses only the squared term, for simplicity.

    6. ＋ 模型外的恒定扰动+ An unmodeled constant disturbance

      xk+1=Axk+B(uk+dk)dk+1=dk

      标准 MPC 没有积分作用：模型增益有偏、或有模型外的恒定负载时，它会像纯 P 控制一样留下稳态误差。把扰动当作一个不变的状态加进模型，用观测器估出来、在优化里补掉，就是无偏移 MPC（估出模型外的恒定扰动并补掉，消除稳态误差），相当于 MPC 版的积分作用。

      Standard MPC has no integral action: with a biased model gain or an unmodeled constant load it leaves a steady-state error, just like pure P control. Add the disturbance to the model as a state that never changes, estimate it with an observer and cancel it inside the optimization, and you have offset-free MPC (estimate the unmodeled constant disturbance and remove the offset) — MPC’s version of integral action.

    7. ＋ 计算时间+ Computation time

      tsolve<T

      每个周期都必须在截止时间前给出解。量级上，十来个状态、10–30 步的线性 MPC，在 PC 上用 QP 求解器（专门解第 ① 步那种二次规划的程序）是亚毫秒级；非线性 MPC 用实时迭代（每周期只迭代一次）在毫秒级。

      足式机器人在简化模型上跑 MPC，数十到数百 Hz，下面再由 0.5–1 kHz 的全身控制（02 节：把整机要的力分到各个关节）和关节环执行。热启动（用上一步的解当这一步优化的起点）、限定迭代次数，让耗时可预测。

      Every cycle needs a solution before its deadline. As rough magnitudes, a linear MPC with a dozen states and a 10–30 step horizon solves in under a millisecond on a PC with a QP solver (dedicated software for quadratic programs like the one in step 1), while nonlinear MPC with real-time iteration (one iteration per cycle) takes milliseconds.

      Legged robots run MPC on a simplified model at tens to hundreds of hertz, with whole-body control (section 02: splitting the force the whole machine needs among its joints) and joint loops at 0.5–1 kHz underneath. Warm starts (starting each solve from the previous solution) and a capped iteration count keep the timing predictable.

    工程实例From the field

    MIT Cheetah 3 与 Mini Cheetah：用凸 MPC 规划地面反力MIT Cheetah 3 and Mini Cheetah: planning ground reaction forces with convex MPC

    系统　力矩控制的四足机器人 Cheetah 3，以及约 0.3 m 高、9 kg 的 Mini Cheetah。

    System　Cheetah 3, a torque-controlled quadruped, and Mini Cheetah, about 0.3 m tall and 9 kg.

    问题　机身怎么动，只能通过脚底的接触力间接控制，而接触力受约束：只能推不能拉，要落在摩擦锥里，只有着地的脚能出力。这正是正文说的“接触约束加预见”。

    Problem　The body can only be steered through foot contact forces, and those are constrained: they push but never pull, must stay inside the friction cone, and only feet on the ground can supply them — exactly the “contact constraints plus preview” of the main text.

    怎么做　把机器人简化成一个单刚体（忽略腿的质量），在这个模型上把“未来一段时间里每只脚该出多大的地面反力”写成凸优化（二次规划），约束就是单边接触和摩擦锥；和正文一样，只执行第一步，以 20–30 Hz 反复重解。求出的地面反力交给下层，换算成关节力矩，由力矩控制的关节执行。

    Approach　Simplify the robot to a single rigid body (leg mass neglected) and pose “how hard should each foot push over the coming stretch” as a convex optimization — a quadratic program whose constraints are unilateral contact and the friction cone. As in the main text, only the first move is applied, and the problem is re-solved at 20–30 Hz. The resulting ground reaction forces go down a level, are mapped to joint torques, and are executed by torque-controlled joints.

    学到什么　同一组增益和权重覆盖了站立、小跑、跳跃到三维疾驰的全部步态，靠的是约束随接触状态自动改变，而不是为每种步态手调控制器：在线优化的算力花在了约束和预见上。能实时跑起来的关键是“简化模型加凸化”：用模型精度换来可靠的亚毫秒级求解，剩下的模型误差交给每个周期的重新测量去纠正（MPC 本身是反馈）。接口是“力”：MPC 输出地面反力，底层按力矩执行，这要求执行器力矩可控、可背驱——也就是 05 节第一个工程实例里的本体感知执行器。

    Lesson　One set of gains and weights covers every gait from standing and trotting to bounding and a full 3D gallop, because the constraints change automatically with the contact state instead of a controller being hand-tuned per gait: the online computation is spent on constraints and preview. Real-time feasibility comes from “simplified model plus convexity”: trade model fidelity for reliable sub-millisecond solves, and let the fresh measurement at every cycle correct the leftover model error (MPC is a feedback law). The interface is force: MPC outputs ground reaction forces and the lower level executes them as torques, which demands torque-controllable, backdrivable actuators — the proprioceptive actuators of the first case study in section 05.

    预测时域Prediction horizon
    最长 0.5 sup to 0.5 s
    求解时间Solve time
    < 1 ms，运行在 20–30 Hz< 1 ms, run at 20–30 Hz

    ILC：向后看上一次ILC: look back at the last trial

    很多任务一模一样地重复：同一条焊缝、同一个抬臂动作、步态里的每一步。反馈每次都要等误差出现才动，同样的误差每次都重来。ILC 把上一次的整段误差存下来，在下一次开始之前改好前馈。每一次完整的重复叫一个批次（文献里也叫一次迭代或 trial）。

    Many tasks repeat exactly: the same weld seam, the same arm raise, every step of a gait. Feedback has to wait for the error each time, so the same error comes back each time. ILC stores the whole error record from the last repetition and fixes the feedforward before the next one starts. Each full repetition is called a trial (the ILC literature also says iteration or pass).

    1. 理想模型：逐个时刻修正Ideal model: correct every sample

      uj+1=Qu˜ju˜j(k)=uj(k)+Lej(k+1)ej(k)=yd(k)−yj(k)k=0,…,Nb−1

      j 是批次号，k 是批内时刻，Nb 是一批的采样点数。学习律（怎样用这一批的误差修改下一批的输入）对每个时刻分别更新：ej 是整条时间序列，不是一个“累计误差”标量，RMS 这类标量只用来判断学得好不好。先按学习增益 L 把误差加进上一批的输入，再过一道Q 滤波（只让可信频段参与学习的低通滤波）。用 ej(k+1)，是因为这一步的输入要到下一步才影响输出。

      j indexes trials, k the samples within a trial, and Nb is the trial length. The learning law (how this trial’s error updates the next trial’s input) works sample by sample: ej is a whole time series, not a single accumulated number — scalars such as the RMS only tell you whether learning is working. The error is added to last trial’s input through the learning gain L, and the result passes through a Q-filter (a low-pass that lets only trustworthy frequencies learn). The law uses ej(k+1) because an input at step k first shows up in the output one step later.

    2. ＋ 批内的非重复扰动+ Non-repeating disturbances within a trial

      u(k)=uj(k)+uC(k)

      uj 在这一批开始之前就定好了，批内新来的扰动它完全看不见。所以 ILC 通常和一个并联的反馈控制器 C 一起用（对象本身不稳定时则必须有）：任何能镇定对象的控制器都行，比如 PID 或状态反馈，不必是预测控制器。存储器存下本批的误差和前馈，留给下一批用（见上图）。

      uj is fixed before the trial starts, so it is blind to any new disturbance that arrives during the trial. ILC therefore usually runs alongside a parallel feedback controller C — and must, if the plant is unstable: any controller that stabilizes the plant will do — PID or state feedback — and it need not be predictive.
