The memory keeps this trial’s error and feedforward for the next one (see the figure).

    3. ＋ 收敛是有条件的+ Convergence comes with conditions

      ej+1(ω)≈λ(ω)ej(ω)|λ(ω)|<1∀ω

      学习律不是随便选的。每一批的误差，大致等于上一批的误差乘上同一个“放大系数” λ（整批写成矩阵时，它是一个矩阵）。把误差按频率拆开看，只要这个系数在每个频率上的大小都小于 1，误差就会一批比一批小。

      为什么高频最危险？对象有滞后，高频误差的修正量等到真正起作用时，相位已经错开，可能反而把误差推大，这些频率上的 |λ| 就大于 1。最常见的坑是只检查了一个更宽松的条件。以最简单的 P 型学习律为例，教科书上“理论上收敛”的条件只看一个数：把整批写成矩阵以后，误差传递矩阵的对角元。它只取决于学习增益和“这一步的输入对下一步输出的直接影响”这一项。只要它的绝对值小于 1，就能保证批数趋于无穷时误差最终回到零，但并不保证每一批都在变好；途中误差可以先放大好几个数量级，这叫学习瞬态（见深入一层）。上面“每个频率都小于 1”的条件更严，满足了就能保证每一批都不比上一批差（这是充分条件；批次足够长时也接近必要）。Q 滤波把高频（模型最不准、最容易被放大的部分）挡在学习之外，代价是 Q 截止频率以上的误差学不掉。

      The learning law can’t be chosen at random. Each trial’s error is roughly the previous trial’s error multiplied by the same “gain” λ (for a whole trial written as one matrix equation, it is a matrix). Split the error into frequencies: as long as this factor has magnitude below 1 at every frequency, the error shrinks from one trial to the next.

      Why are high frequencies the danger? The plant lags, so by the time a correction to a high-frequency error takes effect its phase has slipped, and it may push the error up instead — at those frequencies |λ| exceeds 1. The most common trap is to check only a looser condition. For the simplest, P-type learning law, the textbook condition for convergence “in theory” looks at a single number: the diagonal entry of the error-propagation matrix once the whole trial is written as a matrix, which depends only on the learning gain and on the direct effect of this step’s input on the next output. As long as its magnitude is below 1, the error is guaranteed to return to zero eventually, as the number of trials goes to infinity; nothing guarantees that every trial improves. Along the way the error can grow by several orders of magnitude: a learning transient (see Going deeper). The per-frequency condition above is stricter, and when it holds, every trial is guaranteed to be no worse than the last (a sufficient condition, and close to necessary for long trials). The Q-filter keeps high frequencies — where the model is least accurate and amplification most likely — out of the learning, at a price: error above the Q cutoff can’t be learned.

    4. ＋ 非重复噪声+ Non-repeating noise

      ej+1=(1−γ)ej+wj−wj+1σ∞2=22−γσ2,0<γ<2

      ILC 只能学可重复的部分，不重复的反而会放大。在理想逆模型 L=γG−1、Q=I、批次间独立白噪声 wj（方差 σ2）这组简化假设下，上一批的噪声被学进了这一批的前馈，这一批自己又来一份，于是误差随机部分的稳态方差是 2σ2/(2−γ)：γ=1 时是不学习时的 2 倍。学得越快，噪声放大越多。

      这个数可以慢慢推出来。先看 γ=1：每一批都按逆模型把上一批的误差整个补回前馈，连上一批的噪声也当成误差补了进去，于是它原封不动地搬过来一份，这一批自己又来一份，两份独立的噪声相加，方差是 2σ2。γ 小于 1 时，每批只补一部分，但会一批一批地累积：上一批的噪声在这一批里留下幅度为 γ 的残影，再上一批留下 γ(1−γ)，依此类推。把这些残影的方差按等比数列加起来是 σ2·γ/(2−γ)，再加上本批自己的 σ2，就是 2σ2/(2−γ)；γ 越小，越接近不学习时的 σ2。

      注意：下面实验的学习律直接乘误差（uj+1(k)=uj(k)+γej(k+δ)），不是公式里的“γ 乘逆模型”。所以实验的 γ 和这里的 γ 不是同一个量，γ = 2 也不是实验的发散边界。

      ILC can only learn what repeats; what doesn’t repeat gets amplified. Under a simplified set of assumptions — an exact inverse model L=γG−1, Q=I, and white noise wj of variance σ2, independent from trial to trial — last trial’s noise gets learned into this trial’s feedforward, and this trial adds its own. The random part of the error settles at a variance of 2σ2/(2−γ): twice the no-learning value at γ=1. The faster you learn, the more noise you amplify.

      You can derive that number slowly. Start with γ=1: every trial uses the inverse model to cancel the whole of the previous trial’s error in the feedforward — noise included, since it looked like error — so that noise is carried over intact and this trial adds its own; two independent noises add up to a variance of 2σ2. With γ below 1 each trial cancels only part of the error, but the corrections pile up: the last trial’s noise leaves a trace of amplitude γ in this one, the trial before that γ(1−γ), and so on. Summing the variances of these traces as a geometric series gives σ2·γ/(2−γ); add this trial’s own σ2 and you get 2σ2/(2−γ). The smaller γ, the closer it stays to the no-learning value σ2.

      Note that the experiment below multiplies the raw error (uj+1(k)=uj(k)+γej(k+δ)), not “γ times the inverse model” as in the formula. So its γ is not the same quantity as the one here, and γ = 2 is not where the experiment diverges.

    5. 它的特权：可以非因果Its privilege: it may be non-causal

      uj+1=Qzpu˜ju˜j(k)=uj(k)+γej(k+δ)

      有了上一批的完整记录，计算第 k 个时刻的修正时，可以用更晚时刻的误差 ej(k+δ) 来抵消对象的滞后，还可以先正向、再反向滤一遍，做零相位滤波，不引入相位滞后；Qzp 就是这样一个 Q 滤波。这种非因果（计算某一时刻时用到更晚时刻的数据——批次之间可以，实时反馈不行）的处理，是 ILC 相对实时反馈的独特优势。

      With the previous trial fully recorded, the correction at sample k can use the later error ej(k+δ) to cancel the plant’s lag, and the filter can run forward and then backward — zero-phase filtering, which adds no phase lag; Qzp is such a Q-filter. This non-causal processing (using samples from later times — fine between trials, impossible in real-time feedback) is ILC’s unique advantage over real-time feedback.

    深入一层Going deeper P 型 ILC 理论上收敛，为什么实际会先放大到失控？If P-type ILC converges in theory, why does it blow up first?

    前置知识 矩阵乘法和特征值（三角矩阵的特征值就是它的对角元）；频率响应。“2-范数”可以理解成“这个矩阵最多能把一个向量放大几倍”。

    Background. Matrix multiplication and eigenvalues (a triangular matrix’s eigenvalues are its diagonal entries); frequency response. Read “2-norm” as “the most this matrix can stretch any vector”.

    思路　把一整批写成矩阵：yj=Guj+d。G 是对象脉冲响应的采样值（Markov 参数 g1,g2,…）排成的下三角 Toeplitz 矩阵，g1 是“这一步的输入对下一步输出的直接影响”，d 是可重复的扰动。P 型律 uj+1=uj+γej（不加 Q）让误差每批乘上同一个矩阵：

    Idea　Stack a whole trial into one matrix equation, yj=Guj+d. G is the lower-triangular Toeplitz matrix built from samples of the plant’s impulse response (the Markov parameters g1,g2,…), where g1 is the direct effect of this step’s input on the next output, and d is the repeatable disturbance. The P-type law uj+1=uj+γej (no Q) multiplies the error by the same matrix every trial:

    ej+1=(I−γG)ej‖I−γG‖2≈maxω|1−γeiωG(eiω)|

    I−γG 是下三角矩阵，特征值全都等于对角元 1−γg1，所以渐近收敛只看 g1：|1−γg1|<1。可这个矩阵高度“非正规”：对角线下方的元素远大于对角元，乘很多次之前，范数可以一路增长。决定“每一批最多放大多少”的是它的 2-范数；批次足够长时，2-范数趋近第二行的频域量（对因果的 G 它是上界）。它小于 1，才保证每一批都不比上一批差，即单调收敛，这就是 Bristow 等（2006）的频域条件。

    I−γG is lower triangular, so every eigenvalue equals the diagonal entry 1−γg1, and asymptotic convergence depends on g1 alone: |1−γg1|<1. But the matrix is highly non-normal — the entries below the diagonal dwarf the diagonal — so its norm can keep growing for a long time before the eigenvalue wins. What bounds the growth per trial is the 2-norm, which for long trials approaches the frequency-domain quantity in the second line (an upper bound for causal G). Only when that is below 1 is every trial guaranteed to be no worse than the last — monotonic convergence, the frequency-domain condition of Bristow et al. (2006).

    本实验的数　g1 ≈ 1.7 × 10−4，γ = 0.5，特征值 1−γg1 ≈ 0.99991，理论上收敛；可第二行的最大值约 1.19，超过 1 的频段从约 1 Hz 开始，每批最多放大 19%。按本实验的模型做无噪声的批次矩阵计算：第 41 批误差 RMS 约 10 rad（正是实验被停算的那一批），第 100 批约 104 rad，第 1000 批约 1017 rad；粗略估计要到几百万批以后才会回落。“渐近收敛”在任何物理意义上都等于发散，Longman（2000）专门讨论过这种学习瞬态。所以设计时要用单调收敛的条件，不要只看谱半径；Q 滤波的作用，就是把 |1−γeiωG|>1 的频段挡在学习之外。

    This experiment’s numbers　g1 ≈ 1.7 × 10−4 and γ = 0.5, so the eigenvalue 1−γg1 ≈ 0.99991 and convergence is guaranteed in theory. Yet the maximum in the second line is about 1.19, exceeded from roughly 1 Hz upward: up to 19% growth per trial. A noise-free lifted computation with this experiment’s model gives an RMS error of about 10 rad at trial 41 (exactly where the experiment stops the run), about 104 rad at trial 100 and about 1017 rad at trial 1000; a rough estimate puts the turnaround several million trials out. In any physical sense, “converges asymptotically” here means “diverges”; Longman (2000) discusses this learning transient in depth. Design with a monotonic-convergence condition, not the spectral radius — and that is the Q-filter’s job: to keep the band where |1−γeiωG|>1 out of the learning.

    自己验证Check it yourself

    • 超前调到 1、关掉 Q 滤波：误差先降几批，第 41 批超过 10 rad 被停算。
    • Set the lead to 1 and switch off the Q-filter: the error falls for a few trials, then passes 10 rad and the run stops at trial 41.
    • 保持超前 1，打开 Q（截止 5 Hz）：不再被停算，但误差从约 0.09 rad 慢慢涨到约 0.6 rad。坏频段从 1 Hz 就开始，5 Hz 的 Q 挡不住。怎样用超前把坏频段推高，见 ILC 实验后面的“深入一层”。
    • Keep the lead at 1 and switch the Q-filter back on (5 Hz cutoff): the run no longer stops, but the error creeps from about 0.09 rad up to about 0.6 rad. The bad band starts at 1 Hz, below a 5 Hz cutoff. How lead pushes the bad band upward is in the “Going deeper” after the ILC experiment.

    外骨骼视角按步态相位或肩上举角索引做 ILC，可以学掉气动执行器可重复的充气滞后：用非因果的超前提前开阀，这是单靠反馈做不到的，因为反馈带宽被充放气动态卡死了。但阀已经全开时，ILC 只能把开阀时刻往前挪，学不出更快的上升沿，所以要把学习结果投影到饱和限内。人也在学：把 ILC 限定在设备侧的压力 / 力矩跟踪上，人的运动学只用作索引，别让两个学习回路互相追逐。

    Exoskeleton lensIndexed by gait phase or shoulder elevation angle, ILC can learn away the repeatable inflation lag of a pneumatic actuator by opening the valve early through non-causal lead — something feedback alone can’t do, because its bandwidth is pinned by the fill-and-vent dynamics. Once the valve is already wide open, though, ILC can only move the opening earlier; it can’t learn a faster rise, so the learned command must be projected back inside the saturation limits. And the person is learning too: keep ILC on the device side, tracking pressure or torque, and use the person’s kinematics only as an index, so the two learners don’t end up chasing each other.

    反过来想Flip it around

    不向前看：约束只能在执行时削顶，等发现快撞限位时已经刹不住。不向后看：重复任务里，同样的误差每一次都重来。

    MPC 的边界：性能只和模型一样好；每个周期都必须按时给出解；约束很少激活时不值得。ILC 的边界：任务不重复、每批初始状态不同、批次长度不一致时学不到东西，还会放大噪声；执行器已经饱和（阀已全开）时，学不出更快的响应。

    两者都离不开模型：MPC 每一步在线用它做预测，ILC 在设计学习律、判断收敛时用它（图里的 G）。

    卡在哪里：MPC 的预测只和写得出的模型一样准；ILC 只对同一条轨迹有效，换一个动作就要重学（工业上的折中，是不学整段信号，改学前馈里少数几个参数，比如与轨迹加速度成正比的系数；学到的参数对一类轨迹都适用，见深入一层）。摩擦、迟滞这类写不出公式的残差，两者都没有真正“学到”。

    Without looking ahead, constraints can only be clipped at execution time, and by the time the controller sees the stop coming it can no longer brake. Without looking back, a repeated task repeats the same error every time.

    MPC’s limits: it is only as good as its model, it has to deliver a solution every cycle on time, and when constraints rarely become active the online optimization buys you little. ILC’s limits: it learns nothing — and amplifies noise — when the task doesn’t repeat, the initial state differs between trials, or trial lengths vary; and once the actuator saturates (valve wide open), it can’t learn a faster response.

    Neither escapes the model: MPC uses it online to predict at every step, and ILC uses it to design the learning law and check convergence (the G in the figure).

    Where it gets stuck: MPC’s predictions are only as accurate as a model you can write down, and ILC only works for the one trajectory it practiced — a new motion means learning from scratch. (Industry’s compromise is to learn not the whole signal but a few parameters of the feedforward, such as a coefficient proportional to the trajectory’s acceleration; the learned parameters then hold for a whole class of trajectories — see Going deeper.) Neither really learns residuals that have no formula, such as friction and hysteresis.

    深入一层Going deeper ILC 换一条轨迹就要重学，工程上怎么绕开？ILC must relearn for every new trajectory — how do engineers get around that?

    前置知识 01、02 节的前馈；最小二乘；离散传递函数的零点（单位圆外的零点一求逆就不稳定）。

    Background. Feedforward from sections 01 and 02; least squares; zeros of a discrete-time transfer function (inverting a zero outside the unit circle gives an unstable inverse).

    思路　逐点 ILC 学的是一整段信号 u(k)，几百到几千个数，只对应一条参考轨迹。换个对象来学：不学信号，学“生成信号的前馈控制器”里的少数几个参数。

    Idea　Sample-by-sample ILC learns a whole signal u(k) — hundreds to thousands of numbers tied to one reference. Learn something else instead: not the signal, but a handful of parameters in the feedforward controller that generates it.

    uff(k)=θ1r˙(k)+θ2r¨(k)+θ3r(3)(k)+⋯

    ① 固定结构前馈加批次调参　前馈写成参考轨迹各阶导数的线性组合（系数的物理意义是粘滞摩擦、质量……），每做一批，就用实测误差把 θ 更新一次。因为是线性参数化，这是一个误差平方最小的凸问题，不需要精确的对象模型；学到的 θ 对一类运动轨迹都适用（van der Meulen 等 2008，用在晶圆台和桌面打印机上）。Blanken 等（2017）讨论的是有理形式的参数化（同样面向不重复的运动任务），并把此前“迭代学习”和“系统辨识”两类批次调参做法统一到一个框架里。

    1. Fixed-structure feedforward tuned batch to batch　Write the feedforward as a linear combination of the reference’s derivatives (the coefficients act like viscous friction, mass, …) and update θ from the measured error after every trial. Because the parameterization is linear, this is a convex least-squares problem that needs no detailed plant model, and the tuned θ works for a whole class of motion profiles (van der Meulen et al. 2008, on a wafer stage and a desktop printer). Blanken et al. (2017) treat rational parameterizations (again aimed at non-repeating motion tasks) and unify the earlier iterative-learning and identification approaches to batch-to-batch tuning in one framework.

    ② 稳定逆　最理想的学习律是对象的逆，但单位圆外的零点不能直接求逆，否则逆本身不稳定。ZPETC（Tomizuka 1987）抵消能抵消的极点和零点，对抵消不了的零点只抵消它造成的相移，让期望输出到实际输出在所有频率上零相位。它要用到“未来”的参考，这对批次之间计算的 ILC 恰好不是问题。

    2. Stable inversion　The ideal learning law is the plant inverse, but zeros outside the unit circle can’t be inverted without an unstable inverse. ZPETC (Tomizuka 1987) cancels the poles and zeros it can and, for the zeros it can’t, cancels only their phase shift, so the map from desired to actual output has zero phase at every frequency. It needs the future of the reference — no obstacle for ILC, which computes between trials.

    ③ 没有复位的周期运动　改用重复控制（Hara 等 1988）：在反馈环里放一个周期信号的内模，离散形式是 1/(1−z−Np)（Np 是一个周期的采样点数），相当于把“上一周期”的记忆直接接进实时反馈。它的稳定条件和 ILC 很不一样，但 Longman（2000）指出，两者在工程上要满足的是同一个“学习瞬态要好”的设计准则。

    3. Periodic motion with no reset　Use repetitive control (Hara et al. 1988): put an internal model of a periodic signal inside the feedback loop, 1/(1−z−Np) in discrete time (Np samples per period), which wires the memory of the last period straight into real-time feedback. Its stability conditions differ sharply from ILC’s, yet Longman (2000) argues that in practice both must meet the same good-transient design criterion.

    想一想Think it through

    • ILC 实验只有一条轨迹，看不到这个问题。设想把学到的 uj 用在一段快一倍的“抬起—放下”上：每个时刻对应的误差都变了，整段信号作废；而“质量 × 加速度”这样的前馈参数，对新轨迹照样成立。02 节的计算力矩前馈就是一个固定结构前馈，批次调参只是用实测误差去调它的参数。
    • The ILC experiment has a single trajectory, so this problem never shows. Imagine reusing the learned uj on a raise-and-lower twice as fast: the error at every instant changes and the whole signal is useless, whereas a feedforward parameter such as “mass × acceleration” still holds. Section 02’s computed-torque feedforward is a fixed-structure feedforward; batch-to-batch tuning simply sets its parameters from measured error.

    文中其他出处Other sources cited　Hara, S., Yamamoto, Y., Omata, T., & Nakano, M. (1988). Repetitive control system: A new type servo system for periodic exogenous signals. IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control, 33(7), 659–668. doi:10.1109/9.1274

    预测—优化—只执行第一步—滚动，这个循环在场景里看得见。场景是俯视图：一根摆臂要从 0 转到 1 rad，目标后面 0.05 rad 就是机械挡块，力矩最多 4 N·m；每一步臂尖前方都会画出一串预测点，末端还有一只虚影臂标出预测终点，但只执行第一步（播放速度可调；想一个阶段一个阶段地看，点“单步讲解”）。先只把预测时域缩到 2–4 步，先猜：只看 0.15 s（3 步），它还来得及在挡块前刹住吗？The predict–optimize–apply-one-move–roll loop is visible in the scene, drawn from above. An arm must swing from 0 to 1 rad; a mechanical stop sits 0.05 rad past the target, and torque is capped at 4 N·m. At every step a string of predicted points is drawn ahead of the tip, with a ghost arm marking the end of the prediction, yet only the first move is applied (the playback speed is adjustable; to go one phase at a time, click “Step through”). Shorten only the horizon at first, to 2–4 steps. Predict: looking just 0.15 s (3 steps) ahead, can it still brake before the stop?

    你应该看到：默认 N = 10 不越过挡块。N 缩到 2–3 步，臂冲过限位约 0.18 rad；关掉约束感知，冲过约 0.22 rad，而且这时把 N 从 10 改到 40，越界量完全不变：没有约束时，带终端代价 P 的 MPC 不管 N 多长，第一步都和 LQR 一样。终端代价 P 来自无约束 LQR，它不知道力矩上限：时域短于刹车过程时，有终端代价也会冲过限位（N = 2 时约 0.18 rad，去掉终端代价约 0.42 rad）。要真正保证，需要终端约束，或把时域拉长到覆盖刹车过程（本例最高约 2.75 rad/s，按 8 rad/s² 刹车约需 0.34 s，即 7 步；N ≥ 7 时越界量为零）。加上恒定扰动，标准 MPC 留下约 0.05 rad 的稳态误差，加扰动估计后归零。What you should see: at the default N = 10 the arm never crosses the stop. At N = 2–3 it overshoots the stop by about 0.18 rad; with constraint awareness off, by about 0.22 rad — and then changing N from 10 to 40 makes no difference at all: without constraints, an MPC with the terminal cost P takes the same first step as LQR, whatever the horizon. The terminal cost P comes from unconstrained LQR and knows nothing about the torque limit, so with a horizon shorter than the braking, the arm still overshoots even with the terminal cost (about 0.18 rad at N = 2, versus 0.42 rad without it). A real guarantee needs a terminal constraint, or a horizon long enough to cover the braking (here the arm peaks at about 2.75 rad/s, and braking at 8 rad/s² takes about 0.34 s, or 7 steps; from N = 7 up the overshoot is zero). With a constant disturbance, standard MPC leaves about 0.05 rad of steady-state error, and the disturbance estimate removes it.

    深入一层Going deeper 预测时域 N 到底在买什么？What does the horizon N actually buy?

    前置知识 01 节的 LQR 与 Riccati 方程。“动态规划”只用到一个想法：从最后一步往回，一步一步地算“从这里走到底还要花多少代价”。

    Background. LQR and the Riccati equation from section 01. “Dynamic programming” here needs only one idea: work backward from the last step, computing at each step “how much it will still cost to finish from here”.

    ① 没有约束时，N 什么也没买　终端代价 xTPx 里的 P 是 Riccati 方程的解，它恰好等于“从 x 出发、按 LQR 一直走下去的总代价”。按动态规划，把最后一步换成 xTPx 以后，每往前递推一步，代价函数都还是 xTPx，因为 P 正是下式的不动点：

    1. Without constraints, N buys nothing　The P in the terminal cost xTPx solves the Riccati equation, which makes it exactly the total cost of running LQR forever from x. By dynamic programming, once the last stage is priced at xTPx, every backward step returns the same cost-to-go, because P is a fixed point of

    P=Q+ATPA−ATPB(R+BTPB)−1BTPA

    所以任何 N 的有限时域问题都等于无限时域问题，第一步都是 u=−KLQRx。

    So the finite-horizon problem equals the infinite-horizon one for every N, and the first move is always u=−KLQRx.

    ② 有约束时，N 买的是“看得见刹车”　P 来自无约束 LQR，它默认可以用任意大的力矩刹车，对刹车距离过于乐观。所以预测窗口必须覆盖从“必须开始刹车”到“停下”的整段：本例最高速度约 2.75 rad/s，amax=umax/J = 8 rad/s²，刹车时间 vmax/amax ≈ 0.34 s，约 7 步。

    2. With constraints, N buys seeing the braking　P comes from unconstrained LQR, which assumes it can brake with any torque it likes, so it is optimistic about stopping distance. The window therefore has to cover the whole stretch from “must start braking” to “stopped”: here the peak speed is about 2.75 rad/s and amax=umax/J = 8 rad/s², so braking takes vmax/amax ≈ 0.34 s, about 7 steps.

    ③ 想要不依赖 N 的保证　在预测末端加终端约束 xN∈𝒳f：𝒳f 是一个“在里面用 LQR 不会碰到约束、而且会一直留在里面”的状态集合。名义模型下，这保证每一步都有解（递归可行）且闭环渐近稳定（Mayne 等 2000）。它不是免费的：N 太短时，从起点在 N 步内根本进不了 𝒳f，问题直接无解，能用的初始状态范围随 N 缩小。有有界扰动或模型误差时，还要把约束收紧，让真实状态始终待在名义轨迹周围的一根“管子”里（tube MPC，Mayne、Seron 与 Raković 2005）。

    3. For a guarantee that doesn’t hinge on N　Add a terminal constraint xN∈𝒳f, where 𝒳f is a set in which LQR never hits a constraint and from which it never leaves. For the nominal model this guarantees a solution at every step (recursive feasibility) and asymptotic stability (Mayne et al. 2000). It isn’t free: with a short horizon the initial state may not be able to reach 𝒳f within N steps at all, the problem is infeasible, and the set of usable initial states shrinks with N. With bounded disturbances or model error you also tighten the constraints so the true state stays inside a “tube” around the nominal trajectory (tube MPC; Mayne, Seron and Raković 2005).

    自己验证Check it yourself

    • 关掉“约束感知”：N = 2、10、40 的越界量都是 0.223 rad，一模一样。
    • Switch off constraint awareness: the overshoot past the stop is 0.223 rad at N = 2, 10 and 40 alike.
    • 打开约束感知：越界量在 N = 2–3 时约 0.18 rad，4 时 0.097，5 时 0.041，6 时 0.006，7 及以上为 0——正好在 N·T 超过刹车时间 0.34 s 时归零。
    • Switch it back on: the overshoot is about 0.18 rad at N = 2–3, 0.097 at 4, 0.041 at 5, 0.006 at 6 and zero from 7 up — vanishing just as N·T passes the 0.34 s braking time.
    • 再去掉终端代价（“更多参数”里的复选框）：N = 2 时越界约 0.42 rad，N = 6 时约 0.042 rad。终端代价能帮一点，但替代不了“看见刹车”。
    • Now untick the terminal cost as well (under More parameters): about 0.42 rad at N = 2 and 0.042 rad at N = 6. A terminal cost helps a little, but it is no substitute for seeing the braking.

    文中其他出处Other sources cited　Mayne, D. Q., Seron, M. M., & Raković, S. V. (2005). Robust model predictive control of constrained linear systems with bounded disturbances. Automatica, 41(2), 219–224. doi:10.1016/j.automatica.2004.08.019

    第 ③ 步说学习律要满足收敛条件，第 ④ 步说它会把非重复噪声也学进来。场景里一根由气囊抬起的摆臂，一批一批重复同一个“抬起—保持—放下”，执行器有 80 ms 的充气式滞后；第 0 批留成灰色淡影，之后彩色的这一批一次比一次贴近目标。先只按播放，再调学习增益 γ，先猜：学习增益越大，最后的误差就越小吗？Step 3 says the learning law must meet a convergence condition; step 4 says it also learns non-repeating noise. In the scene an arm lifted by an inflatable bladder repeats the same raise–hold–lower motion trial after trial, through an actuator with an 80 ms inflation-like lag; trial 0 lingers as a faint gray ghost, and the colored current trial hugs the target more closely each time. Press Play first, then change the learning gain γ. Predict: does a larger learning gain always give a smaller final error?

    你应该看到：默认设置下，误差在十来批内降到约 0.012 rad，之后停在约 0.015 rad 的平台；剩下的主要是 Q 截止频率以上学不掉的误差（第 ③ 步），非重复噪声再添一点。把“更多参数”里的非重复噪声加到 0.02，γ = 2 的平台（约 0.038 rad）比 γ = 0.3（约 0.028 rad）更高：学得越快，学进前馈的噪声越多（γ 太小又学不完，最好的值在中间）。在本实验里，γ = 2 恰好让直流（频率为零的）成分处于临界，所以学得慢、来回摆，但不会发散。再把超前调到 1 步（只看下一个采样的误差，即最简单的 P 型律）、关掉 Q 滤波：误差先降几批，然后一路涨过 10 rad，四十来批后被停算。为什么说它“理论上仍会收敛”？数学上的“渐近收敛”只保证批数趋于无穷时误差最终回到零，不管中途涨到多高。按本实验的模型算，第 100 批约 104 rad，第 1000 批约 1017 rad，要到几百万批以后才会回落（条件见深入一层）：数学上叫收敛，工程上和发散没有区别。这正是 Q 滤波存在的理由：“渐近收敛”不等于“越学越好”，工程上要的是每一批都不比上一批差。What you should see: by default the error drops to about 0.012 rad within ten or so trials, then settles on a plateau near 0.015 rad; what remains is mostly the error above the Q cutoff, which can’t be learned (step 3), plus a little non-repeating noise. Raise the non-repeating noise (under More parameters) to 0.02 and γ = 2 plateaus higher (about 0.038 rad) than γ = 0.3 (about 0.028 rad): the faster you learn, the more noise goes into the feedforward (too small a gain never finishes learning, so the best value lies in between). Here γ = 2 happens to put the DC (zero-frequency) component exactly at the margin, so learning is slow and oscillatory but does not diverge. Now set the lead to 1 sample (looking only at the next sample’s error: the simplest P-type law) and switch off the Q-filter. The error falls for a few trials, then climbs past 10 rad, and the run is stopped after forty-odd trials. Why call that “converging in theory”? Asymptotic convergence, in the mathematical sense, only promises that the error returns to zero eventually, as the number of trials goes to infinity — however high it climbs on the way. With this experiment’s model the error is about 104 rad at trial 100 and 1017 rad at trial 1000, and it turns around only after several million trials (conditions in Going deeper): convergent to a mathematician, indistinguishable from divergence to an engineer. That is exactly why the Q-filter exists: “converges asymptotically” does not mean “improves every trial”, and improving every trial — or at least never getting worse — is what engineering needs.

    深入一层Going deeper 学习增益 γ、超前步数 δ 和 Q 截止频率怎么选？How do you choose the learning gain γ, the lead δ and the Q cutoff?

    前置知识 频率响应的幅值和相位；纯延迟 δ 步会让频率 ω 处的相位落后 ωδ（00 节讲延迟时用过）。

    Background. Magnitude and phase of a frequency response; a pure delay of δ samples lags the phase at frequency ω by ωδ (used for delays in section 00).

    思路　三个旋钮都围着同一个量转：逐频率的收缩率。它小于 1 的频段才学得动：

    Idea　All three knobs revolve around one quantity, the contraction factor at each frequency. Learning only works in the band where it is below 1:

    |1−γeiωδG(eiω)|<1

    ① 超前 δ　它把 G 的相位往回拉 ωδ；上式成立的必要条件是补偿后的相位落在 ±90° 以内。本实验的对象是 80 ms 的执行器滞后加一个 1.5 Hz、ζ = 0.7 的二阶环节，低频的等效延迟约 0.23 s（0.08 s 加上 2ζ/ωn ≈ 0.15 s，约 23 步）。但它的相位滞后不是纯延迟，高频段增长变慢，所以 δ 并不是越接近“延迟”越好。按实验的模型算，γ = 0.5 时：δ = 1 在 1 Hz 以上就越界；δ = 11 把越界点推到约 9 Hz，而且越界量极小；δ = 21 又回落到约 4 Hz。经验做法：从对象的等效延迟或相对阶开始，再看误差频谱微调。

    1. Lead δ　It pulls the phase of G back by ωδ; a necessary condition for the inequality is that the compensated phase stays within ±90°. The plant here is an 80 ms actuator lag plus a 1.5 Hz, ζ = 0.7 second-order stage, so its low-frequency equivalent delay is about 0.23 s (0.08 s plus 2ζ/ωn ≈ 0.15 s, some 23 samples). Its phase lag is not a pure delay, though — it grows more slowly at high frequency — so matching δ to “the delay” is not the goal. Computed with the experiment’s model at γ = 0.5: δ = 1 violates the inequality above 1 Hz; δ = 11 pushes the violation out to about 9 Hz, and only by a hair; δ = 21 pulls it back to about 4 Hz. In practice, start from the plant’s equivalent delay or relative degree and refine by watching the error spectrum.

    ② Q 截止频率　放在收缩率开始接近 1 的频率以下；截止频率以上的误差学不掉，这是鲁棒性的代价。有噪声时还要再低一些，因为截止频率以内的非重复噪声也会被学进前馈。

    2. Q cutoff　Place it below the frequency where the contraction factor approaches 1; error above the cutoff can’t be learned, which is the price of robustness. With noise, go lower still, because non-repeating noise inside the cutoff gets learned into the feedforward too.

    ③ 学习增益 γ　在收敛速度和噪声放大之间折中（正文的 2/(2 − γ) 是理想逆模型下的版本）。注意本实验的 γ 乘的是误差本身，而对象的直流增益为 1，所以 γ = 2 时直流处 |1−γ|=1，正好临界：这就是 γ = 2 时即使没有噪声也学得慢、来回摆的原因。

    3. Learning gain γ　Trade convergence speed against noise amplification (the main text’s 2/(2 − γ) is the exact-inverse version). Note that this experiment’s γ multiplies the raw error and the plant’s DC gain is 1, so at γ = 2 the DC contraction factor |1−γ| equals exactly 1 — marginal. That is why γ = 2 learns slowly and rings back and forth even without noise.

    自己验证Check it yourself

    • 关掉 Q：δ = 1 在第 41 批被停算；δ = 11 稳在约 0.0085 rad；δ = 21 约 0.012 rad。
    • Q-filter off: δ = 1 is stopped at trial 41; δ = 11 settles near 0.0085 rad; δ = 21 near 0.012 rad.
    • 默认噪声下改 Q 截止频率：1 Hz → 0.118 rad，2 Hz → 0.051，5 Hz → 0.015，10 Hz → 0.009。δ = 11 时坏频段在约 9 Hz 以上，Q 可以放宽。
    • At the default noise, vary the Q cutoff: 1 Hz → 0.118 rad, 2 Hz → 0.051, 5 Hz → 0.015, 10 Hz → 0.009. With δ = 11 the bad band starts only around 9 Hz, so Q can be opened up.
    • 噪声 0.02 时改 γ：0.3 → 0.028 rad，1 → 0.023，2 → 0.038，呈 U 形：太小在 60 批内学不完，太大把噪声学进前馈。
    • At noise 0.02, vary γ: 0.3 → 0.028 rad, 1 → 0.023, 2 → 0.038 — a U-shape: too small doesn’t finish learning within 60 trials, too large learns the noise into the feedforward.

    一句话Takeaway

    MPC 用模型换来约束与预见，ILC 用重复换来精度；两者都离不开模型——MPC 每一步在线用，ILC 在设计学习律和判断收敛时用。

    MPC spends a model to buy constraint handling and foresight; ILC spends repetition to buy accuracy. Neither escapes the model: MPC uses it online at every step, ILC uses it to design the learning law and to check convergence.

    下一个问题：如果模型里剩下的那部分——摩擦、迟滞、气动执行器的压力—力矩关系——写不出干净的公式，动作又不重复呢？Next question: what if the rest of the model — friction, hysteresis, a pneumatic actuator’s pressure-to-torque map — has no clean formula, and the motion doesn’t repeat?

    延伸阅读Further reading

    1. Rawlings, J. B., Mayne, D. Q., & Diehl, M. M. (2017). Model Predictive Control: Theory, Computation, and Design (2nd ed.). Nob Hill Publishing. sites.engineering.ucsb.edu/~jbraw/mpc

      从这里开始：作者在主页上免费提供全书 PDF。稳定性、状态估计、无偏移、数值求解都在一本书里，本节 MPC 部分的每一步都能在这里找到严格版本。

      Start here: the authors post the full book as a free PDF. Stability, state estimation, offset-free control and numerical solution in one volume — every MPC step in this section has its rigorous version here.

    2. Mayne, D. Q., Rawlings, J. B., Rao, C. V., & Scokaert, P. O. M. (2000). Constrained model predictive control: Stability and optimality. Automatica, 36(6), 789–814. doi:10.1016/S0005-1098(99)00214-9

      “终端代价加终端约束集保证稳定”这套理论的经典综述，上面“深入一层”第 ③ 点的出处。

      The classic survey behind “terminal cost plus terminal set guarantees stability” — the source for point 3 of the “Going deeper” above.

    3. Pannocchia, G., & Rawlings, J. B. (2003). Disturbance models for offset-free model-predictive control. AIChE Journal, 49(2), 426–437. doi:10.1002/aic.690490213

      正文“无偏移 MPC”一步的严格版：加多少个积分型扰动才够？答案反直觉——测量量多于控制量时，按控制量个数加是不够的，按测量量个数加才够。

      The rigorous version of the offset-free step: how many integrating disturbances are enough? Counterintuitively, when there are more measurements than inputs, one per input is not enough; one per measurement is.

    4. Bristow, D. A., Tharayil, M., & Alleyne, A. G. (2006). A survey of iterative learning control. IEEE Control Systems Magazine, 26(3), 96–114. doi:10.1109/MCS.2006.1636313

      ILC 最好的入门综述：稳定性、性能、学习瞬态、鲁棒性，以及四种最常用的设计方法。本节深入一层里收敛条件的写法就来自这里。

      The best entry point to ILC: stability, performance, learning transients, robustness, and the four most popular design methods. The convergence conditions in this section’s Going deeper follow its notation.

    5. Longman, R. W. (2000). Iterative learning control and repetitive control for engineering practice. International Journal of Control, 73(10), 930–954. doi:10.1080/002071700405905 · Tomizuka, M. (1987). Zero phase error tracking algorithm for digital control. Journal of Dynamic Systems, Measurement, and Control, 109(1), 65–68. doi:10.1115/1.3143822

      前者是写给工程师的 ILC 与重复控制：只留少数几个参数可调，报告在商用机器人上 8–12 批就把高速轨迹的 RMS 误差降低 100–1000 倍，并强调“学习瞬态要好”；后者是稳定逆（ZPETC），设计 ILC 学习律时的常用工具。

      The first is ILC and repetitive control written for engineers — only a few tuning knobs, a 100- to 1000-fold drop in RMS tracking error on a commercial robot within 8–12 trials, and an insistence on good learning transients; the second is stable inversion (ZPETC), a standard tool for building learning laws.

    6. van der Meulen, S. H., Tousain, R. L., & Bosgra, O. H. (2008). Fixed structure feedforward controller design exploiting iterative trials: Application to a wafer stage and a desktop printer. Journal of Dynamic Systems, Measurement, and Control, 130(5), 051006. doi:10.1115/1.2957626 · Blanken, L., Boeren, F., Bruijnen, D., & Oomen, T. (2017). Batch-to-batch rational feedforward control: From iterative learning to identification approaches, with application to a wafer stage. IEEE/ASME Transactions on Mechatronics, 22(2), 826–837. doi:10.1109/TMECH.2016.2625309

      回答本节“卡在哪里”的工业解法：不学整段信号，改学前馈里少数几个参数，学到的结果对一类运动轨迹都适用；后者针对有理形式的参数化，把迭代学习与辨识两类调参做法统一到一个框架里。

      Industry’s answer to this section’s “where it gets stuck”: instead of learning a whole signal, learn a few feedforward parameters that then hold for a whole class of motion profiles; the second paper covers rational parameterizations and unifies the iterative-learning and identification routes to tuning them.

    07机器学习：让数据补上模型写不出的部分Machine learning: let data fill in what the equations miss

    用预测与数据Use prediction and data

    问题The question

    推一块放在桌上的木块：一开始推不动，推力到了某个值它才突然滑出去，滑起来反而省力。关节里的摩擦、迟滞、织物气动执行器的“压力—力矩”关系，都常常写不出干净的公式。能不能让数据把这一块补上，又不把整套控制交给一个黑箱？

    Push a wooden block across a table. At first it won’t budge; at some force it suddenly breaks free, and once it slides it takes less force than a moment ago. Friction in a joint, hysteresis, the pressure-to-torque map of a fabric pneumatic actuator — these rarely have clean formulas. Can data fill that gap without handing the whole controller to a black box?

    本节要点（5 分钟版）This section in brief

    • 数据最稳妥的用法是补残差：刚体部分对惯性参数是线性的，用最小二乘辨识；摩擦有参数模型；写不出公式的迟滞、柔性才交给学习。残差的标签来自机器人自己的传感器（实测力矩减模型力矩）。
    • 学到的残差优先做成前馈（按期望轨迹算，稳不稳仍由反馈回路决定），输出限幅，超出训练范围就平滑衰减到零。按实测速度补偿时（外骨骼透明模式只能这样），补过头就是负阻尼，所以摩擦经验上只补七到九成；按期望轨迹做的前馈补错了，只是一个有界扰动。
    • 神经网络的“万能逼近”只说合适的网络存在，不保证训练找得到，更不管训练范围之外；在零速的摩擦跳变处，任何连续的网络误差都至少有静摩擦峰 Fs 那么大。
    • 高斯过程给出均值和置信带，离数据越远越退回先验，“不知道”被写了出来；但核选错时置信带会过度自信，只有看得见测量值的检验（如边际似然）才发现得了。零速处跳变的摩擦，用 Matérn-1/2 核更诚实。
    • The safest use of data is to fill in the residual: rigid-body dynamics are linear in the inertial parameters, so least squares identifies them; friction has parametric models; only what has no clean formula — hysteresis, compliance — is left to learning. The residual’s labels come from the robot’s own sensors (measured torque minus model torque).
    • Put the learned residual in the feedforward (evaluated along the desired trajectory, so stability is still decided by the feedback loop), clamp its output, and fade it smoothly to zero outside the training range. When compensation uses the measured velocity (the only option in an exoskeleton’s transparent mode), overcompensation is negative damping, hence the usual 70–90%; a feedforward term along the desired trajectory that is off is just a bounded disturbance.
    • A network’s “universal approximation” only says a good enough network exists — not that training will find it, and nothing about what happens outside the training range; at the friction jump at zero velocity, any continuous network is off by at least the static-friction peak Fs.
    • A Gaussian process returns a mean and a confidence band and falls back to its prior far from data, so “I don’t know” is written down; but with the wrong kernel the band is overconfident, and only a check that looks at the measured values (such as the marginal likelihood) catches it. For friction that jumps at zero velocity, a Matérn-1/2 kernel is more honest.

    第一次读可以跳过：惯性参数的物理约束那一段、两个工程实例、外骨骼视角、模糊控制那一小节、各处“深入一层”。

    Safe to skip on a first read: the passage on physical constraints for inertial parameters, the two field examples, the exoskeleton lens, the short part on fuzzy control, and the “Going deeper” boxes.

    本节符号：θ 是惯性参数；f 是真实摩擦，g 是网络的输出；k(x, x′) 是核函数，ℓ 是长度尺度，σn 是测量噪声。

    Notation: θ holds the inertial parameters; f is the true friction and g the network’s output; k(x, x′) is the kernel, ℓ the length scale and σn the measurement noise.

    从理想模型开始，一项一项往上加Start from the ideal model, add one term at a time

    先说结论：数据最稳妥的用法，不是学整个模型，而是补上物理模型算完之后剩下的残差。把一个关节需要的力矩从理想情况写起，每加一项，就问一句“这一项写得出公式吗”。

    Short answer: the safest use of data is not to learn the whole model but to fill in the residual the physics model leaves behind. Write the torque a joint needs, starting from the ideal case, and at every added term ask one question: does this term have a formula?

    1. 理想模型：刚体Ideal model: rigid bodies

      τRBD=M(q)q¨+C(q,q˙)q˙+g(q)=Y(q,q˙,q¨)θ^

      刚体动力学对惯性参数 θ 是线性的。θ 里是各连杆的质量、质量乘质心位置、惯量；回归矩阵 Y 只由 q、q̇、q̈ 算出，未知数全在 θ 里。所以让机器人走一段激励轨迹（专门设计的一段运动，让每个参数的影响都能被单独看出来，也就是 04 节说的持续激励），记下力矩，就能用最小二乘解出 θ。有些参数在方程里总是捆在一起出现、单独分不开，能辨识的只是这些组合，叫基参数。

      需要物理意义时，还要加约束，保证这组数字真能对应一个存在的物体：质量为正，三个主惯量都为正，而且任意两个之和不小于第三个（“三角不等式”）。最后一条从定义就能看出来：绕 z 轴的主惯量是每一小块质量到 z 轴距离的平方再求和，Iz = ∫(x² + y²)dm；同理 Ix = ∫(y² + z²)dm、Iy = ∫(x² + z²)dm。两式相加，Ix + Iy = ∫(x² + y² + 2z²)dm ≥ Iz，只有质量全在一个平面里的薄板才取等号（垂直轴定理）。所以只要求惯性张量正定还不够：主惯量 (1, 1, 3) 是正定的，却没有哪个真实物体做得出来。这一项有公式，而且公式在没采过数据的区域照样成立。

      Rigid-body dynamics is linear in the inertial parameters θ. θ holds each link’s mass, mass times center-of-mass position, and inertia; the regressor Y is computed from q, q̇ and q̈ alone, so every unknown sits in θ. Drive the robot along an excitation trajectory (a motion designed so that each parameter’s effect shows up on its own — the persistent excitation of Section 04), record the torques, and least squares solves for θ. Some parameters always appear bundled together and cannot be separated; what you can identify are those combinations, called the base parameters.

      When the numbers must mean something physical, add constraints so they describe a body that could actually exist: positive mass, positive principal moments of inertia, and any two of those moments summing to at least the third (the triangle inequality). The last one follows from the definition: the principal moment about the z axis adds up every bit of mass times its squared distance from that axis, Iz = ∫(x² + y²)dm, and likewise Ix = ∫(y² + z²)dm and Iy = ∫(x² + z²)dm. Add the last two and Ix + Iy = ∫(x² + y² + 2z²)dm ≥ Iz, with equality only for a flat plate whose mass lies in one plane (the perpendicular-axis theorem). That is why a positive-definite inertia tensor alone is not enough: principal moments of (1, 1, 3) are positive definite, yet no real object has them. This term has a formula, and the formula still holds where you never collected data.

    2. ＋ 摩擦+ Friction

      τfric=F(q˙)sgn(q˙)+Fvq˙F(q˙)=Fc+(Fs−Fc)e−(q˙/vs)2

      摩擦也有成熟的参数模型：库仑项 Fc、黏滞项 Fv，再加上 Stribeck 效应（低速时摩擦先随速度下降、再随速度上升；开头那块木块“先粘住、再突然滑出去”就是它）。式中 Fs 是刚要滑动时的静摩擦峰，速度一大就降到库仑值 Fc。这几个参数同样能从数据里辨识。到这里为止，模型仍是灰箱（物理结构 + 数据拟合的参数或残差）：结构来自物理，数字来自数据。

      Friction has mature parametric models too: a Coulomb term Fc, a viscous term Fv, and the Stribeck effect (at low speed, friction first drops and then rises with velocity — the block that sticks, then suddenly breaks free). Here Fs is the static peak just before sliding starts; as speed builds, friction falls to the Coulomb level Fc. These parameters are identified from data as well. So far the model is still gray-box (physics structure plus data-fitted parameters or residuals): the structure comes from physics, the numbers from data.

    3. ＋ 写不出公式的那一块+ The part with no formula

      τ=Yθ^+τfric+fML(·)

      迟滞、传动柔性、执行器的非线性、温度漂移——剩下的这些没有干净的公式，才交给机器学习。物理模型在数据范围外的外推是合理的，学到的函数不是；只让学习补小残差，需要的数据更少，出错时后果也小得多。

      Hysteresis, transmission compliance, actuator nonlinearity, thermal drift — only these leftovers, which have no clean formula, go to machine learning. A physics model extrapolates sensibly beyond the data; a learned function does not. Asking the learner for only a small residual needs less data and does far less damage when it is wrong.

    残差的“标签”从哪里来？从机器人自己的传感器：实测力矩减去模型力矩。这是自监督的辨识数据，不需要人工标注。但它必须在真机上采，激励要覆盖整个工作区，低速和换向附近要采得更密——摩擦在那里变化最剧烈。加速度要把编码器读数差分两次才得到，噪声很大，标签的质量常常决定了残差最终能学多准。

    Where do the labels come from? From the robot’s own sensors: measured torque minus model torque. It is self-supervised identification data; nobody annotates anything by hand. It does have to be collected on the real machine, though, with excitation that covers the whole workspace and extra density near zero speed and at reversals, where friction changes fastest. Accelerations come from differencing the encoder reading twice and are noisy, so label quality often caps how accurately the residual can be learned.

    深入一层Going deeper 为什么残差模型离线验证很准，一上机就变差？Why does a residual model that validates well offline get worse on the robot?

    前置知识 二阶差分，以及低通滤波会带来滞后（01 节讲过编码器测速和 D 项低通）。

    Background. Second differences, and the lag a low-pass filter adds (encoder velocity and the D-term low-pass in Section 01).

    思路　残差的标签是 τmeas − τmodel(q, q̇, q̈)，其中 q̈ 要把编码器读数差分两次：

    The idea　The residual label is τmeas − τmodel(q, q̇, q̈), and q̈ comes from differencing the encoder reading twice:

    q¨k≈qk+1−2qk+qk−1T2

    差分放大高频噪声：编码器每跳一格 Δ，二次差分后就是 Δ/T² 量级的加速度跳动。17 位编码器（Δ = 2π/2¹⁷ ≈ 4.8×10⁻⁵ rad）、1 kHz 采样时，一格约 48 rad/s²；乘上 0.1 kg·m² 的惯量，标签里凭空多出约 5 N·m——对很多关节，这已经和库仑摩擦同一量级。所以标签非滤波不可，问题出在怎么滤。

    结论

    1. 标签可以离线用前后向（零相位）滤波来算：没有相位滞后，也不必因果。上式本身就用到了“未来”的样本 qk+1，离线算标签时这完全合法。
    2. 网络的输入特征必须和在线时一模一样，用同一个因果滤波器。二阶、截止 20 Hz 的巴特沃斯低通在低频约有 √2/ωc ≈ 11 ms 的群延迟。训练时若喂零相位滤波过的速度，网络学到的是一个“没有这 11 ms 滞后”的世界，上线后在换向这类快速变化处系统性地错位。
    3. 力矩标签若由电流换算（τ ≈ Kti），Kt 的误差和齿槽转矩也会进残差。齿槽转矩随转角周期性重复，先查表扣掉，再把剩下的交给网络。

    Differencing amplifies high-frequency noise: every one-count jump Δ of the encoder becomes an acceleration spike of order Δ/T². With a 17-bit encoder (Δ = 2π/2¹⁷ ≈ 4.8×10⁻⁵ rad) sampled at 1 kHz, one count is about 48 rad/s²; multiply by a 0.1 kg·m² inertia and the label gains roughly 5 N·m out of nowhere — for many joints, the same order as Coulomb friction. So the labels have to be filtered. The trouble lies in how.

    What follows

    1. Labels can be computed offline with forward–backward (zero-phase) filtering: no phase lag, no causality required. The formula above already uses a “future” sample, qk+1, which is perfectly legitimate when labels are computed offline.
    2. The network’s input features, however, must be exactly what it will see online, produced by the same causal filter. A second-order 20 Hz Butterworth low-pass has about √2/ωc ≈ 11 ms of group delay at low frequency. Train on zero-phase-filtered velocities and the network learns a world without those 11 ms of lag; online it is systematically misaligned exactly where things change fast, such as velocity reversals.
    3. If torque labels come from motor current (τ ≈ Kti), errors in Kt and cogging torque land in the residual too. Cogging repeats with rotor angle; remove it with a lookup table first and give the network what is left.

    自己验证Check it yourself

    • 回到 01 节的 PID 实验，展开“更多参数”，勾选“编码器量化（14 位）”，再把 Kd 从 8 调到 20：力矩曲线上的毛刺，就是一次差分之后的量化噪声（实验里的测速已先经过 100 Hz 低通），“最后 1 s 力矩波动”读数从约 0.26 N·m 升到约 1 N·m。二次差分还要在此基础上再除以一次 T。
    • Go back to the PID experiment in Section 01, open “More parameters”, tick “Encoder quantization (14-bit)” and raise Kd from 8 to 20: the fuzz on the torque curve is quantization noise after a single difference (the experiment’s velocity estimate already passes through a 100 Hz low-pass), and the “Torque ripple, last 1 s” readout climbs from about 0.26 N·m to about 1 N·m. A second difference divides by T once more.

    放在前馈里，不放进回路里Feed it forward; keep it out of the loop

    同一个学到的残差，接在哪里决定了它会不会惹麻烦。打个比方：开车看到前面有坡，提前多踩点油门，是前馈，踩多踩少都不会让车“晃”起来；盯着车速表、慢了才补油门，是反馈，补得太猛，车速就会忽快忽慢。

    残差也一样。以期望轨迹 (qd, q̇d, q̈d) 为输入，它就是 00 节说的前馈：闭环是否稳定只由反馈回路决定（对非线性的机械臂还要补一句：轨迹越快，反馈增益要留的余量越大），补偿算得不准，也只是一个有界的外加输入。以实测状态 (q, q̇) 为输入，它就进入了反馈回路：测量噪声经它放大，为了去噪加的滤波又带来相位滞后，稳定裕度要重新校核。

    由此有三条工程规矩：优先做成前馈；输出限幅；输入超出训练范围时，把补偿平滑地衰减到零。“超出”可以用训练数据的范围粗判（高维时每一维都在范围内，不等于这个组合见过），也可以用下面要讲的高斯过程方差，或几个网络之间的分歧来判断。

    Where you plug in the same learned residual decides whether it causes trouble. Think of driving: seeing a hill ahead and pressing the accelerator a little early is feedforward, and pressing a bit too much or too little never makes the car oscillate. Watching the speedometer and adding throttle only once you have slowed is feedback, and if you correct too hard, the speed starts to surge back and forth.

    A residual works the same way. Driven by the desired trajectory (qd, q̇d, q̈d), it is feedforward in the sense of Section 00: stability is decided by the feedback loop alone (for a nonlinear arm, add that faster trajectories need more margin in the feedback gains), and a wrong compensation is just a bounded extra input. Driven by the measured state (q, q̇), it sits inside the feedback loop: it amplifies measurement noise, the filtering you add against that noise costs phase, and the stability margins have to be checked again.

    Hence three working rules: make it feedforward whenever you can; clamp its output; and when the input leaves the training range, fade the compensation smoothly to zero. You can judge “leaves the range” roughly from the range of the training data (in many dimensions, every input being in range does not mean the combination was seen), with the Gaussian-process variance introduced below, or from the disagreement among several networks.

    深入一层Going deeper 同一个学到的摩擦模型，接在前馈和接进反馈，稳定性差在哪？The same learned friction model, fed forward or fed back: what changes for stability?

    前置知识 能量函数的思路（对 ½Jq̇² 求导；04 节的 Lyapunov 函数是同一个想法）。推导跟不上时，直接读下面三条后果。

    Background. The energy-function idea (differentiate ½Jq̇²; Section 04’s Lyapunov function is the same idea). If the algebra loses you, skip to the three consequences.

    思路　看能量。单关节做定点调节（重力已补偿），真实摩擦 f 只会耗能：q̇·f(q̇) ≥ 0。控制律 τ = −Kp(q − qd) − Kdq̇ + f̂，f̂ 是学到的补偿。若 f̂ 以实测速度为输入，取 V 为动能加“控制弹簧”的势能：

    The idea　Follow the energy. Take one joint regulating to a set point with gravity compensated. True friction f only dissipates: q̇·f(q̇) ≥ 0. The control law is τ = −Kp(q − qd) − Kdq̇ + f̂, where f̂ is the learned compensation. If f̂ is driven by the measured velocity, let V be the kinetic energy plus the energy stored in the “control spring”:

    V=12Jq˙2+12Kp(q−qd)2V˙=−Kdq˙2+q˙Δ(q˙)Δ=f^−fV˙≤0⇐q˙Δ(q˙)≤Kdq˙2

    只要“多补的部分” Δ 落在这个扇区里，V 就不增。三个工程后果：

    1. 少补是安全的。f̂ 与 f 同号且不超过 f 时，q̇Δ ≤ 0，补偿只是少抵消了一点耗散。“摩擦只补七到九成”的道理就在这里。注意这是 PD 的结论：若回路里有积分，没补掉的静摩擦会和积分器一起造成“卡住—突滑”的极限环，那要另外处理。
    2. 零速偏置最危险。若 f̂(0) = c ≠ 0，而真实摩擦在极低速下压不住它（比如摩擦在零速附近连续地降到零，或者 |c| 超过了静摩擦），q̇ → 0 时 Δ/q̇ → ∞，任何有限的 Kd 都满足不了扇区条件，关节会自己慢慢“蠕动”。即使 |c| 只超过动摩擦、没超过静摩擦，关节平时靠静摩擦停着，一旦被推动或被人带着走，也可能停不下来。外骨骼透明模式下 Kd ≈ 0，余量只剩人和装置自身的阻尼，所以要在穿戴者放松时专门测。
    3. 噪声。接进回路后，速度噪声 n 变成力矩噪声 (∂f̂/∂q̇)·n。模型在零速附近越陡（越像真实的跳变），放大得越狠。

    若 f̂ 以期望速度 q̇d(t) 为输入，它不依赖状态，只是一个有界的外加力矩，上面的耗散结构原封不动。代价是换向时刻由轨迹说了算：实际换向若晚了，补偿会“提前”作用一小段。

    As long as the over-compensation Δ stays inside this sector, V cannot grow. Three engineering consequences:

    1. Under-compensating is safe. If f̂ has the sign of f and never exceeds it, q̇Δ ≤ 0: the compensation merely cancels a little less dissipation. That is the reason behind “compensate only 70–90% of the friction”. Note that this is a PD result: with integral action in the loop, the uncompensated stiction and the integrator can together produce a stick–slip limit cycle, which needs separate treatment.
    2. A bias at zero speed is the worst case. If f̂(0) = c ≠ 0 and the true friction cannot hold it at very low speed (friction that falls continuously to zero through zero speed, or |c| above the stiction level), then Δ/q̇ → ∞ as q̇ → 0, no finite Kd satisfies the sector condition, and the joint creeps on its own. Even when |c| exceeds only the kinetic friction, stiction holds the joint still — until it is nudged or carried along by a person, and then it may not stop. In an exoskeleton’s transparent mode Kd ≈ 0, and the only margin left is the damping of the wearer and the device, so test explicitly with the wearer relaxed.
    3. Noise. Inside the loop, velocity noise n becomes torque noise (∂f̂/∂q̇)·n. The steeper the model near zero speed — the closer it gets to the real jump — the harder it amplifies.

    If f̂ is driven by the desired velocity q̇d(t), it does not depend on the state at all; it is a bounded external torque, and the dissipation structure above is untouched. The price: the trajectory decides when the reversal happens, so if the real reversal comes late, the compensation acts a little “early”.

    自己验证Check it yourself

    • 在下面的 gp 实验里勾选“以物理模型为先验均值（只学残差）”，把鼠标停在图上 v = −0.02 和 +0.02 rad/s 处读后验均值（只悬停，鼠标点击会在那里采样；触屏上轻点即可读数，不会采样）：均值约从 −0.22 跳到 +0.29 N·m，局部斜率约 13 N·m·s/rad（不勾选时约 3）。若把这个模型接在实测速度上，0.01 rad/s 的速度噪声就会变成 0.1–0.2 N·m 的力矩抖动，和实验里 0.3 N·m 的库仑项同一量级。
    • In the gp experiment below, tick “Use a physics model as the prior mean (learn only the residual)” and hover over the chart at v = −0.02 and +0.02 rad/s to read the posterior mean (hover only — a mouse click takes a sample there; on a touch screen a tap just reads the value): the mean jumps from about −0.22 to +0.29 N·m, a local slope of about 13 N·m·s/rad (about 3 without the prior). Drive that model with measured velocity and 0.01 rad/s of velocity noise becomes 0.1–0.2 N·m of torque chatter — the same order as the experiment’s 0.3 N·m Coulomb term.

    神经网络能保证什么，不能保证什么What a neural network guarantees — and what it doesn’t

    “神经网络什么都能拟合”这句话来自万能逼近定理：在有界的输入范围内，存在某个足够大的网络能把连续函数逼近到任意精度。它只说“存在”，没有说训练能不能找到这组权重，也没有说分布外（训练时没见过的输入区域）的误差有多大：ReLU 网络由一段段直线拼成，在远处线性外推，输出可以无界增长；tanh 网络会饱和，但饱和值没有物理意义。

    还有一条限制与训练好坏无关。摩擦在零速处跳变，而常用的网络都是连续函数：

    “Neural networks can fit anything” comes from the universal approximation theorem: on a bounded input range, some large enough network approximates a continuous function to any accuracy. It is an existence result. It says nothing about whether training will find those weights, or how large the error is out of distribution (in input regions not seen in training). A ReLU network is stitched together from straight pieces, so it extrapolates linearly and can grow without bound; a tanh network saturates, but the saturated value means nothing physically.

    One limit has nothing to do with how well you train. Friction jumps at zero speed, and the usual networks are continuous functions:

    f(0+)−f(0−)=2Fssupv|g(v)−f(v)|≥Fs

    按上面带 Stribeck 效应的模型，真实摩擦 f 在零速两侧分别趋向 +Fs 和 −Fs（静摩擦峰；只有库仑项时 Fs = Fc），跳变 2Fs。连续的网络 g 在零速只能取一个值，无论 g(0) 取什么，离其中一侧至少差 Fs：最大误差至少是跳变量的一半，训练得再好也一样。

    Under the Stribeck model above, the true friction f tends to +Fs and −Fs on the two sides of zero velocity (the static peak; with a pure Coulomb model Fs = Fc), a jump of 2Fs. A continuous network g can take only one value at zero, so whatever g(0) is, it misses one side by at least Fs. The worst-case error is at least half the jump, however well you train.

    深入一层Going deeper 连续网络“学不完”零速处的跳变，工程上怎么办？A continuous network can never fully learn the jump at zero speed. What do engineers do?

    前置知识 本节的 Stribeck 摩擦模型；LuGre 的三行公式看个大意即可。

    Background. This section’s Stribeck friction model; for the three LuGre equations, the gist is enough.

    思路　把跳变交给结构，把“形状”交给数据。误差不会消失，但可以挪到你控制得了的地方。

    ① 显式符号特征。写成 τ̂ = a(·)·sgn(q̇) + g(·)，网络 a、g 只学光滑的部分（比如幅值怎样随温度、负载变化），跳变由 sgn 承担。实践中常用 tanh(q̇/vε) 代替 sgn，vε 要取在速度噪声之上，否则它就是上一个“深入一层”说的噪声放大器。

    ② 动态摩擦模型。LuGre 模型（Canudas de Wit 等 1995）用一个“刷毛”内部状态 z 描述接触面的微小弹性变形：

    The idea　Let structure carry the jump and let data carry the shape. The error does not go away, but you can move it to where you control it.

    1. An explicit sign feature. Write τ̂ = a(·)·sgn(q̇) + g(·): the networks a and g learn only smooth parts (how the amplitude drifts with temperature or load, say), and sgn carries the jump. In practice sgn is replaced by tanh(q̇/vε), with vε chosen above the velocity noise — otherwise it becomes the noise amplifier from the previous “Going deeper”.

    2. A dynamic friction model. The LuGre model (Canudas de Wit et al. 1995) adds an internal “bristle” state z for the tiny elastic deflection of the contact:

    z˙=v−σ0|v|g(v)zF=σ0z+σ1z˙+σ2vg(v)=Fc+(Fs−Fc)e−(v/vs)2

    稳态时 ż = 0，F 退回上文的 Stribeck 静态模型；在零速附近，摩擦力随“预滑动”位移像弹簧一样连续地建立起来，同时复现迟滞和随加载速率变化的脱离力。代价是 z 测不到，要靠观测器估计——又回到了“有记忆的模型”。

    ③ 零速附近单独处理。前馈里用期望速度决定符号；速度很小时，把补偿平滑地降到零，或者保持上一次的符号（滞环），免得在零速附近来回切换。外骨骼里再配合只补一部分的比例。

    工程后果　误差集中在宽度约 vε 的过渡带里，时间上集中在每一次换向。机床和机械臂常用画圆测试来检查摩擦补偿：换向处轨迹上的尖峰，就是这一块误差。

    In steady state ż = 0 and F reduces to the static Stribeck model above. Near zero speed, friction builds up continuously with pre-sliding displacement, like a spring, and the model also reproduces hysteresis and a breakaway force that depends on how fast the load is applied. The price is that z cannot be measured and needs an observer — which brings us back to models with memory.

    3. Special handling near zero speed. In feedforward, take the sign from the desired velocity; at very low speed, fade the compensation smoothly to zero or hold the last sign (hysteresis) so it does not flip back and forth around zero. In an exoskeleton, combine this with partial compensation.

    Engineering consequence　The error concentrates in a transition band about vε wide, and in time at every reversal. Machine tools and robot arms check friction compensation with a circle test: the spikes on the path at each reversal are exactly this error.

    自己验证Check it yourself

    • gp 实验里（默认的 12 个数据点），不勾物理先验时，零速附近（|v| < 0.2）只有约四成真值落在 ±2σ 内，均值的均方根误差约 0.28 N·m。勾选物理先验（它含一个陡峭的 tanh(v/0.01)，就是做法 ①）后，均方根误差降到约 0.07 N·m，零速附近的比例升到约 58%。
    • 剩下没盖住的点集中在 |v| ≤ 0.1 的静摩擦峰里：物理先验只有库仑项和黏滞项，没写 Stribeck 峰；而 ℓ = 0.3 的平方指数核又“画”不出只有 0.1 rad/s 宽的峰。结构里没有的东西，数据补得很吃力。
    • In the gp experiment (with its 12 default data points) and without the physics prior, only about 40% of the truth near zero speed (|v| < 0.2) lies inside ±2σ, and the RMS error of the mean is about 0.28 N·m. Tick the physics prior — it contains a steep tanh(v/0.01), which is recipe 1 — and the RMS error falls to about 0.07 N·m while the near-zero share rises to about 58%.
    • What remains uncovered sits in the breakaway peak at |v| ≤ 0.1: the physics prior has Coulomb and viscous terms but no Stribeck peak, and a squared-exponential kernel with ℓ = 0.3 cannot draw a peak only 0.1 rad/s wide. Whatever the structure leaves out, data fills in only with difficulty.

    要不要带记忆的网络，看输入是不是完整的状态。刚体逆动力学在 (q, q̇, q̈) 上没有记忆，多层感知机（MLP，最基本的前馈神经网络，没有记忆）就够了。迟滞、气腔压力、温度、线缆摩擦这类测不到的内部状态，才需要时序网络，或者给 MLP 喂一段历史窗口。时序网络常见两种：RNN（循环神经网络）每一步把新输入和自己的一个内部“记忆”向量一起更新，像边听边记笔记；TCN（时间卷积网络）每次都回看最近一段固定长度的历史，像每次决策前回放最近几秒的录像。拿迟滞来说：同样的气压，是刚充上来还是刚放下来，力矩不一样；只有看得到“刚才往哪边走”，网络才分得清。

    Whether you need a network with memory depends on whether the input is the full state. Rigid-body inverse dynamics is memoryless in (q, q̇, q̈), so a multilayer perceptron (MLP: the basic feedforward network, with no memory) is enough. Unmeasured internal states — hysteresis, chamber pressure, temperature, cable friction — are what call for temporal networks, or an MLP fed a window of past samples. Two kinds are common. An RNN (recurrent neural network) updates an internal “memory” vector together with each new input, like taking notes while listening. A TCN (temporal convolutional network) looks back over a fixed window of recent history every time, like replaying the last few seconds of video before each decision. Take hysteresis: at the same pressure, the torque differs depending on whether the chamber was just filled or just vented, and only a network that can see which way things were going can tell the two apart.

    工程实例From the field

    ANYmal 的执行器网络：机器人“学模型”的标志性案例ANYmal’s actuator network: a landmark learned model in robotics

    系统　ANYmal 四足机器人，约 32 kg，12 个串联弹性执行器（SEA）。每个关节里依次是：位置指令 → PD（算出期望力矩）→ 力矩环 PID（算出期望电流）→ FOC 电流环（磁场定向控制：按转子角度调节三相电流，让电机输出指定的力矩）→ 减速器 → 弹簧。

    问题　刚体连杆用多体模型就能描述得很好；难的是“指令 → 关节力矩”这一段：多层软硬件带来的延迟、驱动器内部的控制环、弹簧的柔性与阻尼，很多内部状态测不到。作者为它手工调解析模型，调了一周多也收效甚微。

    做法　用数据直接学“指令 → 力矩”。输入是当前、10 ms 前、20 ms 前三个时刻的位置误差和速度——单个采样不满足马尔可夫性，所以要一段历史，正好对应上文“要不要带记忆”。网络是 3 个隐层、每层 32 个单元的 MLP（softsign 激活）。采集时让足端走正弦轨迹，同时改变幅值和频率，并用手推扰机器人：激励必须覆盖足够宽的频带，否则学出的模型在训练中就会产生不自然的振荡。

    对照　同样的训练流程，换成理想执行器模型（无限带宽、零延迟）或手调的解析模型，训练出的策略上机一步都迈不出，四肢剧烈抖动——作者推测，主要是各种延迟没有建对。

    System　ANYmal, a quadruped of about 32 kg with 12 series elastic actuators (SEAs). Inside each joint: position command → PD (desired torque) → torque PID (desired current) → FOC current loop (field-oriented control: shapes the three phase currents by rotor angle so the motor produces the requested torque) → gearbox → spring.

    Problem　A multibody model describes the rigid links well. The hard part is command-to-torque: delays through several hardware and software layers, the drive’s internal control loops, spring compliance and damping, and internal states nobody measures. The authors spent more than a week hand-tuning an analytical actuator model without much success.

    Approach　Learn command-to-torque directly from data. The input is the position error and velocity now, 10 ms ago and 20 ms ago — a single sample is not Markov, so the model needs a short history, exactly the “memory” question above. The network is an MLP with three hidden layers of 32 units (softsign activation). During data collection the feet followed sine trajectories of varying amplitude and frequency while the robot was pushed by hand: the excitation has to span a wide frequency band, or the learned model produces unnatural oscillations even during training.

    Ablation　With the same training pipeline but an ideal actuator model (infinite bandwidth, zero latency) or the hand-tuned analytical model, the resulting policies could not take a single step on the robot and the limbs shook violently — most likely, the authors say, because the delays were not modeled properly.

    采数据时间（12 个执行器并行）Data collection (12 actuators in parallel)
    < 4 min
    采样率 · 样本量Sampling rate · samples
    400 Hz · > 10⁶
    激励：足端幅值 · 频率Excitation: foot amplitude · frequency
    5–10 cm · 1–25 Hz
    验证误差（均方根）Validation error (RMS)
    0.7–0.8 N·m
    含执行器网络的仿真速度Simulation speed with the actuator net
    ≈ 5×10⁵ 步/秒≈ 5×10⁵ steps/s
    相对实时Relative to real time
    ≈ 1000×

    学到什么　① 该学的，是最难建模、又能大量廉价采样的那一块；刚体仍交给物理。② 输入历史要比所有通信延迟与机械响应时间之和更长。③ 这个模型的用途是“进仿真器”，不是进实时回路：它给 08 节的强化学习当环境用（见 08 节的 ANYmal 实例）。

    Lessons　(1) Learn the piece that is hardest to model and cheapest to sample in bulk; leave the rigid bodies to physics. (2) The input history must be longer than all communication delays plus the mechanical response time. (3) The model’s job is to live inside the simulator, not the real-time loop: it is the environment for the reinforcement learning of Section 08 (see the ANYmal case there).

    出处：Source: Hwangbo, J., Lee, J., Dosovitskiy, A., Bellicoso, C. D., Tsounis, V., Koltun, V., & Hutter, M. (2019). Learning agile and dynamic motor skills for legged robots. Science Robotics, 4(26), eaau5872. doi:10.1126/scirobotics.aau5872 （数字取自其 arXiv 全文 arXiv:1901.08652）(figures from the full text, arXiv:1901.08652)

    高斯过程：把“不知道”写出来Gaussian processes: writing down what you don’t know

    补偿量要进控制器，比“拟合得多准”更重要的是“知道自己哪里不准”。高斯过程（GP，对“函数长什么样”先给一个概率上的猜测，看到数据再更新）正好提供这一点（Rasmussen & Williams 2006）。同样从理想情况写起：

    When a compensation term feeds a controller, knowing where it is wrong matters more than how well it fits. A Gaussian process (GP: a probabilistic guess about what the function looks like, updated as data arrive) gives you exactly that (Rasmussen & Williams 2006). Again, start from the ideal case:

    1. 先验：用核函数说清“像不像”Prior: a kernel defines “similar”

      f∼GP(m(x),k(x,x′))k=σf2exp(−d22ℓ2),d=|x−x′|

      核函数 k 规定两个输入有多“像”，从而决定函数多光滑：k(x, x′) 越大，两个点的函数值越相关；长度尺度 ℓ（函数在多大的输入变化内会明显改变）决定两点距离 d 多小才算“近”。均值函数 m 是看数据之前的最好猜测：可以是 0，也可以是物理模型。上式是最常用的平方指数核，它假设函数处处非常光滑。

      具体感受一下平方指数核：两个速度相差 d，它们的函数值的相关系数是 exp(−d²/2ℓ²)。d = ℓ 时约 0.61，d = 2ℓ 时约 0.14，d = 3ℓ 时只剩约 0.01。离数据超过两三个 ℓ，数据就管不到那里了。

      “对函数长什么样的概率猜测”可以这样想：按核的规定，随手画出成千上万条曲线。平方指数核画出来的条条圆滑，Matérn-1/2（下面第三步）画出来的毛糙、带折角；ℓ 越小，曲线拐弯越勤。这一大把曲线里，哪种形状多、哪种形状少，就是先验。

      The kernel k says how similar two inputs are, which sets how smooth the function is: the larger k(x, x′), the more the two function values move together. The length scale ℓ (how far the input must move before the function changes noticeably) sets how small the distance d must be to count as close. The mean function m is your best guess before any data: zero, or a physics model. The kernel above is the common squared-exponential kernel, which assumes the function is very smooth everywhere.

      To get a feel for the squared-exponential kernel: for two speeds a distance d apart, the correlation between their function values is exp(−d²/2ℓ²) — about 0.61 at d = ℓ, 0.14 at d = 2ℓ and only 0.01 at d = 3ℓ. More than two or three ℓ away from the data, the data have no say.

      One way to picture a “probabilistic guess about what the function looks like”: draw thousands of random curves the way the kernel allows. The squared-exponential kernel draws every one of them smooth and rounded; Matérn-1/2 (step three below) draws them rough, with kinks; a smaller ℓ makes them turn more often. Which shapes are common in that bundle and which are rare — that is the prior.

    2. 看到数据：后验After the data: the posterior

      μ(x*)=m(x*)+∑iwi(x*)[yi−m(xi)]

      接着上面那一大把曲线：看到数据，就只留下从数据点旁边（测量噪声范围内）经过的那些。在每个速度上，留下的曲线平均落在哪里，就是后验均值；散得多开，就是置信带。数据点附近，曲线都被“钉”住了，带子窄；离数据远的地方没有东西约束它们，曲线又散回先验的样子——散开的程度，就是“不知道”有多少。

      写成公式，预测是“先验猜测 + 附近数据的加权修正”：yi 是在 xi 处的测量值，权重 wi 由核函数和数据点的位置算出（完整公式在本节实验后的“深入一层”里）。离数据越远，新点和数据点的相关越接近 0，权重也跟着趋于 0：均值退回先验 m，后验方差（看过数据以后还剩多少不确定）退回先验的 σf²。“不知道”被诚实地写了出来，这是安全应用最依赖的性质。

      GP 常被称为“非参数”方法。这不是说它没有参数，而是说它不事先定死一个公式：拟合直线 a + bv 永远只有两个系数可调，数据再多也画不出弯；GP 的预测直接由全部数据点加权得到，数据越多，能表达的细节越多。这也不是说它没有假设——假设都藏在核里：核决定了哪些形状“可信”，也就是上面那一大把曲线长什么样。

      Back to that bundle of curves: seeing data means keeping only the curves that pass close to the data points (within the measurement noise). At each speed, where the surviving curves sit on average is the posterior mean, and how widely they spread is the confidence band. Near the data every curve is pinned down and the band is narrow; far from the data nothing holds them, so they spread back out as in the prior — and how far they spread is how much we don’t know.

      As a formula, the prediction is “prior guess plus a weighted correction from nearby data”: yi is the measurement at xi, and the weights wi come from the kernel and where the data sit (the full formula is in the “Going deeper” after this section’s experiment). The farther the new point is from the data, the closer its correlation with them gets to zero, and the weights follow: the mean falls back to the prior m and the posterior variance (how uncertain we remain after seeing the data) returns to the prior σf². “I don’t know” is written down honestly — the property safety-critical uses depend on most.

      GPs are often called “nonparametric”. That doesn’t mean they have no parameters; it means no formula is fixed in advance. A straight-line fit a + bv has two coefficients forever, and no amount of data will make it bend; a GP builds its prediction directly from all the data points, so more data buys more detail. Nor does it mean they make no assumptions: the assumptions all live in the kernel, which decides what shapes are plausible — what that bundle of curves looks like.

    3. ＋ 核选错了+ The wrong kernel

      k=σf2exp(−d/ℓ)

      平方指数核假设函数无限光滑，任意阶导数都存在；拿它去拟合零速处跳变的摩擦，跳变附近的置信带会过度自信：带子很窄，真值却落在带子外面。

      带子为什么自己发现不了？回到那一大把曲线：平方指数核画出来的曲线条条圆滑，里面根本没有“陡跳”这种形状。数据点密密地落在跳变两侧时，留下来的只能是一些平滑地穿过去的曲线；它们在数据点附近彼此贴得很近，带子就窄。至于这些曲线全都不像真实的摩擦，带子不会知道。说得更直接些：超参数固定时，置信带的宽度只由数据点的位置、核和噪声设定算出来，根本不看测到的数值（公式见本节实验后的深入一层）。好比一位天气预报员，他有多大把握只看附近有几个气象站，不看这些站报来的读数和他的理论对不对得上。所以后验方差衡量的是“在所选的核这个先验下，附近的数据有多密”，不衡量核本身选没选对。

      要发现核选错，得用看得见测量值的检验。最常用的是边际似然（在这组核与 ℓ 下，“恰好测到这批数据”的可能性有多大）：数据越像这个核会画出的曲线，它就越大；实验里的“对数边际似然”读数就是它取了对数。Matérn-1/2 核（上式）只要求函数连续，允许折角和陡变，更适合零速处跳变的摩擦，也诚实得多。

      The squared-exponential kernel assumes an infinitely smooth function, with derivatives of every order. Fit it to friction that jumps at zero speed and the band near the jump becomes overconfident: narrow, with the truth outside it.

      Why can’t the band notice? Go back to the bundle of curves. Every curve the squared-exponential kernel draws is smooth; a sudden jump is simply not among its shapes. With data packed on both sides of the jump, the only curves that survive are smooth ones that sweep through; near the data they all stay close together, so the band is narrow. That none of them looks like real friction is something the band cannot know. Put more bluntly: with the hyperparameters fixed, the width of the band is computed from where the data points are, the kernel and the noise setting — never from the values measured (the formula is in the “Going deeper” after this section’s experiment). Think of a weather forecaster whose confidence depends only on how many stations are nearby, not on whether their readings agree with his theory. So the posterior variance measures how dense the data are under the chosen kernel’s prior; it does not measure whether the kernel was the right choice.

      Catching a wrong kernel takes a test that does look at the measurements. The most common is the marginal likelihood (how likely this exact set of measurements is under the chosen kernel and ℓ): the more the data look like curves the kernel would draw, the larger it is. The experiment’s “log marginal likelihood” readout shows its logarithm. The Matérn-1/2 kernel (above) asks only for continuity and allows kinks and steep changes, so it suits friction that jumps at zero speed and is far more honest.

    4. ＋ 维数与数据量+ Dimension and data size

      O(N3)dimx=3n=21(n=7)

      精确 GP 训练要分解一个 N × N 的矩阵，计算量按 N³ 增长。“少量数据就够”只在输入维数低时成立：常用的核主要靠邻近样本说话，覆盖工作区所需的样本随维数迅速增加。7 自由度机械臂逆动力学的输入是 21 维，要大量数据，还得用稀疏或局部近似（只用一部分有代表性的数据点，或只用附近的数据）。

      Exact GP training factorizes an N × N matrix, so the cost grows as N³. “A little data is enough” holds only in low input dimension: common kernels rely on nearby samples, and the samples needed to cover the workspace grow quickly with dimension. Inverse dynamics of a 7-DOF arm has a 21-dimensional input; it needs a lot of data, plus sparse or local approximations (using only a representative subset of the data, or only the data nearby).

    外骨骼视角Exoskeleton lens织物气动执行器的“压力 → 力矩”映射依赖关节角、织物形变和迟滞，充气与放气两个方向不一样。合理的做法是以准静态物理模型（压力 × 随角度变化的有效面积与力臂）打底，用 GP 或小 MLP 在 (p, q, sgn q̇, sgn ṗ) 上学残差，sgn ṗ 用来区分充气和放气两条主回线；但小幅来回调整时，迟滞走的是中间的“小回线”，力矩还取决于上次在哪里转向，要再加一小段历史输入。|ṗ| 很小时沿用上一次的方向，免得在零附近来回跳。台架标定不能照搬到人身上：软组织和绑带滑移会改变有效力臂。还要记住，外骨骼里监督学习的主战场常常是“估计”（步态相位、生物关节力矩），而不是“补偿”。In a fabric pneumatic actuator, the pressure-to-torque map depends on joint angle, fabric deformation and hysteresis, and inflation differs from deflation. A sensible recipe: start from a quasi-static physics model (pressure times an angle-dependent effective area and moment arm), then let a GP or a small MLP learn the residual over (p, q, sgn q̇, sgn ṗ), where sgn ṗ separates the two main branches, inflating and deflating. Small back-and-forth adjustments, however, trace minor loops inside those branches, where the torque also depends on where the pressure last reversed, so add a short input history too. When |ṗ| is small, keep the last direction rather than letting the sign flip around zero. A bench calibration doesn’t transfer directly to a person: soft tissue and strap slip change the effective moment arm. And in exoskeletons, supervised learning often earns its keep in estimation (gait phase, biological joint torque) rather than in compensation.

    工程实例From the field

    用网络实时估计人体关节力矩来控制外骨骼Controlling an exoskeleton by estimating the wearer’s joint moments in real time

    系统　自主运行、与衣物集成的髋膝外骨骼。

    问题　“状态机 + 任务分类器”式的控制器只能照顾事先列出的几种活动；而人的动作从周期性的步行、跑步，到没有规律的闲逛、急转侧切，根本列不完。

    做法　深度网络根据外骨骼自带的传感器，实时估计髋、膝的生物关节力矩，再按估计值给出多关节协调的助力。控制律本身很简单，难的是估计。生物关节力矩没法直接测，训练用的“真值”一般来自实验室里的动作捕捉加测力台逆动力学——这是真正昂贵的标注数据，和机器人残差学习“传感器自带标签”正好相反。

    System　An autonomous, clothing-integrated hip–knee exoskeleton.

    Problem　A “state machine plus task classifier” controller only handles the activities someone listed in advance, while human movement runs from cyclic walking and running to unstructured meandering and sharp lateral cuts — far too many to list.

    Approach　A deep network estimates hip and knee biological joint moments in real time from the exoskeleton’s own sensors, and the device assists in proportion to those estimates, coordinated across joints. The control law is simple; the estimation is the hard part. Biological joint moments cannot be measured directly, so training “ground truth” usually comes from motion capture and force-plate inverse dynamics in a lab — genuinely expensive labels, the opposite of a robot’s self-labeled residuals.

    28 种活动的力矩估计Moment estimates, 28 activities
    R² = 0.83
    10 种活动的用户能耗（对零力矩）User energetics, 10 activities (vs zero torque)
    −5.3% ～ −19.7%−5.3% to −19.7%
    活动之间改控制器Controller changes between activities
    无none

    能耗按任务取代谢或下肢生物关节功；10 种活动包括平地走、跑、提起 25 lb（约 11 kg）重物和弓步。该方法显著优于按“最好情况”构造的任务分类器方法（样条曲线加阻抗参数）。

    学到什么　外骨骼里监督学习的主战场是“估计”，控制律仍然简单、可以分析。两个坑：跨用户、跨穿戴的泛化（每次绑带位置都不同），以及训练人群与目标人群（例如健康人与患者）之间的分布偏移。

    Energetics means metabolic cost or lower-limb biological joint work, depending on the task; the ten activities include level walking, running, lifting a 25 lb (about 11 kg) weight and lunging. The approach significantly outperformed a best-case task-classifier controller built from splines and impedance parameters.

    Lessons　In exoskeletons, supervised learning earns its keep in estimation, and the control law stays simple enough to analyze. Two traps: generalizing across users and across donnings (the straps never sit in the same place twice), and the shift between the population you train on and the one you serve (healthy volunteers versus patients, for instance).

    出处：Source: Molinaro, D. D., Scherpereel, K. L., Schonhaut, E. B., Evangelopoulos, G., Shepherd, M. K., & Young, A. J. (2024). Task-agnostic exoskeleton control via biological joint moment estimation. Nature, 635(8038), 337–344. doi:10.1038/s41586-024-08157-7

    顺带一提：模糊控制和“按工况切换”An aside: fuzzy control and regime switching

    模糊控制常和神经网络放在同一章，但它不是机器学习：规则（“误差大、还在变大，就使劲推”）和隶属函数（“多大算大”）都由专家给定，不从数据里学。以 e、ė 为输入的二维模糊控制器，本质上是一张非线性 PD 查表曲面；少数变体才从数据学参数。同理，“用聚类识别工况、再切换补偿参数”属于增益调度：聚类只能分出工况，每一簇该用什么参数，还要靠辨识或专家标定。切换也要小心：切换后至少停留一段时间，进、出切换用不同的阈值，免得在边界上来回跳；否则每个子控制器各自稳定，整体仍可能不稳。缓慢漂移的摩擦，用 04 节那样的在线辨识更合适。

    Fuzzy control often shares a chapter with neural networks, but it is not machine learning: experts write the rules (“if the error is large and growing, push hard”) and the membership functions (“how large counts as large”), and nothing is learned from data. A two-input fuzzy controller on e and ė is, underneath, a nonlinear PD lookup surface; only a few variants fit parameters to data. Likewise, “cluster the operating regimes, then switch compensation parameters” is gain scheduling. Clustering finds regimes but cannot say which parameters each one needs — that takes identification or expert calibration. The switching needs care too: after a switch, stay put for a minimum time, and use different thresholds for switching in and out so the controller doesn’t flip back and forth at the boundary; otherwise stable sub-controllers can still add up to an unstable whole. Slowly drifting friction is better tracked by online identification, as in Section 04.

    反过来想Flip it around

    不用数据会怎样？写不出公式的残差只能留给反馈去扛，又回到 01 节的增益上限。

    用错了地方会怎样？学整个模型而不是残差，训练范围外的外推毫无依据。残差依赖测不到的状态（迟滞、气压）却用静态网络，根本拟合不了。输入用噪声大的实测速度和加速度，等于在回路里塞进一个带噪声的非线性增益。

    补过头会怎样？摩擦和惯量的透明性补偿，本质上是在向人注入能量；补过头就是负阻尼，装置会在低速时自己“走”，与人耦合后可能失稳。经验上摩擦只补辨识值的七到九成，并专门检查人放松时装置会不会漂移；网络在零速输出的小偏置，也会让装置慢慢“蠕动”。

    边界在哪：训练分布之外没有任何保证。学习补的是模型，不是替代模型。

    卡在哪里：控制律的结构仍然是人设计的：先规划轨迹，再跟踪，再补残差。可有些任务的目标，根本写不成“跟住某条轨迹”。

    What if you don’t use data? Residuals without a formula are left for feedback to fight, and you are back at the gain ceiling of Section 01.

    What if you use it in the wrong place? Learn the whole model instead of the residual and extrapolation beyond the training range has no basis at all. Fit a residual that depends on unmeasured state (hysteresis, pressure) with a static network and no amount of training will fit it. Feed it noisy measured velocities and accelerations and you have put a noisy nonlinear gain inside the loop.

    What if you compensate too much? Friction and inertia compensation for transparency injects energy into the person. Overdo it and you get negative damping: the device creeps on its own at low speed and can go unstable once coupled to a human. A rule of thumb is to compensate only 70–90% of the identified friction and to check explicitly that the device doesn’t drift when the wearer relaxes; a small bias in a network’s output at zero speed causes the same slow creep.

    Limits: outside the training distribution there is no guarantee. Learning supplements the model; it does not replace it.

    Where it gets stuck: the structure of the control law is still designed by people: plan a trajectory, track it, compensate the residual. Some tasks have goals that simply can’t be written as “follow this trajectory”.

    场景里，电机经过一个力矩传感器，带着一个压着刹车片的转盘：电机按“新样本位置”给的转速转一下，等转速稳定后读一次传感器，这个摩擦力矩读数就掉进图里，成为一个新点（横轴速度 v，纵轴“摩擦残差”——场景里没有别的力矩要扣，读数就是它）。真机上，这些点来自让关节匀速转动时，实测力矩减去刚体模型力矩。先只在零速附近采几个样本（直接点图，或把“新样本位置”拉到 0 附近再按“在此处采样”），盯着阴影带（均值 ±2σ）。先猜：那里采了很多点，置信带就一定可信吗？In the scene, a motor drives a braked disc through a torque sensor. It spins up to the speed set by “New sample at”, the sensor is read once the speed is steady, and that friction-torque reading drops into the chart as a new point (speed v across, “friction residual” up — the scene has no other torque to subtract, so the reading is the residual). On a real robot, such points come from running the joint at constant speeds and subtracting the rigid-body model’s torque from the measured torque. First take a few samples near zero speed only (tap the chart, or set “New sample at” near 0 and press “Sample here”) and watch the shaded band, the mean ±2σ. Predict: with many samples there, can you trust the band?

    你应该看到：用默认的 12 个点，平方指数核在零速附近（|v| < 0.2）只有约四成真值落在 ±2σ 内；在那里再多采几个点，带子变窄了，这个比例反而往下掉（例如在 0、±0.05、±0.1 各采一个，降到约 18%）。按“恢复默认”，把长度尺度拉到 0.6，比例掉到约 5%：带子很窄，却是错的。再换成 Matérn-1/2，比例回到九成以上（约 97.5%）。勾选物理先验，训练范围外的均值跟着物理趋势走（v = 2 处约 0.57 N·m，和物理模型本身的 0.55 相差无几），不再掉回 0。What you should see: with the 12 default points, the squared-exponential kernel keeps only about 40% of the truth near zero speed (|v| < 0.2) inside ±2σ. Add more samples there and the band narrows while that share drops further (one sample each at 0, ±0.05 and ±0.1 takes it to about 18%). Press Restore defaults and stretch the length scale to 0.6: the share falls to about 5% — a narrow band, and a wrong one. Now switch to Matérn-1/2 and it climbs back above 90% (about 97.5%). Tick the physics prior and, outside the data, the mean follows the physical trend (about 0.57 N·m at v = 2, close to the physics model’s own 0.55) instead of falling back to zero.

    深入一层Going deeper 为什么高斯过程的置信带发现不了“核选错了”？那靠什么发现？Why can’t a GP’s confidence band reveal a wrong kernel — and what can?

    前置知识 矩阵求逆、多元高斯分布的对数密度。公式看不懂，也可以直接读“结论”。

    Background. Matrix inversion and the log-density of a multivariate Gaussian. If the formulas don’t land, go straight to “The answer”.

    思路　看测量值 y 出现在后验公式的哪里。K 是数据点两两之间的核矩阵，k* 是新点 x* 与各数据点的核值，σn 是测量噪声：

    The idea　Look at where the measurements y appear in the posterior. K is the kernel matrix between data points, k* holds the kernel values between the new point x* and the data, and σn is the measurement noise:

    μ(x*)=m(x*)+k*TA(y−m)σ2(x*)=k(x*,x*)−k*TAk*A=(K+σn2I)−1logp(y)=−12(y−m)TA(y−m)−12logdetA−1−n2log2π

    结论　超参数固定时，σ² 里根本没有 y：它只知道数据点在哪里，不知道数据说了什么。数据再不像核所假设的样子，置信带也不会因此变宽。要发现核选错，只能靠依赖 y 的检验：

    • 边际似然（最后两行，只有第一项看得见数据）。用它自动选超参数时，有个信号特别有用：估出的噪声 σn 明显大于传感器规格，说明模型在拿“噪声”吞掉它解释不了的结构。
    • 留一法：去掉一个点，用其余点预测它。标准化残差 (yi − μ−i)/σ−i 应当大多落在 ±2 以内；这里的 σ−i 是对测量值的预测标准差，方差里要加上 σn²。
    • 留出数据上的覆盖率，以及残差像不像白噪声（有没有成片同号）。

    Matérn-1/2 更诚实，并不是因为它能表示跳变——它仍是连续函数的先验——而是它允许函数在很短距离内陡变，数据点之间的方差长得快。工程上，GP-MPC 用 μ ± βσ 收紧约束（Hewing 等 2020），β 有没有意义完全取决于核选得对不对：上线前先在留出数据上核对，95% 的带是否真的盖住约 95% 的点。

    The answer　With hyperparameters fixed, σ² contains no y at all: it knows where the data are, not what they say. However badly the data disagree with the kernel’s assumptions, the band does not widen. Catching a wrong kernel takes tests that do depend on y:

    • The marginal likelihood (the last two lines; only its first term sees the data). When you use it to fit hyperparameters, one symptom is especially telling: a fitted noise σn well above the sensor’s specification means the model is using “noise” to swallow structure it cannot explain.
    • Leave-one-out: drop one point and predict it from the rest. The standardized residuals (yi − μ−i)/σ−i should mostly fall within ±2; here σ−i is the predictive standard deviation of the measurement, so its variance includes σn².
    • Coverage on held-out data, and whether the residuals look like white noise rather than runs of the same sign.

    Matérn-1/2 is more honest not because it can represent a jump — it is still a prior over continuous functions — but because it lets the function change steeply over short distances, so the variance between data points grows quickly. In GP-MPC, constraints are tightened with μ ± βσ (Hewing et al. 2020), and β means something only if the kernel is right: before deployment, check on held-out data that the 95% band really covers about 95% of the points.

    自己验证Check it yourself

    • 平方指数核、ℓ = 0.6：零速附近的覆盖率约 5%；只把核换成 Matérn-1/2：约 97.5%。
    • 留一法是用本实验默认的 12 个数据点离线算的（实验里没有这个按钮）。平方指数核、ℓ = 0.3 时，v = −0.1 和 +0.1 两点的标准化残差约为 −3.7 和 +4.0（v = 0.25 处也有约 −2.8）；Matérn-1/2 的全部在 ±1 以内。
    • 按边际似然同时选 ℓ 和 σn（σf 固定为实验的 0.6），平方指数核会把 σn 估成约 0.15 N·m（实验注脚里的传感器噪声是 0.03 N·m），ℓ 约 0.78，零速附近的覆盖率只剩约 10%。实验里的“按边际似然选 ℓ”只选 ℓ、σn 取滑块值：保持默认的 0.05 时它选出 ℓ ≈ 0.2，覆盖率约 60%；在“更多参数”里先把观测噪声调到 0.15 再按，就得到上面这组结果（ℓ 落在滑块能取到的 0.79）。调超参数，救不回选错的核族。
    • Squared-exponential kernel, ℓ = 0.6: coverage near zero speed is about 5%. Switch only the kernel, to Matérn-1/2: about 97.5%.
    • Leave-one-out was computed offline from the experiment’s 12 default data points (the experiment has no button for it). With the squared-exponential kernel at ℓ = 0.3, the standardized residuals at v = −0.1 and +0.1 are about −3.7 and +4.0 (and about −2.8 at v = 0.25); with Matérn-1/2, all of them are within ±1.
    • Fit ℓ and σn together by marginal likelihood (σf held at the experiment’s 0.6) and the squared-exponential kernel sets σn to about 0.15 N·m (the experiment’s footnote gives 0.03 N·m of sensor noise) and ℓ to about 0.78, while coverage near zero speed drops to about 10%. The experiment’s “Fit ℓ by marginal likelihood” fits ℓ only, taking σn from its slider: at the default 0.05 it picks ℓ ≈ 0.2 and covers about 60%; set the observation noise to 0.15 under “More parameters” first and the button reproduces the numbers above (ℓ lands on 0.79, the nearest value the slider can take). Tuning hyperparameters cannot rescue the wrong kernel family.

    一句话Takeaway

    学习最稳妥的位置是“物理打底、只学残差、做成前馈、超出训练范围就退回”；它补充模型，而不是取代模型。

    The safest place for learning: physics underneath, learn only the residual, apply it as feedforward, and fall back when you leave the training range. It supplements the model; it doesn’t replace it.

    下一个问题：可到这里，控制律仍然是人写的。如果目标本身——在碎石路上走稳、把手里的积木翻个面——就写不成一条控制律呢？Next question: but the control law is still written by hand. What if the goal itself — walk steadily over gravel, flip a block in the hand — can’t be written as a control law?

    延伸阅读Further reading

    1. Nguyen-Tuong, D., & Peters, J. (2011). Model learning for robot control: A survey. Cognitive Processing, 12(4), 319–340. doi:10.1007/s10339-011-0404-1

      从这里开始：学模型的几种架构（正模型、逆模型等）、各自适用的学习方法、实时在线学习，再加几个案例，机器人“学模型”的全景图。

      Start here: model-learning architectures (forward, inverse and more), the learning methods each one calls for, real-time online learning, and a set of case studies — the map of model learning for robots.

    2. Rasmussen, C. E., & Williams, C. K. I. (2006). Gaussian Processes for Machine Learning. MIT Press. doi:10.7551/mitpress/3206.001.0001

      第 2 章（回归）、第 4 章（核函数，含 Matérn 族）、第 5 章（边际似然与交叉验证选模型）正好对应本节的三步；作者网站提供免费电子版。

      Chapters 2 (regression), 4 (covariance functions, including the Matérn family) and 5 (model selection by marginal likelihood and cross-validation) map onto this section’s three steps; the authors host a free electronic edition.

    3. Nguyen-Tuong, D., & Peters, J. (2010). Using model knowledge for learning inverse dynamics. Proc. IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA), 2677–2682. doi:10.1109/ROBOT.2010.5509858

      把刚体动力学模型当作先验知识做半参数回归，学得更快、泛化更好——本节实验里“以物理模型为先验均值”的原型。

      Uses the rigid-body model as prior knowledge in semiparametric regression, for faster learning and better generalization — the prototype of this section’s “physics model as the prior mean”.

    4. Armstrong-Hélouvry, B., Dupont, P., & Canudas de Wit, C. (1994). A survey of models, analysis tools and compensation methods for the control of machines with friction. Automatica, 30(7), 1083–1138. doi:10.1016/0005-1098(94)90209-7; Canudas de Wit, C., Olsson, H., Åström, K. J., & Lischinsky, P. (1995). A new model for control of systems with friction. IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control, 40(3), 419–425. doi:10.1109/9.376053

      前者是摩擦建模与补偿的权威综述（附约 280 篇文献），后者提出 LuGre 动态摩擦模型：先把摩擦的物理弄清楚，再决定哪一块留给数据。

      The first is the standard survey of friction modeling and compensation (with a bibliography of 280 papers); the second introduces the LuGre dynamic friction model. Understand the physics of friction first, then decide what to leave to data.

    5. Hewing, L., Kabzan, J., & Zeilinger, M. N. (2020). Cautious model predictive control using Gaussian process regression. IEEE Transactions on Control Systems Technology, 28(6), 2736–2743. doi:10.1109/TCST.2019.2949757

      名义模型加 GP 残差放进 MPC，用 GP 的方差构造机会约束（“谨慎控制”），并在 20 ms 采样的遥控赛车上实测：把“写出不知道”真正用进控制器。
